name: Probability Falsification
description: The user will have the ability to manipulate probability by falsifying certain information. The user can shroud factors and variables that affect the likely end results of events in order to create a new probability. They can also use it make people miscalculate their plans and strategies. The user can create false factors and information in order to create an event that is not real. In short, the user can create an illusion through probability.
summary: The ability to hide or create false information, factor, or variables that affects probability..
strengths: Manipulate probability through removed or falsified factors
Create illusion
weaknesses: Probability manipulators/ perceivers could be able to see through this ability.

name: Memory Sword
description: With this ability you can access the tactical skills of anyone who previously wielded the sword.
summary: The ability to Wield a sword and access the tactical knowledge and sword skills of previous wielders.
strengths: Access the skills of previous users.
Gain tactical skills and knowledge you might not possess.
Can instantianiously learn new skills.
weaknesses: Is useless if you are the first user.
Only works with swords.
Can grant useless ineffective and outdated tactical knowledge.

name: Spectral Death Weapons
description: With this power, you can summon any weapon. The weapons will be colored black and red, and will be made out of a unique material with the essence of death. You can also choose to imbue your weapons with the Death Mark. This means that the weapons have an aura of death - if they harm someone, the victim will have an essence of death that surrounds their soul.  This means that the victim cannot die, and will be locked permanently in a prison inside their mind, unable to perceive reality.
summary: The ability to summon any weapon from a plane of death.
strengths: You become a powerful warrior.
You instinctively have great skill with the weapons you summon.
weaknesses: If you injure yourself with your weapons, you will bestowed with the Death Mark yourself.

name: Imaginative Causality
description: The user is able imagine an action and this ability makes the effects happen in real life. For example, the user needs to karate chop a block of wood. The user first imagine chopping the wood in two(the cause), and his ability makes the wood in real life to be actually cut in half (the effect). The user and everything effected by this power is placed in the exact positions of how things would be like after the imagined action.
summary: The ability to imagine any action in one's mind in order to create the effects in the real world.
strengths: Complete any action and subsequent effecst by thinking it.
If you imagine traveling to a different location, you will be teleported there.
Very effective in conjunction with strategies.
weaknesses: If you imagine yourself being hurt, you will be. (If you don't master it. )
If the user imagines an action that seems impossible, the user will suffer.

name: Grandmaster Of All
description: Chess, competitive sports, martial arts, mathematics, painting, music - you name it. This power gives you all the required knowledge, experience, mental and physical aptitudes to be extremely skilled at everything. You will gain a Grandmaster level for each of these skills, which would be anywhere between the 1st to 10th current best in the world. You can improve each skill even more with practice, but without practice it will eventually revert to the state when you first gained it.
summary: The ability to be extremely, superbly talented at everything.
strengths: Your skills will never deteriorate beyond the level you gained them at.
Top-notch physical capabilities and obviously superhuman mental capacities.
Improved physical appearance. Hey, you can be at least the 10th best model in the world!
weaknesses: You're not necessarily the best in the world for any skill (although you're pretty darn close)
People may begin to question how you gained all these abilities if you show too many of them.
Unless you have other powers that change this, you still age at a normal rate.

name: Storage
description: With this power you can turn any object into a storage container for any skill, power, talent, memories, or knowledge, even personality trait/defect, or mental disorders. Whoever possesses the storage object has access to any and all things stored inside it. Which means potentially someone use a power stored inside like green lantern ring, or be hindered by a Obsessive compulsive disorder, or even haunted by someone's memories of torture and abuse. The object can be used to store for many people
summary: The ability to store info, powers, skills, mental defects, personality traits, memories or talents in objects
strengths: Store powers, and skills in any object.
Hace access to powers you don't possess, use other people's knowledge and experiance to succeed.
Get of Defects/traits, memories or Mental diseases you don't want.
weaknesses: If you find an object that has memories of being tortured, has a mental disease.
If you use the object so often you forget it's not your power or skills, then lose it.
Some memories or mental disease might stick with you forever.

name: Theory Of Relativity
description: You are able to control gravity; you may increase it or decrease it. For example, you may pin targets to the ground, or levitate objects. Or else, you may create your own gravity, and make flying objects orbit around you. You may use this as a form of psychokinesis, pulling and pushing targets.
summary: The ability to manipulate gravity and forces.
strengths: There is no limit to the area that you cast your power upon.
If you try hard enough, you may lift extremely heavy objects such as cars with lack of gravity.
You can activate this power to you yourself, thus being able to fly.
weaknesses: It requires a lot of skill to actually perform this skill. Even through practicing, you can mess up.
Your weakness is electricity or radar.
You may not increase gravity and decrease it at the same time, even if the targets are different.

name: Psychic Powers
description: Every day when you wake up, you'll have a psychic power. This psychic power will change every day. You can only have one psychic power each day. These psychic powers include but are not limited to: psychokinesis/telekinesis, telepathy, clairvoyance, levitation, astral projection, precognition, ect. because there are only so many psychic powers, the you will eventually re-attain psychic powers that you have already had before.
summary: The ability to have a different psychic power every day
strengths: New psychic power every day
weaknesses: Allowed only one psychic power a day

name: Natural Talent Power
description: With this power you can increase your natural talents to the point where they become super powers. For instance if your natural talent is singing you will become the best singer ever and your singing will be hypnotic. If your natural talent is baking you will make the best breads and other baked goods ever and they will be able to cure diseases. If your natural talent is writing you will become the best writer ever and whatever you write will become true.
summary: The ability to increase your natural talents
strengths: You can increase your natural talents to the point where they become super powers
weaknesses: You cannot increase the natural talents of others

name: Thought Weaponary
description: Create and manifest all types of solid/normal weapons by use of mental energy. Any weapon you create can have any effects you want, evben ones that are fictional (within boundaries).
summary: The ability to manifest various types of weapons through your imagination.
strengths: Through your imagination you'll able to create and manifest any weapon imaginable.
The weapon you create can have a number of special attacks you choose
weaknesses: You must focus for your weapons to manifest from your imagination/mind.
Manifesting any weapon from your mind can tire you out.
Manifesting too many weapons in a short amount of time will result in a coma or death.

name: Library
description: With this power it will be as if you've read every single book ever written be it a picture book, comic book, novel, encyclopedia, bible etc. You will be able to quote and understand any book without ever even seeing it. You can also read the books in your mind.
summary: The ability to know the contents of every single book ever written
strengths: You have every book ever written in your mind
You can read books in your mind
You don't ever even have to see the book
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Quantakinesis
description: One with this ability can psychically manipulate the quantity of nearly anything they encounter. Adding grows matter in size, or fuses different bodies of matter together. Subtracting shrinks matter in size,, or separates matter into different bodies. Multiplying generates numerous copies of whole bodies of matter. Dividing causes matter to split into smaller copies. One can also use fractions, integers, squares/cubes, roots, absolute value, equations, inequalities, logarithms, etc.
summary: The ability to psychically manipulate numbers and quantities
strengths: Change how much of anything you have (infinite food, flawless counterfeiting, etc. )
Perfect combo of Size Shifting, Replication, Fusion and Fission, if used on self
Affect matter with fractions, squares/cubes, roots, logarithms, matrices, equations, roots,etc.
weaknesses: Doesn't improve your actual math skills, or control the outcomes to math problems...
Cannot affect space or time until developed (NCN)
Cannot reduce matter to zero, or divide by zero until developed (NCN)

name: Ability Access
description: The holder innately knows about all available abilities of any kind, can know everything about them, can choose to acquire them, from something like a Universal Database. No Omni powers, limit is ten per day. The user cannot have powers forcefully added and also comes with enhanced memory to remember powers.
summary: The ability to gain abilities from a mental link.
strengths: Can add powers freely to yourself (ten per day)
Alternative to god level abilities
You choose powers (cannot be forced to take self destruction powers)
weaknesses: Only ten daily
No god level abilities

name: Gravity Manipulation
description: A Gravity Manipulator can use their mastery of gravity for many effects. They can make an object so heavy it collapses under its own weight, or so light it floats. They can cause artificial gravity on walls or ceilings, make a ring of supergravity around themselves that serves as a shield, and with practice, bend light around an object making it invisible. They can even make a single mote of dust colapse and make a black hole, but it usually collapses after five minutes, and knocks them out.
summary: The ability to mentally control gravitational fields
strengths: Very versatile
Impressive to watch
There is nothing you cannot affect
weaknesses: Mainly fueled by emotion, but does take concentration
Crushing things that shouldn't be crushed
Black hole can get a bit out of control

name: Power Of Imagination
description:
A simple (but also complex) power that enables the user to turn their imaginations into reality. Your limit is your own imagination and subconscious, because if you think that something is impossible, it will be impossible to you. 
Can also be used to create imaginary creatures and realms that you can control, but this is limited by your logic.
This power could be a gift or a curse depending on the user's own mind and imagination. If you're a dreamer, then this power is absolutely for you.
summary: The ability to turn your imagination into reality
strengths: Can create imaginary friends and realms
Can create new powers by using power
Optimists and daydreamers will find this REALLY useful
weaknesses: People might think that you're crazy if you talk to your imaginary friends
Logical people might not be able to do a lot of things
You can't do anything that you think is impossible

name: Obedience Manipulation
description: This ability can make anything obey to the user even non-living things. The user can make things obey to anything else if they want. This ability can make anything disobedient as well. This could cause anarchies in kingdoms. The effects only go away if the user is not mentally focusing on the victim.
summary: The ability to make anything obey or disobey anything eles.
strengths: Absolute control
weaknesses: Effects go away if the user is not mentally focusing on the victim.

name: Telekinesis Via Sight
description: Normal telekinesis can work eventhough you cannot see the object you want. For example, if you left you cup behind you you can use telekinesis to bring it to you. However, with this power you must be able to see you cup or the object you want, then only will the user be able to use this power. Anything in the user's field of vision can be moved telekinetically. If the user were to move, resulting in the object he or she is currently levitating to go out of sight, he or she will drop the object.
summary: The ability to move thing with their mind as long as they can see it or have eye contact with it
strengths: Can move things with your mind
Dont need to get your hands dirty
Easily defeat opponents by just looking at them
weaknesses: If you are blinded even temporarily your powers will stop working
Cant use this power in very dark places

name: Telepathic Suggestion
description: You can have anyone do whatever you want. Or anything, that is, which has life. You have to picture that person doing what you want them to do, which sends them a mental suggestion of the task to them in their mind. This has a 0. 03% chance of failing.
summary: The ability to make other humans or animals do what you want by thinking of it.
strengths: Everyone is at your command.
Could suggest people into giving you what you desire.
Have animals accompany you, including dangerous predators.
weaknesses: It fails 0. 03% of the time.. Could get hurt while trying to tame animals, etc.
You have to get a picture in your head of the suggestion's result for it to work.
Much more difficult if you do not have eye-contact with the person / target.

name: Physics Application
description: This power allows you to create your very own laws of physics and apply them to yourself or others. You can gain an edge in battle or make a law that gets more work done for less effort. These laws can replace existing ones or coexist with them and you can make as many as you want. You have a perfect memory of all the laws you created and once one law is made you can instantly recreate it at another time. However the laws can not interfere with the workings of superhuman abilities.
summary: The ability to create your own laws of physics to apply to yourself or others.
strengths: Make up your own laws of physics.
Can make a law to boost your chancees of winning.
Have an exact memory of laws you created and can recreate them when you wish.
weaknesses: At first you can only make laws similar to existing ones.
You cant do more powerful laws in the beginning.
Thinking of new physical laws could take a while.

name: Metal Kinesis
description: You can control any metal by making it bend, twist, break, float, slide, etc without even touching it! You can also turn objects into metal, but this effect only lasts 24 hours.
summary: The ability to control metal and turn any object into any metal.
strengths: You can control any piece of metal with your mind.
Stop your enemies by turning them into metal.
You can stop metal bullets and secretly steal metal coins.
weaknesses: When you turn something into metal, it lasts only 24 hours.

name: Tychokinesis
description: This ability is very powerful, because of all the applications. First off, it's more controlled by your subconscious mind then your conscious. It will affect things you're subconsciously thinking about, like paying the rent. But after you gain more control over it, you can become very powerful. Not only can you control chance short-term, but long-term as well. For example, you can warp chance so that everyone who lives in a certain house will constantly be losing their car keys.
summary: The ability to manipulate probability and chance
strengths: You can control probability and chance
You can be very powerful
Long-term warps are possible(without constantly focusing on them)
weaknesses: At first, your subconscious mind is more in control then your conscious.
The larger the warp, the more it takes out of you

name: Phasing
description: People with phasing don't respect doors. Or walls. Or floors, or ceilings, or cars, or buildings, because they don't have to. At the slightest thought, they become immaterial, and objects pass right through them without stopping. They keep from sinking into the ground by a type of electron repulsion.
summary: The ability to pass through solid objects
strengths: Ultimate thief
Can ignore hallways and go straight to your room
Freak people out
weaknesses: No offensive powers
Unable to phase more than twice your own mass
EMPs can disrupt electron repulsion

name: Dream Realization
description: If you can DREAM it, you can DO it! UGH, so cheesy! But I digress. If you are dreaming and you find yourself doing something you can't normally do, if you remember it when you wake up, then you can do it. This can potentially make you very powerful. Your powers may be as useful as flight or as ridiculous as transforming into a Sailor Moon outfit. This does not apply to objects or events in your dreams, and you can only use powers that you exhibit. You are also incapable of lucid dreaming.
summary: The ability to gain any power that you exhibit in a dream
strengths: Potentially quite powerful
Allows for a unique array of powers that reflect your personality
Much easier to explain your dreams to people
weaknesses: Can only use abilities after you dream them
Does not apply to objects or events
If you only dream in third person you are outta luck

name: Telepathy
description: A person with telepathy can place his thoughts in the heads of others. They also have mind-reading talent and can attack others using only their thoughts.
summary: The ability to communicate mentally with other people
strengths: Can communicate without speaking
Can pick brains for information
Can fight without having to hit anyone
weaknesses: Unable to affect physical world
Can be blocked by other telepaths
Often mistrusted and feared

name: Planetary Empowerment
description: The person with this power , by stating the name of a planet; will gain the different powers each planet has to offer. If you shout Mars (invulnerability), Earth (geokinesis), Jupiter (electrokinesis), Mercury (super speed), Venus (florakinesis), Saturn (psychokinetic powers), Ketu (Umbrakinesis), and finally Rahu (illusions). When the planets are alligned, the power and effectiveness of each power doubles
summary: The ability to be empowered by the planets in our solar system.
strengths: Different sets of power to combat different situations
Huge arsenal to take down the powerhouses
weaknesses: You only can use 9 sets in a day ( 1 set is equivalent to all 9 planets )
Magic is one of your biggest enemies

name: Extrasensory Teleportation
description: This power will instantly sends you to a place based on what you decided to do. Example: A person decided to go to the movies, they'll teleport to the movie theater. A person may be able to teleport anywhere, but it means nothing if they don't where to go. That's what makes this teleportation unique.  With advanced training, the user can stop the teleportation at will.
summary: The ability to teleport based on what your next course of action or decision.
strengths: You won't be late.
With training, stop teleportation or teleport ahead of time
weaknesses: Without training, teleport anytime.

name: Materialization
description: The user is able to turn imaginary thoughts into real matter. Just from imagining them, a person would be able to create an infinite amount of swords, money, or even their own world.
summary: The ability to create matter from imagination alone.
strengths: What you create is 100% just up to your imagination.
There is no limit as to what or how many of something you create.
Your wildest dreams may come true.
weaknesses: Creating something from nothing goes against the laws of nature.
Due to the above, reality will begin destroying whatever you made as soon as it is made.
Even a tiny scratch can destroy your object if you did not imagine that scratch possible beforehand.

name: Psychic Strategy
description: Also known as Quantum Precognition or Stochastic Precognition, this is the ability to perceive all the probable outcomes of a situation in hypertime. The user can also sense which outcome is more likely to come to pass. In addition, if the power develops, you can sense how to alter situations to affect the future, perceive the ultimate conclusion of a decision you make (called Butterfly Effect Observation), or avoid telepathy by pretending that the probabilities you perceive are your thoughts.
summary: The ability to perceive all probable outcomes of a situation, and otherwise perceive probability
strengths: Perceive all probable outcomes of a situation (and which one is most likely)
Perceive the ultimate conclusion of a decision (and how to alter situations to affect outcomes)
Probability/Chance/Luck-based MythPowers enhance this power greatly
weaknesses: Unpredictability (unless you have a Probability/Chance/Luck-based MythPower)
The strongest sense manipulators can distort the psychic perception
Sometimes the perception isn't in hypertime (immoblilzing you like Precognition til the vision ends)

name: Claircognizance
description: Claircognizance is one of the most powerful abilities. With this ability, you can gain knowledge without ever experiencing an event that could have given you that knowledge. Interestingly, when actively using this ability, you also can find something that has not happened, and you can also get another evolved human's abilities. You can also get these abilities in a random way or passive way. You also can find about location, history, person's characteristic, and everything that you want to know.
summary: The ability to acquire knowledge without ever experiencing an event that could have given you that knowledge
strengths: You can become a great people for country or world
You can be a psychic for the greater good
You can be the most powerful heroes in this universe
weaknesses: You can be the most powerful villain in this universe
You can get information that you don't want to know in a passive way or random way
Many people who will come to you for bad or good reason cause they think you're dangerous

name: Empathic Telekinesis
description: With empathic telekinesis, a person can move things with their mind by creating links to others through empathy. The powers can then be used by that person to help and protect other people they choose. It has the same properties and versatility as vector telekinesis.
summary: The ability to gain powerful telekinetic abilities through empathic connections with others
strengths: Can only be used by good people
Is extremely powerful
Can be learned and controlled in a very short amount of time
weaknesses: Confused or negative emotions negate the power

name: Transmechanization
description: "Scrap" is another word for junk, though in this case it is useable and not useless. You can transmechanize an old car into a massive cannon or even a pile of wooden planks mixed with old engine parts into a speed boat. You can also turn a complex machine into another complex machine (example already used with the old car). However, there's no guarantee the machine will work properly (refrigerator to jetplane), and not EVERYTHING is "scrap".
summary: The ability to turn "scrap" into a machine or turn a machine into a different type of machine using your mind.
strengths: Can create cool machines from just about anything
Can transmechanize the machine, even if the machine is being used
No blueprints, which means no one can steal your creation.
weaknesses: Must be formed from multiple objects, or one complex object (can't make cannon out of just one can)
Does not work on stones, bricks, or organic material (even if decayed or dead), except for wood.
No guarantee it will work right (example: turning a refrigerator into a jetplane)

name: Virtuoso Reaction
description: Say that you caused a fire and you don't know how to put it out. With this power, your brain will begin to calculate the thoughts and ideas on how to put out the fire. Then, your body will follow your brain's lead in which it would put out the fire skillfully. This ability doesn't last long; once the situation is over, you will lose the knowledge that you gained.
summary: The ability to respond to any situation with advanced skills and knowledge of an expert.
strengths: Gain knowledge.
Be ready for anything.
weaknesses: You will lose the knowledge after the situation is over.

name: Data Realization
description: Using the DNA of creation, you have the ability to create objects, feelings, people and many other things out of nothing. Also, it is possible to create and destroy the world in the blink of an eye. Most of the powers are being controlled by your own emotions, and mostly, the bearer is unaware of the power.
summary: The ability to create objects/events from nothingness
strengths: Be able to have everything you want
Be able to recreate what you do not like
Be able to make your own world at your own liking
weaknesses: When under emotional pressure, the power could get the better of you
You might be unaware of this power

name: Nonlinear Time Perception
description: You can see the past, events that have already happened, you could solve all history's unanswered questions or have the greatest history textbook memory there is! You can also see the present, no change there. But most of all you can see the future, and change or perform different actions to shape the future as you wish. With training and concentration you can look into a certain person's or object's past or future.
summary: The ability to see past, present and future at any given time.
strengths: See the past and everything in it.
Shape the future to your will with your actions.
Helpful for people with bad memories.
weaknesses: You cannot change the past.
Shaping the future can have consequences. Some small, some dire.
You WILL see how your loved ones die.

name: Psionic Tactility
description: This ability allows you to control others through physical contact, but unlike tactile hypnosis, you can use telepathy instead of your voice. You can also control someone's thoughts, memories, and emotions, read their minds and memories, and also control their physical actions.
summary: The ability to read & control the minds of others you touch
strengths: A very versatile form of mind control
Is strong enough to override most healing powers except for regeneration
Psychics will find this a very useful ability
weaknesses: Someone with regenerative powers is immune to this ability
Cannot be used against empaths
May cause painful static feedback if someone is strong enough to resist telepathy

name: Morph
description: You have the ability to change any type of object into anything you want when touched. With this ability, you can't morph any living creature. This ability is difficult to master considering it is tied to your emotions and mind (you need to be at peace with yourself before truely mastering it).
summary: The ability to change anything when touched
strengths: Once mastered, your power will become invincible
Can get you out of any situation or trap
Can disguise your physical appearances
weaknesses: Has no effect on living things
Is difficult to master
Your emotions can ruin your powers

name: Mind Writer
description: With this power, you can see into the minds of those around you, alter their memories, erase or even wipe them clean and make your own in their head. It's not some silly 'they don't know ANYTHING' power, they still retain the basic functions, knowledge and human interaction, but their knowledge of who they are, who their family is, likes and dislike can be meddled with. Note it may take you some time to reform a person from scratch. You can also take their knowledge.
summary: The ability to alter, implant fake memories or erase someone's mind all together and reform it
strengths: Alter people to follow you fanatically, no special memory needed, it will simply be in their nature
Gain knowledge from your enemies and turn them into slobbering fools
Remove traumatizing memories from victims
weaknesses: Must be within 50 meters of the person. Time stops as you use it. And you must see them
Might make a mistake. You can erase their memory multiple times, but might erase something important
Must plan ahead meticulously to know what will be in an altered memory

name: Memory Wipe
description: You can help people be at peace by wiping their mind of their worst most horrific memories by letting those memories into your mind. You may even change villains into good people this way but you'll have their memories.
summary: The ability to take someone's worst memories from them to give peace.
strengths: Helping people be at peace
Potentially reforming criminals if their past horrors male them become criminals.
weaknesses: You'll have to live memories of being, shot stabbed, raped, and any other number of horrible acts do
Pain from all these memories is real in your mind forever.
You'll spend most most you free time and money on Psychiatrists. Or kill yourself.

name: Reality Key
description: This power gives you the key to reality, a device so complex it doesnt have a shape but instead takes the form your mind imagines for it. The device is so complex that it will never be fully understood. The key becomes linked to the user's soul and commands are entered depending on what form the key takes, though it is unknown what the command may do. Since the key is linked to the user's soul, the key can respond to basic instructions, but stray thoughts can change the outcome.
summary: The ability to own the key to reality that allows you to do nearly anything.
strengths: Nearly anything is possible.
May be able to cause things that break the laws of reality.
So complex that other powers cannot affect the key.
weaknesses: Will never be able to fully understand how to use the key.
Random effects of the key may be undesirable.
May lose patience before learning a command you require.

name: Unbreakable Spirit
description: While many seek to dominate and break the will of others through evil, unspeakable methods, they will find you undefeatable. With this power, all your emotions still exist but can never defeat you. Nothing can control your mind or drive you insane. You can hold the One Ring in your hand for years without budging a finger. You'd laugh at Ctulhu and poke his tentacles with a stick. And the cruellest, most vile forms of torture known to man wouldn't draw so much as a whisper from your lips.
summary: The ability to have such a strong will that your mind and emotions can never be broken or manipulated
strengths: Ever heard of Batman? Pssh. Guy's a wuss.
Imagine the distilled blood of several hundred thousand Spartans flowing through your veins.
Best for last: Infinite stimulus threshold. The worst chemicals, pain, or pleasures can't break you.
weaknesses: ABSOLUTELY NOTHING.

name: Speed Absorption
description: You can take a speeding bullet for example and turn it around and shoot it at your enemy.
summary: The ability to stop any motion coming at you with your mind and reverse it.
strengths: You can take away any speed of an object and turn it around
You can always hurt your enemy because you can backfire anything back at them
weaknesses: NONE

name: 100 Percent Brain Efficiency
description: Humans generally use only 10% brain capacity or maybe less, and within the 10 percent it is possible for errors to occur. With this power, the user can use the maximum amount of brain capacity allowed without intruding on the subconscious functions like breathing. The user also has no errors in thought, they will not freeze up when thinking about things. The user can exhibit near clairvoyance due to being able to perceive more things about their environment in shorter time. Does not grant ESP.
summary: The ability to use your brain with 100 percent efficiency
strengths: Can process information faster and retain it
Immune to error in the mind-includes illusions and mind control can also tell if mind is being read
Quick prediction and analysis-also allows user to dodge bullets if the body is fast enough
weaknesses: Contrary to popular belief, does not give you psychic powers
A great brain does not equal a great body
You will find regular things not challenging enough

name: Stealth Mode
description: With this power, your aura dampens down and becomes harder to sense. Also, any sound you make is slightly muted and harder to detect. Your smell also becomes more similar to that of the environment's and your footsteps are lighter than normal, leaving footprints that are harder to see. Your mind also becomes less likely to be found by a mind reader/detector.
summary: The ability to become more stealthy in multiple ways
strengths: Harder to detect.
Can be underestimated in a fight, due to the 'weak' aura.
weaknesses: Doesn't do anything about visibility.
Just lowers the possible ways to detected, doesn't eliminate them.

name: Mending Minds
description: You can hack into people's mind and change their mind and tempt them to do other things while you're not completely controlling them.
summary: The ability to make people do stuff without completely controlling them.
strengths: You can make your crush have a crush on you.
You can make your mom get you whatever you want!
You can make your enemies hurt themselves.
weaknesses: No bad things

name: Infinite Knowledge
description: Simply means that you know everything. Anything anyone on Earth learns or discovers is instantly added to your knowledge bank. You leave no questions unanswered. The future and such are still a mystery to you and other people's histories and personalities are not necessarily included, but essentially, everything known by man is known by you.
summary: The ability to possess the full spectrum of human knowledge.
strengths: Know everything.
Ace tests like a madman
Never surprised by anything you learn

You might find memories you wish you hadn't

name: Tactile Power Counteraction
description: This is an extremely powerful form of immunity. A person can match, and thus nullify, any offensive power an enemy uses against them, such as pyrokinesis. If the enemy uses it on you, the moment you touch them, you will absorb the part of that person's power which grants them immunity, and thus be immune yourself.
summary: The ability to build immunity to an attack by absorbing the enemy's power through physical contact
strengths: Once you absorb a person's power immunity, it is permanent!
Catch a foe off guard by faking your injury or death!
They cannot feel the absorption, and skin-to-skin contact isn't always necessary.
weaknesses: This is a 'tactile' ability: You ALWAYS need to physically touch your opponent to activate it

name: Telepsychic Wings
description: You can manifest telekinetic razor-sharp wings from your back composed of pure mental energy which spans about sixteen feet from wingtip to wingtip at its highest intensity. You can fly anywhere undetected too, very difficult to track, even by very powerful telepaths. Those wings can fire Psychic flechettes which are able to stun or kill.
summary: The ability to sprout telekinetic razor-sharp wings of pure mental energy.
strengths: You might become a divine psychic.
weaknesses: Those wings will eventually wear off in about 576 hours.

name: Tactile Vector Telekinesis
description: This form of telekinesis is extremely rare. You can control objects with telekinetic vectors that are first created by physical contact with the object. It's vastly useful in the hands of experts, and connections between the mind and a desired object take no more than three seconds. There's an unlimited time frame of control, and you can maintain or terminate it at will. A side effect is pale amber fire seen around objects moving at high speed due to molecular control, a basis for this power.
summary: The ability to create psychic energy appendages to control objects, by first touching that object
strengths: Move huge objects of immense weight with ease, and fly by riding long projectiles like snowboards!!
You cannot be harmed by the psionic fire created at advanced control levels
Despite being a 'tactile' ability, this form is as powerful as Jean Grey's telekinesis!!
weaknesses: Takes time to learn to control
A very dangerous power in the wrong hands!
Despite limitless power time, you always need to touch an object before it can be controlled

name: Depth Perspective Telekinesis
description: Makes depth perception your weapon. If a car is far enough away to look 2 inches long, you can reach out and manipulate the car as if it was shrunk to 2 inches. It extends to held objects, so if you hold a newspaper and make hitting motions at a person who looks one inch tall, the effects work accordingly.
summary: The ability to psionically manipulate objects as if they were the size depth perception makes them look.
strengths: The farther away from the target, the more powerful it is.
Very destructive.
weaknesses: VERY DESTRUCTIVE!

name: Mental Escape
description: With this power, you can easily escape from any prison with only your imagination. If you are in handcuffs or trapped on an island surrounded by sharks, all you have to do is imagine yourself escaping and you will be free.
summary: The ability to escape from anything by imagining.
strengths: Get out of jail everytime.
Bad guys can never capture you.
Get out of all boring conferences.
weaknesses: Won't help you fight.
Won't work if you can't imagine escaping.

name: Psychometric Terrakinesis
description: This form of terrakinesis is very rare. A person can control any form of earth that they have previously worked on, as when farming. They gain total control of that section of earth, and their psychic link to it can be maintained or terminated at will.
summary: The ability to control earthen minerals you have had previous contact with
strengths: Psychometric connections make this an extremely powerful form of terrakinesis!
You can extract minerals to use for healing, weaponry, and even artistry!
Is very easy to control once it is mastered
weaknesses: Use for weapons and artistry take sufficient practice
If you can't recall memories, you could easily lose control

name: Magnetism
description: Magnetism is a universal force keyed to nickel, iron and cobalt. A person with Magnetism can repulse, levitate, attract, and manipulate these metals using only their mind. They can also repel their body iron from the Earth's core and float, although they cannot fly.
summary: The ability to manipulate magnetic fields
strengths: Best bank robber ever
These metals are fairly common
Limited only by will
weaknesses: Useless without metal
Weakened by EMPs
Limited control over less magnetic elements

name: Head Rushed
description: You want to learn about something, you power activates and the information about it rushes into your head so fast you literal convulse. All information no matter how closely or vaguely connected it be to your targeted topic will be in your mind permanently.
summary: The ability to instantly learn everything about any one thing by simply wanting to learn about it.
strengths: Learn about anything you need to know.
weaknesses: The rush of information makes your entire body convulse uncontrolably until you've learned it
You could become addicted to learning, thus your mind will eventually rip itself apart.
You cant turn it off ever, no matter how many times you want to know how it works you wont learn it.

name: Light/Dark Energy
description: You can only use light energy when exposed to light and dark energy when exposed to the dark. Both energies can be used to blast energy and/or create force-fields of energy. Light energy can be used to travel as/with light, fuse with light, inflict positive emotions/thoughts, and generate heat. Dark energy can be used to travel as/with darkness, fuse with the dark, inflict negative emotions/thoughts, and generate cold. Both energies can be used as explosives. Power is greatest during eclipse.
summary: The ability to manipulate light/dark energy
strengths: Manipulate light energy when exposed to light
Manipulate dark energy when exposed to the dark
Manipulate dark and light energy during eclipse
weaknesses: Cannot manipulate dark energy unless exposed to the dark
Cannot manipulate light energy unless exposed to the light
Eclipse isn't very long

name: Sharingan
description: You don't need to worry about forgetting anything if you have your Sharingan on! Also known as the "Mirror Wheel Eye", the Sharingan can copy anything, as long as you don't need a specific genetic structure for it. You can also perform hypnosis. But be warned, your Sharingan is nearly useless under any condition that reduces visibility. Also, if you want the Mangekyou Sharingan, you must kill your best friend. And if you want the Eternal Mangekyou Sharingan, you must take the eyes of yo brother.
summary: The ability to copy and memorize anything that does not require another person's genetic structure
strengths: Learn, and remember, anything you want!
Creep out your enemies!
weaknesses: Anything that blinds you makes the Sharingan useless
To get the Mangekyou Sharingan, you must kill your best friend
To get the Eternal Mangekyou Sharingan, you must take the eyes of a brother w/ a Mangekyou Sharingan

name: Superhuman Intelligence
description: With this ability, your intelligence, creativity and attention span are far above ordinary genius level.  You can assess, analyze, synthesize, deduce and solve nearly any problem with lightning speed, accuracy and objectivity. This extends into nearly any field of study one encounters, including social interaction (meaning you realize that people would find an arrogant, know-it-all brainiac to be annoying, and you'll know how to keep humble, despite your intelligence).
summary: The ability to have intelligence far above genius level.
strengths: Use your brainpower to change the world
Solve problems, like cancer or this morning's Sudoku
Write killer rap song lyrics
weaknesses: The simple things in life may not feel fun or funny to you--you'll probably see them coming
People constantly hounding you for answers
People may get jealous of you and try to do you harm

name: Dream Recreation
description: With this power you can enter into the world of a dream you previously had allowing you to re-experience the dream world with greater clarity. In addition to having greater clarity, you can stay in the dream longer than you did originally to experience new things. To activate this power simply think of its activation when you sleep and you will enter into a world with a menu of your dreams to choose from. To exist a dream simply wish yourself to wake up. Time in dreams is not equal to real time.
summary: The ability to enter into a dream you have had before.
strengths: Re-experience your favorite dreams.
Do not have to do the same thing you did the first time you dreamed.
Can stay in the dream for as long as you wish.
weaknesses: May not want to exit the dream.
You may not have many good dreams.
Can not experience new dreams while in the world of your old dreams.

name: Telelocation
description: Essentially, the ability to answer any question that starts with the word "where." Once you have a concrete target - the criminal in hiding, the assailant waiting to ambush you, the kid on the milk carton, your TV remote - you can sense where it is. This is not 'tracking' that requires your quarry to have left a physical trail as it moves, but a psychic 'homing device' that tells you where it is right now. Advanced power levels may include the ability to see the location site (clairvoyance.)
summary: The ability to be able to find anything lost, missing, or hidden.
strengths: Track down any loved ones kidnapped or taken hostage.
Be hugely successful as a treasure hunter, or a private investigator
Never lose anything again, ever.
weaknesses: By going straight to a target, you can miss a lot of valuable information about it.
Locate physical items only - you can't ask "Where is the best restaurant in town?"
Must be consciously activated - you don't get alerts that something of interest might be near.

name: Memoripath
description: Similar to Telepathy. When a memoripath comes in contact with a person with a very strong or painful memory(ies), they will experience it mentally. Afterwards, it will feel like their own memory. The more powerful, the more painful for the Memoripath. Memoripaths tend to have great trouble controlling their power, and unless proper mental barriers are put in place, often go insane, not knowing which of their memories are theirs. In addition to this, Memoripaths can alter the memories of others.
summary: The ability to know and control a person's memories.
strengths: Talented at extracting valuable information from others without torture.
Can make entire armies forget why they were fighting, or create false memories.
If used correctly, a potent form of mind control.
weaknesses: Identity confusion often leading to insanity.
Burdened by traumatizing memories that don't belong to them.
If they do go insane, they can create entire reality shifts by altering the memories around them.

name: Mind Warp
description: You can completely change people's minds and make them think whatever you want.
summary: The ability to completely change others' minds.
strengths: Get out of trouble.
Get better grades.
Get the boy/girl of your dreams.
weaknesses: You may lose control over the power.
You may use the power to corrupt people.
If they find out, they may kill you.

name: Extreme Intelligence
description: Extreme Intelligence is the power to take all knowledge around yourself and use it for your own advantage, making the people around you with less to no intelligence. This includes their memories, their way of thinking, their emotions and their general knowledge.
summary: The ability to take the intelligence out of people close by.
strengths: You gain supreme intelligence.
You know the extent of people's knowledge.
You are smater than ever before.
weaknesses: Taking too much intelligence from people can be overwhelming.
As well as affecting your brain's mental patterns.
Can erase all humanly emotions.

name: Nightmare Manipulation
description: This ability allows the user to change a foe's nightmares. You can make them slightly LESS scary, or way MORE scary, but because it's based on fear, it will be scary to some degree (at least creepy). This can even be used to make people exchange nightmares, or to not be able to wake up from their nightmare. This ability cannot induce good dreams AT ALL.
summary: The ability to influence people's nightmares.
strengths: You can tap into a person's worst fear and then manifest it into their dreams.
Change wimpy nightmares into hellacious, unearthly visions from the depths of perdition
Enter an ally's nightmare and help them wake up
weaknesses: Cannot be used to induce dreams
Cannot end a nightmare, unless it's to start another

name: Psychic Counterforce
description: With this power, a person can resist every form of psychic power from telepathy to clairvoyance. For example, someone using telekinesis to hurt another can be stopped, and will suffer injury ranging from nosebleeds to a cerebral hemorrhage if they persist using their ability while being blocked.
summary: The ability to exact a countering effect on psychic abilities
strengths: Become one of the strongest 'super-humans'!
Be safe from psychics
weaknesses: Prolonged or strenuous use of this power results in painful static feedback leading to migraines

name: Person Altering
description: Well you can change one person into one of your own- as long as it's still 'human' and make them think that they're whoever you want them to be, including yourself. For physical changes you must be able to see them and to changes their memories and personalities you must be touching them. It lasts for 1 week one yourself
summary: The ability to change the appearance, memories and personality of a person
strengths: You can turn somebody you hate into whoever you want
You can change yourself into whoever you want
You can get a date with whoever you want
weaknesses: People would notice that someone's gone
You may not like the new people you create
You can't change yourself back for 1 week, which after you automatically change back

name: Telekinetic Touch See
description: This is a version of TK with a very specific use, similar to echolocation but more effective in darkness. The user generates a 90 ft radius field of millions of semi-tangible touch sensors that allow him to perceive all physical objects in range. Unlike echolocation, however, it is silent and can navigate around objects; ergo, if the user is in a warehouse full of boxes and an attacker is hiding behind them, the user can navigate his TK field to search all available areas within range
summary: The ability to telekinetically perceive your immediate surroundings
strengths: Can detect ambushes in close proximity without giving away his position
Can perfectly perceive environment in total darkness
Undetectable to anyone but the user
weaknesses: Enclosures/containers can still evade the sensor field
Powerful telekinesis users and telepaths might sense the field
Only 90' range as a beginner - may be increased with practice/proficiency

name: Bowel Manipulation
description: You can control using ones mind others poop. You can make someone crap there pants at any force. You can also control your own.
summary: The ability to Control ones own and others bowel.
strengths: You can make others crap there pants.
You can embarass enemies.
You use your mind so no one will no who did it.
weaknesses: The poop will have a strong smell.
Many find this power gross.
Regular poops will intense.

name: Damage Control
description: With this power, one creates a field the size of 100 meters where the amount of damage inflicted is controlled. Any type of damage: cellular, blunt, slash, pierce, crushing force, psychic, psychological, dimensional, spiritual, even damage to the ego.
summary: The ability to control damage inflicted and received
strengths: By setting damage to 0% everyone around you is invincible to all types of damage
By setting damage to higher than 100% all people will have critical hits
Your power can work at the cellular level through concentration
weaknesses: You cannot heal injuries or disease, you can only delay it
If someone cannot breathe, they will still die
The effects of the field also apply to you

name: Levitation
description: Indian gurus have been doing it for thousands of years, but never on this scale. Levitation enables the user to make objects as much as half a ton lighter than air, thus making them float. The objects can then be lifted as easily as balloons. They can also make themselves float. However, there is no thrust that comes with this; the objects will drift aimlessly unless acted on by an outside force. Also, prolonged usage causes intense migraines.
summary: The ability to make yourself and other objects float
strengths: Can levitate up to 1000 pounds
Move normally heavy objects
Float above normal life or danger
weaknesses: Objects levitated will drift unless pushed in a direction
Requires some active focus
Prolonged usage causes intense migraines

name: Skill Mimicry
description: It takes all sorts of skills to make a society run. A Skill Mimic can tap into that. By merely standing near a person, they can take on their applied skills: surgery, martial arts, plumbing, etc. This has a range of 2 football fields and is limited to applied skills--no theory or mental skill.
summary: The ability to take on the skills of the people around you
strengths: Able to take on any applied skill
Being surrounded by skilled people
Martial arts, plumbing, archery, etc.
weaknesses: 2 football field range
Limited to applied skills
Being surrounded by unskilled people

name: What If
description: Imagine if everything and everyone has been altered in ways you have never imagined. With this power you canLike you can. Change history, control reality etc. by saying the phrase "What If". You'll get mental records of the new situation and all the consequences (a la the movie Butterfly Effect), and you can always undo them (like restore points).
summary: The ability to change reality and alter history by saying the word What If.
strengths: A great use for saving lives and altering fates
Automatically become aware of the new situation and all the consequences
Can always return to an unaltered reality
weaknesses: Might use it to corrupt the universe.
Can become a ego-megalomaniac.
Reality Anchoring

name: Advanced Omnitrix
description: The Omnitrix is a watch that gives you control over the alien DNA within it. You can transform into any of the aliens with just a thought. You have control over the evolution of the Aliens and can use prehistoric or future versions of the aliens within. Hybrids can also be made by combining any of the aliens DNA. The clothes you wear are transformed into clothes wearable by the aliens.
summary: The ability to have full control over the DNA of 10,000 Aliens.
strengths: Can transform yourself into any of the 10,000 aliens.
Can use prehistoric or future versions of the evolution of the aliens.
Can create hybrids of the aliens within the Omnitrix.
weaknesses: So many aliens that you will not know all the powers that you have.
If the Omnitrix is broken you may be left with the default of only 10 aliens.
You can not add new aliens to the 10,000 within the watch.

name: Reality Is A Story
description: You can shift reality to fit a story. From as basic as "there are werewolves" to as complex and the stories of King Arthur. Keep in mind that changes you do not intend for will occur, such as vampires appearing as well, or your neighbor being a werewolf or magician himself. The roles are either brought into existence or select a random person. However, if you use a specific character name, the person who exists with that name will have a very high chance of being in that role.
summary: The ability to change reality to fit any story.
strengths: Can change reality to suit needs
Can give yourself great power if used correctly.
weaknesses: Reality change is very limited
May end up harming others unintentionally

name: Enhanced Memory
description: Most people remember around 55% of what they read or see. Imagine 100%. Reading a Spanish-English dictionary and becoming fluent, never forgetting an appointment or date, remembering what it was like as a baby...the possibilities are endless.
summary: The ability to possess total recall in your memory
strengths: Never need memory aids
Become fluent in every language
Immune to Memory Manipulation
weaknesses: Still may not understand what is read
Not able to replicate physical events w/o training
May never give yourself a break for mistakes

name: Nightmare Maker
description: Travel into and control dreams, even harm or kill the host.
summary: The ability to travel into dreams and bring someone's greatest fear to life
strengths: Make someone's fears attack them.
Attack someone in their dream.
weaknesses: Nightmares out of control.
Dreams come true, even nightmares.

name: Predictability
description: Its a bit like mind reading without all the personal details. You can know what people are going to say, do and how they will react to situations. You will be able to be very persuasive because they react differently according to what you say.
summary: The ability to know what people are going to do, say and how they will react.
strengths: You can tell when people are lying
Know what to say to people in order to get what you want.
You can help people because you will know what they want easily.
weaknesses: Life can get a bit boring

name: Psionic Wolf
description: Summon a wolf created from the energy of your own mind, which exists in the form of a silvery-black mist shaped like a wolf, with glowing amber eyes. It is immortal and intangible to everyone and everything, except it's creator and master. Communicate telepathically with the wolf, and also sense it empathically. It has phasing, telepathy, clairvoyance, telekinesis, and invisibility, some of which it can pass to it's master if desired. Moonlight strengthens the wolf, and you can merge with it.
summary: The ability to create and control a psionic entity in the form of a wolf
strengths: When merged, the wolf is your companion and protector
Upon merging, the wolf can partially bestow it's own immortality and powers to it's master
The wolf is at your command, but can protect others you choose as well
weaknesses: If your mind is breached by someone with psychic powers, the wolf can be weakened
It's powers and physical abilities can be detected or weakened when your mind is breached
This power only works at night, or during either a full moon or lunar eclipse

name: Fractured Healing
description: This ability is influenced by emotion, making it very unstable. The user can heal injuries at an astounding rate, and also possesses the power to kill.
summary: The ability to heal or kill other living things with a touch.
strengths: Heal near-fatal wounds with ease.
Both healing and offensive capabilities
weaknesses: The ability is touch activated
Negative emotions can cause death if someone is touched.

name: The Memory Will Never Die
description: This power lets someone gain superhuman strength and healing powers from memories of their family and friends. It can be enhanced if you have telepathy, but evil people with psychic powers can weaken this ability, unless the memories are crystal clear to the user, and thus are made indelible.
summary: The ability to gain super strength, speed, stamina and healing powers from memories of your family and friends
strengths: Telepathy used to focus on the memories can exponentially strengthen this ability
Strong memories can make you near-invincible!
A side effect is a heightened memory, and clarity of the senses
weaknesses: Evil psychics can weaken this power, and thus your strength, unless you can fight it

name: Photon Manipulation
description: With the ability to control light, you will have plenty of abilities. Illusions would be the first on the list. Concentrating light into a laser for offence. With enough pressure, you would even be able to add concussive force into your light based attack. The illusions won't be solid however, and any "clone" of yourself or others would not be able to take damage or make sound. With a little imagination, this power can go a long way!
summary: The ability to control all forms of visible light
strengths: Both offensive and Defensive abilities.
Change your appearance
Awesome illusions/mirages
weaknesses: Offensively limited
illusions are just that, illusions

name: Brain Control
description: This ability allows the person to manipulate and control any person that they wish, and with a single thought can "persuade" them to obey and commit their master's will and wish. The more powerful that person is, the more people that person can control.
summary: The ability to manipulate someone's mind
strengths: Control a person
"Never can get your hands dirty."
The more powerful, the more population control
weaknesses: Occasional headache
With more practice, headaches occur more often
Takes a lot of brainpower, too much exhaustion

name: Object Creation
description: Everyone remembers that one time when they wanted a small toy for Christmas-- a doll, a pocketknife, cowboy boots. An Object Creator can make these objects and others like them using their mind. This isn't limited to toys-- grenades, handguns, knives, and all sorts of neat stuff are creatable. There are some catches: the object has to be less than 15 pounds, it takes a massive amount of concentration, and it can't be too complex (no laser guns).
summary: The ability to create small objects with your mind
strengths: Weapons
Toys for Christmas
Decks of cards for long trips
weaknesses: Massive amounts of concentration
Cannot be larger than 15 pounds
Cannot be overly complex

name: Visual Imagination
description: By digging into your brain's visual stimuli, you can create an extremely detailed world in your mind. One analogy of it is like playing your own video game in your head. It's only stable if the user can control their thoughts fairly well. Also, you have to be in a meditation-like state to use this power.
summary: The ability to control what you see.
strengths: Make detailed worlds.
Useful with architecture or house design.
weaknesses: Have to be in a meditation state.
Your thoughts have to be stable.

name: Infinite Memory Palace
description: A memory palace is a mental method typically used by mnemonists and memory champions to organize and easily recall information. While it normally takes a long time to build and sustain in one's mind, this ability gives its user their own personal self-organizing memory palace with an infinite amount of rooms to store any information. With time and practice, the user can even populate each room with made-up or important characters to give more life to their palace and help recall information.
summary: The ability to have a memory palace with infinite rooms, corridors and floors.
strengths: You have Enhanced Memory and each memory palace is different from one person to another.
Protects against memory intruders, as they will have a hard time navigating through the palace.
If this power is stolen, mimicked or negated, stored information will remain in your memory.
weaknesses: If this power is negated or stolen, you'll have a hard time recalling information.
People with extraordinary memory are generally considered as creeps.

name: Jedi Mind Tricks
description: Anybody with this power can fool gullible people into believing what they say. They will repeat what you just said as if it were truth. This can also work if you wave something of value over someone else since they become more susceptible to this power when this happens. This is a weak form of verbal hypnotism.
summary: The ability to fool the weak-minded
strengths: Fool the guards to let you out
Get away from small accidents
The other person is left dazed after you finish using this power
weaknesses: You will probably become a con artist

name: Mind Set
description: By controlling one's mine he/she will be able to set their mind in to an object revealing to them what has happened in the past to that specific object. This also in turn gives you all information on what the object is about. Example: Setting your mind into a computer can give you all it's info like age, data etc. You may also use this against opponents by stealing any battle strategies and such other things.
summary: The ability to gain information from any device or organism through mind connectivity
strengths: Steal info. From others
Store memeory in your brain
weaknesses: You have limited storage space
You may lose memeory
Brain damages may occur

name: Cheat Code
description: Cheat codes are no longer just for video games; with this power, you can use cheat codes for real life. Skip - Next significant stage in your life. Redo - Do over a stage in your life again. 2nd Chance - Like having many lives; basically, you cheat death.  You can do any cheat code that you can relate into your life. Cheat codes for life aren't actual codes--you just input the code into your mind.
summary: The ability to use cheat codes in real life.
strengths: Can use cheat codes when playing sports, taking test examinations etc.
Skip boring moments of your life.
Redo your mistakes.
weaknesses: Skipping stages in your life defeats the purpose of your life.
Cannot control what happens when skipping stages.

name: Willpower Mimicry
description: The Will, is the most powerful primal inner force that can exist inside any conscious being. It is the power that drives our ability to choose & act. Even though it is unseen or unheard at most times, its manifestations in the physical realm is undeniable. A person with this ability is a very formidable opponent; being able to transform himself into pure willpower he has omnipotence over his own will & actions & can control the freewill or actions of others living and non-living alike.
summary: The ability to transform into pure willpower.
strengths: Time, Space, & anything in it is a slave to your freewill. Induce them to act according to your wish
When you are in this form you are intagible, indestructible, and unpercievable by the 5 senses.
You are immune to all types of control or attack that targets the mind.
weaknesses: When in this form both body and soul is rendered nonexistent.
You cannot directly attack anything or anyone with this form, you can only control them.
People that possess strong willpower can resist you.

name: Green Light
description: A green flashing aura that greatly heightens your speed, reflexes and intellect (all things that require neurotransmission).
summary: The ability to generate a green aura that speeds your cognition and reflexes.
strengths: Think fast.
Worlds fastest reflexes.
Make complex plans instantly.
weaknesses: Your perceptions make other things seem slow

name: Poison Immunity
description: You are immune to all poisons with this power. This includes mental and physical poisons as well as moral ones.
summary: The ability to be immune to any poison
strengths: Immune to poisons without need to build up resistance.
You can eat fugu safely! It's a Japanese delicacy of pufferfish.
You'll never be greedy, angry, or ignorant (3 Buddhist Poisons).
weaknesses: Won't have the thrill of not knowing whether the fugu was incorrectly prepared.
Might get the physical only version.
Can still get killed by a poisoned dagger slitting your throat.

name: The Will: Tactile Terrakinesis
description: This form of terrakinesis is extremely rare, but also highly versatile. Unlike other psychic powers, this one is controlled by your willpower. You can control the ground you stand on in any way imaginable, and create earthquakes, landslides, rifts, and many other natural phenomena directly related to the earth. You also have natural regeneration, and can heal others regardless of ailment or injury severity.
summary: The ability to control geological elements through both physical contact and willpower
strengths: Have extremely strong and precise control over geological elements
Be a formidable fighter!
Gain accelerated cellular regeneration with absorbed terrakinetic energy
weaknesses: A very dangerous power in the wrong hands
Some people might find this power dangerous, and thus fear you
This is a 'tactile' ability: you ALWAYS need to have physical contact with the earth to control it

name: Dark Spawn
description: A dark spawner can generate dark energy and use it to spawn anything his mind can come up with. It could spawn weapons, different items and vehicles. The dark spawner could also spawn puppets to do his bidding. Puppets are creatures created by the spawner's imagination, with powers and sometimes minds of their own. The spawner can also spawn wings on his back to fly. Spawning money is also possible. Anything you spawn must stay within your vicinity to exist otherwise they wouldn't last for long.
summary: The ability to use your dark energy to spawn absolutely anything
strengths: Could create anything your heart desires or needs to survive
Puppets are awesome and can be powerfull allies or just good to have around
Wings dude wings... Well you could spawn a hover-board too... Anyway you could fly
weaknesses: Uses up a lot of energy and the bigger and more complicated you try to spawn the more energy you use
Forgetting you have wings attached to your back (what that could happen)
You will be counting a lot on your puppets and won't actually fight yourself

name: 3 D Subconscious World Builder
description: One can enter their own subconcious into a ''blueprint'' kind of world where they can make anything and control anything e. G. Time speed, oxygen levels e. T. C. They are basically god's in this world. More advanced users of this techniques can project aspects of their world onto the real life. But a special barrier prevents the projection of OP'ditems into the real world. It is also possible for one to suck another into this world. But it required a long time of charging up and an unwary enemy.
summary: The ability to enter your subconcious and create you own world with anything you want
strengths: You can do anything as long as your subconcious is up for it
You can project anything (except OP'd items) Into the real world
You can make wacky items to solve real world problems
weaknesses: If you do manage to suck someone into this world they could run amok and destroy your mind
The more complex the item the more time it takes to build
The bigger the world the bigger the persons mental capacity needs to be to store it

name: Psychic Bursts
description: The power to make psychic bursts with your hands, making things explode, implode or shatter.
summary: The ability to make explosions of psychic powers with your hands.
strengths: Great offensive power.
Great defensive power when in trouble.
Disappear with it.
weaknesses: Big explosions could destroy the Earth.
Takes some concentration.

name: Psychic And Psionic Weapons
description: This ability allows you to attack the mental body instead of the physical one. You can create daggers, swords, guns, hammers, any weapon you want. You can completely K.O. someone without touching the physical body.
summary: The ability to create Psychic and Psionic weapons that attack the mental body instead of the physical one
strengths: K.O. someone way easier
weaknesses: If someone has the ability to block mental attacks, the weapons are useless.

name: Mind Bullets
description: Using the gun gesture with your hands and fingers, you can shoot psychic energy at a person. From powerful telekinetic energy bursts, which can bruise or puncture flesh like a bullet, to emotional empathic pain or mental pain that makes a person go catatonic. The downside is you can only shoot 15 times at once before having to rest and recharge, or you risk passing out from mental exhaustion or worse. You can recharge with quick meditation and focus.
summary: The ability to shoot psychokinetic energy blasts, causing mental, emotional or physical pain
strengths: Shoot psychic energy at a person causing different kinds of pain
weaknesses: You can only shoot 15 times, or else you will pass out if you don't rest and recharge real quick

name: Emotions Are The Enemy
description: The user of this ability is able to draw pure emotion from either their own or another's memories and manifest them into a physical form. That form can be anything from a statue, to a ball of light, to a puddle but the effect will always be the same: an aura of its patron emotion that overpowers a persons or group of people's rational selves.
summary: The ability to overwhelm someone with their emotions.
strengths: Instant distraction with an emotion "bomb" if you need to make a quick getaway.
Have the ability to keep yourself calm in stressful situations.
Alternatively; you can keep your enemies off balance by flooding them with anger.
weaknesses: Memories used to get emotions could lose all meaning to the person they were gotten from.
If the emotions are gotten from the user they run the risk of losing them completely.
Prolonged exposure to an emotion construct could cause personalities to be permanently changed.

name: Empathy
description: Empathy, sometimes called Telempathy,is the ability to sense the emotions of those around you and influence those emotions. This power can be used to instill confidence, fear, anger or any other emotion in anyone you choose. Empathy can also be used to channel the emotions of a victim into the mind of their attacker and force them to relive what their victim felt until they fell guilt for what they did.
summary: The ability to sense and control the emotions of others.
strengths: Cannot be lied to because you would sense the lie.
Can make others feel what you are feeling or vice versa to improve interpersonal relationships.
Can incapacitate an opponent with a simple thought.
weaknesses: If in a crowded room emotions can be overwhelming.
Opponent can use the ability against you to force you to feel their rage which can be painful you.

name: Intellectual Surge
description: You gain an instant rush or surge of knowledge coursing through your brain, it happens at random and is involuntary. You don't have to be aware or be taught that knowledge. It's more an instant absorption of the knowledge possessed by others through a telepathic process.
summary: The ability to obtain and instant intellectual surge/rush.
strengths: Gain an instant rush of knowledge.
Knowledge does not have to be taught or shown in any direct way.
weaknesses: Is an involuntary ability; thererfore can not be controlled.
Ability happens at random.

name: Reality/Imagination Confusion
description: This power allows you to curse anyone to be unable to tell the difference between imagination and reality. They won't be able to tell if something or someone is real or imaginary. Imagined objects will appear as real to them, no matter how goofy it would seem to a normal person. Imagined situations can appear as real memories or seem to occur in front of them. If they are imagining a fictional world, they can become trapped in it, living inside as if it was real.
summary: The ability to make someone unable to distinguish between reality and their own imagination.
strengths: This curse prevents them from realizing and believing anything imaginary is false.
As time goes on, they should eventually question the veracity of reality itself.
Great against people with Extraordinary Imagination.
weaknesses: As most curse, this one can be removed if the user is killed.

name: Moderate Existent Manipulation
description: You have moderate control over how a person perceives your existence. You can exist to a person in a certain sense: a sound, a smell, a feeling, a picture, or a taste.
summary: The ability to control another's perception of your existence.
strengths: Excellent for stealth; you can sneak past henchmen as a peculiar smell or taste.
Can be the best thing anyone has ever tasted, smelled, felt, heard, etc.
weaknesses: You could unintentionally make multiple people perceive you as something.

name: The Will
description: This ability allows you have complete control over people's actions, movements, and anything else that is voluntary movement. You can't stop involuntary movements like heart beats and breathing, but you can to a small extent control their emotions and feelings, but it is very limited and can only increase through experience with this power. The Will is a cross between puppeteering and possessing, where they are aware of their actions, but can't control them, unless you let them.
summary: The ability to have control over everyone's free will.
strengths: Complete control of people's free will
weaknesses: Limited control of emotions, thoughts, and feelings
Can not control the involuntary movements of a person.

name: Dream Tale
description: Dream Tale allows you to bring your dreams to life. It also allows you to control your dream once you get in the middle of it.
summary: The ability to bring your dreams to life.
strengths: You may be able to make a 'crush' like you
You may be able to make fake creatures real
You may be able to bring a departed one back to life
weaknesses: You can only control dreams once you get in the middle of them
Sometimes the power goes off randomly
You can only bring back the last dream you had

name: Clairvoyance
description: Thousands of people go missing every year. A person with Clairvoyance can find them. By simply concentrating for a short while, they can pinpoint their exact location: the city, building, floor, and even room number they're in at that moment. However, dead people cannot be found. And since this ability hones in on someone's mind, Telepaths and other Clairvoyants can tell when they're being found.
summary: The ability to find anyone, no matter their location
strengths: Worldwide range
Very precise (city, building, floor, and room #)
Find friends in your area to hang out with
weaknesses: One person at a time
Dead people cannot be found
Telepaths and other Clairvoyants know when they're being found

name: Shadow Automatism
description: This ability is quite the odd one; it is the presence of a shadow that can act independently of the user; this shadow can affect matter by affecting the matter's shadow. In fact, the shadow almost seems a separate entity; while it is still connected to the user, it can "speak" to the user, formulate thoughts of its own, and bond with the user, gifting him with night vision and enhanced attributes.
summary: The ability to have an independently-acting shadow which can affect one's environment
strengths: Shadow affecting the shadows of other matter gives the appearance of telekinesis (shadow's strong)
Shadow can't be harmed by normal means (it's intangible AND fortified with psionic power)
Shadow can "speak" to user and merge with him to heighten stats (strength, etc. ) in darkness
weaknesses: Enhanced attributes only work in darkness
Shadow can get bossy or it may be evil
Umbrakinesis or Psionic Energy Manipulation can harm the shadow

name: Light Bulb
description: With a thought or a 'for flair' snap of your fingers, people suddenly get an idea. The idea can be about absolutely anything. This can very helpful or unhelpful. For instance, give someone a new astro-physics equation to test or give them the idea to think you're a monkey's uncle. With practice you can force the idea to focus on one central theme. This power encompasses epiphanies also. (Note: The ideas doesn't come from the user its random. )
summary: The ability to give others and yourself ideas
strengths: Help someone understand a subject... Sometimes
Give yourself ideas and eventually something worthwhile will appears that you can patent.
Be able to be completely original.
weaknesses: Give someone the thought that if they kill you they'll be forever happy.
Bad Ideas
Overall having little control over your own powers.

name: Pusher
description: Mind control is just like brainwashing. You could get somebody to do your dirty work while at the same time get another thing done. When you're using your power, your eyes turn black. You can control more than one person. You can create a lie and project it into the mind of another person.
summary: The ability to create and push thoughts into a person's mind.
strengths: Make anybody believe anything
Have somebody do your dirty work
Control more than one person at a time
weaknesses: Your eyes turn black

name: Mind Contraption
