description: With this ability, you can trap someone in your mind. Once you begin, your foe's mental self leaves his body and is placed into your mind. You can choose to enter your mind with him. Once inside, the foe can do only what you want him to do, and you can do anything you want to do. If you decide to destroy his mind, you can do that, and he will be killed in the real world. However, anything else that you do is simply imagination.
summary: The ability to enter your own mind, or trap someone inside of it.
strengths: Send yourself or anyone else into your mind.
You have full control over people while they are in your mind, you can destroy their mind.
Anything is possible in your mind. Whether everyone else can do anything in your mind is your choice
weaknesses: People eventually become weary from staying inside of your mind.
Everything is only imagination.
Your bodies will stay left in the real world unless your experienced enough to make them disappear.

name: Unlocker
description: With this ability, you can unlock everything you want just by concentrating. Doors, chests, combination locks, user accounts... Everything.
summary: The ability to unlock everything with just your mind, from locks to passwords.
strengths: Losing your keys or forgetting your password won't be a problem anymore.
Allows you to go everywhere, even where you're not supposed to.
Best. Hacker. Ever.
weaknesses: You can still get caught while being in forbidden places.
You can still get caught while stealing accounts.
Not useful in a fight.

name: Fantasia
description: By looking at a person(s) directly or indirectly, (seeing their reflection in a mirror or their shadow), you can see what their fantasies are. Fantasies are often what people see themselves as or what they wish for the most. By knowing what their fantasies are, you can shatter them in order to make up a new fantasy in their minds. By creating a false fantasy for them, they may see themselves differently or change their goals in life. Their dreams may alter and may possibly gain more fears.
summary: The ability to see and manipulate the fantasies of others.
strengths: Learn more about the person you see.
Can make your enemy fear something new that they may not have feared before.
Can turn those with evil fantasies good by destroying those fantasies and recreating good ones.
weaknesses: Cannot see fantasies of others while they're asleep.
Changing certain fantasies of some individuals may have unintended consequences.
Changing others fantasies too often could damage their psychie.

name: Empathic Mimicry
description: Empathic Mimicry is one of the most powerful abilities. When other people with powers get near an Empathic Mimic, the Empathic Mimic can do what they can do: Technopathy, Super-Strength--even physical abilities like Shape-Shifting. There is no limit to the amount of abilities they can mimic, nor is there a limit on the types of abilities they can mimic. However, there is a range limit---2 football fields(200 yards), and the Empathic Mimic has to know about the ability.
summary: The ability to mimic other powers while you are near the users
strengths: Using multiple abilities at once
Hitting someone with their own power
One of the more powerful abilities
weaknesses: 200 yard range
Must know person has the ability
May mimic a uncontrollable ability

name: Automatic Thought Transference
description: Using the power of your mind, whatever you would like to build or create or fix, you can. However you want it to look, wherever you want it to be at, however you want it to taste like. Rules: Have to use your right index finger to point where stuff goes at. Need to have a good clear picture of what you want and where you want it at. However, you can change your mind and switch things around to your liking.
summary: The ability to automatically be able to build or fix things
strengths: Always get to have the vehicle and residence you want to have.
Always get to eat or drink what you want to.
Always get have the clothing you want to have.
weaknesses: Have to be careful not to point your right index finger all the time.
Might have to use pictures of what you want to get something right.

name: The Knower
description: If anyone asks you something you automaticlly know the answer. You don't have temptation to answer them, but you will get the answer yourself. The power is only triggered if you are extremely upset or emotional.  If someone asked you when the world would end, you'd know.
summary: The ability to know anything that you're asked.
strengths: Never get bad grades on tests again!
Know anything that is asked.
Control over saying the answer to the asker.
weaknesses: You can't ask yourself a question.
Sometimes the answer can change things for you.
You trigger the power with a certain emotion.

name: Psychometry
description: When you touch an object or person, you know everything that has happened and that will happen to that person. The future is susceptible to change, since that person can make a decision later on that changes the future. This happens every time you touch something, no matter if you have touched it before. The time it takes for the visions to pass varies on how long the object or person has been in existence.
summary: The ability to relate details about the past or future condition of an object, by touching it.
strengths: Can save lives by knowing if they will be murdered
Can help people regain memory if they have been affected by a memory sapper
Can change an enemies' perceptions by bringing up something that happened to them in the past.
weaknesses: Cannot relate details to your own future or past.
Learn unwanted details of someone's past or future.
Involuntary. Contact with anything will have to be limited.

name: The Best Superpower Ever
description:
You gain the best superpower ever according to what your subconscious mind thinks. If it was your conscious mind, you would have to actually decide what you think the best superpower ever is, and that would be annoying. 
All superpowers have their limits. This power won't give you any ultimate future deciding powers and you can only use it once a week.
summary: The ability to gain the best superpower ever according to your subconscious mind.
strengths: You choose it. (Kind of)
It's powerful.
It can be fun.
weaknesses: It can't be everything.
It can only be used once a week.
It might not help with the situation.

name: Ambient Energy Conversion
description: This ability allows the user to change surrounding energies by influencing them. For example, the user can change the normal ambient energy around you into heat energy with your mind. Heat energy would surround you or the area you wanted. The user can also turn it into cosmic, negative, positive, or even cryo- energy. With training, the user would be able to create constructs.
summary: The ability to change (transform or convert) ambient energy into a different type of energy
strengths: Change ambiant energies
Surround enemies and objects with this specified energy
With training, the user would be able to create constructs.
weaknesses: Still affected by the changed energies
Can't actually manipulate.

name: Memory Access
description: Whenever a person is sleeping near you, an icon appears above their head. This icon is only visible to you, you can touch this icon as well. Once you touch it an entire organised database appears in front of you. You can look in it and access any file/memory you wish to see. You can even copy memories from the sleeping person. Permanently.
summary: The ability to access anyone's mind like a computer database.
strengths: Know things you would never know otherwise.
Your mind is immune to anyone with the same or likewise power.
If you remove the right data, you can take someone out forever.
weaknesses: If the target awakes, you risk corrupting data and permanently damaging their mind.
You are left without defense while accessing a mind.
If you alter the wrong data, you might make someone blind or deaf.

name: Double
description: This power allows you to split into 2 just like duplication, but would give each of the 2 a distinct power. To do your first split, you must think of a power you will give yourself. Your twin will receive a different power to complete your choice. The twins are mentally linked so can communicate from afar but share their pain. You can always become 1 again, but the powers will remain the same after the first split. With practice, you could split into more than 2 & reset the powers given.
summary: The ability to split into 2 of yourself with 2 distinct powers
strengths: Instant twins
Will automatically know the weak point of the power you choose
Won't fear dating twins anymore, for a while
weaknesses: You feel the pain being inflicted to your twin even though you won't be hurt physically
Choosing a power can be difficult
Splitting into more than 2 takes a lot of patience

name: Ambiguous Power
description: A person with this power has access to all the powers that have not yet been considered by people. They can fly but only by using an alternative method to do so, because if anyone knew they were using flying they would instantly stop working and you would fall off the sky. Thus you need to think of powers that have the same function as flying such as telekinesis so that when you are flying they will not think that you are actually using telekinesis.
summary: The ability to have all the abilities that have not been thought of by other people around them
strengths: You can do a lot of things with imagination.
Your powers always have a surprise factor.
weaknesses: If someone figures out your ability the ability stops working
If you are going against a mind reader
Powers are limited because the user has no time to develop every single power.

name: Mental Mechanic
description: This ability allows you to disassemble and reassemble mechanical objects with your mind. So, when one has a weapon pointed at you all you have to do is think and it shall fall apart in their hand. It can be influenced by emotion, so when the user has extreme anger they may cause a whole bunch of stuff to fall apart.
summary: The ability to make mechanical items disassemble or assemble with your mind
strengths: Useful when faced with a weapon
You can take apart, fix, and reassemble mechanical items with no work
weaknesses: Useless in battles with weaponless powers
Anger subconsciously activates the power

name: Psychokinesis
description: A person with Psychokinesis can perform a variety of startling effects. They can soften objects, making titanium as soft as butter by touching it. They can also liquefy objects and disentegrate objects.
summary: The ability to manipulate the attraction between atoms
strengths: Very versatile
Can liquefy cold butter for toast and save some time
Scare foes
weaknesses: Unable to mentally move objects
Disintegration leaves a very distinctive powder,so they know it's you
Liquefication has its limits

name: Dafentesis
description: This is the ability to get what you want! What ever power you want! But once you've attained a power there is no giving it back or getting a different one! So be careful what you wish for.
summary: The ability to think of any one power and attain it!
strengths: You get what you've always wanted.
weaknesses: It's inexchangable

name: Clairsentience
description: Every year, millions of pieces of police evidence are scrutinized so they can tell their stories. A Clairsentient has a shortcut. They can experience an object's past just by touching it, i.e. seeing the history of a gun or a suit, all its owners and what they did with them. With intensive practice, they can even tell what their past owners are doing now, and their state(dead, alive, etc.).
summary: The ability to have visions of the past of an object by touching it
strengths: Become a good policeman (never wrong)
Become an excellent forensic scientist
Know other's secrets (if these walls could talk...)
weaknesses: Involuntary, takes work to master
Might not like the truth
Learn nasty, unwanted secrets (if these walls could talk...)

name: Memory Viewer
description: With this power you can see the memories of other people
summary: The ability to see a person's memory
strengths: You can see what the person has done in his life
weaknesses: You can only see things the person remembers not just anything that has happened to him/her

name: Reverse Psychology
description: For example, if you asked someone not to get out of a car, they would get out instead. If you asked someone that you didn't need money, they would probabally ask you how much you needed. This effect is normally switched off, and you must 'will' it to be switched on.
summary: The ability to have people do certain things for you by reversing psychology
strengths: You have the power of reverse psychology.
Tell someone you don't need money, they probabally will give you money anyways.
Can be 'willed' off or on.
weaknesses: Gets confusing when you talk while using reverse psychology.

name: Mnemonic Power Absorption
description: This is possibly the most powerful form of ability mimicry in existence. You can absorb another person's power(s) through memories you have of them, and also through information you gather from objects that person has been in contact with.
summary: The ability to absorb the powers of others through memories and/or psychometrics
strengths: You can absorb someone's power by simply remembering them using it, similar to empathic mimicry
Psychometry is a natural part of this ability, and thus makes it easier to use
You can choose to absorb a power entirely, partially, or not at all
weaknesses: Some people might fear you
This power can be countered by telepathy
Unless you can suppress and/or destroy a memory, you could be stuck with an undesired power

name: Marionette Quartz
description: This ability allows it's user to inject small quantities of quartz, through touch, in living organisms. The implanted quartz reacts and responds to the user's thoughts, allowing the user to remotely control the actions of infected organisms. The quartz dissolves in the blood after a few days, ending the user's control.
summary: The ability to implant small amounts of quartz in living beings that allow you to control their actions remotely
strengths: Control enemies and allies from afar
weaknesses: Wears off after a few days
Requires skin contact to implant quartz

name: Instilled Perception
description: You can tell anyone that 2 plus 2 is 5 and they believe you! You could steal money without a mask and say you didn't steal the money and everyone would believe you. Or say you're in love with someone and tell them they love you, they will be convinced they are in love with you.
summary: The ability to cause others to believe something no matter how illogical or ridiculous it may seem.
strengths: Can get out of anything.
Can get the girl of your dreams.
Can make lots of money.
weaknesses: Some villains may be extremely intelligent and can not be controlled.
You can only control 25 people at a time.
You can't undo it after 5 hours.

name: Visible Imagination
description: This power allows you to see your own imagination before you, like it's really there. You'd have an amazing memory, this power is great for creative people. These illusions affect all 5 senses. You can see what others imagine about too.
summary: The ability to experience imagination all around you and other people
strengths: Have an amazing memory
Useful when you're an artist
Be a superhero, meet celebrities, do everything you ever wanted
weaknesses: It's a beautiful show only you can see
It's not always great to see what people create in their head
Some people will never turn this power off and will finally lose their senses.

name: Optimism
description: Optimism allows the users to shape reality to his will, restrained only by his/her negative thoughts. Examples would include changing the share market, or never-ending "luck" (as long as you're still optimistic). If user is pessimistic, this ability does nothing.
summary: The ability to shape reality depending on your optimism
strengths: Unlimited "luck"
No "bad" luck
Worryfree
weaknesses: Sometimes it may be hard to be optimistic
It may also be hard to know you have this ability
Hard to control & use

name: Mind's Eye
description: Everything around you, you will be able to see within your mind. You'll a 360 degree view of the whole area. So if you are in a dark space where an ambush is possible, you'll see everything using your power. & inside your mind, you can make the space bright, know exactly how many foes you're facing & what obstacles are in your way.
summary: The ability to see all of your surroundings within your mind
strengths: Know all of your surroundings
Never be in a surprise attack
weaknesses: You'll ruin your own surprise parties

name: Sensory Framerate Acceleration
description: With this power, you have the ability to see and hear everything in slow motion for however long you want. Normally, humans perceive the world around them in 300 something frames per second. This power allows you to increase that number to extreme amounts, thus slowing down your perception of time.  You will not physically move faster but you will be able to see and hear everything slower. You will have more time to process information and think about situations.
summary: The ability to see everything in slow motion by increasing the number of frames of light you perceive per second
strengths: Have near perfect hand-eye coordination
Be able to out-think your opponents by giving yourself more time to think about the situation
Faster reflexes
weaknesses: You do not physically move faster

name: Object Teleportation
description: How many times have you forgotten something small but completely necessary, like a lunchbox or a few extra dollars? A person with Object Teleportation can bring objects like these (under 15 pounds) to their hands immediately and over great distance. They can pickpocket from a mile away, pull off awesome card tricks, and take a gun out of a sniper's hands.
summary: The ability to teleport small objects to you
strengths: Never lose things (at least for long)
Never lock your keys inside your car
Great against guns
weaknesses: Must have clear picture (visual/mental) of the object
Cannot teleport larger objects, even with practice
Excessive use may induce headaches

name: Cerebral Ability Mimicry
description: This is a very powerful form of ability mimicry. Someone can mimic the abilities of another simply by sensing the patterns of the user's brainwaves when they are using their ability, and alter their own brainwaves to tap into that power. The maximum range of this power is up to five miles.
summary: The ability to mimic the powers of others by sensing their brainwave patterns
strengths: You can mimic and/or absorb ANYONE'S ability, but you can also choose NOT to absorb a power
Psychics are the easiest to gain powers from.
Your brain can naturally nullify a power that someone uses to hurt you, and thus protects you
weaknesses: Although power immunity is natural, you need to practice gaining/discarding power
Learning to read other's brainwaves, and thus mimic powers, takes practice.
Just like Empathic Mimicry, there is a range.

name: Arcana 19: The Sun
description: You may generate large amounts of any single kind of energy (Such as Heat or Psychic Energy). You may not choose not to generate energy, though you may choose how much energy you generate. Energy generated by this power bubbles off of you without harming you or anything you wear. Any people capable of manipulating the type of energy you generate will find their abilities more powerful while the are near you. (A pyrokinetic would be more powerful while you generated heat, etc).
summary: The ability to generate huge amounts of energy.
strengths: You can create large amounts of energy without much cost to yourself.
You can enhance the powers of your allies, or give them more energy to work with.
You may attack people simply by touching or going near them.
weaknesses: Generation of energy is not control over energy.
You may only generate one type of energy a time.
You may not select which people use the power you make.

name: Cognitive Variable Analyses
description: This applies to a current situation or a hypothesized situation. You are able to see all the lines of causality and their effect and what they lead onto. Example, you need to make a decision - will you go left or right? - well in your mind's eye, you can see exactly what will happen within the next 24 hours and each other child path stemming from the parent path. The situation doesn't just have to involve you - you can see anybody's paths.
summary: The ability to understand and perceive all the variables in a given situation
strengths: Never make the wrong decision again
The time it takes to analyse any amount of variables - takes one second for every step down a path.
Extreme insight and foresight
weaknesses: Risk of becoming obsessed and lost in your thoughts - obsessing about ''What If" scenarios
The further ahead you look - the more time it takes - a second for each step or ''child path''

name: Network Telekinesis
description: This power allows you to spread a psychic network that you can channel telekinesis through (though only in one direction). The user can choose whoever is connected to the network to channel telekinetic energy through so that THEY are the ones using telekinesis, not you (you however, control it). This allows for suprise attacks as well as ones over a long distance. Only you and the people you directly connect can spread the network and, at first, you can only make a small network.
summary: The ability to form a psychic network that you can channel telekinesis through.
strengths: No matter how many people you channel through, the telekinetic power is still the same.
You can attack from a distance and utilize several telekinetic forces at once.
If you become skilled, your network can become huge.
weaknesses: You can only control the telekinesis of however many people you can concentrate on.
If you don't concentrate while channeling, then the telekinetic power acts randomly.
Your skill level determines how large the network can become.

name: Psychomagnetic Manipulation
description: You can generate powerful psychomagnetic energy into four forms: a deflective barrier which deflects any projectile and most physical attacks, an inescapable psychomagnetic prison which can detain anything at any time, even moving objects, a psychomagnetic pulse, which is a burst of energy like an explosion, and finally, psychomagnetic interference, which blocks other psychomagnetic based powers such as induced psychomagnetism, precognition, empathy, telepathy, etc.
summary: The ability to create powerful psychomagnetic fields.
strengths: Difficult to be harmed.
Stops people knowing your future unless you want them to.
weaknesses: Difficult to control and can be unpredictable.
Wears you out and is easy to overextend yourself.
Can't be restricted, nullified or absorbed.

name: Arcana 14: Temperance
description: You may separate bits of your mind from the central portion of your mind. You can place emotions, memories, compulsions or thoughts inside these partitions; while they are there, your central mind is unaffected by them. Memories are forgotten, thoughts are ignored, emotions are unfelt. You may also use partitions as shields against mental attacks or possession. Those are affected rather than you; possessors are sealed away until you release them. You may reunite partitions with yourself at will.
summary: The ability to partion off parts of your mind.
strengths: Can ignore worrisome or negative thoughts.
Can become immune to mental assaults or emotional attacks.
Can selectively inflict amnesia.
weaknesses: Overusing this power may result in your mind become full of more holes than swiss cheese.
You may forget why you forgot something.
You may seal away so many emotions that you no longer wish to have them back.

name: Situational Evasion Perception
description: This power gives you the ability to instantly sense the best path to escape from any situation. The situations could range from how to best maneuver through a crowd of people or a maze to how to best dodge eight knives that have been thrown at you to how to escape from a straitjacket. You must have seen your destination before you can know the best path to it, and the path would be within your physical abilities.
summary: The ability to sense the optimal path to escape from any situation
strengths: Know how to escape from any situation that you are able to
Can also sense the best path for other people or objects to take to escape from their situations
weaknesses: Must be physicaly able to escape from the situation in order to see the path

name: Human Control
description: You can make any HUMAN do your bidding at any time and at any given place.If you get knocked unconscious or get a coma you have a chance of losing control(this does not include sleeping or dreaming).You can only control people you know exist. People not under your control may try to kill you.
summary: The ability to be able to control anyone (except animals)
strengths: Get revenge
Rule the world
Never be unhappy again
weaknesses: getting bored
possibly losing control if you get knocked out
people not under your control may try to kill you

name: Hypno Mist
description: You can spew some hynotic mist that comes out from your mouth that causes the victim to be tranced under you control and he or she becomes brainwashed.
summary: The ability to breathe out hypnotic haze from you mouth that cause your foe to become under your control.
strengths: A strange use for brainwashing.
weaknesses: It can be worn off by a snap of a finger or spalsh in the face with water.

name: Object Reanimation
description: Object Reanimation is the ability to create other objects ny reanimating the molecules and the molecular structure of another object, either from mind or touch. This creates the idea of getting an object you might need, say a ballpen, from another object that you might use later. This is limited to the volume of the object you are reanimating. Say you want a knife, and start reanimating a ballpen. The result would either be a small knife, a weak and brittle knife, or no knife at all.
summary: The ability to create other objects by reanimating the molecules of other objects
strengths: You can create an object you want at anytime
You have the power to change an object that might be a threat
You have the power to make an object much or less useful
weaknesses: You are limited to the volume of the object
The item you reanimate does not ensure great quality
You might change something you don't want to change

name: Aura Shield
description: If done properly, this can protect you from any attack; physically or mentally.
summary: The ability to create a shield out of your aura
strengths: Protection from anything
weaknesses: Can only protect you if used properly
Cant deflect arrows yeah it sucks

name: Fear Inducing
description: With this ability, you can induce fear in any living thing with emotions. You can choose the intensity of the fear, which can also determine how long the being is in the state of fear. This is done mentally, and you can use it on large areas. You can induce fear without visual contact. However, it requires more concentration.
summary: The ability to induce fear in any living thing.
strengths: You can get anyone frightened.
weaknesses: Has no offensive use on its own.

name: Telepathy Via Sight
description: The person with this power is able to read minds as well as send people information mentally whenever a person or a group of people is within their sight. If the person they are mind reading or sending information goes out of the user's sight, then he losses the mind reading and information link.
summary: The ability to read people's mind or send people information whenever they are in your sight.
strengths: Can read minds
Good for getting information as well as sending information
weaknesses: Cannot use this power against someone with Mental Shielding
A power that only can be used primarily surveillance, not combat effective.

name: Psychometric Power Absorption
description: This very rare ability is a curious mix of empathic mimicry and psychometrics. A person can mimic and later absorb abilities of people who have touched and/or used objects that the person with this power comes into contact with. There is no limit as to the number of powers that can be absorbed, nor is there a limit on the types of powers that can be absorbed.
summary: The ability to emulate the powers of others by touching an object they had previously been exposed to.
strengths: A very useful power for an empath.
Is extremely powerful.
Can be harnessed and controlled in a very short amount of time.
weaknesses: Is useless if the memories you collect do not involve people using abilities.

name: Elaborate Planning
description: A person with this power has the ability to make the most convoluted schemes ever and have them succeed. They MAY take many years and may involve time travel, messing with the continuum, meating alternate versions of yourself, ruining the lives of countless others all in the name of doing one simple action. But they don't have to, they can also be short, concise plans executable for someone without any further powers. However, mind readers etc. will not even be able to understand your plans.
summary: The ability to make unnecessarily elaborate plans that have a 99.9% success rate
strengths: Your plans always work (99.9%)
Your plans can never be understood until you reveal it
People will underestimate you, giving you the win
weaknesses: Sometimes your plans involve doing stupid things
Your plans may take many years to accomplish versus making a regular plan
Could put a lot of planning into a few simple tasks

name: Synapse Manipulation
description: In the nervous system, a synapse is a structure that permits a neuron to pass an electrical or chemical signal to another cell. Basically, the user can manipulate the electrical or chemical functions between neurons. For example; electrical synapses conduct nerve impulses faster such as defence reflexes. Chemical synapses are crucial to the biological computations that underlie perception and thought. They allow the nervous system to connect to and control other systems of the body.
summary: The ability to control neurons and command them to do your bidding
strengths: Control a human body from within
Have the great advantage in battle
weaknesses: Negative emotions trigger this if unexperienced

name: Mental Control
description: This is your basic mind-control superpower. You touch someone, tell them to do something, and they will obey, no questions asked. But, there's a small twist. You must truly mean what you're saying when you're controlling someone's mind.
summary: The ability to control anyone's mind.
strengths: You can make anyone do anything you want. Nuff said.
weaknesses: You need to touch them and really mean what you're saying.

name: Time Spark
description: With this ability, a person can control time via a special metal cube called the 'Time Spark'. It resembles the All Spark from 'Transformers', but has no symbols, except for an Egyptian eye, on all sides. The user psychically sees into the past and future, and can open a silver vortex known as 'The Time Twister' to escape enemies, trap them in eternal dimension limbo, or mess up their life through alteration of that person's perception of time.
summary: The ability to use a mirrored metal cube to harness power over time
strengths: Escape to a better timeline
Banish enemies into eternal limbo
Know the best moments in life yet to come!!
weaknesses: This power is unimaginably destructive in the wrong hands!
Using the Time Spark's full potential takes practice
Time Defiance

name: Multitask
description: Also known as Assembly Line Brain. The user has the ability to do many activities at once with the same mental efficiency of doing only one task for each task. The user is able to process information in their brain for each task without the details confusing them. Another side-effect is that the user also never forgets anything that they were supposed to do. The user can also increase his efficiency in one task by splitting up the single task into multiple simpler tasks.
summary: The ability to do multiple activities at the same time without decrease in mental efficiency for any task
strengths: You can do everything you want to in a day-and even more
You can do many jobs at once without problems at either job-you also have full concentration on each
You can fight multiple opponents with no sweat-you would feel like you are only fighting one person
weaknesses: If you got everything done and there was nothing else you needed to do in the day-kind of boring
Activities must be closeby and within reach-limited only by physical constraints
You remember that you have to do your chores

name: Cosmality
description: You can control the mind of anyone you choose. You can see anything that has happend to the person. You will be able to put things in the person's head that would drive them insane. And you can take their knowledge and and their powers.
summary: The ability to see the thoughts of others and unhinge their minds
strengths: You can destroy people's minds
You could create an army of all the people you are controlling
No one would have chance to destroy you
weaknesses: You have to be at least within 1000 miles of the person
It takes a lot of power
It takes a lot of energy

name: Postcognitive Telepathy
description: Postcognitive Telepathy is the ability to perceive the thoughts of others way after they have come up with them. The time one receives thoughts afterward can vary as randomly as with normal Postcognition. In addition, the reception is not simply receptive. One with this ability can also dominate minds in the past, implanting telepathic compulsions and illusions for later on (as far back in time as he can hear thoughts, he can project thoughts as well).
summary: The ability to perceive the thoughts of others after they are thought of
strengths: Perceive thoughts in the past (how far back in the past can be improved in time)
Implant thoughts in the past (including suggestions and illusions)
Bypass present mental defenses
weaknesses: Doesn't allow one to actually see the past
Seers with Telepathy can predict past mental attacks
If mental defenses are always up

name: Attunement To Space
description: This power is a strange one. Instead of just manipulating space it causes you to become totally attuned to space. This causes space to quickly and precisely act to the users thoughts as if it were an extra limb. It also allows the user to sense disturbances in space as well as the nuances of space itself. Due to being attuned space also responds to unconscious thoughts causing changes much faster than normal as well as giving space the tendency to protect the user from harm.
summary: The ability to be totally attuned to space and spacial energy.
strengths: Acts on both conscious and unconscious thoughts so you can warp space quickly.
You have space bend to your will for attack, defense, travel, or storage.
You can detect the nuances and disturbances of space.
weaknesses: You cannot easily control the warps from unconscious thought AND they come faster than normal warps.
Much,MUCH harder to figure out and properly utilize than manipulation.
Your own warps might be interfered with by space trying to protect you.

name: Remote Hearing
description: Like Remote Viewing, you can use one of your senses to spy on targets. But with this, you can only hear what's happening, not see it. So, if you develop your hearing so that you can recognize sounds, you will overcome that little disability.
summary: The ability to hear what's happening in other places
strengths: Can hear what people do when they are alone.
Can train yourself to recognize sounds
weaknesses: Can only hear things, not see them

name: Genetic Control
description: Person can change their own or another's genetic structure.  This enables the person to grant themselves new powers based on others abilities.  Would work extremely well with a genetic perception power, but if you have the equipment to take samples and analyze them, you'd still be able to to any genetic advantage anyone had.
summary: The ability to control and change the genetic structure of self or others.
strengths: Improve Genetic structure.
Potentially could be theri own experiment in search of genetic perfection.
weaknesses: Need to know what you are doing, or could kill yourself or others.

name: Dream Reality Warping
description: Also allows the user to release anesthetic into their body so as to allow them to fall asleep. Can create a powerful force field to subconsciously protect them while they are dreaming. Could potentially be a powerful weapon if a telepath (or dream manipulator) were to manipulate their dreams to affect the real world.
summary: The ability to manipulate reality through dreams.
strengths: Can potentially do anything.
Invincible while asleep.
Can fall asleep whenever.
weaknesses: Dreams are unpredictable without the aid of a telepath (or a dream manipulator).
Unable to do anything while asleep.
Could be very dangerous.

name: Illusory Form
description: One with this ability can assume a form of illusory energy. This form prevents anyone from knowing what the user truly looks like, because all they see is what they expect the user to look like, or what he wants them to think he looks like. In recording devices, his voice is garbled and his appearance is blurred.
summary: The ability to assume a form that is subject to interpretation
strengths: No one knows what you look like (get away with anything)
No recording device (surveillance camera, audio recorder, etc) can track your true identity traits
You become invisible to people who are immune to illusions
weaknesses: Your true form can be seen with Clairvoyance and Reality Perception
Your true voice can be heard by Clairaudience
The power Disillusion can revert you back to normal

name: Current Situation Intuition
description: This power is very useful and it can get one through nearly anything one encounters. Be it financial problems or life-death situations, and many other things, one knows exactly what to do. One with this ability has a greater mind, thinking of the consequences for a certain decision to get out of that certain situation. This power is always on.
summary: The ability to know everything about any situation one is in, be it anything.
strengths: Know exactly what to do.
weaknesses: Suffer the consequences of the decison one takes to get out of the situation.

name: Unpredictability
description: The user is unaffected by Tychokinesis (when touching a luck-manipulator, their powers short-circuit), and their moves cannot be predicted by Danger Sense, Precognition, Divination or Telepathy (even Combat Telepathy). The user is excluded from prophecies; his moves are hard to determine by Psychic Strategy, Imaginative Deduction, Quantum Deduction or other psychic means, except Omniscience. By simply existing, the user may change things that have been predicted/prophesied
summary: The ability to resist the forces of fate and probability
strengths: Probability manipulation can't affect you directly
Moves can't be predicted (a good foil for those with Superhuman Reflexes and the like)
Mess up prophecies and premonitions of the future
weaknesses: Probability manipulation can still affect you INDIRECTLY
Sometimes your unpredicted presence makes no difference in prophecies
Omniscience still 'sees' you

name: Espermaniacal Form
description: With this power, you grow and gain power by consuming psychic energy. This includes gaining power from mental activity in your area. You take the form of a creature spiraling with energy. As you grow, you gain more psychic abilties, such as telepathy, telekinesis, and eventually powers such as mind control. These powers adapt and become greater as you consume psychic energy, making them much more effective. You have an immunity (and need) for psychic energy, but susceptibility to physical harm.
summary: The ability to grow and gain power from consuming psychic energy.
strengths: Become immune to, and absorb psychic energy. (This includes mental activity in your area. )
Increase in size and power as you absorb the psychic energy around you.
Gain abilities (Telepathy, Telekinesis, Mind Control, Telekinetic Blasts, etc) from psychic energy.
weaknesses: Susceptible to physical damage.
Once you revert to normal form, you lose all the size and abilities that you gained.
If you're not constantly fueled with psychic energy, you revert to normal form.

name: Fictional Character Chatter
description: The user can talk with any fictional character that is willing to talk to you. You picture the character in your mind and you can try to talk to them; it's up to them to allow this and talk back.
summary: The ability to converse with any fictional character
strengths: Infinite ways to know your characters, you can know the way you want.
This superpower can make you feel very accompanied
This superpower lets you know things that only fictional characters know
weaknesses: Limited to fictional characters and their knowledge

name: Hypnotism
description: No watch-and-chain necessary, a Hypnotizer can put a target into a trance by staring into their eyes. This state also leaves the target highly susceptible to suggestions, like "Kill your boss", "You are now a Democrat", or "Every time you hear James Brown's music, you will start to sing along at the top of your lungs." This is limited to 1 hypnosis at a time.
summary: The ability to put people into a trance of extreme suggestibility
strengths: Amass a hypnotized following
Get someone to fight for you
Convince someone to do something humiliating in public
weaknesses: 1 hypnosis session at a time
Cannot make anyone do something they really don't want to
Must establish eye contact

name: Supernatural Magical Powers
description: It is the ability to use magical forces to varying degrees. Often used to simulate other powers, such as mind control and elemental attacks.
summary: The ability to use magical forces to varying degrees.
strengths: You would be one of the most powerful beings in the universe.
You could read minds.
You would have shape shifting.
weaknesses: If you were to have severe hand injuries, you would be unable to control your magic properly.
You would be weakened by mortal wounds.
Without experience, your spells would be as powerful as intended.

name: Fear Illusion
description:
You don't change shape only illude people to see you as what they fear the most.
Example: If someone is afraid of spider you can make that person see you as a spider.
If someone is a afraid of heights you can illude their surroundings by make it seem as if they're at the ledge of a cliff.
summary: The ability to make people see you as what they fear the most.
strengths: You can scare the living daylight out of everyone.
Nobody can scare you.
weaknesses: You can't use your power on yourself.

name: Psychic Map
description: This ability comes in two manifestations. The first is perhaps most beneficial, and it implies that the user possesses a map of the whole universe in his mind. However, the second manifestation is not without its benefits; it implies that the user has a map of the location they are in when the power manifests, and the map expands as they travel from that point. This manifestation also allows one to scan any location on his mental map, to observe anything that is currently in that area.
summary: The ability to house a psychic "map" within your mind
strengths: (First manifestation) have a map of the entire UNIVERSE in your mind (know how to get ANYWHERE)
(Second manifestation) have a mental map that builds from the point your ability manifests
(Second manifestation) locate anything in the areas you've registered in your mental map
weaknesses: (First Manifestation) only extends to your current dimension
(Second Manifestation) only extends to places where you've been
(Both) Can't be used to find someone/something that's been cloaked

name: Problem Solver
description:
Can solve any problem, puzzle, equation. Absolutely anything without flaw.
In order to solve the problem you must first analyze the situation and go through a sometimes time consuming thought process.
summary: The ability to find a solution to any problem without failure.
strengths: Can find the solution to any problem
weaknesses: Can be time-consuming
Doesn't make you a genius or smartest in the world.

name: Sonographic Deduction
description: A person with this power is able to process sounds that they hear in their brain, allowing them to decipher the exact action that causes the sound. This could allwo them to reproduce it. Also known as perfect or absolute pitch. Not only can you use this to learn how to play instruments quickly, you can also tell what people are typing just by listening to it. You can also use this to change dialects quickly by understanding the necessary movements ofyour speech organs.
summary: The ability to process sounds in your mind in a superhuman fashion allowing you to figure out people's actions
strengths: If you hear someone typing, you can tell what they are typing
You have perfect pitch with this ability, letting you play instruments by ear
weaknesses: This only works if there is a set pattern of sounds for a certain action
If there are many sounds at the same time this ability might fail
You have to hear a sound at least once in order to use it as a reference

name: Passion Eye
description: Passion Eyes allow you to have complete and utter control of the victim you use it on. In order for passion eyes to work, your eyes must meet theirs; then they become servant-like and do as you say. Passion eyes wears off based on the victim's mentality. The stronger the mind, the quicker it wears off.
summary: The ability to hypnotize and have complete control over the one you use passion eyes on.
strengths: You have servant like people that cater to you
They actually fall in love with you, which means they are willing to risk their lives for you
weaknesses: If someone's blind, it won't work
If you dont care about the one you used passion eyes on, you will see them as annoying and obsessive

name: Psionium (Destructive Metal)
description: This metal can be turned into any form the user wants it to be in and is fully immune to all psionic effects and powers. However, at lower levels the user can only make the metal resistant to psionic effects and powers and can only have it be partially be in the shape they want it to be in.
summary: The ability to create and control a metal that is immune to all psionic powers and effects
strengths: Covering yourself with the metal will protect you from all psionic effects and powers.
weaknesses: The metal can still be affected by magic.

name: Empathic Hydrokinesis
description: This power works by creating powerful psionic energy when a person feels strong emotions such as fear, anger, elation, etc. That energy can then be channelled into any desired source of water, thus granting the person total control of it, so as long as they remain in their heightened emotional state. They can create tsunamis, waterspouts, floods, and anything else desired with water.
summary: The ability to manipulate water through strong emotions
strengths: Use water as an extremely versatile weapon!
Can overpower fire if used with strong enough emotions
You can protect people without fear of them ever being harmed by your enemy!
weaknesses: Is extremely dangerous unless consciously controlled

name: Master Locksmith
description: This ability allows you to create a lock anywhere you can imagine one or, if there is already one there, pick it with your mind.
summary: The ability to make or pick locks at will
strengths: Never blocked out of anywhere
Keep posessions safe by making really complex locks
Never get locked out of anything again because no need for a key
weaknesses: If they use bars to hold the doors you cant pick it
You can still lose the object you lock
You could still get caught breaking in

name: Twist
description: Basically, by twisting the space around you, any attack will slide off you, making you impossible to hit. It does not work on attacks aimed at the mind, such as mind control, mind reading etc.
summary: The ability to twist the space around you.
strengths: Can't be hit by any physical attack.
weaknesses: Can be hit by attacks aimed at the mind.
Only works when you want it to.

name: Oblivious
description: You are unaffected by things that would change your feelings or thoughts toward something (girlfriend, TV show, etc. ) You cannot be brainwashed because it affects your thinking. You are unaffected by love potions because they affect your heart. Others scenarios are included.
summary: The ability to not be affected by charm spells, hypnotism, brain washing, etc.
strengths: You cannot be manipulated by someone else.
You cannot be hypnotized or charmed.
weaknesses: Can still have thoughts read, just not manipulated
You may not understand other people's feelings; Cold hearted or stone heart.
You might be also seem to be absent minded, dumb,or very mean. Not that you are.

name: Morality Meter
description: Infamous,Fable,MassEffect. The list goes on with moral decisions in games, But what about seeing them in life. Most people are irrational in certain areas and don't think with their brain. With Morality Meter your perception of time stops and you will be able to see a good neutral and bad choice you can possibly do. Friend being a royal pain? Don't know what to say to someone to not hurt feelings? Not with Morality Meter. It happens automatically and gives you the most appropriate response
summary: The ability to see every moral choice you can possibly do in a situation.
strengths: Can choose what moral choices to make.
Can be the most rational person in a situation.
Never say something you would take back ever again.
weaknesses: Time stops and moral conundrums might get annoying after a bit.
If you feel angry you can choose bad choices
You can be too much of a goody two-shoes

name: Superhuman Perception Zone
description: Using this power makes you omniscient on a certain area of range. When using this ability you can see every single detail of every single thing around you. You know what is everyone thinking, what everything is made of, everything in this small zone. Although its really powerful, this ability makes you really tired and while using it, you fall in a deep sleeping state.  The initial range of the power is a small living room, but it can be increased. The sleeping state lasts at least 30 minutes
summary: The ability to become totally omniscient on a small specific area.
strengths: If you are in a criminal scene, you can solve the crime in seconds using this power.
You can locate a hidden person or a lost object.
Using this power you can solve the Da Vinci's code easily!
weaknesses: While using this you become really vulnerable, so you might need to have someone to protect you.
This ability makes you exhausted and using it too much could ruin your mind.
Increasing range is very dangerous; 30 minutes can't be shortened.

name: Tactile Thought Projection
description: This is a Twilight power. Tactile thought projection is the ability to place the user's thoughts and memories  into another person's mind. This power allows the user to project his or her thoughts into  another person's mind in the form of vivid pictures, thoughts and feelings, and requires  physical contact. It works best in communicating with others when words are not  suited to the purpose. One can hijack the user's power to access his/her dreams by  placing their hand on their faces.
summary: The ability to project aspects of your mind.
strengths: Showing people your life story.
Non verbal communication.
weaknesses: Mind invasion while you sleep.
Physical contact needed.

name: Musical Influence
description: The subject who owns this power has a deep affiliation with music, so deep that he/she can acquire a superpower every time he/she listen to a specific song. The power he/she obtains depends from: 1. The meaning of the song; 2. The text, the melody and the rythm of the song; 3. The subjective emotions inspired by that song to the owner.
summary: The ability to gain a superpower by listening to a specific song.
strengths: A very wide range of acquirable powers, as various as the existing songs;
The most appreciated is the song, the most powerful will be the received power.
weaknesses: A silly song will give a useless power;
The song must be listened entirely.

name: Mirage Inducing
description: Mirage Inducing is a version of Illusion in which the user can generate illusions which last, and are completely real, as long as targets don't know that they are illusions. One with this ability could cause any type of illusion they desire, but the second someone calls out "it's not real! " or shakes subjects out of their deluded state or subjects see the illusionist working his power, the illusions wear off entirely (until they can go unnoticed again).
summary: The ability to conjure illusions that are real as long as people think they are
strengths: Cast powerful, convincing illusions
They can affect and interact with the environment as though they were real
Requires little concentration, and the power gets much stronger over time
weaknesses: Partly requires others' mental power (belief, fear, etc) or one's own self-delusion to work
If subjects are shaken out of their deluded state or catch the user casting the illusion
Perspicuity (Mental Immunity), Anti-Telepathy and similar abilities provide immunity

name: The Power Of Random
description: You can change your power whenever you want but you can't control what power you get. With some training and practice you might be to control what type of power it is. You know,mental,biological,supernatural,ect. But without you could get any no matter what.
summary: The ability to change your power randomly whenever.
strengths: Many uses.
Unique power!
Can control what type of power you get with practice.
weaknesses: Get a stupid power.

name: Modern Science
description: Science has many great powers. It has carried us through many problems. You can control and invoke the forces of any modern day science. This includes physics, biology, chemistry, astronomy, psychology, and geology.
summary: The ability to manipulate the forces of modern day science.
strengths: Very powerful
As science evolves, so does this power.
weaknesses: May not understand your power at first

name: Thought Breaker
description: If you want to break something such as someone's bones or breaking a light, all you have to is think about it and will it to happen.
summary: The ability to break things with a simple thought in mind.
strengths: You can break an enemy's bones with a simple thought
You can not be accused of something that you didn't touch
It's the thought that counts
weaknesses: If you think of something and will it to happen it will happen.
You have to control your thoughts a little more when you are angry

name: Psi Armor
description: When activated, this power covers you in a layer of psionic energy that negates physically based psychic attacks, such as telekinesis or pyrokinesis. Any attempt at using such powers on you fails, with the attack just bouncing off or sliding past. However, this does not prevent indirect attacks, such as throwing a car with your mind. It also is ineffective against any kind of mental attack, such as telepathic mind control.
summary: The ability to create armor that protects from some kinds of psychic attack.
strengths: Protection from pesty kinetic powers.
Allows you to fight psychics more easily.
weaknesses: Doesn't protect from indirect attacks
Or from telepathy.

name: Psionic Blast
description: Using this power, you can blast psychic energy at a person or group of people. This energy psychically attacks the mind causing either pain, memory loss, unconsciousness to even brain death if you use that much power. The downside is it takes great mental concentration and it is possible to easily exhaust yourself. Also, you cannot read or communicate psychically, its just used for offensive and defensive attacks.
summary: The ability to blast powerful psychic energy.
strengths: Attack people's minds.
weaknesses: Takes great  focus.
Easily become fatigued and weak if you used too much power.
Not telepathic.

name: Location Memory
description: Just by being in an area, you instantly learn everything that had happened in that square mile in the past year. You can dim it down so it does not distract you but you can not turn it off.
summary: The ability to learn what had happened in the past at any location.
strengths: Be an awsome detective.
Learn what you forgot about the party last night.
Find out who stole your car and where they went.
weaknesses: No physical ability.
Going to public restrooms.
Still having to go find your stolen car.

name: Myth Power: Kronos' Craft
description: Kronos (Cronos, Cronus, Khronos, Chronos, Chronus), in Greek myth, was the Titan god of time. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive the passage of time, at will. In addition, one can withstand temporal effects. Furthermore, one can psychically manipulate the flow of time, and psychically travel through time, at will. One can also psychically perform feats of Telepathy and Telekinesis across time, at will. One can even psychically project temporal energy blasts, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Kronos' command over the essence of the passage of time
strengths: Psychically perceive the passage of time, at will; withstand temporal effects
Psychically access Chronokinesis and Time Travel, at will
Psychically access Temporal Telepathy and Telekinesis, project Temporal Blasts, at will
weaknesses: Temporal anomalies and paradoxes are likely to ensue, if timeline not altered carefully (NCN)
Anachronism, Unpredictability and Attunement to Time provide resistance (NCN)
Time Defiance, MythPowers based on Kronos' parents, siblings and offspring provide immunity (NCN)

name: Essence Conduit
description: The user can create a telepathic link to all things that have an essence. With the connection, they will be able to create a duplicate of the thing they are connected to with their own essence. Depending on the thing they are copying, the user will lose a certain amount of themselves but will control the duplicate. If the duplicate is destroyed, the original will not die for it is the users essence. You will be restored in the process.
summary: The ability to connect to anything that has an essence and create and manipulate a duplicate with your essence.
strengths: Be connected to all things that have an essense.
Create a duplicate to control.
Can make more than one duplicate as well as have different duplicates at the same time.
weaknesses: Uses a certain amount of essence to create a duplicate.
Beware of using all of your essence.

name: Shadow Wrap
description: With this power shadows wrap around your forearms and will harm anything that comes near you with hostile intent. You cannot control the shadows in any way as they are automatically controlled by your mind's desire to protect itself.
summary: The ability to have the shadows wrap around one's forearms in order to protect oneself
strengths: A good defensive power.
Don't need to concentrate to use this power.
weaknesses: Can't control the shadows protecting you.
The shadows automatically attack anyone with hostile intent nearby even if it is not towards you.

name: Alert Spheres
description: There is not much to say about this ability. The user produces the orbs that stay where the user places them mentally. When any moving object comes near it, they will be triggered and attack the object. They also make a thunderous sound to warn the user.
summary: The ability to generate stationary energy orbs that will strike any moving object.
strengths: Good guards
Warns you
weaknesses: Will not move when placed
Cannot make exceptions, also strikes allies

name: Empathic Self Healing
description: By using this ability, the person can transfer any wound or illness they have to another person as long as they are near them.
summary: The ability to heal yourself by transfering the wound or illness to another person.
strengths: Can hurt anyone you don't like by harming yourself.
weaknesses: Have to transfer it onto another person.
The person using this ability still feels pain.

name: Ambush Detector V2
description: With this power you will instantly know if somebody is planning on ambushing you. You don't have to be near the person or even know who the person is but if they want to ambush you a faint beeping will go off in your head and you will know wear the ambush is set up, who planned the ambush and who is part of it.
summary: The ability to instantly know if someone is planning on ambushing you
strengths: You will know if someone want to ambush you
weaknesses: Not much use if nobody wants to ambush you

name: Forced Choice
description: You are able to sense when someone in your vicinity has to make a decision, as well as the choices they have if there are any. You can then force them to select any choice you want. Unless they can detect mental intrusions, the victim will be left with the feeling that they made a free selection, whether it turns out to be a good or a bad one. Even if someone made up their mind about something, the slightest hesitation is an opening to make them change their decision.
summary: The ability to force someone's choice.
strengths: Your victim will have the feeling that they made their choice on their own.
You can affect any choice, whether it's talking to a girl, choosing a card, commiting a suicide,...
You can use this power on yourself. It reinforces your determination to do whatever you want to do.
weaknesses: A weak form of persuasion. You can only affect someone if they have a decision to make.
Even if you made up their mind for them, they can still hesitate and change their choice.

name: Love Manipulation
description: Love is one of the most powerful powers because it can destroy people and make them only focused on love. You can make yourself and others attractive and you can make people fall in love. You can also sense when people are in love and when they are not. See, love is like a magnet; with this power you can have an army of people willing to do anything for you even if it kills them.
summary: The ability to manipulate love and hypnotize people with your beauty.
strengths: Can get anything you want
Can get hot guys or girls
Can be really attractive
weaknesses: You have to face havings thousands of people coming up to you a day
Your beauty can make people do anything for you

name: Arachnomancy
description: You have three benefits with this ability. One. You can study the web patterns of the spiders and see a short distance into the future/past. Two. You can summon and control the actions of a horde of spiders. The horde can be a mixed bag of different species and genders. Your power stops any natural behavior that would prevent a mixed horde of spiders from working with each other. Thirdly, you can share the senses of and communicate psychically/empathically with any spider.
summary: The ability to control arachnids for attack, perception and seeing through time.
strengths: Command massive hordes of arachnids (not just spiders, if you develop your ability).
You can look at a web and see a brief distance into the future or the past.
Sense what arachnids sense, communicate with them psychically and empathically
weaknesses: Spiders are easily squished.
All spiders don't have deadly poison.
You'll need to find a free or cheap source of insects to feed your spider horde.

name: Shadow Guardian
description: You unconsciously give life to a Shadow Guardian as a result of your mental energy being uncapped. This Guardian will protect you by any means necessary so Guardian control via thought command is a must if you didn't want it to kill. You can merge with your Guardian and share its darkforce energy which allows for numerous shadow-based abilities, such as shadow slipping. A byproduct of this power is a passive mind over matter ability which gives you an extremely high pain threshold.
summary: The ability to use Darkforce energy through your Shadow Guardian
strengths: A Guardian that protects you at all times
Use of darkforce
weaknesses: Difficulty in controlling an angry Guardian
Your Guardian can influence your personality
Your Guardian isn't bound by morality

name: Memory Force
description: Using all your memories and emotions, you can send all of it to your palm and send out a blast of energy.
summary: The ability to generate memories and emotions into force.
strengths: You can use good memories and happiness as a shield.
You can also use a memory and emotion to increase your agility.
You can also use a memory and or emotion to increase your speed.
weaknesses: Using too much force and memories can make you tired for a few minutes.
Using it on machines can malfunction a machine and may even destroy it.

name: Psychic Photography
description: When you take pictures of someone, their deepest secrets show up on the photographs as a colorful cloud twirling around them with relevant pictures and words in it. The cloud reflects the nature of the secrets and the person's feelings. A thin part represents doubts or suspicions. A massive part represents a heavy or important secret. Dark colors are for shame, guilt or sick intentions. Light colors are for lightheartedness or innocent secrets. Bright colors are for important promises or vows.
summary: The ability to capture people's secrets on photographs.
strengths: Every paparazzi and tabloid's dream.
Discover anyone's secrets.
Works with any type of camera.
weaknesses: The results are not always explicit and are open to interpretations.
The target has to be isolated in the picture or there will be clusters of secrets.

name: Bending Shield
description: When activated this power makes long-range physically-based attacks go in a semicircle around you. This prevents the damage from actually affecting you in the first place. This power CANNOT be made to affect mental attacks instead of physical ones and is not passive.
summary: The ability to make attacks go around you instead of through you
strengths: Attacks won't hurt you.
weaknesses: Only affects distance-based attacks.
Does not affect telepathic attacks.
Unaffected by Con Negation and similar powers.

name: The King's Champion
description: The King's Champion power compells a single individual to become devoted to serving and protecting you permanently. This compulsion lasts untill the champion dies. In the case of the champion being killed, the champion's killer becomes the next individual compelled to be champion. If the champion dies in any other way, or if you kill the champion yourself, you may then compel another individual to become your champion. You may have no more than one champion at any given time.
summary: The ability to compel a single being to protect and serve you untill killed, in turn, compelling whoever killed it
strengths: Always have a champion to protect and serve you.
Each time your champion is killed, you gain a more powerful champion.
Free butler, maid, jester and bodyguard.
weaknesses: This power involves lots of slavery and death.
This power permanently ruins the lives of others.
Champions can be needy with thier compulsion to serve and make sure that you're O. K.

name: Mind Melding
description: You can link any two minds together to have them think exactly the same, or alter a chain of thoughts the other person thinks. Much like regular thinking, except thinking for someone else.
summary: The ability to change or trade another's thoughts
strengths: You could help a friend cheat on a test, or give their thoughts to yourself
You can make two people angry at one another, or the exact opposite
You can play with your rivals', and friends', minds by sending weird messages
weaknesses: If you link to someone else's mind, they can hear you also
Tuning into another person's mind shuts out all hearing except for their mind

name: Deepest Desire
description: This power grants you the ability to cause anyone's deepest desire to come true. This is very similar to granting wishes, but some rules apply: you can only use this power once per person, you cannot use this on yourself, and the person may have no control over what their deepest desire is (they might not even know what it is). When using this power, you'll hear a badass sound so you know it worked. But choose wisely, though. If their deepest desire is for you to be dead... Well, you'll be dead.
summary: The ability to make anyone's deepest desire come true.
strengths: Bring people's deepest desires into reality
Your powers aren't merely an illusion; they're real
You will garner respect and reverence!
weaknesses: Someone's deepest desire might change physics or disrupt the natural order of things
Using this on depressed people. They might not be desiring the happiest things.
You can't use this on yourself. The only way it affects you is if someone else desires it.

name: Fallproofing
description: Also called Fall Protection or Fall-Induced Invulnerability, this is a specified form of invulnerability in which one cannot take damage from any fall, no matter how high up, or what you land on. When the user's mind subliminally perceives that they are falling, the user's invulnerability is triggered to keep the user from dying from the impact of the fall. After the user perceives that they are no longer falling, their vulnerability goes back to normal.
summary: The ability to be totally invulnerable to tripping or falling damage
strengths: Makes skateboarding, bike-riding and rock-climbing way more fun
Makes skydiving A LOT more fun--no more need for that pesky parachute
If you trip or fall off of something, you can just get back up, no matter HOW far you fall
weaknesses: If you ever try to commit suicide by hanging yourself or jumping off a building, good luck
Landing from a fall or being tripped still hurts, even if you don't get a bruise or scratch
Bottomless pits REALLY suck

name: Panmnesia (Total Recall)
description: Interchangeably called Panmnesia, Hypermnesia, Total Recall or Perfect Memory, this is the ability to easily remember (and recall) everything that one has ever experienced, learned or encountered in one's lifetime, regardless of how you acquire the information (visually, verbally, via smells, etc. ). This includes everything from the time the user's power manifests (and the power may be present from birth).
summary: The ability to remember everything that one has ever experienced in one's lifetime
strengths: Remember important facts, figures, dates, times, events, etc. (and recall them at will)
Even if you get distracted from doing a task, you don't forget important things you have to do
Memory cannot be manipulated externally (but is also not consciously present all the time)
weaknesses: If power is weak, all of one's memories WILL always be consciously present (mental bombardment)
Your memories CAN be manipulated (fairly rare, but it happens)
Doesn't mean you automatically understand info (remedied by memorizing definitions/formulas, etc.)

name: Idiosyncratic Theft
description: This ability will strike people were it hurts, their hearts. What is tucked inside their heart, their prized possession. This ability takes it away so that the user can control it. Basically, the user has a partial mind reading ability that only allows them to know what is their target's most prized thing nothing more. This ability can be dangerous, because the user can develope a coveting problem if not stopped.
summary: The ability to obtain a another person's most prized possession (power, person, or object) and control it.
strengths: Take a person's most prized possession
Use it as a shield against the victim
Use it to bargain with your victim
weaknesses: Might develope a coveting disorder

name: Music Generation
description: With this power you can cause any song to start playing out of nowhere. Everybody around you will hear the song until you either change decide to change it or stop the music completely.
summary: The ability to make any song start playing randomly
strengths: You can cause any song or musical composition to start playing out of nowhere
Everyone around you will hear the song but they will have no idea where it's coming from
You can change the songs or stop the music completely whenever you want
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: God Of Words
description: Tired of being wrong all the time?  Well, with this power, anything and everything you say will automatically come true!  Simply say "I know the answers to this test" and the answers will flow into your mind!  Also use this ability to get back at people who hurt you or improve your bank account with a whisper!
summary: The ability to always be right.
strengths: Always be right
Your word is law
Make yourself into a super being with a word
weaknesses: Must watch what you say
May affect reality in unwanted ways
Don't be like Timmy Turner

name: Power Ritual
description: Basically, you can create rituals that can give people powers. One ritual can only ever give one specific power. Ex. One ritual could give Telepathy while another ritual gives Immortality. The better the power is the more complicated or physically-damaging the ritual is. Also, only someone with this power can perform or initiate the rituals on others. 'Omni' powers are beyond what any ritual can give and thus cannot be gained.
summary: The ability to give people powers by performing rituals on them
strengths: People will probably pay to gain powers.
weaknesses: You have to think up multiple rituals if you want to help others gain multiple different powers.
Strong powers are harder to gain.
This power will not do anything for powers that can only be gained one way.

name: Dream Invader
description:
This ability allows you to invade another person's dream. You can only use this ability while asleep and your victim must be asleep too.
While in their dreams you can cause a person to have unbearable nightmares or you can lock a person inside their dream.
summary: The ability to invade another's dream.
strengths: Make people you hate have nightmares.
weaknesses: You have to be asleep to use your ability.

name: Blessing Of Morpheus
description: Morpheus is the Greek god of dreams and sleep. His blessing allows you to have various effects over his realm. You can control your own and others' dreams, and mentally enter another's dreams. Also, you can force people and things to sleep and control for how long they do.
summary: The ability to have the Blessing of Morpheus
strengths: Controlling dreams
"Sleeping" people and things(turning off a TV, shutting down a car, etc. )
weaknesses: Until you can control your power, everything around you will sleep.

name: Transcendent Dominator
description:
With a simple grabbing gesture of the hand this power enables you to instantly snatch a super powered target and use him as an acquired ability. 

This removes the target from this realm, sending him into a non dimensional pocket within your existence where he will remain in a mindless/non-sentient and will-broken state as a superpower for you to use for all of eternity.
summary: The ability to manipulate, take possession of, and use a super powered being as an acquired ability.
strengths: Gives access to all abilities the target has acquired.
This ability ignores space/distance between you & the target. In effect it also disregards barriers.
Ideally useful against targets with 'Power Hold' because of their existence as one with superpowers.
weaknesses: Can only be used against super powered beings.
Effects cannot be undone. Targets with powers like Craktart or suicidal abilities are threats.
Range: 10 miles around the user. Beyond that this power is useless.

name: Duplicity
description: By simply tapping into the power of Loki, one would have the ability to harness any capability that helps to deceive or trick people, and start chaos; the primary ones being the power of shapeshifting, illusion, lying with a straight face (and no bodily changes) and the power to subliminally compel people to believe one's lies in the same way a person with psychic persuasion (mind control) subliminally compels you to follow their orders.
summary: The ability to have the power of Loki and harness the forces of deception and trickery
strengths: Pwn lie detectors (the machines and people with the power)
Never get caught doing mischief
Make enemies turn against each other
weaknesses: Sometimes you have to worship Loki to get these powers
Um, nothing else, it's like a god power.

name: Neuro Kinesis
description: Pain, touch, perception of cold, all of it can be administered or removed using Neuro-kinesis. A telepathic ability, the user can force enemies into submission through intense pain, sexually stimulate a person to get them into a comedic mishap or even just lessen the effects of cold or heat on another person mildly. This power has several different uses and can be used primarily to cause or ease pain, making it suitable for good or bad people.
summary: The ability to alter physical feeling.
strengths: Can change your or others' perceptions of the immediate environment.
Never have to worry about feeling hot, cold or in pain ever again.
Can make death less painful for others or yourself (or more, if that's cool with you).
weaknesses: Can form an addiction to numbness.
Pain is natural and needed for a healthy body. Being always numb could lead to potential death.
If someone else has this power, they are immune to its effects.

name: Mystic Eyes Of Death Sight
description: Full title: Mystic Eyes of Death Perception. Upon activation, their owner may "perceive death" in the form of red lines and dots. The user in question is the only one who can see, touch or use these lines and dots. Lines be traced with any held blade which cuts the line and inflicts damage which cannot be healed or repaired. Dots can also be pierced by sharp weapons, which effectively erases that object or creature from existence. The user's irises will glow blue when these eyes activate.
summary: The ability to destroy anything by perceiving and cutting its mystic weak points.
strengths: These eyes allow their users to destroy nearly anything that has a concrete, physical existence.
Users will have 100% accuracy and superhuman speed when attempting to cut or pierce a line or dot.
The depth of a cut is always magnified. Ex: Users can easily slice through boulders thrown at them.
weaknesses: A user must fight with a held blade to use this ability. There is no benefit for ranged weapons.
Using blunter objects to sever or pierce, such as fingers, will require much more effort.
Size is the only limit: extremely colossal targets, such as planets and moons, cannot be destroyed.

name: Pyropathy
description: Pyropathy is a specialized form of telepathy which only circles around fire.
