With this power you would be able to start fires in someones mind which can cause mental explosions or sweating because you are heating the hypothalamus. This is definetely not to be confused with pyrokinesis. You could also burn someone's memory away, create illusions of fire, and in some cases see the future through fire(Pyromancy).
summary: The ability to stimulate anything fire related into the mind of someone else
strengths: It can be very useful against those wo are afraid of fire
Can erase people's memories
You could heat an ally if there are close to hypothermia
weaknesses: Can cause severe headaches
May accidently erase too much of a persons memory
Can be activated by extreme anger so you might harm others unintentionally

name: Arcana 18: The Moon
description: You possess an aura that enhances mental powers, imagination and creativity within in. The longer a person remains within the aura, the strength of the enhancement increases, however, prolonged exposure to the aura can have negative effects. This can include dream-like states, hallucinations, poor emotional control, odd delusions and eventual psychological meltdowns. This can be prevented by taking a break from the aura. You may allow the aura to affect or not affect you as you desire.
summary: The ability to enhance mental powers and creativity.
strengths: You may enhance your or allies creativity, imagination or mental powers.
You can cause people to dissolve into insanity just by being around them.
Your aura expands when you are exposed to its effects.
weaknesses: You are not immune to the negatives of prolonged exposure.
Insanity caused by this power can cause random outburst of telepathic noise or illusions.

name: Derailment
description: A person with this power has the ability to get others to think the same thing as them for 10 seconds. For example, you can derail a serious conversation by talking about getting burgers, then the other party will start discussing about burgers until they realize that you just tricked them again with this power. The power lasts for 10 seconds, but the other party might continue to be in the same train of thought after 10 seconds is up. They might actually want burgers now that you suggested it.
summary: The ability to pull others into your own train of thought for 10 seconds
strengths: Derail conversations and get people to help you
Its hilarious to use just like a comedy gag---try not to laugh at the stuff you get to happen
Can work on groups of people
weaknesses: If not trained this power might happen subconsciously(which can be terrible)
After 10 seconds, the other person(s) realizes what they are doing
If the user's thoughts are too complicated this power will not work

name: Text Commands
description: With this power, you are able to write and type hypnotic commands that people will automatically obey upon reading them.  Whether something you write is actually a command is entirely up to your intent while you write it.   You can be as vague or specific as you want with your commands.  Upon completing their tasks, people will not remember reading your commands and will have thought they acted on their own unless you specify otherwise in their command.
summary: The ability to write and type commands that people will perform upon reading them.
strengths: People will follow your written commands automatically.
You can determine whether something your write is a command or not.
By default, people will not remember being controlled upon completing their tasks.
weaknesses: Will not work if the target does not have the required knowledge to perform the task.
Will not work if the command is physically impossible for the target to perform.
May result in controlling people you never intended on controlling if the wrong people read your commands.

name: Geological Empathy
description: Geopathy is the ability to connect ones self with earth materials. The person can feel the earth and everthing that is happening to a specific area. The ability can also change geological objects and materials by projecting the landscape as a hologram, which then can be used to change it.
summary: The ability to connect to, feel, and control earthly materials
strengths: You can see and feel the earth.
You can talk to the earth.
weaknesses: Sometimes you may hear many voices if you are near a lot of geological materials.

name: Altor's Shield
description: You can be safe from any illusions, mental manipulation, telekinesis, any time control, any sort of powers as long as you're inside the shield. Kind of like nullification, but that'ss only while youre inside the shield. The shield is also physical, so if someone tries to hit you while you're in the shield, they'd be repelled. It takes little time to erect the shield, like 30 seconds. The shield will stay as long as you are conscious and you will it to.
summary: The ability to shield yourself from any other super power or anything physical.
strengths: You are safe from any attacks
You can protect others with this
You won't be defeated
weaknesses: If you're taken by surprise, then you will most likely lose
You can only protect those standing close to you
You have to erect your shield

name: Outta Sight, Outta Mind
description: Outta Sight, Outta mind, right? This lets you make anything you want, *Poof* Disappear. No matter the size, or what its made of, You can make it invisible for as long as you want. No restrictions, just don't forget to make the object visible again. It doesn't have to be the whole object, it can be just a finger or toe or hair. It can even be something or someone on TV.
summary: The ability to make anything invisible for as long as you want.
strengths: Rob banks without getting caught on camera.
Make Secret item (Cherished or handed down) Invisible so no one will steal it.
Make anyone or anything you see on TV disappear.
weaknesses: Can Still be seen on thermal detectors, or heartbeat sensors.
Can still be Injured while invisible.
May accidently make National monuments disappear.

name: Molecule Separation
description: You can separate your molecules so that you can become invisible and things can pass through you, but you can't go through walls or anything like that. With your molecules separated, you become light and can somewhat fly or float, too. If you become too emotional, your molecules could separate without you wanting them to and if you are invisible and you become shocked or become emotional, they can come back together.
summary: The ability to separate your molecules so you become invisible.
strengths: Become invisible
Can fly somewhat
weaknesses: Could become invisible without you wanting to.
Could become visible again without wanting to.

name: Contagion
description: Also called Contagious Contact, one with this ability can project and receive numerous mental and bodily conditions simply by touching subjects. One with this ability can project or receive thoughts, emotions, behaviors, psychic imprints, compulsions or the like. In addition, they could also project or receive illnesses.
summary: The ability to pass on and receive conditions by touch
strengths: Project thoughts, emotions, behaviors and psychic imprints onto others by touch
Receive (hear or sense) thoughts, emotions, behaviors and psychic imprints of others by touch
Pass on (or receive) illnesses, skills and superpowers
weaknesses: At the lower levels, conditions passed on involuntarily (accidentally sicken others, etc. )
At the lower levels, conditions received involuntarily (accidentally take on sickness, etc. )
At the lower levels, being compelled is much easier (they just have to touch you)

name: Super Perception
description: One can instantly see out of place things that one would have to either be alert for or trained to find.  Behaviors like tics, nervous habits, and even faked emotion stand out to the user.  Even things like a missing or unusual objects and a different physical atmosphere becomes apparant.  This power is almost completely visual, in that the user must be able to see to perceive through his/her other senses.
summary: The ability to notice instantly suspicious or out-of-place things
strengths: You can tell when people are acting suspiciously
You instantly recognize hidden messages
Easily win at Where's Waldo and Eye-Spy
weaknesses: Not all perceptions necessarily indicate danger
Sometimes you wish you didn't notice some guy picking his nose
It helps if you're not blind.

name: Shadow Of Mara
description: You have the power to overwhelm the victim's senses to be fully blocked off by his/her surroundings. You can convince them to do your bidding by giving them their most desirable temptations, or fully immobilize them to the point of paralysis, coma, or even death by giving them the darkest fears they have. The victim does not even know where he/she really is. It is an extremely powerful mind manipulator.
summary: The ability to cover all the victim(s') five senses with illusions and false realities.
strengths: You can affect as many as a hundred, or even a thousand.
You can make the victims be fully convinced in their false reality.
You can even affect them in their sleep.
weaknesses: This power will more likely turn you to the dark side.
You may be susceptible to mind control unless you activate this power first.
This power will not work if your opponent has "Eye Of Awakening"

name: Emotional Empowerment
description: With this power, you can be everything from invincible to being able to cause attraction from another person. This power obviously works with your emotions. This power works in making you physically different, to affecting the emotions of others, such as fear or love.
summary: The ability to become empowered by your emotions
strengths: If you're emotional, you can become god-like
Any babe you want is yours
Completely unstoppable if in the zone
weaknesses: Emotionally challenged people wouldn't be good at this
Could affect your logic
Your sadness could cause people to kill themselves

name: Pov
description: You will be able to witness things from afar via another person. You will mentally sync with another person & be able to see things from there eyes & hear from their ears. You have to previously known the person you will psychically use as a vessel. Also it doesn't work if the person is blind or deaf and if the person dies or is dead.
summary: The ability to mentally see & hear through the eyes & ears of a person
strengths: Point of view from another person
Your power works globally
weaknesses: Have to have known or met  the person
If the person is handicapped (blind or deaf) it doesn't work
Also if the person is dying or dead the power can't be used

name: Greatest Desire Manifestation
description: The user can reach into their mind and find their most greatest desire. At this point, the user can make their greatest desire come true whenever they choose. This power can only be used once, meaning only the user's MOST greatest desire comes true and none of the rest of the user's desires do. If the user's most greatest desire changes, but they've already used the power, then they're out of luck.
summary: The ability to pinpoint your greatest desire and make it come true
strengths: Pinpoint your greatest desire and make it come true
weaknesses: Only the user's MOST greatest desire comes true and none of the rest of the user's desires do
If your most greatest desire changes after the power's been used, it's too late

name: Ultimate Form
description: You can transform into a humanoid form made of pure energy. It has power beyond belief. It cannot get damaged in any way. This form is also uncontrollable. It will destroy anything and anyone to serve justice. Even if it means destroying the whole world to achieve world peace. You can only control it if you have a pure heart, stupendous physical and mental discipline, and a vast amount of willpower.
summary: The ability to transform into the ultimate form with unimaginable power.
strengths: Incredible power beyond belief.
Invulnerability
Able to stop anyone with a simple glance at them.
weaknesses: Uncontrollable
Will destroy anyone or anything that will get in the way of world peace.

name: Lucid Dreaming
description: A person with this power always has lucid dreams. This lets them control every aspect of their dream. In addition they can use this power even when they are pulled into someone else's dream in ways such as mind contraption. When two lucid dreamers exist in the same dream the person with the stronger mind and willpower becomes dominant. In a lucid dream you are invincible because your thoughts become reality. As long as you believe what you are doing you can do anything.
summary: The ability to always have lucid dreams
strengths: Take that Freddy Krueger--you can beat him at his own game
Be the hero even in your nightmares
No dream manipulator can beat you and you can shut off the dream at will
weaknesses: Only works in dreams
Sleepwalking--if you first gain this power
Once you learn to control it you can do anything within your dreamworld

name: Latent Power Activator
description: Can 'reach' in to a person's mind and 'turn on' their powers. This results with them gaining powers and you becoming a little tired. You can only use this power on those with no powers.
summary: The ability to psychically activate powers that haven't revealed themselves
strengths: Could get rich selling your services.
Everyone has a latent power even if it is just better memory.
Good counter to Latent Power Absorption
weaknesses: Can't use this power on yourself.
Not much battle use.
No peace and quiet from those who want their powers activated.

name: Personal Demon Inducement
description: This ability is a mental power. This ability allows one to induce other people's hidden mental problems in the form of pesky demons. They will taunt and torment them until their eventual self- destruction. The user can induce new issues to their victims as well. For example, if a victim suffer a major failure, the user can create mental demons to poke fun at that failure. The demons are mental, they can only seen by the victim.
summary: The ability to induce psychological issues in the form of demons onto people
strengths: Torture victims
The demons are invisible to other people
weaknesses: Victims can overcome them if they beat their problems

name: Via Curious Control
description: Through a pyschic link, your mind takes over someone else's. You yourself are still in your body, but you're remotely controlling whoever you want. Every experience is experienced by both persons. Only emotions and death are not experienced by you.
summary: The ability to control someone remotely and expirence what they do
strengths: You can experience multiple lives in one lifetime.
You can fulfill desires of all kinds. Wether good or bad
Your able to go, do, learn, and experience things you never could before.
weaknesses: If you try to completely changing someone else's life it can either turn against you or stop working
The link can only work for a day up to a year then this person is no longer accesible to you.
You can have multiple links but only one person can be controlled at a time.

name: Astral Projection
description:
Using this power allows you to go into a trance & astral project yourself to a psychic dimensional plane. You can communicate with spirits & you can astrally appear & communicate to people & enter their dreams. You can also astrally trap another person in the psychic plane so they can't go back to their body. But using this power, you only have a 24 hr. period or your body will fall into a catatonic state. Also while in
trance, you are left defenseless.
summary: The ability to mentally have an out of body experience
strengths: Spiritually appear anywhere
Communicate with the dead
Astral trap another astral projected person
weaknesses: You only have 24 hr out of body before your body goes into a coma or catatonic state
Your body is left defenseless

name: Alarm Clock
description: With this power, you never need to hit the snooze button again. Using your mind alone, you can set an internal alarm clock that wakes you up at a specific time or after a specific length of time. But here's the best part: Be it 5 minutes or 5 hours, you always feel COMPLETELY refreshed when you wake up. You can also purposely knock yourself out for things like surgery, MRIs, class, and that strange curiosity you have about what it's like to fall asleep at the wheel.
summary: The ability to sleep for a specific amount of time and always wake up completely refreshed.
strengths: Always wake up feeling refreshed no matter how little you sleep.
Stay up all night or go to bed with the rest of the world (heyooo)--your choice.
Nyquil's got nothin' on you
weaknesses: You might miss that exhausting, tired dragging you get after sleepless nights. Wait... No you won't!
You won't be able to relate with people who feel tired in the morning
You might get carried away with those wild dreams you keep having

name: Decimation
description: Devistating if used by the wrong people because it can be used to destroy continents.
summary: The ability to destroy anything with a simple thought
strengths: Destroys anything easily
Can be used to get to what you're headed for quickly
weaknesses: If in the wrong hands it could be used to destroy continents
Too destructive to be used by the inexperienced

name: People Person
description: With you mind you put every trait that you would want that person to have and in a matter of moments they will appear
summary: The ability to create an infinite amount of people in any image, physical attributes, personality you want
strengths: You can "play" God
You can make the perfect person
You can make super soldiers
weaknesses: You "play" God
The creations might rebel like Frankenstein
You might miss some details

name: Empathic Blast
description: Empathic Blast is the ability to generate a blast out of pure emotions (perhaps a specific emotion or numerous combined) which imposes said emotions on whoever is hit; OR it may vary in intensity based on the emotions of the user; OR effects may vary based on emotions (happy means a good effect, etc. )
summary: The ability to fire a blast of emotional energy as an attack
strengths: Finally, a truly offensive use for empathy
It's actually a concussive attack
Blast is also potentially helpful, if used on a friend/loved one (boost confidence, numb pain)
weaknesses: Aniothability
Perspicuity
Empathic Backlash

name: Paradis Terrestre (Eden)
description: By fanning your wings, you can place your victim in an illusion by utilizing pollen. Now you evade all their normal senses, so you can assassinate him quickly.
summary: The ability to release a toxin that confuses all five senses
strengths: Produce madness inducing illusions
Kill your enemy while he/she's in a daze
Enemy has no way of counterattacking unless he's a wind user.
weaknesses: Have to be a Butterfly hybrid
Have to sleep for 24 hours after use
Can be blown away by a strong wind

name: Telesympathy
description: A person with this power does not have telepathy. They have no power over a person's thoughts based on reason. Instead, they have the ability to read people's emotions, motivations, and values. The person immediately knows what kind of person they are talking to and whether they are inherently good or bad in nature. In addition, they can send their emotions to others, so that others can understand their own emotions.
summary: The ability to tell and understand others' motivations, emotions, and values
strengths: You will be an excellent psychologist and can persuade people to turn good/evil
You understand people-something that millions, maybe billions of people can't do
This works in any language, since emotions and goals are universal
weaknesses: Another Pro: You can convey your own emotions back to others, similar to giving a speech
Doesn't work on machines and is less effective on completely rational people
You might be swayed to your opponents side, unless you have a strong will

name: Emotion Negation
description: With this power you can negate people's emotions. You can make it so that a person will never be angry or sad or happy or scared etc. You can give people back their emotions whenever you want.
summary: The ability to negate people's emotions
strengths: You can negate people's emotions
You can negate villain's emotions for anger making them good
weaknesses: You can't negate your own emotions

name: Flash Mnemonics
description: This ability is extremely rare, and very powerful. You can recall people you've met or thought of before, and also recall any kind of power or ability that someone had. It works through 'flashes' of someone you've seen or met, or of someone using an ability, such as regeneration or telekinesis. The user can then rely on the memory they have of someone to activate the same ability that that person displayed. It is different from empathic mimicry in that you rely on memory instead of empathy.
summary: The ability to recall people and/or powers through memories when in a dangerous situation
strengths: Flashbacks of abilities allow split-second replication of a power
Can be used in any dire situation
Once a person recalls someone, they get their ability permanently
weaknesses: Does not work if you aren't in a dire situation
You might remember someone with a dangerous ability

name: The Butterfly Effect
description: Just like in the movie you could go back in your life and choose to fix things in your past, see what really happened during certain moments, play out different scenarios, etc.
summary: The ability to go back into specific places in your life through the memory of that moment
strengths: Fix mistakes that you or others have made
Have fun with the question"what could have happened"
weaknesses: Can only  go as far back as your first memory
If you die in a memory, you will be completely erased from the world

name: Retrocognitive Projection
description: One with this ability needs only to be in an area for an instant, and they can pick up on psychic vibrations left behind by others who have been there. This psychic-vibration channeling allows the projections of a 3-D holographic image of the area's past. This can be used on any are previously visited by sentient/animated/living beings (people, ghosts and undead, plants, robots, aliens ALL count)
summary: The ability to produce images of the past of an area
strengths: Project the past of an area (who committed a crime, who took the cookie from the cookie jar, etc. )
Looks like the event is really happening (great form of illusion that few are immune to)
Psychic imprints are left in areas all the time
weaknesses: If a place has never been visited before, you could only project the scene of you visiting
If power is undeveloped, can't control how far back into the past to project (Stone Age, 1850's etc)
True Sight is able to see through this projection (the only powerc that CAN)

name: Bookworm Immunity
description: Matter of any form, energy of any form, psionic or magical damage, if you can understand how an attack might work you're immune to it. Viruses, poisons, venoms and also bacteria. This power will protect you from deadly gases, but not let you survive vacuum. However, it would let you survive extreme cold or heat. If you can grasp how reality altering works, then no one could erase you from reality. Know how telepathy works and no one could erase any knowledge from your mind.
summary: The ability to be unaffected by anything you can understand.
strengths: Most non-psionic or non-magical things will be easy to learn about.
The easiest immunities just require Internet access.
weaknesses: Reality alteration could require a genius level IQ.
Knowledge about something esoteric, like magic, could be hard to find.

name: Short Term Memory Eraser
description: It allows you to wipe out someone's short-term memory before the information has a chance to be consolidated in the long-term memory. You do not have to touch your target; you just need to be in their vicinity, allowing you to erase many people's short-term memory at the same time. Be aware that if some information had time to form enough connections with the long-term memory, the person will experience a sense of presque vu, as the information has disappeared but the connections still remain.
summary: The ability to erase someone's short-term memory.
strengths: You can erase anyone's memory of the last seconds or minute.
You JUST did something wrong? Quick! Wipe out everyone's memory!
You know how frustrating it is to feel you just forgot something but can't remember it at all?
weaknesses: There's a short time frame before a recent memory is either forgotten or remembered for a long time.
You can't select which information to erase. There's not much information to choose from anyway.
It's much less effective on people with Enhanced Memory, Infinite Memory Palace or Digital Mind.

name: Controle De Les Spirte
description: You can stop everything that is going on in this person's body and mind, including the heart. They're your own personal puppet. You can control up to 1000 people doing this. In battle, it'll be easy to kill your opponent. You can go into their mind and see their memories. You can't control them for more then 5 minutes though. Not even a mental shield can break this. It is strong and will cause awful pain to the victim once it is over. You will receive a headache after though.
summary: The ability to control someone's mind, body, soul, heart, and thoughts.
strengths: You can control anyone
You can control as much as 1000 people at once
You can kill them by just stopping their heart
weaknesses: You lose your common sense and mercy when you are doing this
You get a headache after
You lose at least 100 brain cells.

name: Induced Explosion
description: A person with Induced Explosion has one of the more dangerous abilities. By mentally damaging the atomic structure of an object, they make it so unstable it has to blow up. This ability is not limited to combustibles--wood, plastic, even metal can be made to blow up. However, it is limited to solids and takes active concentration to use.
summary: The ability to make objects explode
strengths: Blowing up cars
Can explode any solid object
Intimidation factor
weaknesses: No real peaceful use
Cannot make liquids/gases explode
Getting angry

name: Power Source
description: This power is sort of a telepathy/empathy-based power. The user can create a mental link with any superpowered being. Now, the user can tap into that power and store it somewhere in their mind. Now, the user can use that power whenever they want. The amount of powers the user can hold in their mind depends on their mental strength. If the user were to store too much power in their mind, it would most likely cause permanent brain damage, and judging on the amount, can possibly destroy the user.
summary: The ability to take power from the source of anyone's power.
strengths: Tap into other superpowered beings powers.
weaknesses: Limits to amount of power being stored in the mind.

name: Answer Me
description: With this power, everyone has to answer a question you impose and cannot attack you while they are answering questions since their mind is preoccupied.   After the question is answered the person forgets that he/she answered the question.  If the other person does not know the answer then the other person will go into a trance and will move to find the answer.  If it is a math problem the other person will go into "calculator mode" and attempt to calculate the answer
summary: The ability to make anyone answer your question truthfully
strengths: Get info on people and person forgets that he/she answered
Forced calculation-make anyone into a human calculator
Can be used to blackmail or prevent blackmail
weaknesses: You can only get what people think is the right answer
If the answer cannot be answered then other person's mind becomes entranced
If you ask a rhetorical question this ability activates even on yourself

name: Shadow Stealing
description: You can steal people's shadows with this power, and when you do, they not only lose their shadow, but they lose their reflection, their voice, their emotions and their opinions (as well as their need to blink, eat, sleep, rest or breathe). It's like they don't exist (and nobody can perceive them except you). And that's perfect, because during this time of "nonexistence", they become entirely loyal to you, and do whatever you want.
summary: The ability to steal the shadows of others, gaining total control over them
strengths: Steal a person's shadow, and they become totally-loyal servants
They lose their emotions, their opinions and their need to eat, sleep or breathe
Only you can perceive them (and you can control them mentally)
weaknesses: Some users can't communicate mentally with their minions (looks like you're talking to yourself)
Umbrakinetics, Immutables and people with Fixed Forms can keep their shadows
The subjects that become your minions aren't mindless, but they try to follow you everywhere

name: Auto Locking
description: This is a mental power that allows you to lock things by just thinking about them. For example, say you forgot to lock your house. Poof!... The door automatically locks. Even better, this isn't confined to doors and other things with locks on them. Anything that can be opened can be auto-locked. Only you can open something that's auto-locked. This power is very useful for protecting valuable objects.
summary: The ability to lock anything automatically.
strengths: Automatically lock anything by thinking about it.
Only you can unlock the locked item
Useful for protecting valuable items
weaknesses: Unlocker, Janus' Key etc.

name: Intuitive Comprehension
description: Knowledge is power, and understanding is the key to knowledge. An Intuitive Comprehender needs to only look at a serial number, acronym, or abbreviation and the facts will come to their mind. When they see it, they must stare at it for a moment; in a flash they will know what it means. This ability does not work on the spoken word or drawings.
summary: The ability to immediately understand any list of symbols
strengths: Know the difference between M80 and E80
Looking at a serial code lets you know what it is and where it was made
Learn if you should visit the CMF or not
weaknesses: Must get a good look at the number string
Does not work on the spoken word
Does not work on drawings

name: Pursuit
description: With this ability, anything is possible. If you pursuit it, you can do it. If you constantly pursue thoughts and concepts, they will become a reality. For instance, if you always want to fly, you may gain the ability to float, or grow wings. If something is troubling you, pursuiting thoughts of it ending may make the problem go away. There is no end to what your mind can pursue. However, more specific abilities or concepts take more concentration, and everything takes time to become a reality.
summary: The ability to make things come true by continuously pursuing them
strengths: Pursuit your dreams, your goals, and they will come true
weaknesses: Nothing can happen instantly, it takes a real want for something to come true
Things can be awkward without being specific, and pursuing more specifically takes more effort

name: Psychic Sound
description: A person with Psychic Sound can create sound waves made out of pure psychic energy. The psychic sound waves can affect the world like normal sound waves but are unaffected by Sonokinesis. The psychic sound waves can also be used to affect other things using psychic energy. The psychic sound waves can also be used to talk to others in a sort of false telepathy. Can also choose which individuals can hear or are affected by your psychic sound waves.
summary: The ability to create sound waves made out of psychic energy.
strengths: Use sound waves that are unaffected by sonokinesis.
Use sound waves to also affect psychic related objects.
Can use the sound waves to create a sort of false telepathy.
weaknesses: Affected by other psychic powers.
If your focus is lessened then your power weakens.
Works similiar to sonokinesis.

name: Inundation
description: This ability is QUITE unpleasant for the person on whom it is used. It causes an overload of every sense the user has. One with this ability causes the foe to lose control over his senses and train of thought, so that every sensory stimulus in range is constantly in his mind. Combine that with the fact that his thoughts no longer form coherently into cognition he can understand (thoughts and memories emerge/disappear randomly, emotions constantly changing) and the foe is left a mind-numbed mess.
summary: The ability to overload a foe's mind and senses
strengths: Overload a foe with his own thoughts, memories and emotions (can't focus them into coherent thought)
His senses go haywire and everything he picks up on is very strongly present in his mind
Often knocks the foe unconscious within a few seconds
weaknesses: If one's power is too strong, it causes coma or even death
If the power can't be undone at will, you might feel bad using your power (MIGHT)
If the power is uncontrolled, it can go off randomly

name: Eye Of Awakening
description: You are impervious to mind tricks, controls, and any illusion. You even repel the Shadow Of Mara.
summary: The ability to repel the even the most powerful mind controls and illusions
strengths: You are Impervious to any mind control, and illusion.
You can duplicate this power and bestow it on others.
You can even use it as a shield on thousands of people.
weaknesses: If you use your other powers for evil, this power is temporally disabled.
Be wise before bestowing on this to someone else.

name: Tactile Telepathy
description: You can hear any thinking creature's thoughts and transmit your thoughts to them by skin-to-skin or skin-to-conductor-to-skin contact
summary: The ability to hear thoughts or transmit thoughts to others by touch.
strengths: You can know what people are thinking.
You can show people exactly what you mean.
weaknesses: You must be toughing it's body with your skin or a good conductor that is touching both beings.
Can't be turned off.
You might not always want to know what people are thinking.

name: Terrain Morph
description: A terrain morpher can change the terrain to his or his allies' advantage. Make the surrounding underwater for battles with a pyrokinetic. Make a battleground of mist for a sharp shooter. But without concentration, you'll end up mixing terrains and turn it accidentally against you. And it would just last as long as the battle. And it's simply a physical illusion like those in the card games in TV whre the terrains change.
summary: The ability to change the terrain or the surroundings to your advantage.
strengths: Make the battleground fit for your battle.
Make your allies comfortable in battle.
weaknesses: The terrains might mix up and turn against you
You can anly make terrains you know how it looks like.

name: Vampirism: Psychic
description: Also called Psychic Absorption, this is the ability to absorb psychic energy and thought waves, temporarily diminishing the thought capacity of others (and sometimes even allowing one to temporarily steal thoughts and memories), and convert that same psychic energy into physical strength and sustenance; sometimes, the user is limited to sustenance only from GOOD thoughts, or only from BAD thoughts (this is especially helpful against a mental type foe)
summary: The ability to gain sustenance and power from the psychic energy of others
strengths: Take away the thoughts of others, making them temporarily tired and stupefied
Taking their thoughts also delays having to eat or rest (and may allow you to steal memories)
Foes with Psychic Blasts, Telekinesis, Telepathy, Psionic Powers, etc.
weaknesses: Doesn't allow permanent theft of memories or thoughts
Sometimes it requires and actual bite like a true vampire
Foes with psychic/mental protections

name: Predestined Constucts
description: The user is able to produce an odd, psionic material that,once released, either becomes a construct that the user will need in the near future, or covers things to indicate that those things will be important in the future. This material can make a trail for the user follow to where he needs to go to.
summary: The ability to generate a luminous, psychic material that is capable of showing what actions need to be taken
strengths: Create construct without the need for concentration.
Know what to do next or find something that will be important in the near future.
Mastering it will allow you to manipulate it.
weaknesses: Materials last as long as purpose.
You might have the perfect tool for upcoming situations, but a bad interpretation can ruin it.

name: Shadow Extrasensory
description: This power is great for umbrakinetics. It allows the user to perceive anything located within darkness. This ability is the projection of one's sight to any area submerged in darkness (project your sight all around a dark room to look for people without moving and tripping over things, or the like), the perception of the presence and activity of things as long as they aren't touched by light, and the discernment of the past or future condition of an object by touching its shadow.
summary: The ability to perceive information from shadows
strengths: Project your sight to any location shrouded in darkness
Perceive the presence/activity of things (living or inanimate) that aren't touched by light
Perceive the past or future condition of a subject by touching its shadow
weaknesses: No night vision, so your sight is still impaired in darkness (though this is compensated for)
This doesn't allow you to see past camouflage, even in darkness
Perceiving the past/future condition of something may be draining if your powers are weak

name: Monster Creator
description: With this power, you can make any monster from movies, books, etc, but it must be on a paper or TV. You can't just have it in your mind. To get rid of them, you can just poof them away.
summary: The ability to create an army of monsters with your mind.
strengths: Make "the super devil", "dementors, "B.O.B.," etc.
They're on your side and they obey you
Have a lot of fun scaring people
weaknesses: You might go crazy with so much power

name: Involvement Manipulation
description: The user has the power to change, create, or neutralize any form of involvement. The user can be or not be apart of any event. They can avoid events that could harm them. They can do the same for other people as well. The user can make other things involved or not like objects, materials, or super/natural phenomenon. The can manipulate the levels of involvement: physical, mental, spiritual,etc. By making one not involve with something in a spatial level, the user can teleport.
summary: The ability to control one's or other's involvement in any situation.
strengths: Be a part or not a part of event, people, and things.
if you make yourself not involved in a spatial level, you can teleport.
Manipulate other's involvement
weaknesses: You will miss out on something great
You could get involved in something way over your head

name: Comic Book Physics
description: Think about it. How do most superheroes get their powers? Radioactive spider? Gamma bomb? Lab accident? These methods are ridiculous by our standards, but with this ability that is no longer the case. Become a nuclear man by exposing yourself to dangerous amounts of radiation, or develop psychic powers the next time you wake up!
summary: The ability to gain powers through ridiculous and sometimes fatal methods
strengths: Become a super soldier through little exercise
Spinach will actually give you strength and stamina
Lab chemicals will give you super speed or molecular control
weaknesses: Your powers depend on what is around you
If you lose this ability, these methods may kill you

name: Pattern Sense
description: This ability comes in two parts: the analysis and the perception. First, the user looks at a subject, or otherwise, comes into contact with it, which triggers the willful psionic analysis of a subject's properties and features (shape, density, texture, etc. ). After the analysis, the second part comes into play, allowing the user to pick up on any subject of the same molecular/chemical/genetic, or otherwise, structural makeup, and track them accordingly.
summary: The ability to analyze, and later pick up on, patterns in one's environment
strengths: Become an awesome analyst (analyze chemical components, texture, beneficial/harmful effects, etc. )
Sense a subject's true nature (age, gender, race, any diseases) to "out" shapeshifters, or the like
Track down any specimen similar to one you've previously analyzed
weaknesses: Analysis, if undeveloped, can be triggered randomly
Analysis can be used to analyze language patterns, fighting styles, etc. But this can take a while
At higher levels, even analyze the space-time continuum, but this takes a while to obtain

name: Psychic Absorption
description: With this ability, you can absorb psychic energy. You can choose to build up the energy you store, and release it in a concentrated blast. This includes Mind Control, Telekinesis, and other psychic attacks. Telepathy can still be used on you. However, you can choose to absorb it as well.
summary: The ability to absorb psychic energy aimed at you.
strengths: Immune to psychic energy.
Can fire back the psychic energy in a concentrated blast of energy.
Can store this energy for as long as you want.
weaknesses: Not many have abilities which use psychic energy.
No resistance to physical or emotional damage comes from this ability.

name: Fear
description: Everyone has a fear, which means everyone can fall victim to this power. The person will see what they fear, like a giant spider, but the spider can't actually hurt them. It's all just one big illusion.  Must have physical contact with the victim.
summary: The ability to know what people fear and bring it to life
strengths: No one is immune
weaknesses: Must have physical contact of some type
The created illusion can not physically hurt the other person

name: Artifact Projection
description:
A form of mental sorcery forming a copy of any held object. Power is drawn from the collective thoughts humans have about the target object. The power of the item made depends on its original abilities and the current number of people who think about the item. 

Common items will be almost identical to their real counterparts (ie a generic sword), artifacts known to some countries will suffer moderate ability reduction (ie Excalibur), while obscure relics suffer large penalties (ie Fragarach).
summary: The ability to recreate with your mind any held objects.
strengths: Any held object can be recreated. Try the One Ring, Hermes' sandals, or the Lasso of Truth!
Abilities bestowed by a copy of a highly popular object will be virtually identical.
If more people see the copy and/or its effects, it will gain power as more people think of it.
weaknesses: Only items that have truly existed in real life or in literature can be copied.
Using this power will induce physical strain proportional to the strength of the artifact recreated.
Copies will always shatter and disappear within fifteen seconds of summoning.

name: Extraordinary Imagination
description: With this ability, you have an extraoridinary imagination. You can imagine concepts that could not be imagined by the normal human mind, such as different dimensions, advanced technology, and other abnormal phenomena which, again, can't be grasped by the human mind. This also gives you a much wider imagination, making you extremely creative.
summary: The ability to have an imagination much greater than that of a normal being's.
strengths: You would be amazing at developing art concepts.
Imagine ideas and concepts that are superior of a normal human's.
Invent new things with your imagination.
weaknesses: Others may not understand your imagination if you explain it to them.
A lot of your imagination may not be particularly realistic.
May have daydreams at the wrong moments.

name: Reader
description: French, Spanish, Japanese, Creole, Ancient Egyptian, any language that can be written, the holder of this power can understand in its written form. It does not matter how old or complicated the written language is, the holder of this power will understand it. The words will automatically translate to a language that the holder of this power already knows in their mind.
summary: The ability to read and understand any language without prior training
strengths: Can read and understand any written language.
Can act as a one-way translator.
Dictionaries can be useful for writing things out if they are fully in the other language.
weaknesses: Can't speak or write the languages witjout training.
If you want to translate to a language you don't know, you must have samples of the writing on you.

name: Money Controller
description: Never be affected by poverty or a recession anymore!  With this superpower, you can bestow riches upon yourself and others with ease!
summary: The ability to generate money with your mind
strengths: Become a multi-trillionaire!
Can make other people rich as well
weaknesses: People may mooch off of you

name: Lightless Vision
description: One with this ability does not need visible light, infrared, x-ray, or the like, in order to see; the user isn't blind, he simply doesn't require light of any sort to see, so he can see even when light is bent or entirely absent (meaning he can see the invisible and is immune to intense light and light-based illusions); sight capacity for this superhuman can only be impaired if the mind is somehow injured, because they require only mental power to see
summary: The ability to see without the aid of electromagnetic radiation
strengths: Mental power is all that is required to see (absence/presence/distortion of light doesn't matter)
Immune to invisibility, light-basede illusions and intense light
Sight is normal (not green-tinged like night vision or the like)
weaknesses: Optikinesis can impair this power
Psychic energy manipulation can impair this power
If you're normally blind, and this power is negated, you're screwed

name: Empathic Sight
description: Being stabbed in the back took down Caesar, Brutus, and King Lear. People with Empathic Sight don't have to worry about that. At will, they can tell friends from enemies by the color they emanate--blue for friends and red for foes. They can also read messages that friends scratch on the wall. To them, it looks like a glowing neon sign.
summary: The ability to tell friend from foe and to detect hidden messages
strengths: Detect potential foes
Find friendly forces in a dangerous place
Reading life-saving messages from friends
weaknesses: Finding out your best friend hates you
Looking around and seeing all foes
Unable to read foe's messages

name: Thoughtform Projection
description: Artists have been trying for years to transform emotions or music into visual media. A person with Thoughtform Projection has a shortcut. They can produce abstract illusiory projections of things like music, emotions, or even a person's thought process. The projection changes shape and color as the idea changes, and it can be made as big or as small as the person needs it to be.
summary: The ability to create abstract 3-D holograms of ideas, emotions, or thought processes
strengths: Create some beautiful 'laser' shows
Stun opponents with the sudden brightness of a thoughtform
With practice, can tell what someone is thinking
weaknesses: Thoughtforms not physical
Color or pattern is totally out of your control
Not very useful for everyday purposes

name: Instant Biographic Aptitude
description: The power to learn the entire biograpy of a person by making skin contact without the need of long-term relationship building or extensive education. Similar to Telepathic Psychoanalysis (Mind Reading), Psychometry (or Clairsentience) and Intuitive Aptitude, but this ability is as if you have been living next to the subject/victim all your life. One with this ability knows all the secrets and details of the person they touch.
summary: The ability to instantly learn the biography of a people by touching them
strengths: Easy friend making ability
Can discover secrets and info from unwilling individuals
Can easily cope with ailed/sick people
weaknesses: Limited only to touch
The trigger is uncontrollable, so you must wear gloves
Intimacy may turn out awkward

name: Electromagnetic Receiver
description: A person with this power does not have telepathy, instead they are able to read the electric signals within people's minds to figure out their thoughts and emotions. This power does not leave any telekinetic trail of any sort and is unaffected by Anti-telepathy or Telepathic Prison. In addition, the user can also "read the minds" of machines. However, they can be fooled if there is electrical interference or if a person wears an insulator helmet. If mastered, the user can also influence others.
summary: The ability to read the electromagnetic waves given off by people or machines to read minds
strengths: Alternate method of telepathy
Works on both humans and machines
If mastered, you can also send your own signals to try to disrupt or alter people's thoughts
weaknesses: If you don't focus, you might accidentally listen to radio instead of people's emotions/thoughts
It's even harder to manipulate people's minds with electricity than regular telepathy
Insulator helmets block out your readings

name: Psychogenesis
description: Ignite superhuman mental abilities and control persons with mental abilities within 92 meters of ignition. Anyone with a psychic ability is your mental puppet. But you only have powers through other individuals. When you control their ability through them, their powers are exponentially stronger. Vicariously you are stronger than any other psychogenic power.
summary: The ability to ignite, dominate and control any mental superpowers
strengths: Ignite, boost and control anyone with mental powers within 100 yards
Their power is exponentially stronger when you are in control of their mind
Your domination and power increase by the number of psionic ones around you
weaknesses: Alone you have no power. Must ignite at least one person a day to keep this ability
Alone you also have headaches and will suffer a massive cerebral aneurysm
Run the risk of igniting someone with Psychogenic potential

name: Infliction Of Agony
description: Pain Infliction is the ability to inflict a mental illusion of extreme pain onto your opponent. The longer you hold it the more intense the pain becomes, causing your victim to see mental images of their worst most painful nightmares and experiences. However, it is not actual pain, just an illusion.
summary: The ability to inflict an illusion of intense pain
strengths: Dehabilitating and powerful.
Can take down just about anyone.
If used for long enough, can cause the target to go mad.
weaknesses: As soon as you break concentration the illusion is broken.
No phyiscal damage is done.
Only targets one person.

name: Audiopathy
description: A person with this power has the telepathic ability to transmit sound into the minds of others. For example, they can cause anyone in their vicinity and later farther away to hear anything they want. While you make them telepathically hear stuff, their own natural sense of hearing is disabled so they only hear what you send them. The user controls the volume and other audio controls.
summary: The ability to telepathically control people's sense of hearing
strengths: Can be used as offensive weapon to hurt people mentally or distract them
Even if someone broke their eardrums this will still work - since this is sent mentally
Can also be used to listen to a song you like or communicate long distance
weaknesses: They can't hear anything else when you send them the sound

name: Decision Change
description: You can listen to any thoughts in the room you're in and if you don't like them, you can change them. The good part is changing minds and stopping fights. The bad part is that you HAVE to hear every thought in the room. The power is useful for stopping wars, changing laws, keeping yourself from being spotted, and keeping yourself out of trouble.
summary: The ability to take a person's thoughts and change them with your mind
strengths: Changing people's thoughts
Hearing what people think of you
Preventing bad things from happening
weaknesses: Hearing every thought in the room
Making things happen that weren't supposed to happen

name: Your Mind Is A Stage
description: Your Mind Is A Stage allows you to be the lead role, playwright and director of any event. Say you want to ask someone on a date, Your Mind Is A Stage allows you to change the world to a mental plane where you can create a fantastic theatrical result. In this situation you could make it so you stop them from getting jumped by thugs, or reveal a long lost twin. You're the lead role, director, and playwright. But you can only have 3 acts in a play, and 3 uses per day.
summary: The ability to change your surrounding into a mental state (represented by a theatre stage) and control the outcome
strengths: You can control any outcome
Closed thoughts (unlike Your Mind Is A Prison)
It's theatrically themed (that's why it's called "Your Mind Is A Stage")
weaknesses: 3 acts in a play, 3 times a day
Can cause delusions.
It's theatrically themed (that's why it's called "Your Mind Is A Stage")

name: Sedation
description:
The power to tranquilize organisms into a somnolent state. The user can induce a feeling of calm and sleepiness within the minds of others. The subjects are vaguely conscious; their upper brain functions are slowed down. 
Does not put subjects to sleep or calm emotions (as does Narcoleptic Pheromones and Empathic Manipulation respectively).
summary: The ability to put organisms into a calm state
strengths: Can calm a crazy or angry person
Peaceful ability
Can calm a depressed person
weaknesses: Subjects can become drowsy, so they can't reveal secrets
Subjects may appear intoxicated, so the police may question you
Excessive use may disrupt a subjects sleeping pattern

name: Genetic Memory Lineage
description: Memories are passed via genes from parent to child at the moment of conception.   The children will also inheret all memories of those that lived before the parent and who had this ability.
summary: The ability to pass memories via genes
strengths: You remember multiple lifetimes.
You know your mom or dad very well because you share a lot of memories.
You don't have to instruct your children about your families history.
weaknesses: Your children will know many of your secrets.
Memories are only one point of view on what actually happened.

name: Tale Manipulation
description: At first, you can manipulate a single 'instance' of a story, such as changing the way a book goes for a single copy of that book; turning that copy into an adaption (movie, videogame, anything) of that book; or changing the way one person perceives that story. Also, you can 'create' stories- you just need to think of a few details, then you can will a copy in whatever medium to appear. At higher levels, you could change it worldwide without anyone noticing, or auto-publish your stories.
summary: The ability to manipulate stories, fiction, and mediums
strengths: Want to use a TV-based power on a comic? No problem! Turn a copy of that comic into a set of DVDs
Works for any medium and any type of story. The adaptions are faithful and entertaining.
Using this power to create stories makes them the highest quality possible with the details you give
weaknesses: While this power is great for entertainment and making money, it is worthless in combat on its own
Can't automatically publish works, make worldwide changes, or guarantee people love them at first

name: Natural Ability Balancer
description: Imagine that everyone on the planet has 30 points devoted to their natural abilities: strength, speed, and smarts. 10 being the average for each ability. Well, with this power, you can add and subtract points to and from each ability. This can be done on a whim. Anything is possible if you balance perfectly for the situation. The only catches are that you can't add any points to the total of 30, and you can't do anything completely superhuman. So no light speed or telepathic stuff.
summary: The ability to balance between strength, speed, and smarts
strengths: Become immediately suited for any challenge
Illiteration ROCKS!
Imagine a scrawny nerd turning into a giant ogre and crushing your head. Yeah. Suck it.
weaknesses: Cannot add points to the total
Balancing to far in one direction leaves you open to certain attacks
Nothing Completely Superhuman

name: Destructive Force Blast
description: You'll have the power of an A or H bomb. Fueled by emotion & adrenaline, you can create an explosive destructive force blast around your area without any harm to you.
summary: The ability to create an explosive destructive force blast around you
strengths: Have the power of a nuclear bomb
Harmless to you
weaknesses: You'll be a WMD
Hard to control
Powered by your emotions & adrenaline

name: Irresistible Love
description: It's a good thing to have anything and anyone love you, but things, like a side effect that makes it permanent, could make it worse. There'll always be someone out there you can make fall for you, but the fact that it's not a true deserving love might guilt you. If you hate causing others pain, this isn't a power for you, because you could easily break someone's heart by gently telling them it's not real love. One great thing is that the person will love you without argument and normal problems.
summary: The ability to make anyone or anything love you.
strengths: You can make the evil not want to hurt you
It can make you emotionally happier
Someone will always love you, even if you did something you regret
weaknesses: Sometimes permanent
If you have an alternate normal identity, they'll only fall in love with the super version of you
It could end up like how you love your friends, or the feeling in your heart of needing someone love

name: Minion Army
description: You can hypnotize/brainwash people and make them your servants. They are completely devoted to you and are willing to die to protect you or to do your bidding. You can completely take over a person or more, and use them as a puppet, though you might lose focus if you control too many at the same time. If you do die, you can transfer your mind and power to someone else's body, but do it quickly or you'll completely die and lose all your army. Either way, you do lose some control over your people.
summary: The ability to control an army of minions to do your bidding and transfer your mind into one of them if you die
strengths: Endless supply of controlled people
You are their master overlord
Can take over one or more of them and permanently control one if you die
weaknesses: Complete control takes focus and controlling too many is hard
If you die, you lose some of your subjects

name: Master Oh Disaster
description: Let's say your favorite animal was a bat. Imagine controlling hordes of them to create terror, steal valuable objects, and many others. This power will work with whatever animal is your favorite animal, it is some sort of spiritual connection mixed with a specific type of telepathy. Yes, no voice commands; you think it, they do it.
summary: The ability to control your favorite type of animal through some spiritual connection.
strengths: The unconscious mind can use the animal to defend you, hence sleeping is fine.
Training is unnecessary.
Can be a good or bad guy power.
weaknesses: No powers when your animals are very far away.
If your favorite animal is something like a firefly, your power is somewhat limited.
Humans are immune to control, even though they are animals, because of a more powerful brain.

name: Mental Solitude
description: Someone with this power will never be affected by other mind-affecting powers. The reason? No-one else can find or even touch their mind on the astral or mental planes. This results in the mind of the holder of this power being fully isolated in its own little world that it completely controls. The alterations to this world affect nothing on the outside world.
summary: The ability to be unaffected by mind-affecting powers
strengths: Perfect for completely and totally uninterrupted meditation.
Impossible to be mind controlled.
Get a mental world all to yourself.
weaknesses: Too bad this doesn't affect the physical body.
People can still yell into your ear to pull you out of meditation.
Your mind can't find other minds either, unless it is physically or electronically meeting them.

name: Myth Power: Muses' Message8
description: The Muses (Mousai, Mousae, Musae), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of knowledge, sciences, the arts and inspiration. As such, channeling Thalia (Thaleia- Comedy, Rustic Poetry) allows one to psychically access knowledge of all comedic and rustic works, at will. In addition, one can psychically travel into any comedy story world, at will. One can also psychically summon objects and characters from comedy story worlds, at will. One can even psychically attune oneself to Cartoon Physics, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Muses' command over the essence of knowledge, inspiration and art
strengths: Psychically access knowledge of comedic and country/rustic/bucolic works, at will
Psychically travel into (and summon objects/characters from) comedic story worlds, at will
Psychically attune oneself to the absurdly-lenient laws of Cartoon Physics, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically disrupt creativity (or negate ideas), by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive subject's ideas until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Apollo's Gift may cause bossy attitude toward the user (NCN)

name: Task Clones
description: With this power, you can create clones specially designed to complete a specific task. For example, you could produce a clone to do work while you enjoy your leisure time. The clones will most enjoy whichever task you assigned them to do. They can be reabsorbed at will and if they die or are reabsorbed, you acquire all of their acquired knowledge, skills, memories, powers (if applicable), etc.
summary: The ability to produce duplicates of yourself to perform specific tasks.
strengths: Get a clone to do work more than willingly, while you relax.
The clones thoroughly enjoy whatever task you assign them to.
The clones can be used to acquire powers, knowledge and skills.
weaknesses: Each must represent a different aspect or activity, limiting their numbers.
If the clones die, your clones acquire the experiences as well. If reabsorbed, only you do.
You do not command the clones..

name: Heart Manipulation
description: This power allows you to control another persons' heart. This means you can speed up/slow down their heart rate, make it stop, or even control where it pumps blood. It also applies to mental aspects which are associated with the heart, such as fear, courage, love, empathy and any other emotion that can be justified as being controlled by the heart.
summary: The ability to control the Heart, physically or metaphorically.
strengths: Stopping someones heart is easy to do, even from a distance.
Can be used to make an ally braver before going into battle.
You can control your own emotions and heart.
weaknesses: This is NOT blood-bending, you can NOT control someones' body using this power.
Changing emotions is based entirely on the users willpower vs the affecteds' willpower.

name: Life Touch
description: The ability to, when you touch someone, live their entire life in a split second. But, while living their, life you are able to alter their thoughts, changing somewhat part of their life.
summary: The ability to , when you touch someone, live their life in a split second.
strengths: Learn new things
Somewhat be able to change their life.
weaknesses: To many lives.

name: Gamer's Touch
description: The ability to bring any gaming character to your side whether it be for good or bad. The way to summon them is to focus on that specific person or thing and it shall appear before you. You can also determine how tall or small you want them to be. And as an added bonus, once you begin to perfect your powers, you will be able to obtain a chosen character's power.
summary: The ability to bring your favorite characters to life or use their powers for yourself
strengths: Your favorite hero or villian is by your side to defend you
You won't be lonely
If you pick the right person you will be unstoppable! Like DeadPool!!!!
weaknesses: If that character doesn't agree to help you then you have a big problem on your hands.

name: Mechanical Energy Perception
description: Mechanical Energy Perception, also called Potential-Kinetic Energy Perception, Potential/Kinetic Perception or Potential/Kinetic Energy Sense is the ability to perceive mechanical (potential and kinetic) energy, which appear to the user's vision as contrasting colors (if the user perceives it visually). This can be used to see targets' potential/kinetic energy (sometimes even a target's projected path of motion).
summary: The ability to sense potential and/or kinetic energy
strengths: Perceive potential energy (sense the shape of any immobile thing in your radius)
Perceive kinetic energy (sense the shape of any moving thing in your radius)
Switch between the two perceptions at will (and perception can be either psychic or visual)
weaknesses: If Kinetic Energy Perception is active all the time, it can be disorienting
If Potential Energy Perception is active all the time, it's even more disorienting that Kinetic
If BOTH are active all the time

name: Peaceful Aura
description: A person with a Peaceful Aura has an amazing gift. They can induce feelings of relaxation in people around them. Now, while this can be used to resolve a problem or make friends, it can also be forced on someone. This makes the target go limp into a mellow trance that may not wear off for an hour then go into a dream-like coma. Eventually, it may slow their heart and breathing enough to kill them.
summary: The ability to make people relax and mellow at will
strengths: Making friends
Can relax someone to sleep
Can slow heart + breathing enough to kill
weaknesses: May garner fearful enemies
May use power for personal gain
Fueled by emotion

name: Berserker Instinct
description: This power of Beserker Instinct enables the user to perform mental and physical feats that are athletic under a high adrenaline and heart rate. This ability could enhance the strength, agility, speed, reflexes and the senses under a trance. The user can read an opponent's intentions, drives, emotions even weakness.
summary: The ability to read the moves of an opponent under stress and perform athletic feats related to senses.
strengths: You can be an experienced combatant.
Allows you to be smarter.
Can mimic any skill or trait of another.
weaknesses: This comes with an urge to hunt.
The user can become antisocial.
Once someone is under that 'instinct' it is harder to control.

name: Multi  Host
description: You want to have several allies, use your ability and control several people at the same time. All of the people must be within your vicinity, can also control your enemies. The ability comes useful in a surrounded, gonna die situation.
summary: The ability to control several people at the same time
strengths: Can make escape easy.
Can have several allies at once
Can control enemies
weaknesses: Can not control those with the same ability or have mental blocks
Will forget how to make friends
Will probably become a villain

name: Persona
description: A persona is a facade that people wear in their everyday lives. It is a side of you that you are afraid to show to others. By controlling your emotions, you can give your inner voice physical form (as a mythological figure. ) Remember that your inner self is beyond your limits, but you are still mortal, so you would take care not to get killed, or your Persona will go wild!
summary: The ability to summon your inner self.
strengths: Summon a mythological god from inside your head
Be your own bodyguard
It's Harry Potter meets Pokemon!
weaknesses: You can still get hurt like a normal person
You have to master your emotions to control it
You have to play Shin Megami Tensei to know what I'm talking about

name: Memory Repression
description: Is there anything you don't want to remember? Are you tired of being reminded of your failures or a traumatizing event? Then, this power is for you! With it, you can completely block any memories you want so they never surface again. They won't disappear; you'll just be unable to remember them. Blocked memories are immune to any form of memory reading or alteration. Moreover, to prevent any morbid curiosity on your part to check what you repressed, memories of ever using this power are erased.
summary: The ability to block access to parts of your memories from anyone, especially yourself.
strengths: You can protect your mind and brain against painful or traumatizing memories.
Mind readers won't have access to the memories that have been blocked by this power.
To prevent you from checking what memories you repressed, you won't remember using this power.
weaknesses: You may have forgotten, but other people won't forget so easily.
You can only use this on yourself.
Don't use this power on your whole memory unless you know for sure what you're doing!

name: Hivemind
description: By staring into someone's eyes, you can will them to become a willing follower with a telepathic link to you and all other followers. All followers see you as god and are willing to sacrifice anything for you.
summary: The ability to create a mindless telepathic army
strengths: manipulate anyone
get a LOT of stuff for free
could control nations
weaknesses: dose not work thought sunglasses
you are still very vunerable
you might think yourself a god

name: Telepathic Survey
description: Telepathic surveyors have the ability to broadcast one yes/no question to all sentient minds within range. Examples of some of the questions could be - Are you a cop, terrorist, murderer, etc. , or - Do I owe you money? The question goes directly to the subconscious, so they can't perceive it, nor can they lie. When a target responds, their auras change to red (for yes) and blue (for no) and are visible only to the surveyor
summary: The ability to send out a telepathic ping that delivers a question directly to the subconscious of sentient beings
strengths: Can configure the range - 2 mile radius sphere or 5 mile cone (45 degree angle)
Can be creative w/ questions – find out anything you want to know that can be answered w/ yes/no
Can detect hostile intent from literally over a mile away. Plus, no more speed trap worries.
weaknesses: Limited telepathy - cannot read minds or persuade/compel others
Might not like the answers (are there any girls here that would go out with me? )
Possible unwanted attention - a telepath might want to trace the ping back to the source

name: Connection Severer
description: With this, you can sever the conections between your enemy's teeth and their gum, separate things from a certain space, and much more. You can sever almost anything that has a connection, so no more mind control. However, this can't sever a person from their powers or magic. If you have Abjuration, you can make wards against this to protect yourself.
summary: The ability to sever connections between things, except powers or magic.
strengths: So many connections to cut.
Instant kill by severing the heart.
weaknesses: Can't sever powers or magic.
Wards can prevent it.
Its cons can't be negated.

name: Wood Manipulation
description: You can have the granted ability to control, generate, or absorb wood, but just for that you can even make sharp weapons out of them, or if you try to absorb any wooden object any you'll have some wooden skin and not even electric like attacks will even affect you.
summary: The ability to create or to control anything that is wood with the mind.
strengths: You can become a wood magnet
Electric bolts won't affect you if you have wooden skin.
weaknesses: They can be easliy will burn in the fire.

name: Nightmare Manipulator
description: The target would be put into their own worst nightmare (i.e drowning) and, like the matrix, the mind gets so scared that the nightmare becomes a reality and eventually the person will drown. Their death however will be a complete mystery to those around him/her.
summary: The ability to make people's nightmares a reality to them and only them.
strengths: time for you to escape
makes enemy vulnerable
weaknesses: you will most likely kill the target
your appearance is changed so you will have grey skin and pitch black eyes
once a target is in their nightmare it is impossible to get them back out, even for the manipulator

name: Psychic Link Checker
description: This ability allows you to perceive psychic links established between people/objects. When you're in contact with one of them, this power can explore the links of your choice and give you information about the things at the nodes of the links, mainly their locations and, unless they're immune to mental intrusions, their identities and the nature of the psychic links. In cases of chains or big networks of psychic links, the depth of the exploration depends on your proficiency with this power.
summary: The ability to explore psychic links and find the people/objects at the nodes of the links.
strengths: Someone's being mind-controlled from a distance? Find who the culprit is and where they are hiding.
Someone's sending you anonymous telepathic messages? Find out who they are.
Someone attached parts of their soul to objects in order to become immortal? Locate all the objects.
weaknesses: You need to touch one of the nodes of the psychic links.
You need to get more experience if you want to explore beyond the first nodes of the link.

name: Cranial Insulation
description: Annoyed at powers which target your brainwaves without telepathy? Need a defense? This may be for you. As a side effect, it also prevents electrocution in your brain.
summary: The ability to make your brainwaves undetectable and you brain immune to electrocution.
strengths: Electric shocks cannot harm your brain anymore!
Nobody can read your mind through brainwaves.
Stop people studying your brainwave patterns to explain your mind-based powers.
weaknesses: Some medical scans are now ineffective.
If someone breaks through your skull, this power is rendered ineffective.
Only your brain is immune to electrocution and your heartbeat can still be detected.

name: Mental Shielding
description: The user is able to shield his or her mind from telepaths, effectively blocking them out of their minds. This power is only as powerful as the consciousness of the user. This power is fully active when the user is conscious. Sleep does not affect the power, only being knocked out unconscious will render the power useless
summary: The ability to shield your thoughts from mind readers
strengths: Able to shield your thoughts from enemy telepaths
Good secret keeper
weaknesses: Allies cant relay messages telepathically

name: Vista Orbing
description: With this type of orbing, one can create orbs of sight. These orbs are connected to the users mind allowing them to see in 360 degrees all at once w/o blind spots. These orbs can also me made and then set in a stationary place or be movable.
summary: The ability to create orbs that allow you to see in 360 degrees w/o blind spots.
strengths: Make an orb above your head that follows so you can see all around yourself
Make a small orb and leave it in someones house for survailince.
Make an orb and send it out so you can see into the next room w/o having to enter
weaknesses: Limited orbs, due to the brains inability to focus, becomes over whelming
. Orbs replace normal vision. E. M. F(s) cause distruption
No special sight. No night vision or heat vision.

name: Kything
description: Also called "Speaking Optic", this is the psychic ability to discern what someone wants to say simply by looking into their eyes or reading body language. One with this power can pass it on to others, so they have no need to speak aloud and their thoughts cannot be read, as the thoughts empathically resonate, but only between beings involved in the kything-link. This ability even allows communication through time and across dimensions, as long as kything-link is strong enough.
summary: The ability to communicate non-verbally and non-psychically
strengths: Never need to talk again
Kything link transcends space and time
Kything link is easy to maintain
weaknesses: Annoying people outside of the kything link
Creeps people out when others agree with you and you haven't said anything
Kything link can only be established between willing partners

name: Perception Compulsion Immunity
description: This power allows you to see what's really there. You can see through all illusions, see shape shifters in their true form or anything else that alters perception etc. For compulsion immunity, you can't be controlled through persuasion, telepathy, puppet mastery, or anything that removes your free will.
summary: The ability to see through alterations and not be compelled.
strengths: You know you have free will
Never be tricked
weaknesses: Not the most dynamic power
The person may kill you after they find out you can't be tricked/compelled

name: Avenger Summon V2
description: With this power you can summon any Avenger. The Avenger doesn't have to be currently an active member of the team they don't even have to be living in the current comic book timeline. Also when you summon when of them they under your complete control. Unfortunately if you want to use the mind control function you can only summon one of them. If you summon two or more you lose control over them.
summary: The ability to summon any Avenger
strengths: You can summon any of the Avengers
You can mind control up to one of them at a time
weaknesses: If you want to summon more than one you lose the mind control function

name: Physical Ricochet
description: While this power is active whenever anyone touches you, they rebound forcefully off. This also applies to any other object that hits you (bullets, shrapnel, people with Super Strength) with ten-times the force it hit you. This power does not apply to Non-physical forces or attacks (lasers, things like wind, that psychic dude's mental blast). If you jump off a cliff and hit the ground, YOU will bounce.
summary: The ability to make who ever touches you to rebound off
strengths: You are a Super-Strength-ed hero's nightmare
Can be used for transportation via bouncing
You can ammuse yourself by giving hi-5s
weaknesses: Forgetting to turn it off and...say jumping in a pool
Can't stop Non-physical attacks or energy
You have to read the big paragraph up there to understand this power

name: Vampirism: Phobic
