description: Also called Fear Vampirism, Phobic Absorption or Fear Absorption, this is the ability to absorb the fear of others and turn it into sustenance and energy for one's own use (it also works on doubt, nervousness, anxiety, dread and uncertainty); though some with this power leave subjects temporarily numb emotionally, it is most common that the subject remains conscious, and thus still afraid (this power works especially well on those with fear-based powers, or on neurotic, paranoid, phobic people)
summary: The ability to gain sustenance and power from the fear of others
strengths: Feed off the fear of others, which SOMETIMES leaves them emotionally numb (but usually doesn't)
Taking their fear delays your need to eat or rest
Foes with fear-type abilities or with fearful/fear-inducing personalities
weaknesses: Best if you can also sense fear (but Fear Sense does not ALWAYS accompany this power)
Sometimes it requires an actual bite like a true vampire
If you can't control it, friends and family won't want to be around you

name: Dream Eater
description: With this power, you can eat people's dreams. You can do this by turning into a small spirit at night and going into people's minds. Once in their mind, you can access their dreams and eat them. The powers you get are based on what's going on in the dream you're eating. You have those powers until the next night when you become a spirit again.
summary: The ability to eat people's dreams and gain different powers
strengths: You can gain powers by eating people's dreams.
weaknesses: You lose the powers the next night.
You automatically become a spirit at night.
The only thing you can do as a spirit is fly and go into people's minds to eat their dreams.

name: Me, Myself And I
description: This power gives you great mental coordination, so great in effect you've developed two extra minds. Each functions separately and independently. Your minds are identical but hypnotism, mind control and telepathic powers affect them separately. This power could let you use three mental skills at once or three mental powers at once or one mind could use your senses while the other two focus on an opponent.
summary: The ability to have two extra minds in your head.
strengths: Use three mental powers at the same time.
Telepathic powers only have 33 percent chance of success against you.
Think of the most powerful mental abilities and reread #1.
weaknesses: Unless you're the Man-Thing and you have no mind.

name: Mental Ignition
description: Mental ignition requires one to put their hands on either side of another person's skull and charge their cranium with power. The electricity courses through the brain and effectively "fries" it, killing the victim with enough power. If the attack is not lethal, even a second of forcing electricity to directly enter the brain is enough to cause often-permanent damage.
summary: The ability to channel electricity through another person's brain, causing lethal damage.
strengths: Have the ability to kill anyone at anytime from behind without a weapon. The attack cannot be seen.
Have the ability to impair an enemy mentally with a quick charge
Have the ability to mercilessly torture or threaten anyone with death and intense pain
weaknesses: Very difficult to control the amount of electricity
Very risky to use on a person you do not wish to kill
Unusable if the attacker's hands are damaged or lost

name: Barrier Melting
description: Can melt any type of barrier by touching it. Forcefields,walls, shields, etc. Can be magical, physical, psychic, etc so long as it can be physically touched.
summary: The ability to melt barriers one touches physically
strengths: No barrier can stop one's physical attacks.
Doesn't matter if the barrier is natural or supernatural.
weaknesses: Have to touch the barrier.
Can't melt barries protecting the mind.
Doesn't extend to projectile attacks.

name: Einstein
description: The ability to access Albert Einstein's intellect is a very help full gift, especially during a science pop quiz. You automatically know everything that he knew in life.
summary: The ability to access Albert Einstein's intelligence
strengths: Inventing weapons, armor and gadgets on the go
Quizzes and tests are a breeze
Automatically proficient in German
weaknesses: Sometimes getting flashes of his thoughts
Feeling the need to do some thing great, this can be good or bad
People always bothering you to know what Einstein knew

name: Antinomian Persuasion
description: While this may seem more of a curse to some, it requires a bit of thought to see the true gift behind it. This ability is often called "Psychic Reverse Psychology", and for good reason. By telling anyone to do something, you subliminally compel them to do the opposite. So, in order to compel someone with this power, tell them what you don't want them to do.
summary: The ability to persuade people to do the opposite of what you say
strengths: Works just as well as a normal psychic persuasion
Can make a person do anything within their power (even if they would find it morally questionable)
Compulsion is activated at will
weaknesses: If it can't be suppressed
If it actually makes them do the things you reverse-compel them to do
People avoid conversations with you

name: Telepathic Prison
description: With this power, the user has the ability to trap the consciousness of anyone who uses telepathy on them in a prison within their own mind. The user can then either talk to them from outside the prison and let them out or keep them trapped forever. When trapped, the person with telepathy cannot move their actual body. You can choose to ignore the person and go throughout your daily life, and the telepath will still be stuck in you. You can also "borrow" the telepathic abilities of the trapped.
summary: The ability to trap people that use telepathy on you in your mind
strengths: People with mind power have to go through a clearance check in order to enter your mind
You can either decide to let them out or keep them trapped
Within your mind, their telepathy only makes you stronger. So, they can't break out with their power
weaknesses: Not useful, unless someone with telepathy uses it against you
They can still trick you into opening the telepathic door if they are good at being persuasive ...
... without telepathy

name: Planar Sensory
description: There are multiple planes of reality yet most people can only perceive one. This power allows you to expand your sense to ALL of the planes regardless of their distance from your own(as long as they are in your own dimension). This means that all of your senses(even a sixth if you have it) can be used to detect information from the planes. However the sense area is not limitless, you can sense a wide area but to go farther you have to shift sensory perceptions to another part of the plane.
summary: The ability to expand your senses to the other planes of reality.
strengths: Collect large amounts of information on multiple planes(detecting extra-planar entities,guards,etc)
Can view different areas of different planes all at once.
Some enemies might try to come from another plane for an ambush.
weaknesses: You can get sensory overload if there is too much activity on multiple planes.
The phrase "scared out of your skin" does apply.
Some things could be beyond sensory perception on ALL planes.

name: Psionic Wrecking Balls
description: Also known as the "Melchsee's Door", the person with this ability is able to project their psychic power through the creation of "wrecking balls" or orbs that can obliterate all forms of matter except for the user. Wrecking orbs naturally home toward psionic energy and eat psychic energy. When enough psychic energy is eaten the orbs grow uncontrollable tendrils of psychic energy. However, through effort however the user can learn to control this power and limit the path of destruction it causes.
summary: The ability to materialize your psychic energy into wrecking balls that can obliterates anything except the user
strengths: Wrecking balls can obliterate any type of matter
User can control wrecking balls with effort and can create more orbs and also compress into discs
Wrecking balls immediately home toward any psychic or brain activity and can eat psychic energy
weaknesses: You need to have great amount of control
If a wrecking ball absorbs too much outside psionic energy it will go berserk
User must have lots of imagination to use this in non-destructive ways

name: Aroma
description: A person with this power has the ability to emit fragrances from their body at will as well as control the direction of their fragrances. Fragrances can have multiple effects. It can paralyze others, remove mental limits, cause pain, create illusions, control other's motor functions, knock people out, and anything that affects the nervous system or the brain. You can make the aroma smell anyway you want as well as make the aroma any color you want at well. You are immune to your own fragrances.
summary: The ability to emit fragrances with various effects on the nervous system
strengths: Once it reaches the brain you can control a person's nervous system/brain
You can bottle up your fragrances to sell to others with the same effects
You always smell nice-you can create cologne/perfume at will
weaknesses: Looks very girly if you are a guy using this power unless you made it invisible
People can become immune to a specific fragrance but you can make more types
People can blow away fragrances with a fan/ Burn it

name: Poetic Prophecy
description: This type of ability is hard to control; it could happen anywhere and anytime. You'll be in a trance as you begin to write poems about future events (yourself, others or the world ) and you will awaken without any memory of it. Though, fortunately, most of the time, you have the capability to interpret the poetry you write, no matter how cryptic.
summary: The ability to tap into the future by writting poems.
strengths: Prevent and take action ahead.
You'll become a great psychic.
weaknesses: Fear.

name: Ultimate Trader
description: Physical or abstract traits. Illnesses,damage or injuries. Super powers or just their pros and/or cons. You can trade any of these with another person. Physical objects can be traded for the above mentioned. Just like Ebay but with super powers,emotions or iq points for trade. Deals must be made with free will. A trade partner doesn't have to know you have this power. Some trades won't work. Power pros and cons only work if trade partners have similar powers.
summary: The ability to trade almost anything for anything with someone.
strengths: Lose what you don't need,trade for what you want.
This power can be used without your trade partner knowing you have it.
weaknesses: If you have any power that limits what you can barter.
You might not have what anyone wants or vice versa.

name: Myth Power: Crisis' Crackdown
description: Crisis (Krisis), in Greek myth, was the goddess of judgment, choice and decision. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive the correct answer to nearly any yes-no or multiple-choice question, at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive indecisiveness and uncertainty, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically negate subjects' ability to decide (and thus immobilize them), by touch. One can even psychically communicate with and compel subjects feeling uncertain, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Crisis' command over the essence of the judgment, choice and decision
strengths: Psychically perceive answers to any yes-no/multiple choice question
Psychically perceive uncertainty at will; negate ability to decide (immobilize subjects) by touch
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel subjects feeling uncertain/indecisive, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically adapt body and mind to select numerous choices, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive and travel to alternate realities until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Oknos' Activity and MythPower: Sophrosyne's Solace provides immunity (NCN)

name: Power Pusher
description: If you have an enemy who's powers drain them, mentally or physically, you can push an addiction onto them. They will not be able to stop using their own power and they'll be so exhausted all the time that they'll never be able to fight you ever again.
summary: The ability to make people become addicted to using their power.
strengths: Eliminate enemies without killing them.
Keep dangerous people from hurting any more people
Once drained of all power enemies are no longer a threat.
weaknesses: You cannot use this power against people who immunity powers.
Doesn't work against someone with the ability to throw your back at you.
Some victims of this power may commit suicide if you leave in this state.

name: Arcana: 3 The Empress
description: With this ability you can create any living thing you can imagine out of your own psionic energy. These beings can look or act like anything, and are as intelligent as you want them to be. They look translucent and are the color of your psionic energy and will usually obey you. Mostly.. They are more or less temporary because they dematerialize once they run out of the psionic energy reserve you gave them upon creation. They can be made semi-permanent by periodically replenishing those reserves.
summary: The ability to create living beings out of psychic energy.
strengths: A zoo, pet store, and an army combined.
Anything from throat-ripping bunnies to dragons. Even intelligent life.
They MOSTLY obey you, but might disobey really stupid orders.
weaknesses: More or less temporary.
Can burn lots of psionic energy very fast.

name: Warp
description: Using your mind, you will be able to physically distort & twist objects or people. If using your power on a person, you will cause them agonizing pain when you warp them, but won't kill them. They will revert back to their original form when you're done. Everything will be like clay in your hands to mold.
summary: The ability to twist & distort an object or person
strengths: Be able to distort, shape, twist & mold everything
weaknesses: Cause people pain when warping them

name: Off Panel Action
description: This power manifests in a mental blackout for the other person who will wonder about what you did. Very cheap if used with adequate prep time, such as sneaking in a tracking device or sneaking out items. This can only work for a maximum of 2 minutes. Any more and other people would be suspicious.
summary: The ability to do things that other people can't see
strengths: Very sneaky and you can pull off many things without anyone noticing
Best thief and spy
weaknesses: If other person figured out what you did, they might go after you
If the other person already knew what you were going to do, then they can stop it

name: Advanced Plagiarism
description: Yeah, once the user uses this ability, the targeted person (or any other living creature) can't use any of their strategies, skills, or techniques that the user has copied and upgraded for 5 min. This ability also gives the user minor psychic powers to read the person's mind to see strategies, skills, or techniques. If one of the victim's techiques has to do with their powers, the user can use that power only for that copied technique.
summary: The ability to use other's strategies, skills or techniques, but upgraded, while the original owner can't use them.
strengths: Copy another's strategies, skills or techniques and upgrade them
A person can't use them for 5 min.
Have minor psychic powers
weaknesses: The copied strategies, skills or techniques only last for 5 min.

name: Sensejack
description: This power lets you tap into the sensory input of another person, allowing you to see, hear, taste, feel, and smell as they do. You can ride around in their head as a spy, receiving information unnoticed, but you can't control their senses or actions - you can only observe. Line of sight is needed to tap into a target, but duration is unlimited. Skilled telepaths can detect and evict a sensejacker from a host mind.
summary: The ability to perceive the world using the senses of others.
strengths: Real-time information flow.
Safe and anonymous observation from a distance.
On higher levels, you hear the person's thought what what they perceive
weaknesses: Might have to jump from person to person until you get the right position and perspective.
You can't use your own senses.
You're subject to the limitations of their senses (poor eyesight, hearing, etc.)

name: Pencil Of Freedom
description: Be free from any restraint! In court? Grab a pencil, use the power, and write down what comes to mind. Simply read it off, and you'll have teary eyes and heads nodding that it was necessary. Ram someone's new Porsche? Start scribbling! The Pencil of Freedom is incredibly powerful, and is used almost universally for evil. Can be resisted by people who can shield their mind with superpowers.
summary: The ability to write the world's best excuse for whatever situation you are in.
strengths: Never let it be your fault again.
Get out without blame.
Be truly free of all morality (unless you have a conscience. )
weaknesses: You're a liar.
There may still be consequences from your actions that can't be controlled.
Have to have a pencil nearby to use it, and you have to get that idea to them.

name: Sociological Aptitude
description: With this ability you understand not only all slang terms, but also sarcasm, tone, body language and context, which you can interpret flawlessly. With this power, you will never accidently offend someone and always know exactly how to speak in a way which will not be taken the wrong way. Also offers advanced insight into the human psyche and other sociolgical processes. Perfect for all with Asperger's Syndrome.
summary: The ability to have an innate understanding of society.
strengths: Perfect for those with Asperger's Syndrome.
Perfect for travelling.
Never accidently offend anyone again.
weaknesses: Not useful in combat.
Less useful with Telepathy, Humanity One! , etc.
Useless if you don't speak to relative strangers much.

name: Chaotikinesis
description: When you use this ability, you send out brainwaves that do two things. One, it causes everyone around to start panicing for no reason. And two, they create chaos around them. It could be anything, from a car crash to animals rampaging on the loose. This could be very powerful, even if you have no control of what sort of chaos it generates. You could even focus the chaos and panic into a certian target.
summary: The ability to mentally create chaos and panic.
strengths: You could create some chaos as a distraction.
You can focus your power on a certian target
weaknesses: You or someone else could get hurt in the chaos

name: Reality Breaker
description: Breakers can control reality, though they must pay a price each time they do so (like give up your sight, or your left toenail); but each time you break reality, you have to give up a bigger price than the last one; they also have a certain type of intuition that allows them to sense reality, including the presence of others with superpowers and impending danger.
summary: The ability to break reality
strengths: You can bend and break reality however you want to
You can sense danger in others, even when they are not human
Your mind is the key to breaking reality
weaknesses: You must pay a price for breaking reality
Each time you do so, the price only gets bigger
You must use it wisely or not at all; it could kill you if not careful

name: Anamnesis Embezzlement
description: Ever had an embarrassing moment in front of your crush? Well, all you have to do is "accidentally" bump into (or just touch) him/her and immediately be able to "pick-and-choose" which memory you want to steal, being your embarrassing moment. Basically, through touch you can see the memories of the person you are touching, and then steal and erase the memory from the person. The possibilities are endless!
summary: The ability to steal the memories of another by touch
strengths: You can view the memories of others without having to experience them yourself.
You can steal and "erase" a certain memory that you don't want the person to have.
It's awesome!
weaknesses: You have to be able to touch the person, or it won't work.
They have to have their mental barriers down in order for you to access their memories.
Once you "steal" the memory, the person will not remember the moment.

name: Fear Of Thought
description: The power to touch someone and see their greatest fear. When you touch them, they will see their greatest fear for a couple of minutes, even though it is an illusion.
summary: The ability to touch someone and see their greatest fear.
strengths: You can place an illusion of fear on a person.
You can control your powers.
weaknesses: You may see YOUR greatest fear if you touch the person for too long.
Animals are immune to it.

name: Empathic Replication
description: One with this ability can summon replicates of oneself to assist, defend or do other tasks, but each replicate is only produced by releasing that emotion template from one's psyche and solidifying it as though it were a separate entity. This ability is often accompanied by Empathy or an empathic rapport with one's replicates (this allows the user to keep track of the replicates at all times)
summary: The ability to create replicates that represent each of one's emotions
strengths: As many emotions as you are capable of experiencing, you can project as replicates
They're connected to your psyche, so they don't go rogue (and you can read their thoughts/emotions)
They may manifest abilities of their own based on the emotions they represent
weaknesses: Exaggerated personalities based on the feeling they represent
This form of replication may trap you in the emotional state you were in when you replicated
This form of replication may devoid you of emotion completely until you recall the duplicates

name: Research Zone
description: Creates a zone that increases the intelligence of those inside. Those inside will not be able to suffer from anything that causes a decrease in their mental powers. Objects inside the zone can be turned holographic with a computer screen appearing in front of them that contains information about the object. Experiments can be performed on the holographic items and then returned to their original state if desired. Living things will not be turned holographic but will have a double of themselves.
summary: The ability to create a zone that promotes intelligence and new discovery.
strengths: Mental protection.
Increased intelligence.
Ability to study and experiment on objects.
weaknesses: Your enemies will become smarter as well.
People may perform experiments on things you do not want them too.
Can only study what is in the zone.

name: Living Memory
description: A person with this power becomes a living memory. As long as somebody in the world remembers you, you will continue to exist. You have enhanced strength as a memory since you are not bound by physical constraints and you do not age. You also regenerate. However, you can only appear to people who know you and can only be introduced to people by people who know you. You are not visible to cameras or other things that don't have sentience. You can also appear in people's dreams.
summary: The ability to be a living memory
strengths: It's very hard to kill you since you are a memory
You are not bound by physical limits or the constraints of a physical body
You can automatically appear in front of anybody who knows you
weaknesses: People with memory wiping powers can wipe you from everyone's memory
If you are hit with power negation, you will cease to exist.
You will not be visible to a camera, so you won't leave a visual image for people to remember

name: Akasha Viewing
description: It is a rare and an extremely powerful Godlike psychic ability that enables the user to connect one's mind with the Akasha realm. A realm that keeps infinite records of everything that has been done then, now and will be in the existence of infinity. The user not only sees things that happened, but sees the facts in their purest and truest form in reality.
summary: The ability to mentally connect to the realm that keeps ALL records of ALL things.
strengths: If the user has enough energy, control and power, the user CAN summon this at will.
This power never deceives the user.
The user has a Godlike knowledge of almost everything that has been and will be.
weaknesses: The effect lasts for a short time. Even a God is not able to have a FULL connection with it.
Things that are frightening or bad can come unexpected and may terrify even the toughest user.
It drains the user's energy. If the user dwells within this state for too long, the user dies.

name: Friend Foe Finder
description: Whilst asleep, much like a precognitive vision, you glimpse the faces of other people like you; other people with extraordinary abilities. With time and experience, more knowledge about these individuals will come to you in dreaming; names, voices, echoes of things (both good and bad) that have happened to them. This power proves that all 'special' people are connected, and makes you aware of their identities. You may receive a vague impression of where they are, but rarely learn addresses.
summary: The ability to see the faces of other superpowered people in your dreams
strengths: You become aware of others like you, and can find them if you recognise any scenery from your vision
Based on the dreams, you may know before meeting them if these people are friendly or dangerous
weaknesses: You cannot learn the exact location of these people through your dreams
People you find through this power may react badly, especially if they are trying to appear 'normal'

name: Communication Jammer
description: Whenever an exchange of information is taking place through any form and method (speech, written paper, thought transfer, sign language, braille,... ), you can severely disrupt it, making it incomprehensible to anyone. For example, visual messages will be completely blurred, auditory messages will be drowned in noise, radio communication will suffer from serious interference,... You can select specific flows of communication to jam, or indiscriminately disrupt any going on in your vicinity.
summary: The ability to severely disrupt a communication, making it unintelligible to anyone.
strengths: It even works on communication means protected from 'muggle' ways of jamming.
You can jam radars from getting information about your speed.
You can prevent any kind of communication from taking place in your vicinity.
weaknesses: You are not immune to the effects of this power.
You can't secure a communication since the sender and the recipients won't understand anything.

name: Past Trails
description: Focusing on a person or object will allow you to see a trail of shadowy imprints of where they have been in the past. For example, if you focus on someone you will not only see them but also a trail of shades showing where they were and what they were doing in the past.
summary: The ability to see were a person or object has been
strengths: Follow the trails of suspected criminals back to see if the commited the crime.
Find out where people or objects have been.
Find a deeper insight into people by seeing their past.
weaknesses: You must physically follow the trail to see a persons past.
You can only see things that the person has already done.
You can only see the shade, with no other context other than what you can infer from their actions

name: Shadow Grip
description: This power requires a certain amount of willpower, focus, and thoughts of inner evil.  Once achieved, you can summon 1-2 hands made of pure shadows to do your bidding and attack your enemies.   One back draw is that if you're not focused enough, these hands will turn on you.   Be warned also, as they can only last a limited time.
summary: The ability to summon a large hand of shadows to crush/pound your enemies.
strengths: Helps you lift heavy objects
Self-attacks enemies of all kind
Immune to fire, electric, or ice damage
weaknesses: If not focused right, they turn on you.
Has trouble defeating light
Can only be used for 20 minutes at a time, with a 10 minute recharge

name: Emotion Infliction
description: By concentrating on your emotion, you will make the opponent feel the same way, driving them to madness, or other feelings. A great way to stop them from hurting you, or such. But you have to feel that way, and the emotion has to be true.
summary: The ability to make people feel how you feel
strengths: Can hinder your opponent from hurting you
Can help your friends if they're upset
weaknesses: It won't remove the way you feel
May lead to depression, anger or anxiety
Takes time to inflict emotion, because you have to concentrate

name: Chain
description: With this power, you have the ability to summon forth a chain made out of near-indestructible energy. The chain can be as long as you want it to be, and its movements can be mentally controlled. You can use the chain as a whip for offensive purposes and deflect incoming attacks. Or as a lasso, so you can grab stuff. You can make it disappear again by force of will.
summary: The ability to summon a chain from your hands
strengths: Swing from building to building like Spiderman
The chain is really strong
The chain can be used to mimic almost any weapon
weaknesses: The chain reacts a second after your mental commands

name: Trivia Finder
description: Having a hard time finding the words? Possessing the Trivia Finder ability allows you to instinctively tell when someone has something in common with you. Impress the people around you with your knowledge, and never worry about party lines again.
summary: The ability to tell what someone else has in common with you.
strengths: Helps you talk to members of the opposite sex.
Its much easier to find people with the same hobbies as you.
It makes it easier to make friends.
weaknesses: No real combat ability.
It only works if you both know the same thing.

name: Death Existence
description: A person with this ability has the power to remain in existence as long as there is death (or the absence of life) in the universe. When this ability is active the user's state of mind (meaning its condition, freedom and abilities) is safeguarded by the ever existing death. This ability also safeguards itself and other 'death-powered' abilities like necromancy, death manipulation, and other death dealing abilities ever created from being nullied, manipulated, or dampened.
summary: The ability to unconditionally exist as long as death exists.
strengths: Be the ultimate being of death.
This ability and other's that induce, or manipulate death are totally immune from nullifications etc
You, your mind and your soul will forever be free from destruction & manipulation.
weaknesses: You are not alive and somehow not dead.
Your pain and suffering will eternally haunt you.
In the end you will wish you were dead.

name: Dream Consumption
description: Simply one with this ability mentally consumes the dreams of others, thus gaining strength and other heightened senses from doing so. Consuming nightmares does not affect one in anyway, one may even gain more strength from these nightmares. One can can also eat day dreams and you can't starve to death from not eating dreams that often.
summary: The ability to mentally consume dreams and gain strength and other heightened senses.
strengths: Gain power from eating dreams.
Certain dreams dont hurt you.
Nightmares or extremely good dreams give you even more power.
weaknesses: Must eat dreams to gain power.
Almost useless for combat, but nevertheless can be used in these situations

name: Confessions
description: The user puts a person under there control for the rest of there life (no undoes). The user stares into the subjects eyes and readjusts his/her mind to follow and obey. People aren't sure how this is possible but it is sure it is a family trait.
summary: The ability to make any person fall under a hypnosis for the user to do whatever (like a slave)
strengths: This can make peace with people
Perfect lie detector
Makes criminals good
weaknesses: Slaves
People can die easier at a sound of a vocal box
Heroes can turn bad

name: Dream Library
description: When you fall asleep, you have the choice of entering the library or not. If you choose not to, you will sleep like usual. If you choose to enter the library, then you will find yourself at the entrance of a huge building. You walk inside and see huge bookcases containing every book you ever read and every moment you ever lived. You have the ability to take down any book, and the library's appearance changes upon many aspects of you, such as your past experiences, dreams, etc.
summary: The ability to enter a library which possesses millions of different books
strengths: You only need to read a book once before it will show up at this library.
You don't need to read the whole book for it to appear, but only the parts you read will show up.
You can write books here, and it won't keep your body from resting.
weaknesses: You can only enter the library when you're asleep.
You must have either read part of the book, or lived the moment already.
Any other superpowers you have aren't effective in the library.

name: Soulstorm
description: An array of powers that allow the user to manipulate their soul into living energy. They may bend this energy to their will whether it be a concussive beam, a force field, energy weaponry,or unleashing a soul storm. Every attack tears at the victim's mental and emotional state, piercing the fabrics of their soul. Though powerful and difficult to receive, the power is extremely taxing on the user's mental focus and strength
summary: The ability to transform your soul into a lethal weapon
strengths: Power increases as focus increases
Limited only by imagination and willpower
Attacks can't be physically blocked
weaknesses: Taxing on the mental and emotional state
Can be corrupted or weakened by telekinetic attacks

name: Ability Immunity
description: Someone with this power would be completely normal, only they are immune to all superpower effects. Memory removers, illusionists, suggestionists, pain inflictors, psychics are all rendered useless when confronted with a possessor of this power. However, indirect assaults from powers do inflict damage, such as telekinetic knife attacks or teleporting a heavy weight to above your head.
summary: The ability to not be affected by any super power.
strengths: This, if combined with another power, would be the perfect superhero assassin ability.
Ability stealers can't take this (because of immunity), so the wielder of this ability is unique.
Superpowers don't seem so ominous now.
weaknesses: Positive powers have no effect either (such as telepathic relayal of information. )
Still have regular human weaknesses.
Not immune to indirect power effects.

name: Monetary Telekinesis
description: Tired of rummaging through your wallet for the exact amount of change because the cashier doesn't have it? Then your worries are over with Monetary Telekinesis! If you have the money, but can't seem to find it normally, then the money will be attracted to you like a magnet! Works on bills and coins!
summary: The ability to instantly have your money come to you in the exact amount needed
strengths: Makes it easier to buy things
Makes time at the counter less aggravating
Saves time!
weaknesses: If you have a large bill and no coins, all you can do is use that bill
This does not break up your money for you
If you lose the wallet, this power will not bring it back

name: Future Trails
description: Focusing on a person or object will allow you to see a ghostly imprint of where they or it will be further along in their timeline. For example, focus on a dog and you will see not only that dog, but a trail of the dog shades showing where it will be and what it will be doing in the future.
summary: The ability to see where a person or object will go.
strengths: Easy way to keep tabs on people.
Save people who would be hurt in the future from their fate.
Know what someone will be doing in the future.
weaknesses: You must physically follow the trail of shades to see what happens in that person's timeline.
You can only focus on one person or object at a time.
You can only see the shade, with no other context other than what you can infer from their actions.

name: Mind Printer
description: With this power you can print out any image that you see in your mind. All you have to do is blink twice and say "Print. " The image will then be printed out on the nearest printer. You can't change which printer the image prints on it will always be the printer closest to you.
summary: The ability to send images that you see in your mind to the nearest printer
strengths: You can print out any image that you see in your mind
weaknesses: You can't control where it prints

name: Follow Me
description: With this power you can make a person follow you. The person will not be able to deviate from the path you take and will enter any building and follow any vehicle that you enter. They will also not be able to do anything else except for follow you. This could be useful to make your enemies follow you to prison or something. You can make the person stop following you whenever you want.
summary: The ability to cause a person to follow you
strengths: You can cause a person to follow you
weaknesses: This power does not work on robots

name: Memory Chip
description: With this power you can download anything to your memory. Everything goes: movies, video games, TV shows or enemy plans that someone stupidly put on the internet. But you must be able to access it on a regular computer (so no DoD memos) and the speed is the same as the highest download speed you've ever achieved on your OWN computer. Can also transfer the chip's contents back onto a computer.
summary: The ability to download things onto your memory
strengths: Can download anything from the Internet onto your memory chip
weaknesses: Sometime your memory can get cluttered
Using this power too much can cause your memory & memory chip to crash, leaving both blank
Limited to regular stuff and (possibly) limited bandwith

name: Primal Fear
description: Everyone still has that old 'fear instinct'--the nameless horror that makes us want to run and hide. A person with Primal Fear can subdue conscious thought while bringing up this old instinct. Meaning? Everyone in 50 yards will leave the area, no matter the cost. The user can flip this on and off, like a switch. However, it is difficult to target specific people. The user's eyes also glow yellow.
summary: The ability to induce an irresistible fear in the people around you
strengths: People will want to leave the area, no matter the cost
Good distraction
Cornering someone while using this power
weaknesses: 50 yard range
Difficult to target specific people
When using, eyes glow yellow

name: Attention Detection
description: This power enables you to sense when you are being paid attention to by anyone and wherever they are. If it's from people you are acquainted with, you'll know their identity. You won't know their true intentions but you can feel how much attention you are being given and how (thought, scrutinizing, conversation, overhearing, active listening,...).
summary: The ability to sense when someone is looking at, thinking about or even talking about you
strengths: Discover if someone keeps thinking about you, gossips on you or spies on you.
Knowing there are people thinking or talking about you is motivating.
Not knowing their intentions doesn't mean you cannot guess them right!
weaknesses: Passive power - you'll need active training to shut it off at will.
Can become overwhelming if you are (in)famous.
Can be depressing if you realise noone is paying attention to you.

name: Myth Power: Caerus' Cunning
description: Caerus (Cairus, Cairos, Kairos), in Greek myth, was the god of recognizing and seizing opportunity. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive when an opportunity of any kind has presented itself (a person leaves himself open in a fight, one is about to receive a call offering a great job, etc). In addition, this perception doubles one's speed, reflexes, agility and dexterity to help seize the opportunity at hand. One can psychically perceive how long the opportunity will last.
summary: The ability to channel Caerus' command over the essence of chance and opportunity
strengths: Perceive when opportunities present themselves (when developed, share perception by touch)
Speed/reflexes/agility/dexterity all increase to help seize opportunities
Perceive how long one has to take an opportunity (and when it has passed)
weaknesses: Pro #2 does not last when opportunity passes (during power use) until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with and compel opportunists until developed (NCN)
Probability/chance/luck-based MythPowers and Unpredictability provide immunity (NCN)

name: Music Of The Spheres
description: One with this ability is greatly gifted. With it, you can tune into the Music of the Spheres (the Music of the Heavens or Musica Universalis), which is the normally-inaudible musical and rhythmic working of the universe. Tuning into it brings about a state of true mental and spiritual harmony. In addition, you can allow others to hear the music as well. However, because their minds are not adapted to such frequencies, they enter a euphoric stupor that lasts until they can no longer hear it.
summary: The ability to tune into the transcendent rhythmic, musical workings of the universe
strengths: Mental/spiritual harmony by tuning into the transcendent essence from which all music/rhythm derives
Tuning into said essence will also make you an excellent poet, singer, songwriter, dancer, etc.
Tuning others into it renders them stupefied by the sheer beauty of the music
weaknesses: Some weaker users cannot tune into the music without themselves being stupefied
If you ARE stupefied by your own music, it's permanent, unless undone by another with this power
Some weaker users can't allow others to hear the music

name: The Pendant
description: Alone, this power will create a barrier that blocks all physical attacks up to 5000 Newtons. If you also have The Throne, The Crown, and The Ring then this power will also protect the mind so long as the physical barrier is still standing.
summary: The ability to create a barrier that can protect one against harm
strengths: Protection to the mind and the body in one power.
Like the other powers in this ggroup you don't need an object or artifact to use this power.
weaknesses: 5,000 Newtons isn't that much force (only 500 kilograms or 1100 pounds).

name: The Power Of Chaos
description: Conjure the Chaos Emeralds and use them to their full capabilities. Use Chaos Control to teleport. Use all seven to become invincible and super fast. However, the power only lasts in accordance to your emotion, and the type of power also mimics your emotion, both negative and positive.
summary: The ability to conjure and utilize the Chaos Emeralds
strengths: Teleport with Chaos Control.
Become invincible and super fast with all seven.
weaknesses: Power lasts as long as your emotion is strong.
Power changes depending on positive and negative emotion.

name: Myth Power: Basileia's Best
description: Basileia, in Greek myth, was the goddess of royalty, sovereignty and monarchy. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically summon a crown, which allows one to compel others to do one's will, as well as withstand compulsion. In addition, one can psychically summon a scepter that forces subjects to bow/kneel, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically summon a throne to heal/empower self and allies, at will. One even gains royal status in one's homeland, whether or not one wears the crown.
summary: The ability to channel Basileia's command over the essence of royalty, sovereignty and monarchy
strengths: Psychically summon a psionic crown that allows compulsion of others, and immunity to compulsion
Psychically summon a scepter to make subjects bow/kneel, and a throne to heal/empower self/allies
Gain royalty status in one's homeland (decrees become law, defended by citizens of that land, etc)
weaknesses: Cannot psychically summon (user-controlled) psionic crowns for others until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically teleport to one's homeland at will until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically bend reality within limits of one's homeland until developed (NCN)

name: Chronopathy
description: Tick. Tock. A Chronopath has a powerful psychic link to the timeline. This gives them a powerful internal clock, down to the millisecond of the day (it's 3:09:36:58 PM), a sense of how long events will last, and a sense of when events will occur. They can also detect temporal anomalies, and sense temporal manipulation, and the age of matter (how time has affected things). However, it only gives you a sense of when events will occur, not how to stop them, and it does not bestow precognition.
summary: The ability to possess an intimate link with the timeline
strengths: Grants a powerful internal clock
Gives a sense of how long events will last, or how long till an event occurs
Perceive age, temporal manipulation and temporal anomalies (like time travel)
weaknesses: Not Precognition or Postcognition
Does not let you know how to stop events, only when they will happen
Cannot manipulate time

name: Televandalism
description: All you need to do is concentrate on any object you can see, and it will break under your mental influence. The larger and more complex the object is, the harder it is to break, and it may even require several minutes. The way it breaks is up to the user and their mind, as however they envision it is how it will happen. With enough time and focus, you could fold a 747 in half. However, you are limited to non-organic objects only, so no breaking people's bodies. Now go break stuff.
summary: The ability to break objects from afar
strengths: Break anything you want.
Control over how the object breaks.
Who's going to know you broke it? Nobody can prove you did it.
weaknesses: It's not telekinesis, as you can only break things.
Can only break non-living things, like guns or cardboard boxes.
It may take a long time to break a large object, and you may pass out from the strain.

name: Myth Power: Apollo's Appeal
description: Apollo (Apollon), in Greek myth, was the god of prophecy, oracles, healing, the arts (philosophy, etc), sports and sunlight. As such, channeling him gifts one with skill in sports (especially archery), music (singing, songwriting, playing instruments), art, poetry and divination. In addition, one can psychically perceive the future (at will, in the presence of sunlight). Furthermore, one can absorb sunlight to gain physical power. One can even psychically heal others with sunlight, by touch.
summary: The ability to channel Apollo's command over the essence of prophecy, healing, the arts, sports and sunlight
strengths: Gain skill in sports, music, art, poetry and divination
Psychically perceive the future (at will, in the presence of sunlight)
Absorb sunlight to gain physical power; psychically heal others with sunlight, by touch
weaknesses: Cannot psychically control sun's course (rising/setting) or manipulate solar energy (NCN)
Cannot psychically summon indestructible bow (infinite plague-tipped arrows), until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically bestow powers of Prophecy (or Paradox Prophecy),  by touch, until developed (NCN)

name: Emotion Manipulation
description: A person with this ability can amplify a subject's current emotions (e.g. happy to ecstatic, sad to suicidal), even to the point of overloading them so they can't think (e.g. sexual pleasure so powerful they are immobilized); they can change one emotion into another (e.g. happy to sad, sad to angry, sad to fear, etc.), or once it is developed, suppress emotions completely. You can also induce or negate Empathy and other powers based on sensing, manipulating or using emotions.
summary: The ability to change  a person's emotions
strengths: Can change a person's emotion to your advantage
Turn your enemies against each other
Make your enemies suicidal, or extremely scared
weaknesses: Cannot change your own emotions
May cause you to change someone's emotion unwillingly at first
If you don't practice, emotion changes can be permanent

name: Finger Tracker
description: With this power, when you really want to find something. All you have to do is use this power and your finger will automatically point to you where to find what you need. This is helpful for finding lost objects as well as tracking people or information. The tracker cannot be fooled by any external force however illusions can hide the true answer. Also this does not tell you the distance of people and will only display the fastest route or the route that you specificate
summary: The ability to have your finger point you in the right direction of what you want or need
strengths: You will never get lost
You can always find out where your belongings are
You can find other people or information
weaknesses: If what you are looking for does not exist
Sometimes the power is deceptive if something happens to be in front of your finger for example

name: Dark Charizard
description: You can become an alternate form of the Pokemon Charizard, with dark roan red skin, an orange chest, silver-black claws, glowing amber eyes, and a tail-flame of black fire. You can sense anyone both psychically and physically. You also have extremely powerful 'black fire' pyrokinesis, telepathy, and regeneration. You can read the minds as well as memories of any person or animal within a twenty-mile-radius.
summary: The ability to transform at will into a 'dark' form of Charizard
strengths: You are a very rare and powerful type of dragon, with unmatched aerial abilities and reflexes
Despite being a 'dark' dragon, you are not evil!!
You can use the powers in human form if you choose
weaknesses: Your power starts off fairly weak, and so practice is required to harness your abilities
At first, you could be stuck in your Dark Charizard form for longer than you desire
An extremely dangerous ability in the wrong hands!

name: Ability Information Library
description: Are your information powers causing mental overload? With this power, you problem will be solved. You can set your other powers to send their information into a mental bank, instead of your mind. You can then review your information in your own time, already sorted into the categories you need. Alternately, the information can simply appear as knowledge as it is needed (i. E. When speaking about world history, information from Psychometry may spontaneously surface.
summary: The ability to store information from powers in a special format.
strengths: No more mental overload.
Presorted information.
Can look through stored information in your own time.
weaknesses: Still limited to your own memory; you just access it as needed/wanted.
If you don't review your stored information, you may lose track of what you know.
Still takes up space in your memory, so you may need a memory-enhancing power.

name: Psychic Distraction
description: Focus in anything is key. A person with Psychic Distraction can consciously infulence another person's brain so that it loses some ability to sort information. The result? Small noises, motion, an itch that would normally be ignored suddenly merit full and automatic attention. This ability takes little energy to activate and can be left on for a radius-effect of squirrely people.
summary: The ability to dramatically decrease a person's attention span
strengths: Target loses ability to maintain focus
Can be used to sneak past unfocused people
Devastating in hand-to-hand combat
weaknesses: Weakens with range
Must be careful to not be noticed yourself
Can be accidentally left on, crippling allies

name: Precognitive Dreamer
description: With this power, you will have precognitive dreams about things that will happen in the near future (a few days). Most of the time, it will be an event that concerns you or your friends directly, but it can also be a very important world event, like the 9/11 attacks.
summary: The ability to have precognitive dreams.
strengths: See your future mistakes, and prevent them from happening.
Become the best medium ever.
Prevent disasters.
weaknesses: You don't always remember your dreams
It's random: you might end up not having precognitive dreams for more than a month.

name: Euphoric Aura
description: You can really cheer someone up when your aura of complete blissful happiness spreads to them. They will become entranced & feel complete enlightened aligned centered zen. A nirvana state of euphoria. Without worry, fear, sad gloominess. Just happy thoughts. Though the down side to this happy power is it doesn't affect you, you have normal feelings & the people could become addicted to your heavenly aura & want you around forever.
summary: The ability to make a person become entranced with joy
strengths: You bring happiness to everyone around you
weaknesses: You can't use your happy power on yourself
The euphoria could become addictive for the people
People might withdraw & become depressed when you're not there

name: Hallucinization
description: With this power, you can leave to physical plane and become an illusion in someone else's mind. You then become intangible to everyone but them. You know everything they know and can disappear and reappear at any time. However, while you are in their mind, you are extremely susceptible to chizophrenia medication and their thoughts. Exiting this mode takes a little effort, and you might not get out in time. Still, this power offers a multitude of uses.
summary: The ability to turn yourself into a hallucination
strengths: Easy transportation
Mind Reading
Drive people crazy
weaknesses: Can only affect the victim
If they stop believing that you exist, then you stop existing
The gun is in your hand... The gun is in my hand

name: Hobby Powers
description: With this ability, you'll have powers related to your hobbies and will make them more productive, easier, and more fun. If your into pottery, you can dry your items without the need of a kiln. If your an author for fun, you can write on a surface without a pen or pencil or type with your mind, etc.
summary: The ability to have powers related to your hobby or hobbies
strengths: Hobby is a lot more fun
Can impress your friends with stuff you can make
weaknesses: Not really useful in combat

name: Myth Power: Fertility Force3
description: The phallic companions of Priapus, in Greek myth, were the gods of fertility. As such, channeling Orthanes (Orthannes, Orthages, Orthagenes- sexual arousal), one can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel subjects who are attracted to oneself, and/or to whom one is attracted, at will. In addition, one psychically withstand being knocked off of one's feet (ie remain standing 'erect'), at will. One can even gain physical power in the presence of large phallic objects (skyscrapers etc).
summary: The ability to channel Priapus' companions' command over the essence of fertility
strengths: Psychically perceive and compel attractive/attracted subjects, at will
Withstand being knocked off of one's feet, at will (if you choose, lay down to sleep, etc)
Gain physical power in the presence of large phallic objects (the bigger, the better)
weaknesses: Cannot psychically immobilize people standing upright, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically manipulate phallic objects (baseball bats, pipes, etc), until developed (NCN)
Plant/animal/nature-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Grey Matter
description: You might get a strange feeling if you try to walk past and touch an unknown person who turns out to be a criminal. You are then able to witness, listen, and know what the evildoer is up to.
summary: The ability to see, hear and realize what a villain knows just by touching them.
strengths: You might inform the Police, the FBI or the CIA to let them know what the villain is planning next.
weaknesses: You'll have bad dreams.
The criminals might know you too.

name: Illusory Wishes
description: A person with this power can grant anyone's wishes through illusions. For example, if someone wished for a hamburger, they would instantly see a hamburger and start to eat it despite it being a tree branch or etc. If someone wishes for someone back from the dead, then you can create an illusory duplicate of the same person, but they cannot be grabbed, etc. or if you are evil, you can replace it with a sword, so the person hugs the sword and dies by bleeding.
summary: The ability to grant anyone's wishes with an illusion
strengths: You can grant any wish (except it is an illusion)
You can grant your own wishes (but you know it isn't real)
Can be used as pranks or kill people deceptively
weaknesses: It's not real
Someone has to actively wish for something for you to grant it

name: Willpower: Will Of Corruption
description: A person with this ability has the power to corrupt the freewill of other people by forcing his willpower upon them. The willpower of the user dwells within the mind of his victim; it acts like a poison that merges with the victim's mind and freewill in order to 'rewrite' them. In effect those who were corrupted no longer possess the ability to choose for themselves; instead they act or think in submission to the willpower that took hold of their very existence.
summary: The ability to corrupt the freewill of other people.
strengths: Concentration is not necessary. You just need to poison them with your willpower.
Victims think and act just like you. The need to control them is no longer needed
No conscious being that possess freewill is immune to this ability.
weaknesses: The act of projecting your willpower to corrupt others require absolute mastery.
Corruption may take time depending on the willpower utilized.
Victims eventually die.

name: Luxuria
description: This ability allows the user to cast an illusion(s) to another person based on their most intimate desires. For example the person may see the one they love confessing to them, or perhaps see a harem of women(or men) relinquishing themselves. The illusion is very powerful and cannot be broken easily. Even if the person realizes that its an illusion that alone will not break it.
summary: The ability to cast an Illusion to another based on their most intimate desires
strengths: Can work on just about everybody
Can't be broken by mere recognization of the illusion
weaknesses: Though powerful and realistic it's a mere illusion
The length of the illusion is affected by the users own energy and power

name: Animal Empathic Communication
description: Like Wild Thornberries, you will be able to talk to animals & have them understand you. Animals will also be able to talk to you & you will understand them. Even though you understand each other, it doesn't mean that dangerous, hungry animals won't attack you.
summary: The ability to speak to & understand all animals & vice versa
strengths: Talk with animals & have an understanding of each other
Animals will help you if you need assistance
weaknesses: Dangerous animals might still attack you
Some animals might not shut up

name: Obsession Generation
description: The length of the message and the number of times it will be repeated depend on the energy you will spend to create it. Your target can also reduce the number of repetitions if they perform certain actions related to the message. For example, for "dirty", they can wash themselves or clean their house; for "the door's not locked", they can go all the way to their house and check their door; for "red is death", they can avoid touching red things or saying words with the sound "red".
summary: The ability to make a message of your choosing repeat itself over and over again in someone's mind.
strengths: You can easily drive someone to madness, paranoia, suicide or murder.
It can be an effective way to brainwash someone.
A little energy is needed to use this power, so a message can be repeated for hours.
weaknesses: The victim reduce the number of repetitions. But, they need to perform certain actions to do so.

name: Myth Power: Nike's Knowledge
description: Nike (Nice), in Greek myth, was the goddess of victory (in combat and competition). As such, channeling her allows one to naturally possess every skill one will ever need in one's lifetime. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and gain enhanced physical stats in the presence of subjects that wish for his success. One can even adapt their body, gaining superhuman abilities/features, to enter a competition wherever it is being held (in space, at the bottom of the sea, etc).
summary: The ability to channel Nike's command over the essence of victory
strengths: Become an expert strategist; Win nearly any competition (board games, sports, obstacle courses, etc)
Psychically perceive, communicate with and gain power around subjects who wish for your success

Pro #3 only works in competitons (not combat or the like) until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPowers based on Styx or Styx's Children (Cratos, Bia, Nike, Zelos) provide immunity (NCN)

name: Ruthless Pursuit
description: This power forms a psychic link between a target being pursued, and the user's feelings for the target (his hatred for the target, or his desire to find him for any other reason); this connection allows the user to track the target wherever he goes (or to at least have an idea of what direction the subject lies in, and a psychic vibration that fluctuates with the growing/diminishing proximity of the subject)
summary: The ability to pursue a target, by forming a link between the target and your desire to find them
strengths: Two words: Bounty Hunter
Four Words: Reality Show "The Locator"
Even more words: track down any desired object, subject or location
weaknesses: Must have seen the target before
Your power is only as strong as your desire to find the target
This is kind of a villain power (think "Michael Myers")

name: Millusionance
description: You can create illusions to match up with the music currently playing.
summary: The ability to create an illusionary show to go with whatever music is playing
strengths: Put on a great show
Have a blast
Can make you rich and famous
weaknesses: Not practical in everyday life
Not obviously useful in combat
When the music stops so fades your illusion

name: Myth Power: Tyche's Hand
description: Tyche, in Greek myth, was the goddess of chance, fortune and luck. As such, channeling her effectively makes the user a friend of fate, almost always positively affected by it. In addition, one can influence stochastic fields to produce good and/or bad luck for others. One can also psychically discern all the possible outcomes of a move (or the ultimate conclusion of a decision). The user can even perceive an object or subject's luck factor, impending events of good/bad fortune, and the like.
summary: The ability to channel Tyche's command over the essence of luck, probability and chance
strengths: Almost always positively affected by the forces of fate; immunity to probability manipulation
Distribute good/bad luck at will (and charge objects with bad/good luck by touch)
Perceive stochastic fields (the chances of an event happening, impending fortune/misfortune, etc. )
weaknesses: People with probability/chance/luck based MythPowers and Unpredictability are immune to this ability
People with MythPower: Zeus Power are immune to this ability
People with MythPower: Oceans/Tethys Power are immune to this ability

name: Name Based Powers
description: This ability grants the user with a superhuman capability, power or feature based on one's name. Not to be confused with the power Yclepsis, the power to control a person by calling their name, this power would let a person named Billy gain the proportional powers of a goat, a person named Randy would gain seductive powers, a person named Jasmine would gain the powers of a flower (Pheromones, hypnotic beauty, photosynthesis, maybe plant control, etc), as long as it pertains to one's name
summary: The ability to gain a power based on your name
strengths: If you have a unique name (like Prince or Serenity or Micah) you gain powers pertaining to that name

If someone has the power of Yclepsis and makes you forget your name, your power is negated
If you don't like your name, your power is less than max potential

name: Aspect Clones
description: You create the following clones these clones act independent and cant be reabsorbed they have the same powers as you(unless otherwise stated clone is C) They are as follows:A C just like you, a C that is like you only 7, a evil master mind C, a C of the opposite gender, a C that is dumb and savage but with powers enhanced times 2 if that would be good for it, a nice C, a wussy C, a C with opposite powers, a C that is old and, a C that is dumb and mean,and a C that is better than you in every way

weaknesses: When you gain this power or lose it it activates
All the C's exept the one like you, the opposite gender one and the one that's better than you.
It creates any clone it likes, create clones like themselves.

name: Womanizer
description: With this ability you can think or imagine any woman you want and make a 100% perfect clone of her appear in front of you as your own. You completely own her. You can also change her any way you want. You can make her disappear when you're finished. They will always do whatever you want and or say. It is perfect.

strengths: You can have any woman you want, wherever and whenever you want

You will be better than Playboy
weaknesses: It's demeaning to women
Real women will hate you
Other than that, it is flawless

name: Worl Zuper
description: WorlZuper gives you the power to create your own secret world in your mind. You can even transport your friends there. You can make your own fictional characters. You can create and do ANYTHING!!!

strengths: The world can be anything that you want it to be
You will never age
You will never get sick

If you visit your world for more than 8 hours you will get a small headache
You will disappear off of the face of the earth while visiting your world

name: Blades Of The Fae
description: You can create up to 10 blades composed of light that act like pure acid to whatever they touch. You can control the blades with a thought. In order to gain this power, you must eat a live fairy.
summary: The ability to create and control blades of light that act like acid to what they touch
strengths: The blades can't be controlled by acid manipulators because it only acts like acid.
weaknesses: You can lose control of the blades to photokinetics and blade manipulators.

name: Enmity  Memory Deletion
description: This power allows you to erase all of the negative memories someone has of another person. Bad memories containing only the two of them are completely exorcized, while the person is deleted from any bad memory that contains more people. The good memories your victim has of this person are left completely intact.
summary: The ability to delete all the bad memories someone associates with a specific person.
strengths: Alter someones perception of someone else.
Improve someones reputation.
Help improve a negative relationhip.
weaknesses: The person you erace dosen't change, and has a chance to make a new bad impression.
If you want to compleatly repair someones reputation, you have to get to most of their detracters.
You could set someone to liking a compleat monster.

name: Opinion Shift
description: This ability enables a person to shift/change other people's opinions about anything. However, there is one restriction. A person can only change the opinions of 5 people every day.
summary: The ability to change people's opinion(s).
strengths: Change the opinions of people who dislike you.
Get a girlfriend/boyfriend more easily.
Lots of fun.
weaknesses: Only 5 people per day.
Possibly serious consequences.

name: Thanatoform
description: Thanatoform lets you turn into a Grim Reaper version of yourself, allowing you to access any location, not die of natural causes, and carry a cool weapon that doesn't have to be a scythe. One thing to keep in mind is you are not Death. Death is Death, and Death can still kill you, so don't make him mad and do what he tells you. Also, this power would make the coolest halloween costume and it's just plain cool. I mean you can turn into a Grim Reaper version of you... once every 55 days, sorry.
summary: The ability to turn into a Death/Grim Reaper version of yourself
strengths: People, and natural causes (like animals, poison, drowning, or germs) cannot kill you.
You look cool
You have the power of death
weaknesses: Death itself can still kill you (so don't make Death angry)
You can only use Thanatoform once every 55 days
Death may hire you to "do work" meaning you may have to kill someone you love or is important to you

name: Myth Power: Epione's Epiphany
description: Epione (Epiona, Epigone), in Greek myth, was the goddess of soothing pain. As such, channeling her allows one to soothe pain (physical and mental) by touch, a word or a thought. In addition, one can smooth out cramps, kinks and cricks, by touch. Furthermore, one can psychically access knowledge and skill in massage and other recuperative physical therapies (like yoga, tai chi, etc). One can even totally withstand pain (natural or caused by abilities); this pain immunity may be shared, by touch.
summary: The ability to channel Epione's command over the essence of comfort and soothing pain
strengths: Soothe physical/mental pain; touch eases cramps (used on healthy subjects, increases flexibility)
Psychically access knowledge and skill in massage and other physical therapies
Withstand all manner of physical and mental pain (may be shared by touch)
weaknesses: Cannot soothe pain by transferring it to another party, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot negate pain-based powers until developed (NCN)
Medical/healing/restorative MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Deep Thought
description: One with this ability first conjurs up a thought. This thought is then implanted or psychically communicated to a foe; the foe starts to contemplate on the thought so hard, that as they try to make sense of it, all motor functions cease, and the subject has no other desire except to contemplate the meaning of the thought that has been implanted in their mind.
summary: The ability to trap a subject in such deep concentration that they become immobilized
strengths: The implanted thought can be the simplest thing, and they will contemplate it endlessly
Immobilizes the subjects (he won't even try to retaliate against attacks)
Requires little to no concentration to return the subject to normal
weaknesses: Intense emotion triggers this ability (may make the foe contemplate the emotion that caused it)
If the power can't be turned off at will (or at all) it kills the foe (no desire to eat, drink, etc)
Makes the foe look stupid (trapped in a state of stupefied contemplation)

name: Thoughtermination
description: The ability to kill someone simply by thinking about their death and the conditions thereof. Death is immediate, and is caused by the conditions you select in your thoughts. The power is cut off when you fall asleep.
summary: The ability to kill by thought
strengths: You can destroy evil people in the world
You can remove all of those that get in your way
weaknesses: You can easily and accidentally kill yourself
You can accidentally kill others
You may become too powerful and corrupted.

name: Quantum Mind
description: This is a difficult ability to describe. A person with a Quantum Mind does not see their life as a series of events (I went to work, then I came home, then I went to bed). Instead, their mind is in their future and past even as they are in the present. This means that they know what is in store for them, and can never be surprised. However, they may also develop a fatalistic personality.
summary: The ability to perceive your life as all happening at once
strengths: Know what is in your future
Can mentally revisit your past
Never be surprised
weaknesses: Can be disrupted by large nuclear blasts or tachyons
May develop a fatalistic point of view
Might not be understood by other people

name: Cuetzpalin, The Resilience
description: You embody the Aztecs' representation of resilience, symbolized by lizards. When activated, you'll change into a human-lizard hybrid. The physical manifestation of this power allows you to be very nimble and reactive, climb up walls, have a detachable tail and a high tolerance to pain. The spiritual part of this power gives you more courage and resourcefulness to overcome emotional and psychological ordeal. You can also strengthen other people's courage and inspiration to overcome any obstacle.
summary: The ability to have the means and strength to overcome nearly all obstacles and reinforce other people's courage.
strengths: You're gifted with physical, emotional and psychological resilience.
Your powers can be used not just to flee, but also to dodge and to resist against damage.
You can breathe courage and resourcefulness into people's heart.
weaknesses: Don't be too reckless as this power doesn't give you the means to surpass every obstacle.
While this makes you strong enough to overcome things like grief, others may see you as insensitive.
While you can take damage and still stand up, you are not invulnerable.

name: Myth Power: Ode To The Oneiroi
description: The Oneiroi, in Greek myth, were the gods of dreams.  As such, channeling Morpheus (Morpheos), one may psychically induce and manipulate dreams about people. Channeling Phantasos (Phantasus), one may psychically induce and manipulate dreams about inanimate objects. Channeling Icelos (Ikelos, Epiales, Phobetor), one may psychically induce and manipulate nightmares. One may even psychically receive or bestow dreams of past/present/future, and consciously control and remember one's own dreams.
summary: The ability to channel the Oneiroi and their command over the essence of dreams and nightmares
strengths: Psychically induce and manipulate dreams and nightmares (Oneirokinesis) at will
Psychically manipulate one's own dreams (Lucid Dreaming) and recall them (Dream Recall) at will
Withstand others' Dream Manipulation (Oneirokinetic Immunity)
weaknesses: No Dream Travel/Teleportation, Dream Trapping or Dream Summoning until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot use dream energy (Dreamforce) to inflict hallucinations on waking foes until developed (NCN)
Sleeplessness, Dreamlessness, Perspicuity, MythPower: Hypnos' Lullaby, etc provide immunity (NCN)

name: Yclepsis
description: Also called Naming, this the ability to psychically cause subjects to react a certain way when their name is called followed by a command or a special phrase. After the user calls the subject's true name, they need only to call out a command (within the subject's power) or a predetermined phrase, and the command will carry out. This ability can even form a telepathic/empathic link with any other being of the same name or a similar name
summary: The ability to use names for various effects
strengths: Afflicting the subject with any virus, disease or sickness the user knows the true name of
Causing the user to forget his own name/identity or the name/identity of loved ones
Causing the subject to think he or the user is someone else
weaknesses: No Nicknames
The user must know the name of the subject that he wishes to affect
If the subject can resist Mind Control, Hypnotism or Psychic Persuasion, he can resist this ability

name: Tea Master
description: You need to have access to the necessary materials to brew tea. You don't even need to know how to brew tea, this power will guide you. While you make some tea, this power's effect will infuse the tea with soul-soothing properties, making you the perfect tea master. Even if someone else tries to copy your preparation method, they won't be able to make a tea as good as yours. Drinking the tea, or even just smelling the tea, will appease even the most raging minds.
summary: The ability to brew the perfect soothing tea.
strengths: Make peace, not war.
You don't need to know how to make tea.
This power is required to make this perfect tea.
weaknesses: You are vulnerable while the tea is being prepared.
You need to have the materials to make tea, such as the tea leaves, a pot and some water.
tags: was edited as it was too similar to another power

name: Hive Of Consciousness
description: Your brain is split into several independently functioning organs. You can multi-task at an incredible rate, focusing on several things at once. Your intelligence and ability to analyze things are unsurpassed.
summary: The ability to use the Conscious Hive.
strengths: Multi-task.
Analyse things at incredible rates.
High intelligence.
weaknesses: Might have a multiple personality.

name: Lethal Ability Amplification
description: You amplify the abilities of another superhuman until it kills them, normally by exceeding their necessary secondary powers. For example, you could make a pyrokinetic literally explode incinerating himself, force a speedster to run so fast that the air friction liquefies him, make a telepath's mind shut down from the stress of reading so many minds. With some powers, increasing them could endanger or kill others , such as a pyrokinetic releasing a massive explosion, potentially killing you too.
summary: The ability to increase others' abilities until it kills them
strengths: Can take out any dangerous supervillain
Become a specialised superhuman hitman
If a villain, no metahuman hero could defeat you
weaknesses: If your enemy's power comes from technology, your power is useless
You could be killed by your foe's loss of control
This power only really works for amoral people or villains

name: Cross Telephone Persuasion
description: A person with this power has the ability to control anyone that is answering a phone call. This power is akin to charisma or hypnotic voice but it only works through the electronic interface of phones. You can use any type of phone to call and the receiver comes under your control as long as they don't hang up. The affected person is unaware of the call and will forget everything once they or you hang up.
summary: The ability to control anyone through their phone
strengths: One phone call while in prison
You can control important leaders by calling them
People put on hold are still under your control awaiting orders unless they hang up
weaknesses: People have to be listening to the phone (Bluetooth works though)
You have to tell people not to hang up the phone or else they might hang up first
You have to know the person's number and the power can run out mid-conversation

name: Childish Wishes
description: With this power, you may grant the wishes of anyone under the age of thirteen. All the child must do is say "I Wish... " and you are able to grant the request that follows. Be the kind Fairy Godparent who makes all their dreams come true or the cruel Jinn who twists the words of their wish to harm them and everyone around them.
summary: The ability to grant the wish of a child
strengths: Grant children's wishes.
Sell wishes and make oodles of money.
