weaknesses: You may only grant the wishes of children,
The wish must begin with "I Wish... "
People may think you're a creep for hanging around children.

name: Power Reverse
description: With this strange power you can cause a Pyrokinetic to become a Hydrokinetic, a Flyer to become a Tunneler, a Mind Reader to a Mind Controller. With one touch you could cause anyone's power to completely reverse. All powers have an opposite and this power also tells you what the reversed power will be. Some powers on the other hand might have more than one reversed form. For example, an Ability Amplifier might become either an Ability Thief or an Ability Dampener. With practice you could choose.
summary: The ability to cause anyone's power to become its polar opposite.
strengths: You can reverse people's powers (and change them back).
If someone you know hates their power.
You know what the reversed power will be.
weaknesses: Most won't know how to control their new ability.
You must touch them to reverse them.
Reversing your own power could be bad.

name: Aphrodite
description: This power enables the user to be as beautiful as Aphrodite herself. But Aphrodite has a temper. So the user can also make sure that any victim can never be loved.
summary: The ability to have hypnotizing beauty
strengths: Beauty
More than just looks
weaknesses: Kinda boring

name: Vision Drain
description: This power lets you steal a persons very memories, any they have from now to the day they were born, simply by touching their head. This move can be useful if you need to learn a secret your friend is keeping from you, find out where they hid the diamonds, or discover any other information the target could possibly know.
summary: The ability to drain a person of their memories and add them to yours.
strengths: Find out any bit of information you need.
Good for police investigations.
Find out the answers for that big important test you have on Friday.
weaknesses: You could see some disturbing things.
Mind learn some hurtful things if the target knows you.
Could get cought by someone else if you don't use this power in private.

name: Emotional Submission Chamber
description: With a gesture you can encase your opponent in a grey barrier from head to toe concentrating based on your emotions, he or she get a panicked look on their faces and the barrier closes in an orb around them and lifts them above the ground. Massive color balls of willpower, fear, rage, love, hope, compassion, justice, sorrow, peace, joy, greed & wisdom forming orbiting and spiraling inwards towards the barrier and it powerfully explodes with the foe that's in it dealing a huge amount of damage.
summary: The ability to create a barrier that traps your opponent for free hits.
strengths: You could out-trap your foe with this move.
weaknesses: None

name: The Paths Of Magic:The Warlock
description: The Path of Warlock, or the Path of Thought, is the second Path of Magic. Warlocks use nothing but their minds and visualization to do magic. Because humans have very powerful minds, they are extremely good at following this path. It is also said that warlocks and witches are the best at controlling mana in it's rawest form, or in other words, mana weaving. This gives you a special talent for the Path of Thought.
summary: The ability to have special talent as a warlock.
strengths: As a human, you're already gifted at this path.
weaknesses: Takes great concentration

name: Musical Master
description: Take any instrument, such as a piano. Think out the music as you go along and it will seem like you are playing the piano along to your mental composition. No musical training necessary. This will work for any instrument but will only make music from that instrument, i.e. you can't take a flute and make it sound like a trumpet, etc. Have a rock song stuck in your head and want to play it masterfully for the next school talent show? You can, without any experience. Just play!
summary: The ability to create any music you want with a certain instrument just by thinking it.
strengths: Play any song or piece on any instrument just by thinking it out
No experience required; you can be a master at any musical instrument
Make money by landing gigs as a musical genius
weaknesses: The sound must be playable by the actual instrument
Only play one instrument at a time (unless you can play two at a time in real life)
Be cautious when playing out your thoughts: volume, quality, etc.

name: Akasha Mastery
description: Also called Akasha Manipulation, one with this ability has an immensely powerful one at his disposal. The user is capable of psychically tapping into and altering the collective unconscious (which the mystics call the Akashic Records); this can be used to alter what people remember (including restoring memories, or changing what they know to be history), what people perceive to be true, and even change what psychics pick up on from the astral realms. This can't be telepathically resisted.
summary: The ability to alter the collective unconscious to suit one's desires
strengths: Change what people remember and perceive as truth (distort/hide memories, fool lie detectors)
Change what psychics perceive (make a precog see the wrong future, or the like)
Perceive the true Akashic Records, and undo any changes to it at will
weaknesses: Some people don't have the "PERCEIVE the Akasha" part, and they forget what they changed
Might be tempted to use this for evil
Divine beings, ghosts, extradimensional entities and those with True Sight, etc. Sense the truth

name: Genuine Intuition
description: Everyone has had a "gut feeling" about something at one point or another. Intuition is defined as "the power or faculty of attaining to direct knowledge or cognition without evident rational thought and inference." With Heightened Intuition, you will be able to trust those gut feelings 100% of the time. If you have a bad feeling about something, you will be accurate in thinking so, just as if you have a good feeling about something. You DO still have the power of changing how things turn out.
summary: The ability to trust your intuition 100% of the time.
strengths: Prevent you and your loved ones from getting into bad situations
Getting a bad feeling about your flight and cancelling it
Getting a good feeling about the lottery numbers you picked!
weaknesses: You don't always get gut feelings about things--it comes and goes.
Getting a bad feeling about a presentation you're about to make
Risk is everywhere.  You might start act on your intuition too much.

name: Rumors
description: A person with this power can spread rumors extremely quickly by spreading them telepathically. Only people that know about your power realize that it was you that spread the rumor. Everyone else thinks that it was their own idea and everyone that hears the rumor will have it stuck in their head so that they find it easier to believe or more curious about it. The more people affected by this power the more quickly the rumor will be established as true---in terms of belief.
summary: The ability to spread rumors secretly by telepathy
strengths: Spread fear into an entire populace and humiliate enemies
Can also be used to broadcast messages to allies
Can be used to start up conversation with strangers
weaknesses: Once someone knows about your powers they become immune to it
You are responsible for the consequences of the rumors
Can tempt you to troll people and lie

name: Super Hindsight
description: With this ability, in any disaster you will know what could have been done to prevent it.
summary: The ability to know what should have been done
strengths: You'll help people learn what they should have done
If you personally make a mistake, you'll know what you should have done
weaknesses: You'll never actually be able to prevent disasters

name: Sanity Sucking Illusions
description: The illusions you create with this power can only be seen through by insane people, as they can't perceive reality correctly. As such, in order to see through them, one must lose their sanity. Just realizing it's an illusion isn't enough, they must try to see through or perceive what is hidden by it, but they can only succeed by losing their grasp over reality. Sometimes it's not clear if it's the illusion that directly sucks their sanity or if it's just part of the process.
summary: The ability to create illusions that cause insanity to those who manage to see through them.
strengths: Even if they manage to see through the illusions, who would believe them? They're insane!
Very effective against powers that allow one to see through illusions.
weaknesses: Those who are already insane are unaffected.
It's ineffective against powers that repel illusions.

name: Separate Bodies
description: At the decision of all the personalitities you have, you can separate out all of your personalities into two or more bodies. Each personality gets to choose how its body looks except for the personality in the original body and the personalities can communicate with each other using an unbreakable mental link.
summary: The ability to separate into two or more bodies for one's personalities
strengths: Gang up on an enemy with all your personalities in different bodies.
Me, Myself, And I; Sentient Superpower; and Triple Being all go well with this power.
weaknesses: Not many beings have more than one personality.

name: Enhancement: Shielded
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, the other power generates a shield around you based on its original purpose. Ex. Telepathy-mind scrambling shield, a fire power-a firey shield, etc. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced. This power can only be attached to one power at a time.
summary: The ability to have a power generate a shield around one when this power is attached to it
strengths: Shielded when using an offensive power by that power.
Best offense is a good defense.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Someone with Barrier Defiance or Melting

name: Your Mind Is A Prison
description: Your Mind Is A Prison allows you to take your enemy or enemies and trap them inside your mind; from here you can do what you want to them from making them wear a pink tutu to having them chased by the monster in your closet. While in your mind, your enemy also can't escape until you free them; unfortunately during this time your thoughts are exposed and if they figured out how they could kill you. Another effect is waking nightmares/hallucinations.
summary: The ability to change anyone from a physical state to a mental state and trap them inside your mind.
strengths: Unavoidable and inescapable to your enemies
You can do anything to them
Has unlimited uses and can last as long as you see fit.
weaknesses: Thoughts exposed to enemy
Could cause insanity, death, shift in personality, mental impairment.
Occasional waking nightmares (hallucinations).

name: Transformers Summon And Cntrl
description: With this power you can summon and have complete control over any Transformer. It doesn't matter if they're Autobot, Decepticon, Mini-Con, Vehicon, Maximal, Predacon etc. You can summon as many as you want and when you're done you can send them all back.
summary: The ability to summon and control any Transformer
strengths: You can summon and control all Transformers
You can summon as many as you want
You can send them back when you're done
weaknesses: You might lose them when they're in their alternate mode

name: Hour Skip
description: When tired or bored, watch as up to an hour of time speeds by in seconds as your subconscious mind does everything you would be doing/was planning on doing.
summary: The ability to "skip" up to one hour by seemingly speeding by while your subcouncious does everything you do.
strengths: The ultimate boredom solution
Still get everything done
weaknesses: Only works for up to an hour
Requires 10 minute recharge

name: Blessing Of Loki
description: Loki is the Norse god of mischief and trickery. His blessing comes with many gifts. As he was the only god capable of shapeshifting, some with his blessing can do this as well. Loki was also known for his manipulative nature and persuasive voice. The voices of most with his blessing will take on a near hypnotic quality. Yet the one gift given to all is the ability to devote their energy to general mischief.
summary: The ability to have the blessing of Loki.
strengths: Some can shapeshift
Most have an almost hypnotic voice
All can devote their energy to making mischief. This includes minor illusions, teleportation, etc.
weaknesses: There is no guarantee that the blessing will include the hypnotic voice, or shapeshifting

name: Myth Power: Dos' Donation
description: Dos, in Greek myth, was the goddess of giving. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive what things subjects would enjoy as gifts. In addition, one can psychically access a pocket dimension containing 'perfect gifts', at will. Furthermore, one can psychically summon divine ribbons/gift wrap to bind foes, at will. One can also psychically trap subjects in divine gift boxes, at will. One can even psychically perceive and teleport to the site of any gift-giving occasion, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Dos' command over the essence of giving, donation and generosity
strengths: Psychically perceive what subjects want as gifts, access pocket dimension with perfect gifts, at will
Psychically summon divine ribbons and gift wrap to bind foes, divine gift boxed to trap foes, at will
Psychically perceive and teleport to the site of any gift-giving occasion, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically bestow knowledge, skills or (random) superpowers, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically bestow injuries, beauty, breath or life-force, by touch, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Harpax's Haul and sin/injustice/corruption-based MythPowers provide immunity

name: Matriculation
description: You can turn the real world into a programmable virtual reality and turn any virtual reality into the real world.
summary: The ability to replace the real world with a virtual reality and vice versa.
strengths: You can put the world and all the people in a computer.
You can make any virtual reality as real as the world around you.
weaknesses: Virtual realities are not very developed today, so you have to wait...

name: Anti Telepathy
description: I was thinking, "Sure you might have physical strength, but what about the Psychics? They can hurt us in a way we can never stop, in our minds. So, I took the pleasure into making this 'mentalist-proof armor.'"
summary: The ability to be immune to any attack or contact of mind.
strengths: You won't be affected by any mental ability, even telekinesis.
With enough concentration, you can bounce back the mental ability.
You won't be affected by hypnotism.
weaknesses: I can't think of anything, I made this ability for protection.

name: Intelligence Shield
description: You are not hurt by the attacks of those less intelligent than yourself. This applies to any attack they might make, including nuclear strikes.
summary: The ability to use your comparative intelligence as a shield
strengths: Invincible if you are the smartest in a fight.
You can increase your defence by learning more.
Passive: requires no effort.
weaknesses: Smarter people can still hurt you.
May need a lot time to study
You can still hurt yourself (falling off a cliff, running into stuff, etc).

name: Liquid Quartz
description: With this ability you can generate and control a crystal clear liquid. You can manipulate the liquid with your mind. This liquid will harden into quartz crystal when it is no linger in cotact with you. It will stay liquid as long as you keep a connection to it.
summary: The ability to generate and control a liquid that can harden into quartz
strengths: Unlimited supply of quartz
Can control the liquid
weaknesses: Cannot control the hardened quartz
Must stay in contact with the liquid to control it

name: Metal Detection
description: One with this power can sense metals with ease; not always is the metal apparent to one's perception, though; you must consciously try to tune into the location of the metal; although, if you are standing directly above it (or in close enough distance to it), you'll receive a painless, but shocking jolt that automatically alerts you of its presence; in addition, your power allows you to automatically tell what KIND of metal you've come across.
summary: The ability to perceive metals
strengths: Find any source of metal with ease
Your detection of metal doesn't overwhelm your senses
Detect what type of metal it is
weaknesses: People will bother you all the time to find gold or silver, etc.
SOME have too great a sensitivity to metals (it overwhelms their senses)
Sometimes the detection of the metals is accompanied by a bleeping sound

name: Preferential Politeness
description: Our ability to be civil with one another is the backbone of our society, but this power can take it much farther. As long as you are polite to someone they will cheerfully follow most requests. They will only realize something was fishy if it is pointed out to them later that maybe they shouldn't have given that nice man the secret plans, or stopped to have a chat with the polite young lady when they were supposed to be cleaning out the vault. But if you are ever rude, the spell is broken.
summary: The ability to have people be accommodating to you as long as you are polite
strengths: Everyone will always treat you with respect if you do the same.
You can talk your way into any building and talk down any criminal.
People will comply with most "favors" that you ask for.
weaknesses: If you are impolite to the person your spell is broken and they will probably be angry.
Asking someone straight out for something is incredibly impolite.
What counts as polite can vary from person to person.

name: Subliminal Sexuality
description: Also called Subliminal Seduction, Psychic Seduction or just Seduction, one with this ability can project sexual thoughts to the minds of others, can speak with subliminal seductive power behind each word, and stimulate the brain's pleasure centers by touch, voice or thought. This can be used to attract and seduce any subject one desires, because the subject receiving the thoughts would believe THEY were the ones thinking them.
summary: The ability to psychically project sexual thoughts into the minds of others, and otherwise seduce subjects
strengths: Seduce anyone you find attractive (regardless of gender, as long as they are at least humanoid)
Your touch and voice are sexually pleasing
May be accompanied by the ability to psychically perceive how to sexually please others
weaknesses: If it only works on the gender you're not attracted to (rare, but it happens)
If it's permanently active (EVERYBODY falling in love with you would suck)
If your every touch stimulates pleasure (you could never have a normal conversation again)

name: Total Bs
description: You can tell exactly what individuals want to hear in order to get what you want. It's not telepathy so much as it is an empathetic connection and the careful observation of your target's actions.
summary: The ability to bS your way into or out of any situation
strengths: You see that girl over there, want her number? You got it.
Your boss gave you that raise and promotion, what was it your company does again? Aww who cares!
"Thanks again for not giving me that ticket, officer! I will tell my sick grandmother you said 'hi'"
weaknesses: Just because you fool everyone into thinking you know what you are doing, odds are you have no clue.
Extreme ego boost, you might con yourself into believing the things you tell people.
God forbid you don't get a chance to talk to that mugger before he knifes you

name: Duo Tacto Mimicry
description: This ability allows you to replicate the abilities of any two superhumans! However, keep in mind that when you attempt to copy the abilities of a third meta human, you lose the first ability that you copied, with your second at risk should you copy a fourth mutant's power! You also keep whatever side effects their powers may come with (i.e. the super human's power -- effect on appearance, angel wings, blue fur etc. ) until you copy "over" the power and push it out of its "slot"
summary: The ability to copy the powers of two metahumans by touch
strengths: The abilities of any two meta humans
weaknesses: You have to make contact with them
You gain any features their powers gave them
When you copy a third person's abilties, you lose the first person's abilities

name: Face Reality
description: A hero that just knows he's the greatest. The guy who directed The Happening. This ability is to make individuals like them become non-delusional and realize they're not a good as they think they are. A short period of depression may happen to someone after you use this power on him. After this his behavior will become normal and tolerable. The effect of this power is permanent. Sadly anti-telepathy or similar powers will block it.
summary: The ability to help those with delusions of grandeur realize how the world perceives them.
strengths: No more movies like The Happening.
No egotistical heroes.
This power may make some villains realize they'll never win and give up villainy.
weaknesses: The guy who directed The Happening has anti-telepathy.

name: Unimaginable Existence
description: An existential state wherein the affected person cannot be brought up in other people's mind to be pictured, thought of, or even imagined. Meaning anyone with this ability suddenly becomes an absolute enigma completely alien & unthinkable to anyone who tries to imagine or picture them in mind. In effect, a person with this ability (& with practice even their surrounding) is rendered unaffected by anyone or anything that has something to do with Telepathy, Mind Reading, & Power of Imagination.
summary: The ability to exist as an unimaginable being relative to the existence of people who thinks of them.
strengths: Nobody, not even telepaths, can think of you.
Renders your existence and at a certain extent your surrounding unaffected by power of imagination.
Also makes you a hard target. How can you attack someone you can't even think of?
weaknesses: You can still be attacked if you can be seen
No one thinks of you. Not even your love one's. (yup, no more birthday parties and the like).
Not suitable for team work.

name: Emotional Imprint (Non Living)
description:
While touching any non-living object you can imprint it with any single emotion you have personally experienced, and also multiply that emotion to extreme levels. 
Ex. While holding a public phone you can imprint anger onto it, and then multiply the emotion. Whoever touches that phone will be overcome with the emotion regardless of logic.
summary: The ability to embed imprint emotions onto non-living objects which "infect" those who touch it.
strengths: Can use it for personal gain ex. wearing a ring that emits love so those who shake your hand...
Very powerful "behind the scenes" ability. Lust, Fear, Gulit, etc.
Can create projectile manipulation weapons ex. Airsoft guns...pellets embedded.
weaknesses: Cannot use directly on yourself.
Cannot use emotions you've never experinced.
Effects wear off of person after 12 hrs, and off of object after 3 days.

name: Myth Power: Bia's Benefit
description: Bia, in Greek myth, was the goddess of force, might, power and compulsion. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically manipulate the force behind a projectile (such as giving a paper ball the force of a wrecking ball, giving a Mack truck the force of a tricycle, etc) at will. In addition, one can speak nearly irresistible compulsions, as well as psychically manipulate the power behind others' compulsions, at will. One can even psychically manipulate the power of superhuman abilities.
summary: The ability to channel Bia's command over the essence of force, might, power and compulsion
strengths: Psychically manipulate the force a projectile exerts, at will
Psychically compel others, and manipulate and withstand others' compulsions, at will
Heighten or lessen the force behind any superhuman ability
weaknesses: MythPower: Ananke's Answer provides immunity to direct effects of Pro #2 (NCN)
MythPowers based on Styx and Styx's Children (Cratos, Bia, Nike, Zelos) provide immunity (NCN)
Power/strength/toughness-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Mental Communication
description: Tired of phone credit running out? Well, then this is a great power to have. It enables any two users in the universe to communicate mentally. It can be turned off at will and you can choose if you want to be able to communicate with others. If you think a stray thought, don't worry, you can choose whether to send it or not.
summary: The ability to communicate with anyone else with this power.
strengths: No need for credit.
Message is always perfectly clear.
Can communicate over any distance.
weaknesses: If you are the only one with this power.
Same problems with language barriers.
No other uses common to telepathy.

name: Gift: Minds
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at controlling minds than other beings. Thus their mind-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of minds from them. However, someone with this power can only recieve mind-based powers, nothing else.
summary: The ability to be gifted at the control of minds
strengths: Almost no one has as good control over minds as someone with this power.
Mind-based powers are boosted slightly.
weaknesses: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only mind-based powers now.

name: Number Knowledge
description: You can know ANY number.  Think about it.  Lottery numbers.  The number of times you've been checked out today.  The number of people who think you're sexy.  You can know ANY NUMBER!
summary: The ability to know any answer, as long as the answer is a number.
strengths: Find out things you'd never know
Win the lottery by knowing the winning numbers
weaknesses: You might change the future if you act on certain things

name: Salient Perception
description: A person with salient perception would look at a group of objects, and be able to find/choose the object they need for their situation. This manifests as an intuition-type feeling. For example, a person looking for a paper clip on a messy desk would almost instantly know where to find it. The user, however, must know why they need the object. The more specific the purpose, the more situationally-appropriate the most noticeable object will be.
summary: The ability to distinguish situationally-important objects from the objects around them.
strengths: Answers on multiple question tests would be easily known.
Fighting an attacker in an unknown location? A quick look around, and you can find an improv weapon.
Can also be used for finding people in crowds (as long as you've seen the person's face before).
weaknesses: Requires a reasonable degree of focus.
If you want to find an object, you must have seen one of the object before.
If you're looking for a person, the further you are from them, the weaker your intuition will be.

name: Mood Ring
description: If you're depressed, your eyes turn blue. If you're angry, your eyes turn red. If you're happy, your eyes turn hazel. If you're in love, they turn violet-pink.
summary: The ability to change your eye color based on your mood
strengths: Possible to gain a new power whenever your eyes change color
If you are uncertain if you're in love or not, look in the mirror
weaknesses: Obvious when you're using it

name: Tele Atomic Disintegration
description: By telepathically causing atomic decay in bodies of matter (e.g. tables), this power allows its wielder to cause explosions on the scale of atomic bombs. This means that when provoked, one could destroy an entire city in minutes. The perfect villain superpower.
summary: The ability to cause objects to explode like an atomic bomb.
strengths: Perfect villain power.
Cause mass destruction and murder.
Genocide made easy.
weaknesses: Will probably end up killing oneself in the explosion.
Cause mass destruction and murder.
May not be able to control it.

name: Loki's Staff
description: Used by Loki the Norse god of trickery, mischief, and evil, it allows you to create illusions. The only way you can obtain this is by going through a difficult maze full of riddles. Good with Thor's Hammer.
summary: The ability to wield Loki's staff
strengths: Let's you create illusions
Good weapon
Good with Thor's Hammer.
weaknesses: You can trick yourself at times
It's not able to trick those who have really strong minds(like superhumanly smart)

name: Myth Power: Chrysos' Crusade
description: Chrysos (Chrysus, Khrysos), in Greek myth, was the god of gold and golden riches. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive gold (and gold-colored non-metals), at will. In addition, one can psychically manipulate gold (and gold-colored non-metals), at will. Furthermore, one can turn anything that glitters into gold (the metal), by touch. One may even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those who are wearing gold (and gold-colored non-metals), at will.
summary: The ability to channel Chrysos' command over the essence of gold and golden riches
strengths: Psychically perceive and manipulate the gold metal (and gold-colored non-metals) at will
Psychically turn anything that sparkles/glitters into gold, by touch
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those holding/wearing gold
weaknesses: Cannot turn non-sparkly matter into gold (or manipulate gold-turned matter) until developed (NCN)
Cannot assume a form of gold (or reverse Midas Touch) until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith and MythPower: Hepheastus' Forge provide immunity (NCN)

name: Clairaudience
description: A person who can psychically hear, hears things from either the past or near future or voices of spirits. Its like if you were blind & your hearing was tuned up psychically, you could picture the surroundings of the past or future by the sounds that were psychically echoed. You can also listen to the deceased & technically become a medium. You can't hear things from ancient past or distant future, just events close to the present.
summary: The ability to psychically hear & listen
strengths: Hear things from the past or near future
Listen to ghosts
weaknesses: Can't hear things that happened long ago or distant future

name: Pb: Mind Excercised
description: 'PB' stands for 'Power Boost'. With this ability, all of your mental superpowers are doubled in effectiveness. (Includes powers, need concentration, etc. )
summary: The ability to have all of your mental superpowers doubled in effectiveness.
strengths: Doubles the effectiveness of your mind abilities.
If you have a lot of mind abilities.
weaknesses: If you don't have mind abilities.
Or any superpower whatsoever.

name: The Dealer
description: The cards are "stored" in the hero's mind. Hero wants to use this card upon the person, for example, he wants the person to be hungry, and he visualises the card in front of him, there's special decorations to each card, for example, "be hungry" would be a picture of a plate of food on the card, so he deals the card to the person, putting it on the palm of the person's hand, making sure it's parallel to the life line on the person's palm, and then, the person becomes hungry!
summary: The ability to make things happen based on the card dealt to the person.
strengths: Easy to control others
Can easily visualise any card you want
Works fast.
weaknesses: Must be very very specific.
Quite high chance that you might do someone harm instead of helping them.
Not easy to master.

name: Electrical Perception
description: With this power, you will know the exact location of any electrical current from up to 50 meters away. Power lines, cars, lightbulbs, etc, anything that has an active electrical current.
summary: The ability to perceive any electrical current from up to 50 meters away
strengths: You can know where people are since the brain runs on electricity as does the neural system.
Always know where your cellphone is or where a phone booth can be found.
weaknesses: Only helps if the electrical item is on otherwise there are no electrons moving and thus no current.

name: Myth Power: Asteria's Esteem
description: Asteria, in Greek myth, was the goddess of nighttime oracles (necromancy, astrology, prophetic dreams, etc) and falling stars. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically receive visions of past, present of future nights, at will (or induce them, by touch). In addition, one can psychically perceive subjects' zodiac signs and horoscopes, at will. Furthermore, one can ask spirits of the dead anything, and they must answer. One can even gain physical power in the presence of his zodiac sign.
summary: The ability to channel Asteria's command over the essence of nighttime oracles and falling stars
strengths: Psychically receive, at will (or induce, by touch), visions of past, present or future nights
Perceive subjects' astrological signs and horoscopes; compel the dead to answer questions (at night)
Gain physical power in the presence of your astrological sign (on clothes, in the sky, etc)
weaknesses: Cannot Time Travel to past/future nights until developed (NCN)
Cannot summon falling stars to gain/grant wishes (stronger means more wishes), until developed (NCN)
Sun/moon/sky/celestial-based MythPowers provide immunity to direct effects (NCN)

name: Eternal Existence
description: The concept of non-existence, as opposed to existence, is fully and utterly removed from you. This guarantees that the true 'you' can never be destroyed. Your consciousness or soul (whichever you prefer) will go on forever. As a side effect, you are also immune from unnatural permanent changes (such as mind control) to your mind/personality. The range for 'temporary' changes is infinite, though, as long as there is an eventual revert.
summary: The ability to be incapable of not existing
strengths: Guarantees that you have some sort of afterlife, rather than the whole nothingness after death.
It also forces mind controllers/personality changers to continuously use power to keep your mind.
While your memories are a bit more malleable, they're also difficult to alter.
weaknesses: This is not immortality- you can be killed all the same. It just guarantees there's something after.
You might go to hell, or die and be trapped as a intangible spirit for eternity.
You can go insane, or be trapped in any body that allows you to retain consciousness (maybe stone).

name: Unsee
description: With this handy psychic ability, the user can concentrate for a moment and neatly delete a single unwanted image from his or her mind. With slightly more effort, he or she can remove an unwanted image from the consciousness of another person. Unfortunately, the target of the ability must describe the unwanted image as completely as possible to the user of the power in order for him or her to focus upon it. Therefore, the unwanted image ends up in the consciousness of the user of the power. Yuck!
summary: The ability to erase unwanted mental images from your mind or somebody else's.
strengths: Completely undoes the adage, "What has been seen cannot be unseen. "
Removes images you have actually seen and ones that you have inadvertently imagined.
Great for healing sanity losses from encountering Great Old Ones and other sanity-blasting sights.
weaknesses: Only effects unwanted mental images. You can't erase things you wish your friends can't see mentally
It does not erase the memory that you once had the mental image, so you may imagine it again.
It does not erase any other memories, so it won't save all of one's sanity from such encounters.

name: Myth Power: Muses' Message9
description: The Muses (Mousai, Mousae, Musae), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of knowledge, sciences, the arts and inspiration. As such, channeling Urania (Ourania- Astronomy) allows one to psychically access knowledge of all astronomical works, at will. In addition, one can psychically project one's vision to telescopic distances, at will. One can also fly, as well as psychically propel oneself into outer space, at will (and survive its conditions). One can even psychically mimic alien species, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Muses' command over the essence of knowledge, inspiration and art
strengths: Psychically access knowledge of astronomical works, at will
Psychically project one's sight to telescopic distance, at will
Fly, propel oneself into outer space and survive its conditions; mimic alien species (language, etc)
weaknesses: Cannot psychically disrupt creativity (or negate ideas), by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive subject's ideas until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Apollo's Gift may cause bossy attitude toward the user (NCN)

name: Communication Intrusion Sensor
description: Whenever you're having an exchange of information through any form and method (speech, written paper, thought transfer, sign language, braille,... ), you can sense when an unwanted party is trying to intercept or understand it. It works whether you're the sender of a message or a receiver. However, as a receiver, you can only detect intrusions if a communication with you is already taking place and if you are aware of it, but you won't sense it if the message is blocked before arriving to you.
summary: The ability to detect when a third-party is listening in on your communication.
strengths: It's a good way to know if someone is can listen in on your conversation.
You can detect intruders regardless of the methods thay are using to intrude.
It even works with delayed means of communication, like leaving a note intended for someone.
weaknesses: You will even detect people who are intruding unintentionally or without ill intentions.
Someone can still get the message before you have the idea to stop the communication.
You can't detect it when someone intends to communicate with you or if a message has been received.

name: Identity Assumption
description: By touching a person or a recently deceased corpse, you assume their appearance, knowledge, and identity. In this state, your mind operates on two levels: one duplicates the thoughts and mannerisms of the person whose identity you have assumed, the other is your rational mind which retains ultimate control. You can cancel this power at any time, however you cannot assume that identity again without again having physical contact with the person. Any powers that read minds only see the first mind.
summary: The ability to copy the appearance and memories of a person
strengths: Perfect for disguise and infiltration
Knowledge gained remains permanently
Can duplicate minor power
weaknesses: Unless the subject is dead or restrained, there will be trouble
Cannot duplicate major supernatural abilities

name: Third Eye: Truth Seeing
description: This power is gained by never using the Third Eye powers, but having the third eye open. The Third Eye power slowly turns into this power. The third eye can see through illusions, the true form of a shapeshifter, the general truth, and what happened in the past. The eye can still be decieved with past events. The further back in time the harder it is to see what happened.
summary: The ability to see the truth and past with your third eye
strengths: An evolved form of Third Eye.
Can see the the truth and past.
Can still use Third Eye powers.
weaknesses: Must have Third Eye power and never use it but have the third eye open.
Only the third eye can see anything and it is still decievable.
Cannot get other formerly possible Third Eye evolutions.

name: Power Uneffectiveness
description: The ability to take away others' superpowers with your mind.
summary: The ability to take away others' powers
strengths: No Superpowers can hurt you.
You can decide which power to take away
You can kill someone by taking away his/her power (sometimes)
weaknesses: You're actually not that powerful
You can take away your own power if you're not carefull!
You need to have a weapon with you to hurt someone

name: Injury Illusion
description: This power allows you to fake or create a fake scenario of you, someone else or something else getting injured in anyway. When you perform this power on yourself, you'll never feel the actual pain of the injury but it'll look 100% real. When using this on others you can choose to make them feel the actual pain or not. Say your driving, you can simulate a random car crash or explosion and it'll be a hologram illusion to everyone. Touch it & it becomes real (it has life-like properties)
summary: The ability to fake any type of injury or accident to yourself, someone, or something else
strengths: You're immune to your own simulation, though you can choose to feel a bit of pain for realism.
You can get out of an situation you want by faking the right injury, and you always come out alive.
You can guilt people into feeling sorry for you and doing whatever you want
weaknesses: People will hate you for making sick jokes
You can't really kill anybody or yourself
Can't protect yourself while your asleep

name: Singularity
description: This ability makes you absolutely one of a kind. It prevents you from being forcibly replicated/cloned, having powers mimicked, and being mimicked by Shapeshifters or Illusionists. In addition, no one can ever mimic your voice, your hand writing or your skills/movements. You possess a physical, psychic, and empathic trait marks you as special, so even if someone tried to disguise themselves as you, people who know you would notice the ruse. There aren't even other you's in alternate realities.
summary: The ability to resist being mimicked, copied or replicated
strengths: Being truly one of a kind
Cannot ever be mimicked successfully; anyone who tries to will go back to normal in seconds
Does not prevent you from mimicking others (or replicating yourself if you have the power to)
weaknesses: People who know you will also know when YOU are in disguise (may not always be bad)
Can't help friends if they need to mimic your powers
No other you's in alternate realities... (sad face, only one of me to go around... )

name: Self Insertion
description: With this power, you can look into the memories of others and insert yourself therein. It will seem to them as if they had known you forever and, assuming that you insert yourself into happy and good memories, they will trust you implicitly. Be careful, however, for if a true friend points out that you were not really there, then the spell is broken. So be sure to get everyone connected to that person as well.
summary: The ability to insert yourself into anyone's memories.
strengths: Make people love you by inserting yourself into the happy memories of their life.
Make people fear you by putting yourself in their bad ones.
Become old friends with the rich and powerful.
weaknesses: If you insert yourself into many people's lives you must make sure that the memories are consistent.
If you try with someone who has a big social circle, expect a lot of work.
You cannot change the memories, only put yourself in them.

name: Evt Teleportation
description: Based on sight, thought, and knowledge, this teleportation transfers the volume of yourself to your target location and sends the target volume to where you stood.
summary: The ability to equal volume transfer teleportation
strengths: Effective weapon
Silent teleportation
Inconspicuos
weaknesses: Exhausting overuse

name: Psionic Restraints
description: Someone using this power can prevent a psychic from using their full power by limiting how much power the psychic can access. The psychic can only be restricted down to 50%. The user of this power can decide how many people to use it on at the same time. WARNING: The more people this power is used on the easier it is for them to shed their restraints and use their full power.
summary: The ability to keep a psychic from using their full power
strengths: Don't have to fight psychics at their full power.
Don't have to concentrate once target(s) are determined.
weaknesses: Only affects psychics.
Con Negation and similar powers do not affect this power.

name: Twilight Power: Illusion Of Pain
description: The user projects the illusion of being in extremely intense physical pain into others  minds, thus incapacitating them. Can cause people to experience excruciating pain that  instantly incapacitates them. Can inflict this pain on only one target at a time, must be able to see your target to use this ability on him or her.
summary: The ability to creates the illusion of intense pain.
strengths: Creates the illusion of intense pain.
Useful for torture.
Instant.
weaknesses: Only effects one person.

name: Unforgettable
description: Once you turn 16 you'll enter a 16 hour coma and when you wake up you'll remember all your past lives.
summary: The ability to remember all your past lifes.
strengths: You'll get knowledge that most people can't even dream of.
The things you were good at in your previous lives will bond once again with your body.
weaknesses: Every single bad thing that has ever happened to you or that you have done will return to hunt you.

name: Four Eyes: Torture
description: This power is gained by using the long distance part of the Four Eyes power. The Four Eyes power slowly turns into this power. When someone stares into all of your eyes simultaneously, they suddenly see and feel the worst torture they can think of for themselves.
summary: The ability to make people see and feel elaborate illusions by staring into your eyes
strengths: Do torture without any hard work.
Can still use Four Eyes powers.
This is a Four Eyes evolution.
weaknesses: Must have the Four Eyes power and use the long distance power.
Target must stare into all your eyes at the same time.
Cannot get other Four Eyes evolutions.

name: Triforce Of Wisdom
description: You have the triforce of wisdom and this gives you several powers. First, you know everything that is happening around you. Second, you have vast magical powers including healing, magic or even mind control. Third, you mostly make good choices.
summary: The ability to use the triforce of wisdom
strengths: Magic, healing and mind control
Vast wisdom
Make good choices
weaknesses: when you heal you give up your own life
People with the triforce of power may try to take the triforce of wisdom from you

name: Myth Power: Mnemosyne's Memory
description: Mnemosyne, in Greek myth, was the Titan goddess of memory, remembrance, recollection and language. As such, channeling her allows one to manipulate memory (implanting memories, enhancing memory, distorting memories, erasing them, etc) at will. In addition, the user has total memory of every experience or bit of knowledge he encounters (except anything he WANTS to forget). One can even understand and communicate in all languages (even those of animals, insects, aliens, spirits, machines, etc).
summary: The ability to channel Mnemosyne's command over the essence of memory, remembrance, recollection and language
strengths: Psychically manipulate memories of self and others (implant, enhance, distort, erase, etc) at will
Panmnesia (total recall of every experience one encounters); repress traumatic memories at will
Omnilingualism (ability to understand and communicate in any and all languages)
weaknesses: Cannot survive death as a Living Memory until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith provides immunity (NCN)
Mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Artistic Precognition
description: People have always needed to know what will happen next. A Precognitive can induce visions of the future, which they will experience as if they were watching it themselves. However, many users find it difficult to remember all or part of these visions. So once they enter the trance, they will usually pick up their most familiar art tool available and will begin recording the vision while still in the state. This might be a painting, a sketch, a literary work, a whittling or even a musical piece.
summary: The ability to predict the future through artistic media
strengths: Get hired as a consultant for almost any company
Totally voluntary
The phrase "I whittles the future" never gets old
weaknesses: Might see a very unpleasant future
May become a bit of a control freak
If you predict the future on a musical instrument

name: On A Dimensional Scale
description: This ability changes a power so it is on a dimensional scale. Ex. Telepathy on a dimensional scale.
summary: The ability to alter a power so it is on a dimensional scale.
strengths: Larger area to use a power.
weaknesses: Only one power.
Can only be used once (Cannot be reversed)

name: Gravity Perception
description: Also called Gravitational Energy Perception, Gravity Sense, Gravity Perception, Gravimetry, Baroception or Barognosis, this is the ability to perceive the flux, intensity and flow of gravity, and alterations to such. This perception lets the user sense disturbances in gravitational fields made by movement, as well as sensing the size, shape, weight and density of objects without having to see them; the user can even sense how to maneuver to effectively DEFY gravity, to mimic Superhuman Agility.
summary: The ability to perceive the effects of gravity in one's immediate area
strengths: Sense movements by perceiving disturbances in gravitational fields
Sense the presence, shape, weight and density of objects around you without having to see them
Sense how to effectively maneuver to appear to have Superhuman Agility
weaknesses: Doesn't work in low/no-gravity situations
Especially sensitive to when people alter gravity (may be disorienting)
Maneuvering to defy gravity only comes at the higher bands of ability development

name: The Maze
description: Creates a magical maze that traps anyone you want to trap. Cheating is impossible because the maze's walls can detect any thoughts of cheating. The only way to get out is to find the exit, which is almost too impossible to find. The maze is not visible in the naked eyes of people outside the maze.
summary: The ability to create a magical maze to trap anyone you want to trap
strengths: Can save you from killing the people you hate the most.
weaknesses: You cannot disperse the maze.

name: Decision Redirection
description: One with this ability can change the current decision(s) of others to the opposite. For example, a foe is deciding if he should stay and face one in combat, one simply changes his mind to run away from the user. The major flaw of this ability is that one cannot know what decisons another object is going over or cannot change "spur of the moment" decisons.
summary: The ability to change whatever a subject's current decison to the opposite
strengths: Can stop someone from fighting you.
Stop others from thinking the wrong thing.
weaknesses: Can stop possibly good decisons
Cannot read minds
"Spur of the Moment" decisions, decision without thinking.

name: Displaced Existence In Time
description: Ever been on something like a long car trip and wish you could skip straight to the destination? With this power, you can! Activating this power will displace your soul from your present body and into your future body. You can choose the time your soul re-inhabits your body, and the time passes in the blink of an eye. And whenever you go to sleep next, your soul will travel back to the time of activation and relive the lost time as a dream. No one will notice a thing!
summary: The ability to 'skip' certain periods of time, and relive them later.
strengths: Skip long, boring events
While reliving the events as a dream, you act exactly as you would've normally
No one notices, and the time passes instantly for you
weaknesses: The length of your time-skip will reflect exactly how long you sleep.
You will not be able to wake up until you have completed your lost hours of time.

name: Intimidation
description: Rodney Dangerfield once said, 'I don't get no respect.' A person with Intimidation never has that problem. No matter their age, weight, or gender, they can consciously intimidate the people around them. The user can only affect people who see them, and it is more powerful the fewer people there are.
summary: The ability to cause feelings of fear and discomfort
strengths: Get some respect
Work your way to the top more easily
Completely voluntary, can 'flip the switch'
weaknesses: Cannot affect a crowd efficiently
Can be resisted
Can be blocked by closing your eyes

name: Think Wings
description: With this power you can give people or animals wings with your mind all you have to do is think of the desired person or animal with wings
summary: The ability to give people or animals wings with your mind
strengths: You can give your friends the ability to fly
weaknesses: You can't take away their wings once you give it to them
Does not work on birds
You can't give yourself wings

name: Pandoran Nightmare
description: Every night when you sleep, you have a vivid, detailed nightmare depicting the worst even that will occur in the world the following day. This will continue to happen every night until the day you die. The dream will be detailed enough to accurately figure out what exactly will happen, where it will happen and when.
summary: The ability to have a prophetic dream every night of the most terrible thing that will happen the following day.
strengths: You can prevent major loss of life through early warnings.
You could change the course of history for the better.
weaknesses: Sleep will become an inescapable hell.
The establishment might just write you off as some kind of loony street preacher.
No matter how hard you work to prevent the distaster it will only have been one out of many.

name: Absolute Perspective
description: You've had the worst day ever. You feel like you're starving. You're the luckiest man alive. Are you though? When faced with situations where you feel like this, this power allows you to gain a global perspective, flashing up thoughts, images and emotions of people who are *really* happy, *really* lucky, or *really* hurting. Allows for completely realistic rationality, but will likely leave you emotionally shell shocked.
summary: The ability to perfectly put situations into a global perspective.
strengths: Be completely realistic and rational in your thinking.
Rejoice with those people who are *truly* happy.
Could spur you on to help people who are actually starving etc.
weaknesses: Would drain you to keep seeing *really* bad situations.
Anything you achieve would be put into perspective, likely showing how meaningless it is.
Could find it hard to empathise with people complaining about how bad their lives are.

name: Continue
description: This power requires something to happen first, but once it has it can be continued. Submisiveness or ignorance broadcasted over video can be continued. Other "Continues" are damage, healing, change, replication. You can continue a state of something, emotions, thoughts, actions, and forces such as change, damage and traumas
summary: The ability to cause things to continue through this power.
strengths: Prolong an existing effect.
Creative people love this.
Continue pumpkin pie for years or damage for hours.
weaknesses: Self protection & reality changing powers (Unbendable will, Power of Imagination) break Continues.
Cons can't be negated
The harder Continues are, the shorter it can be continued

name: Artifact Mastery
description: The person with this power is able to use majority if not all the artifacts in Warehouse 13. The only exception are the artifacts in the Dark Vault. Besides that, the person with this power is able to transport the artifact he or she want to their position. The person who has this power also has a psychic link to the warehouse, making them know exactly what is it in the warehouse
summary: The ability to use the ancient mystical artifacts that are stored in Warehouse 13
strengths: Huge assortment of artifacts for different situation
Easily defeat enemies due to huge array of artifacts
weaknesses: Great concentration is needed to summon the artifacts from long distances
Concentration is needed if the user wants to summon multiple artifacts at one go
If the user is knocked unconscious, the artifacts can be stolen

name: Social Theft
description: Stealing all information about someone just by touching them. All of their thoughts will forever are locked inside your mind. You can take away emotions too
summary: The ability to steal emotions, thoughts, memories and dreams
strengths: Learn what people think about you
Know when someone lies
Learn all about someone just by touching them
weaknesses: If you store to many memories, you might forget things
Other people are aware when their thoughts are being stolen
Stealing to many emotions or whatever can cause brain damage.

name: Empathy: Emotional Resonance
description: Words and even actions are an inadequate ways to express oneself.  Now, you simply can have your thoughts, feelings, emotions, motivations, and values conveyed perfectly by simply willing it.  You also will automatically understand other's thought and emotions perfectly. There will be no doubts about intentions, good or bad.
summary: The ability to completely understand others and be understood by them.
strengths: You will likely grow to be a very emotionally mature person.
Most relationships may become stronger than ever!
Less worry over what was said or done.
weaknesses: No matter how hard, you will simply have to grow up.
Some relationships you enjoyed may reveal themselves to be a facade.
You may know what should be done or said even when you can't actually do or say it.

name: Mental Destitution
description: This power(also called mental destruction or mental degrading)is the ability to damage or cancel the higher thought processes of others. Simply put it allows the user to render an opponent incapable of any higher thought causing unconsciousness or worse. As a side effect the user can also stop mental abilities(telepathy, telekinesis,etc) from affecting them due to their usual requirement of high mental power. The user can project this effect in fields or by their sheer presence.
summary: The ability to cancel out thought or higher thought and some of it's products.
strengths: Can easily incapacitate foes AND stop their offensive telepathy or telekinesis.
You can do this in varying degrees(disorientation,delusion,incompetence,death).
You are immune to the effects of this power.
weaknesses: Enemies such as golems or robots.
The effects are never permanent.
Foes who possess backlash powers.

name: Ninja Spawn
description: With this power you can spawn an infinite amount of ninjas and they're all completely under your control
summary: The ability to spawn ninjas
strengths: You have an army of ninjas under your control
weaknesses: Ninjas aren't the strongest people in the world and can be killed by powerful enemies

name: Remnant Affliction
description: Also called Residual Affliction or Recurring Affliction is the responsiveness of an injury to the presence of the inflictor of said injury. Simply put, whenever one goes near a foe, whatever injury the user has caused to that particular foe (physical or psychological) will either resurface entirely, re-bruising and re-scratching up foes, or the area where the subject was wounded will begin hurting again; psychological damage will arise again.
summary: The ability to cause previous injuries to resurface in one's presence
strengths: The more you hurt them one time, the more they hurt next time
You will never leave your enemies' memories
You always get the advantage in a fight (wounds heal at a normal rate, even with a healing factor)
weaknesses: May also work on loved ones
Injuries (sometimes) must have been induced by the user
Makes befriending a former enemy very hard

name: Nuclear Reaction
description: With this ability you can create nuclear explosions and reactions, by having the mental capacity to split any atom with your mind. Once an atom is split a nuclear explosion happens. Also atoms are everywhere in all matter.
summary: The ability to create nuclear explosion, by splitting the atom with your mind,
strengths: Create nuclear explosions anywhere.
Your nuclear explosions won't harm you in any way.
weaknesses: Effect of nuclear explosion is devastating long-term.

name: Precognitive Extrapolations
description: Everyone extrapolates, They all think about what might happen. People with this power take it out to the far end. They can accurately predict what will happen minutes, hours, or even days into the future. However, this power requires vast amounts of information in order for you to make accurate predictions, its also burns alot of energy limiting the number of predictions you can make. The farther the prediction is into the future the less accurate it gets, and the more energy it burns.
summary: The ability to non-psychically predict the future
strengths: Lets you "see" the future
Is not a psychic talent, and is unaffected by powers that mess with psychics
You can choose what to extrapolate about.
weaknesses: Requires TONS of information
Burns alot of energy
Less accurate the farther it goes into the future

name: Psychic Vampire
description: You can enter someone's mind and drain their life energy straight from their body.
summary: The ability to drain a human's life energy.
strengths: You can have a stable telepathic link if you have five people in it.
You can talk to people if you dont want to anyone else to hear.
People will not want to mess with you.
weaknesses: If you have less than five people in the link, it kills the other person.
Once five people are in the link, there's no reversing it.
Once you start a stable telepathic link, your power is useless with anyone not in the link.

name: Sleeper Agent
description: A sleeper agent is someone who has a predetermined program written inside of them. With this ability, you can reprogram someone without them knowing about it. Once you activate the program, they will follow your commands. If you want, you can turn them into super-soldiers.
summary: The ability to plant a modifying program in the minds of others
strengths: Amass an army
Tell people what to do
Reprogram their minds and make them soldiers of fortune
weaknesses: Every program has a kill code
A person of strong will might resist the program

name: Forced Superpower Activation
description: A lot of powers require you to do something or fulfil certain conditions in order to activate them and use them. It may be concentration, certain emotions, saying something, drawing something, being exposed to sunlight, certain gestures or actions, etc. If someone with this ability does exactly what's needed to activate someone else's power, they will activate it without that person's consent. They're NOT copying that ability, nor do they channel it; they just force that person to use it.
summary: The ability to activate someone else's power by fulfilling all the conditions needed to use it.
strengths: Some powers can be used as you please, as if you copied them, like Telekinesis or Geokinesis.
If an ally is put in a position where they can't activate their power, you can activate it for them.
You can use it on a power which is already activated but isn't used to its full capacity.
weaknesses: Unless there's a specific conditions to fulfil, you can't deactivate a power if they are using it.
In most cases, activating a power doesn't mean you can use it on yourself, like Teleportation.
They can be immune to their own power, but not you. So, be careful when you activate a power.

name: Kryptopain
description: With this power, you can send pain by thought to another person. The rules: Be careful--even if it's a little bit of pain, it could be tons of pain to that person. Don't imagine it too much.
summary: The ability to send pain by thought to another person.
strengths: Can torture siblings and bullies
Can send pain through your body to get out of class
Can save people while the bad guy is in pain and can't concentrate
weaknesses: Killing people
Killing family members by accident
Not controlling it

name: Myth Power: Hebe's Hedge
description: Hebe, in Greek myth, was the goddess of youth, youthful vigor and the young, as well as Cupbearer of the Gods. As such, channeling her allows one to only age to one's physical prime, thus gaining eternal youth. In addition, one can psychically de-age subjects (physically and/or mentally), at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive and communicate with anyone younger than middle age (young adults, teens, kids, etc). One can even psychically generate a forcefield that works on the young.
summary: The ability to channel Hebe's command over the essence of youth, the young and youthful vigor
strengths: Gain Eternal Youth (remain in the physical prime of youth)
Psychically de-age subjects (mentally and/or physically), at will
Psychically perceive, communicate with and generate a forcefield against the young, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically trade bodies/minds with the young, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically convert one's youth into physical power, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Geras' Guard and other time/age-based powers provide immunity (NCN)

name: New Emotional Spectrums
description: It can grant you the ability to create solid-light constructs, wild animals, and weapons; whatever only you imagine. Here are the new inversions. Pink - Kindness, Magenta - Temperance, Brown - Sloth (Laziness), Teal - Wisdom, Tan/Beige - Humility, White - Life, Grey - Immortality, Scarlet - Chaos, Crimson - Vampirism, Bistre - Obedience, Gold - Pride/Vanity, Silver - Diligence Bronze - Cruelty.
summary: The ability to have new different wavelengths of light based on thoughts and feelings.
strengths: Might be use for a greater good.
weaknesses: Might be use for Extraordinary Evil.

name: Myth Power: Phobos' Fear
description: Phobos (Phobus), in Greek myth, was the god of fear and phobia. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive fear (the feeling itself, and what fear in particular), induce fear, amplify fear (even to the point of overwhelming, paralyzing phobia) and negate fear by touch, word or thought. In addition, one gains physical power in the presence of (non-induced) fear. One can even totally withstand the effects of fear (whether natural or induced) and share this immunity by touch.
summary: The ability to channel Phobos command over the essence of fear and phobia
strengths: Perceive, identify, induce, amplify and reduce fear in others at will (really easy to scare others)
Gain physical power from the (natural, non-induced) fear and phobia of others
Immunity to irrational fear (natural or induced); share Fear Immunity (Fearlessness) by touch
weaknesses: Cannot cast phobic illusions (illusions of what scares a foe) until the higher levels
Cannot be used to induce or manipulate nightmares (NCN)
MythPower: Ares' Wrath, MythPower: Enyo's Laugh, Fearlessness, etc provide immunity

name: Existence Nullification
description: Saying someone does not exist causes them to disappear and it's as if they never began existence. When this happens, everyone's memories of that person are erased (including yours) and anything they ever did will be gone as well, such as children, bank accounts, jobs, records, if they murdered, those people return with a present life. The time between them dead and coming back alive, false memories are implanted in people's minds, as if they were still alive, even to the reanimated.
summary: The ability to cause someone to never have existed just by saying so.
strengths: Very effective.
Practically unbeatable.
Can null more than one at a time. ("You all don't exist")
weaknesses: Dire consequences.
Can still be attacked by surprise. Therefore, do not have time to nullify the existence.
If you null yourself or someone else with this power nulls you, the same effect happens. See desc.

name: Transparency Curse
description: This power allows you to put a particular curse on anyone you want. The curse is that their thoughts are no longer confined in their own mind and can therefore be perceived by anyone in their vicinity. How big that vicinity is depends on the emotional state of the accursed, ranging from tens of meters to tens of kilometers. The victim usually won't realize they've been cursed until they've been told so or they notice people's reaction. Only the person who put that curse can lift it.
summary: The ability to curse anyone into being a "thought transparent".
strengths: You can make the most intimate secrets of anyone public.
In a combat situation, you AND your allies can anticipate your opponent's moves.
You can drive anyone to suicide, isolation or craziness, as it is unbearable to have that curse.
weaknesses: The curse can also be lifted if you die. If your victims realize this, you're in big trouble.

name: Instinct Negation
description: Also called Instinct Termination, Instinct Suppression or Instinct Blocking. This is the ability to psychically cancel out the subjects' instincts and innate behaviors. One with this ability could cause a person to not get off the train tracks, even though they see the train coming, or cause a person not to move their hand off the stove, even though the temperature is very high and everything in their mind tells them that harm is coming to them.
summary: The ability to cancel out the innate behaviors and responses of living things
strengths: Even pwn people with Superhuman Reflexes (they react faster, but that's if they react AT ALL)
Hurt enemies, and then negate their innate instinct to retaliate or get help
Foes won't move when the train is coming, or get out of the crossfire in a gunfight, etc.
weaknesses: The number of people that can be affected depends on how developed your power is
Effects may be permanent
If powerful, also cancels autonomic body responses (now you're going to superhuman jail for murder)

name: Literally Literal
description: You are able to pick out an idiomatic expression from someone and force them to reenact it, e.g. if someone were to say "pinch me, I'm dreaming", you could pinch them and they would disappear from this world and wake up in another world; if someone said "this bites", an animal will appear out of nowhere and bite them; if someone said "when pigs fly", a random pig with wings/jetpacks will appear in the sky; etc.
summary: The ability to force someone to enact their idiomatic expression.
strengths: Great for a good prank, or getting rid of enemies, e.g. if an enemy said "I'd rather die"
You can control how an idiom is enacted, from funny to deadly (if that idiom is possibly lethal)
weaknesses: Cannot use it on yourself. Is also permanent
Can only use it once a day per person
Can only use it on one idiomatic sentence per person

name: Zodiac: Gemini
description: With this power you can do what Al Bester in Babylon 5 did, just on someone else. You can make someone else's psychic signature appear to be yours for 2 hours by drawing the sign of Gemini above their head.
summary: The ability to create a psionic clone of yourself
strengths: Make enemies confused as to who is truly you.
weaknesses: If the person decides to commit a crime.
Only lasts for 2 hours.
Unaffected by Con Negation.

name: Madness Into Matter
description: By touching a psychotic person's head, you can turn his delusions into reality. If he believed he was Napoleon, he really becomes an awesome strategist who speaks French. If the person believes he's monitored by aliens, little green man really show up. WARNING: a psychotic delusion is rarely stable, so this power can become extremely uncontrollable.
summary: The ability to turn any psychotic person's delusion into reality
strengths: Can recreate Napoleon, John Lennon, etc.
Can summon aliens and whatsoever.
weaknesses: Can become uncontrollable.
Manipulating another person's mind is not so ethical.
Only works on one psychotic person's delusion at a time

name: Myth Power: Train Of Erotes1
description: The Erotes, in Greek myth, were the gods of various aspects of love and relationships. As such, channeling Anteros (Anterus- Mutual, Returned, Requited Love, Avenger of Unrequited Love), one can perceive a subject's love interest, and whether that love interest (including one's own) returns the same affections. In addition, if they DON'T, one may afflict them with ONE curse. One may even afflict a curse on (and do enhanced damage against) those who have hardened, unfeeling, unloving hearts.
summary: The ability to channel the Erotes' command over the essence of love, sexuality and relationships
strengths: Psychically perceive a subject's love interest, and if the love interest returns the same affections
Inflict a curse on one's love interest if they don't return one's affections
Inflict a curse on (and do enhanced damage against) heartless, unloving foes
weaknesses: Only generate wings to fly, summon (and use proficiently) a bow and arrow at will at higher levels
MythPower: Aphrodisia, MythPower: Arrows of Eros and MythPower: Oath of Ouranos provide immunity
Empathic Backlash or similar emotion-resistant abilities provide immunity

name: Myth Power: Agon's Aggression
description: Agon, in Greek myth, was the god of contest and competition. As such, channeling him allows one to to be instantly snapped into peak physical condition. In addition, one can psychically perceive an opponent's game plan or strategy, play by play (as well as any flaws in said plan) at will. Furthermore, one can psychically inflict one misfortune (per power use) on each of one's opponents in a competition, at will. One can even withstand perception and manipulation of probability and skills.
summary: The ability to channel Agon's command over the essence of competition and contest
strengths: Snapped into peak physical condition, even when power's use is up
Psychically perceive an opponent's game plan/strategy (and any flaws in it) at will
Psychically jinx opponents, at will; withstand perception/manipulation of probability and skills
weaknesses: Pro #1 does not amplify stats to superhuman levels until developed (NCN)
Pro #2 and #3 do not apply to combat until developed (NCN)
Probability/chance/luck-based MythPowers and Unpredictability provide immunity to Pro #3 (NCN)

name: X It
description: With this power you can make people leave a room or building whenever you want. Want someone to leave you alone just make them leave the room. Want a free period just make the teacher leave the school. Want to stage a jailbreak just make all of the cops/guards leave. Once you make the person leave they cannot return until you use this power on a different person in a different building.
summary: The ability to make people leave a room or building
strengths: You can make a person leave a room or building
weaknesses: The person can return to the building/room once you use this power on a person in a different buildi

name: The Beauty Of Death
description: If one were to look you in the eyes (which are ever-changing) they would die painfully, after a long period of 1 whole day. Wearing sunglasses will cancel the effect, and only your deepest love can look without dying.
summary: The ability to kill someone by having them look into your beautiful eyes
strengths: Being beautiful
Torturing enemies
weaknesses: Killing accidentally
Always having to wear sunglasses

name: Jla Summon V2
description: With this power you can summon any member of the Justice League of America. The hero doesn't have to currently be an active member of the team, they don't even have to be living in the current comic book timeline. Also when you summon one of them they under your complete control. Unfortunately if you want to use the mind control function you can only summon one of them. If you summon two or more you lose control over them.
summary: The ability to summon members of the Justice League of America
strengths: You can summon members of the Justice League
You can mind control up to one of them at a time
They don't have be an active or living member of the League
weaknesses: You can only use the mind control function if you summon only one hero

name: Myth Power: Muses' Message7
description: The Muses (Mousai, Mousae, Musae), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of knowledge, sciences, the arts and inspiration. As such, channeling Terpsichore (Terpsikhore- Choral Song, Dance) allows one to psychically access knowledge of all music, songs and dances, at will. In addition, one can psychically attune to music, to gain genre, title and/or lyric-based abilities, at will. One can even psychically produce music, which compels subjects to perform a perfectly-coordinated dance routine, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Muses' command over the essence of knowledge, inspiration and art
strengths: Psychically access knowledge of music, songs and dance, at will
Psychically attune to music, to gain genre, title and/or lyric-based abilities, at will
Psychically produce a song, which compels subjects in range to perform a dance-routine, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically disrupt creativity (or negate ideas), by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive subject's ideas until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Apollo's Gift may cause bossy attitude toward the user (NCN)

name: Summon Blood Golem
description: The ability to summon a blood golem. Any where blood has touched the ground, from a battlefield to a grave yard will be the perfect places to summon blood golems. However you do require blood. But if out of luck your own blood will be enough.
summary: The ability to summon a blood golem.
strengths: Always having the ablility to summon a blood golem
Controlling a blood golem that does your biddings
Controlling a creatuer with no will
weaknesses: Hard to summon blood golem without blood

name: Myth Power: Thesis' Theorem
description: Thesis, in Greek myth, was the goddess of creation and creativity in nature. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive the atomic, molecular and chemical structure of matter, by touch. In addition, one can psychically manipulate and alter the atomic, molecular and chemical structure of matter, by touch. Furthermore, one gains an ingenious superhuman creativity. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and share senses with inventors and other creative people at will.
summary: The ability to channel Thesis' command over the essence of creation and creativity
strengths: Psychically perceive matter's atomic/molecular/chemical structure (Material Perception) by touch
Psychically manipulate matter's atomic/molecular/chemical structure (Matter Manipulation) by touch
Gain Superhuman Creativity; psychically perceive, communicate with and compel creative people
weaknesses: Pro #2 does not affect living subjects until developed (NCN)
Pro #3 does not bestow Superhuman Intelligence until developed (NCN)
Plant/animal/nature-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Muses' Message2
description: The Muses (Mousai, Mousae, Musae), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of knowledge, sciences, the arts and inspiration.
