As such, channeling Clio (Cleio, Kleio- History) allows one to psychically access knowledge of recorded history, at will. In addition, one can psychically manipulate subjects' memories of recorded history, at will. One can also psychically astral-project one's consciousness back and forward in time, at will. One can even psychically summon copies of historical figures, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Muses' command over the essence of knowledge, inspiration and art
strengths: Psychically access knowledge of recorded history, at will
Psychically manipulate knowledge of recorded history
Psychically astral-project one's consciousness into past/future, summon copies of historical figures
weaknesses: Cannot psychically disrupt creativity (or negate ideas), by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive subject's ideas until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Apollo's Gift may cause bossy attitude toward the user (NCN)

name: Totems & Crafts
description: By the use of thoughts/magic, you create physical objects, who carry vary in shapes, forms and sizes, as well as purposes too. They contain the shapes, symbols, patterns or motifs on their surfaces that further invoke other powers for you to use, further advancing your current power status. They are physical, and as any physical object, they can be destroyed.
summary: The ability to craft or design totems by the use of thoughts, who further grant you other supernatural powers
strengths: Create items that can elevate your power levels or your magic or any other superpower you have
You can do this continually, as long as you have superpowers, and as long as you have this ability
You can grant these totems to others as well, perhaps if you have allies/sidekicks
weaknesses: You are limited to how much of these you can carry. In battle? Not too many sadly.
These are physical objects that can be destroyed, and easily too. Just a swing of a sword is enough.
They are not immune to magic effects. Inverted & Mirror-effects can screw up your use of them.

name: Psychic Cushioning
description: With this power, you can create cushions of psychic power with a thought. They protect you from tough blows and can be used as objects like pillows, shields, crash pads, air bags and even road blocks to protect vehicles from accidents. These psychic cushions are tough to penetrate as they are powered by the user's willpower.
summary: The ability to psionically form cushions of psychic energy.
strengths: Amazing defensive power.
Never worry about falling to your death.
You'll always have a soft bed.
weaknesses: You can't really harm anyone with this power as the cushions are soft.
Psychic cushions are powered by your own willpower. If you're weak-willed, your cushion won't last.

name: Godlike Memory
description: This power gives you the perfect memory. Which means your memory has infinite space for information. It also retains any information at first glimpse. You also have everything in your mind at the same time. You will not ever get anything locked away in your subconscious like the regular memory always does.
summary: The ability to have the perfect memory that will retain anything and will never get tired and have unlimited space
strengths: You will be the smartest in your school.
You can graduate early because people will think your a genius which you basically are.
You never have to study for school.
weaknesses: Some people might want to disect you to see why your memory is better than everyone else's.
People might bombard you for all the answers.
You might become a human guinea pig.

name: Thespian
description: Dedicated actors spend countly hours trying to perfect a flawed character. The power of 'Thespian' allows an actor to completely become the character they play based on information provided in the script, and writer's treatment, and what they themselves envision the character to be. This character becomes real, you becoming them completely, with mannerisms, physical appearance, and thought processes, moral beliefs etc.
summary: The ability to become in entirety any character you play / portray as an actor.
strengths: Step into the shoes of another human being.
Undergo the 'Heroe's Journey' of your character and play out a movie or play in real-life, experiencing real-life scenarios your character would face.
Can revert back to your own self, if enough of your own will and sense of self remains.
weaknesses: Requires extreme control and focus
There's no guarantee the character you become will let you revert to you, depending on the strength of their will, and what of you remains.
Useless if actor is not your profession, or if not your profession, your power would not come to fruition.

name: Forget
description: With this power you can forget whatever you would like whenever you want no matter how important or insignificant it may be. When you use this power You will forget forever and there will be no way of remembering at all, it will happen a few seconds after you choose to forget about something. Someone could even wipe there whole brain clean if they wanted. (Not Advised)
summary: The ability to forget about anything you know.
strengths: Will not have to remember terrible things that have happened.
Oh ex girlfriend? Who was that again?
Having a less cluttered brain.
weaknesses: Could make yourself forget something that could be important that you didn't think would be.
Will not work on other people.

name: Myth Power: Horae (Hours05)
description: These Horae (Horai, Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of the hours of the day. As such, channeling Nymphe (Nympha- Bath Hour), one can psychically perceive the passage of time, at will. In addition, one can withstand temporal effects. Furthermore, one can psychically regenerate, and gain physical power, when one swims or cleans oneself. One can also psychically teleport oneself and others to any body of water, at will. One can even psychically induce pain in unclean creatures, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Horae and their command over the essence of the hours of the day
strengths: Psychically perceive the passage of time, at will; withstand temporal effects
Psychically regenerate and gain physical power when one swims, bathes or cleans oneself
Psychically teleport to any body of water; psychically induce pain in dirty creatures, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically generate, manipulate and teleport between bubbles, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically purify subjects' minds, bodies and spirits, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically 'wash' subjects' minds or 'cleanse away' powers, by touch, until developed (NCN)

name: Fearsome Projection
description: With this ability you can project your own fears on to others thus momentarily becoming fearless while rendering them cowering in fear.
summary: The ability to Project your fear on to others.
strengths: Become Fearless for a time.
Cause others to be fearful.
Face challenges you normally couldn't.
weaknesses: Can backfire if over used.
Only works for a short time.
Can drive those whom you have projected onto your fear to make unlikely choices.

name: Revan's Mask
description: Wearing the mask of the Dark Lord of the Sith Revan will grant the warer his knowledge and Force talents and abilities, but at the cost of being enslaved to the mask because you're not Revan. You will be influenced by it and mentally dominated by it over time and constant use.
summary: The ability to wield the power granted when you wear Revan's Mask.
strengths: Become as knowledgable and powerful as Revan.
Gain Revan's force talents, abilities and powers.
Become unbeatable by most force wielders.
weaknesses: Lose yourself becoming enslaved to the mask every time you use it.
The mask is still a mask it can be stolen or destroyed by enemies.

name: Mental Compass
description: This ability will allow the user to know the direction of anything, represented by a compass. Sure, there are those powers that would give the user the exact location of what they want, but its other function is the real reason I made this ability. When the user gives another this ability, their brain will make them go blind and they will follow where the user wants them to go.
summary: The ability to turn your own or another person's mind into an all-knowing compass.
strengths: Good tracking ability.
Able to redirect people's movements or attacks.
weaknesses: Sometimes magnetizes wandering brainwaves.

name: Mind Exploder
description: The user drains said enemy's experiences, memories, knowledge and wisdom, and even points of view or personality (optional), leaving their ming reduced to yogurt.
summary: The ability to blow up a person's mind on touch
strengths: you wont have to stay at school that long
nobody will want to mess with you
could be smartest person on the planet
weaknesses: can't work if there's no physical contact
might not be cool at parties
almost no one will want you on their team

name: Superhuman Optimism
description:
With this power you can make anyone happy independent of its physical or mental state. Even if a person lost her arms and is bleeding a lot, yes, you can make her happy! 
This power affects your way of speaking, not the mind of your target, thats why everything you say seems really impressive and motivating. With this power you also uses 25% more of your brain smartness and deductibility, thats why you always know what to say.
summary: The ability to be able to make anyone happy.
strengths: You can convince our enemies to don't hurt you.
You will have a lot of friends and your presence will take away your allies fears.
You will be able to influence an entire army of allies.
weaknesses: You can't really hurt anyone.
You have no hypnotic powers, you just seem really cool while speaking.
Some times motivating ins't enough, even if someone is really happy that wouldn't make him stronger.

name: Mind Cloth Imprinting
description: A person with this power has the ability to make anyone's thoughts appear on their clothes. You can also choose to stop the thought pictures on the clothes. Now, you can not only read thoughts but you can prove them because, they are worn on their shirt/clothes. If they take off the shirt, it will be on the next shirt and on their skin. You can also stop this power at any time to force the words to be imprinted in their shirt.
summary: The ability to make people's thoughts appear on their clothes or skin
strengths: Not only can you mind read, you can prove their thoughts
If they try to take off their shirt, it will appear on the next shirt
Only you can choose when the words go away or when their thoughts stop showing up
weaknesses: Looking at a person's clothes during a fight probably isn't a good idea
Looking at other people can sometimes count as sexual harassment
It is in the language they are thinking in

name: Vampirism: Memory
description: Also called Mnemonic Vampirism or Memory Absorption, this is the ability to absorb memories from the thoughts of others and convert it into sustenance and energy for one's own personal use; this makes the subject temporarily forget weaker memories, and particularly strong or deeply-embedded memories provide an especially powerful boost (this power is especially helpful on those with traumatic memories, those with repressed memories, or those with memory based abilities)
summary: The ability to gain sustenance and power from the memories of others
strengths: Take away their memories of the foe, temporarily making them forgetful
Taking their memories also delays having to eat or rest (and bestows the foe's memories)
Foes with Panmnesia, Photographic Memory, Memory Manipulation
weaknesses: Doesn't permanently steal memory
Sometimes it requires an actual bite like a true vampire
Foes with memory protection

name: Animal Spirit Discovery
description: Do your friends describe you as proud? Brave? Loyal? Then this journey of self-discovery may end with your gaining a beastly lion animal spirit. Perhaps your persuasive, charismatic demeanor will produce a long, exotic python. Whatever form your animal spirit takes, your mind will be forever linked to it. It could become your best companion or your most powerful weapon...
summary: The ability to discover your unique animal spirit.
strengths: Spirit could take the form of a powerful animal.
You and the spirit share each other's thoughts.
weaknesses: The spirit could take the form of a less-than-reliable creature.
You feel the spirit's physical and mental pain.

name: Negative Empathic Psychic
description: With this ability, you can harness psychic abilities while under serious forms of stress, anger, or sadness. It triggers without warning unless you are able to harness or stabilize this ability, which is difficult during negative emotion. As these emotions increase, so does your power. It may sometimes cause objects to break or twist around you unless you are able to control it.
summary: The ability to control and harness psychic abilities while under negative stress
strengths: Gain limited to extraordinary psychic abilities while under negative emotions
weaknesses: Difficult to control,
Very difficult to harness while angered, stressed, under fear, etc.

name: Manchurian Candidate
description: With this power, you can speak someone's name to any other person. The next time these two people meet, the person you spoke to will be compelled to kill the one you named. They will go about the assassination as if they had just decided to kill their victim themselves. The assassin has no idea that they will try to kill their target until they meet them.
summary: The ability to turn anyone into a secret assassin.
strengths: Turn anyone into an assassin.
Change the tide of battle by shouting the name of the enemy commander.
weaknesses: You may not be trusted by people who know you can do this.
You do not control how your assassin will kill the target.
They may fail.

name: Communication Scrambler
description: Whenever an exchange of information is taking place through any form and method (speech, written paper, thought transfer, sign language, braille,... ), you can secure it using this power. Anyone who is not the sender or the intended recipients won't understand the message at all. For example, a visual message will appear as a blur to them, an auditory one as static noise, or a tactile one as a rough surface. The intended receivers don't have to be aware a message is being sent to them.
summary: The ability to make a communication unintelligible to anyone, except the sender and the intended recipients.
strengths: Very useful if the message is something private, critical, intimate or confidential.
The intended recipient can be the sender themselves, so you can protect your own thoughts.
You can protect a communication from being scanned.
weaknesses: An intended recipient can reveal the information to unwanted people without your consent.
You can't protect anything intended for the public, like publications, public speeches,...
You can't protect a communication from being jammed.

name: Scribographic Memory
description: A scribographic can memorize anything that he has ever written before allowing them to remember it word for word even if the paper was destroyed. They can also use it to study for tests by writing everything that will be on the test allowing them to remember it all. This power also applies to typing so if you typed a paper you can remember what you have typed.
summary: The ability to remember anything that you have ever written or typed
strengths: Helps when studying for tests
If you forgot to bring your homework now you you can reproduce it easily
Is usuable by the blind
weaknesses: Not much use aside from remembering things
Writing silly things will distract your concentration---and it will be stuck in your head

name: X Plosion
description: This ability allows you to accelerate the particles on a specific place with your mind and create an explosion in the form of an "X". The explosion can have any size, it can be small enough to crush an enemies brain or big enough to destroy a whole building. Reducing or increasing the explosion size too much would consume too much energy and kill the user.
summary: The ability to create a powerfull explosion in the form of an "X" with your mind.
strengths: Can destroy nearly anything without damaging anything else
The attack has cirurgical precision and can be used to neutralize without killing an enemy
Explosions can be created anywhere in the entire world, if you know where are you aiming
weaknesses: If the explosion is too big or too small, it'll kill you
If you can't see or don't know exactly the place you are aiming you can hurt innocents
Exploding something too far away can make you really tired or even kill you

name: Empathic Backlash
description: Empathic Backlash, also called Emotional Backlash is the ability to cause emotional intrusion to backfire on foes. That means that if the user feels negative emotions, if someone feels negative emotions toward him or if they try to read or manipulate his emotions, the foe will get a backlash which temporarily knocks them out.
summary: The ability to generate a backlash based on emotional contact
strengths: If you dislike someone and they're in close enough proximity, they'll feel the backlash
If someone who dislikes you gets too close, they feel the backlash
Emotion readers and manipulators who try to use their powers on you feel the backlash as well
weaknesses: If friends are mad at you, they also feel the backlash
Animals almost always feel the backlash because of their empathic capabilities
The backlash can rarely be turned off

name: Sun Wukong Channeling
description: You can really go ape with this ability, but you may be able to possess his signature weapon "will-following golden-banded staff" which you can shrink down to the size of a needle and keep behind you ear, as well as expand to gigantic proportions. You also can become immortal, transform into 72 different images, employ clouds as vehicles, turn clumps of your hair into any object you desire, see through most illusions and can even multiply yourself.
summary: The ability to possess the amazing magical powers of The Monkey King.
strengths: Many interesting powers to channel
weaknesses: May be too clever for your own good

name: Mental Freefall
description: Cause others to feel as though they are in total free-fall, disorienting them, making them sick or even stopping their heart from fear. Advanced users of this ability complete the illusion by fooling the victim's mind into "seeing" that they are falling, doubling or even tripling the effect.
summary: The ability to generate the feeling of freefall in another
strengths: Disorient Victims
Good for clean getaways
People who fear heights
weaknesses: Less effective on Brave, Psychic, or Mental Powered people

name: Myth Power: Hyperion's Watch
description: Hyperion, in Greek myth, was the Titan god of light, watching and observation. As such, channeling him allows one to generate and manipulate all spectra of light; this includes forming it into rays, lasers, flashes and bolts; bending it to turn invisible (self and others), cast illusions and project one's sight to other locations; or repelling it to generate darkness. In addition, one can perceive light on all bands, to spot invisible subjects, camouflagers, light-based illusions and the like.
summary: The ability to channel Hyperion's command over the essence of light, watching and observation
strengths: Control light (blast it, repulse it, change its temperature, make yourself glow, etc)
Turn invisible, cast light-based illusions; when developed, turn temporarily into an entity of light
Perceive all bands of light at will (detecting light-based illusion, camouflage/invisibility, etc)
weaknesses: Cannot sense, absorb or disrupt/negate photokinetic powers until the higher levels (no Con Negation)
Light Absorption or Light Repulsion provide immunity (NCN)
Sun/moon/sky/celestial-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Star O Kinesis
description: Star-o-kinesis allows you to take stars from the sky and turn them into 5-pointed blades that you can throw at your enemies with your mind.
summary: The ability to take stars out of the sky and use them as weapons
strengths: The star-blades can be fatal if they cut open any major arteries
You can throw them with your mind and avoid cutting yourself with one of the blades
They go too fast to be dodged by anyone who does not have super speed
weaknesses: You can only use this power at night
Accuracy cannot be guaranteed during a full moon
You cannot use this power on cloudy nights

name: Word Injection
description: According to many theories, people tend to think in words. A person with this power has the ability to insert a word into other people's thoughts. The word will immediately pop up in their head and they will think that they thought of the word. The word can be any length and can be a made-up word. If used when someone is speaking, they have a 90% chance of accidentally speaking whatever word you inserted. This can also be used to invoke fear by inserting the word fear into their mind.
summary: The ability to insert a word into anyone's thoughts
strengths: You can make them think that they think you sound good by inserting good in their minds
Make people mess up their lines by inserting a random word into their thoughts
weaknesses: Does not come with telepathy
If the person does not understand the word
It must be in a language the person understands

name: Surprise Box
description: The Surprise Box works on surprise value. When you open it, it will give you an item which is always useful to you in the current situation if used correctly, but it will always be something noone could expect. So, it's up to you to discover how to use it. It can be something which seems useless, like a whistle, a bouquet or a bicycle pump. It can be a magical object with powers. The box can even surprise you by giving you what you wanted but thought you wouldn't get because you expected it.
summary: The ability to get an object you didn't expect out of this box.
strengths: If your opponent is a precog, the box will overload their visions with all the possibilities.
There is always a way to make use of whatever you obtain to get you out of the situation.
If someone knows the future, the box will change it.
weaknesses: You have to learn to improvise and the box can be stolen.
It can happen that you never discover how to use the object.
If there's a way you could succeed on your own, the box may give you nothing.

name: Anamnesis
description: This ability is not as powerful as many other memory-based abilities, but it does help. This power keeps the user's memory from being absorbed, stolen, erased, distorted or otherwise manipulated. If the user takes drugs, drinks alcohol, is possessed, is mentally dominated, or the like, he will not lose memory of the event. Blackouts don't incur memory loss, the user is incapable of geting amnesia and the only way to impair memory is to remove parts of the brain.
summary: The ability to resist all manipulation or alteration of memory
strengths: Memory can't be distorted, manipulate, absorbed, blocked, etc. (power often accompanies Panmnesia)
You can actually REMEMBER the good time you had when you got drunk or high
Immunity to blackouts and amnesia (and you can remember if you are mentally possessed or dominated)
weaknesses: Doesn't imply total recall
Drugs still loosen your inhibitions (this may not be a bad thing)
You can still go unconscious (but you remember the time during which the body is inert)

name: Emotion Swap
description: Either change others emotions or your own, or swap them. You may get unwanted emotions.
summary: The ability to change emotions.
strengths: Change emotions of others
Change your emotions
Swap emotions with others.
weaknesses: May get unwanted emotions

name: Dream Leeching
description: By touching someone's forehead, you can put them to sleep where they start to dream. Then, you can drain energy, absorbing and gaining strength from their positive happy dreams. They only sleep from 2 to 9 hours, depending on how well they sleep and can be awoken at anytime. Also, you become weak if they have a nightmare, or if they become lucid, meaning they control their dreams and sever your psychic link with them.
summary: The ability to put anyone to sleep and gain strength through their dreams
strengths: Put anyone to sleep where they start to dream
Draw strength from their happy dreams
weaknesses: They sleep for up to 9 hours or less depending on how well a sleeper they are
They can awake at any time
Nightmares and lucid dreamers can weaken you

name: Depth Perception
description: A person with this power has the ability to control a person's sense of depth perception. This can be used in many ways. For example, you can make yourself seem farther or closer. In battle, you can attack people who are unprepared for your attacks, thinking that you are farther away. Also, it is very hard to hit you since they have a higher chance to miss you or not get a direct hit.
summary: The ability to control people's depth perception
strengths: Make other people unable to predict where you are
weaknesses: This power does not fool radars or other senses

name: Myth Power: Deimos' Dread
description: Deimos (Deimus), in Greek myth, was the god of dread, panic, alarm and cowardice. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive panic and timidity, at will. In addition, one can psychically induce and negate panic and timidity, by touch, word or thought. Furthermore, one gains physical power by scaring, startling or alarming (making them nervous, or making them outright panic). One can even withstand irrational nervousness, timidity, dread or panic, which may be shared, by touch.
summary: The ability to channel Deimos' command over the essence of dread, panic and cowardice
strengths: Psychically perceive panic and timidity, at will; psychically induce and negate panic, by touch
Gain physical power by naturally scaring or startling others (making them nervous, etc)
Withstand nervousness, timidity, dread and panic (may be shared by touch)
weaknesses: Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with and compel natural cowards, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically cast frightening illusions, to pop out and frighten foes, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Ares' Wrath, MythPower: Enyo's Laugh, Fearlessness, etc provide immunity

name: Hosting Game
description: You can capture people and place them in your mind, where you can control a game of survival.  You can see if the people care about each other or not. If they don't make it out, you can take their special ability.  They won't be able to come out unless you kill them, in which case they will come out. The people that survive will come out.
summary: The ability to capture people and place them in your mind, forcing them to play a game of survival.
strengths: You can control the game
weaknesses: They might get out

name: Electric Collar
description:
With a single thought, you can emit a signal which will send a pain message to your victim's brain. You will not actually harm the person but they will feel like they are being hurt. The intensity of the pain varies depending on your emotions. If you are feeling strong emotions (like anger, sadness or fear), it will hurt the person much more. 

Example: A gym teacher tells you not to stick your butt in the air when you are doing push-ups. "You were looking at my BUTT?!" ZAP!
summary: The ability to zap someone at will.
strengths: VENGENCE!!!
You can blackmail people by telling them its you and threatening not to stop.
It is oddly satisfying to cause someone pain and confusion.
weaknesses: You can end up regreting your actions. This power is very sensitive, so be careful.
If applied in excess, it may cause nerve damage. To the person, that is, not to you.
If you do not use your power, pressure builds up inside you and you may explode.

name: Myth Power: Astraia's Innocence
description: Astraia (Astraea), in Greek myth, was the goddess of purity and innocence. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically purge impurities from water, air, earth and the like, by touch. In addition, one can purge one's own mind of impure thoughts at will, and others' minds by touch. Furthermore, one can purge one's own body of harmful pathogens/toxins at will, and others' bodies by touch. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel virgins, drug-free people, etc at will.
summary: The ability to channel Astraia's command over the essence of purity and innocence
strengths: Psychically purge impurities from water, air, soil, etc, by touch
Psychically purge one's own body/mind at will (others, by touch)
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel virgins, drug-free people and other innocents
weaknesses: Pro #1 and Pro #2 require touch until developed (NCN)
Cannot purify genetic anomalies (genetic disorders, superpowers etc) by touch, until developed (NCN)
Law/order/justice-based MythPowers and MythPower: Zeus' Zenith provide immunity

name: Song Reading
description: With this ability, upon hearing a person's voice, one can tell many things about that person. Hearing their voice can reveal their innermost thoughts, their emotions, their intentions as well as whether they are telling the truth or not (it also renders one immune to song-based effects). And while it is not required, the ability works best if the subject actually sings.
summary: The ability to perceive information about a subject by hearing their voice
strengths: Perceive the inner workings of a song to find out the thoughts, feelings and motives behind them
Perceive the truth behind a person's voice
Song-based effects don't affect you
weaknesses: Can only read subjects for as long as they vocalize (and it works best if they actually sing)
At the lower levels you can only hear thoughts OR emotions OR intentions OR truth
At the lower levels you can still be affected by song-based effects

name: Real Gaming
description: This ability lets you and only you use a special controller to take control of others' movements. You can control people, animals, vehicles,etc. This doesn't let you control minds however, only their movements. Also you can only control one person or thing at once. You can play them over long distances & can watch the action on a screen on the controller. Like many games you can type in cheats that give the person special powers. Just select a power and whatever you're controlling has the power.
summary: The ability to use a special game controller to control things
strengths: Play real life gta
Have access to several other powers with cheats
Have someone else rob a bank for you
weaknesses: Only control one thing at a time
Limited cheat codes

name: Myth Power: Peitho's Persuasion
description: Peitho (Pitho), in Greek myth, was the goddess of persuasion, temptation, seduction and charm. As such, channeling her gifts one with mesmerizing charm; most neutrals will find one's mannerisms incredibly engaging, so one is hard to dislike, or to resist. In addition, one becomes highly skilled in convincing others to do one's bidding; one communicates in one's own language, which subliminally translates to a language the subject can understand. One can even resist the charm effects of others.
summary: The ability to channel Peitho's command over the essence of persuasion and temptation
strengths: Hypnotic charm (people like you a LOT, and try very hard to please you and gain your approval)
Powers of persuasion work on a subliminal level (no one can tell the power is even being used)
Persuasive capability transcends language barriers; immune to charm/persuasion abilities of others
weaknesses: Cannot verbally compel others to do one's bidding until the higher levels (no Con Negation)
People with love, attraction and sexuality based MythPowers can sense (and withstand) this ability
People with MythPowers based on law, order and justice are immune to this ability

name: Myth Power: Artemis' Art
description: Artemis, in Greek myth, was the goddess of hunting, the wilderness, wild animals, the maiden's chastity (purity), childbirth, healing and moonlight. As such, channeling her allows one to skill in archery, hunting, cooking natural remedies, midwifery and caring for animals. In addition, one can psychically perceive the future (at will, in the presence of moonlight). Furthermore, one can absorb moonlight to gain physical power. One can even psychically heal others with moonlight, by touch.
summary: The ability to channel Artemis' command over the essence of hunting, wilderness, wild animals, and the moon
strengths: Gain skill in archery, hunting, natural remedies, midwifery and caring for animals
Psychically perceive the future (at will, in the presence of moonlight)
Absorb moonlight to gain physical power; psychically heal others with moonlight, by touch
weaknesses: Cannot psychically control moon's course (rising/setting, phases) or manipulate lunar energy (NCN)
Cannot psychically summon indestructible bow (infinite plague-tipped arrows), until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with and compel animals, at will, until developed (NCN)

name: Subconscious Manifestation
description: This is a very dangerous ability to have if you don't have enough control over it. Your subconscious is where your mind hides your repressed memories, the things you don't want to say out loud nor think about, and your deepest desires, fears and emotions. When this power is activated, they can burst into the real world, taking symbolic shapes, transforming reality and interacting with it according to the meaning attached to it. This power is usually activated subconsciously.
summary: The ability to let your subconscious spill into the real world.
strengths: You can sort of exorcise your own fears and satisfy your own impulses.
You can discover more about yourself, things you forgot or kept denying.
The manifestations can take the form of creatures, humans, or alter reality to fit its meaning.
weaknesses: You don't want to have your traumatic memories and your fears manifest into reality.
It's very difficult to control and it's even more difficult to control the manifestations.
Your own manifestations can kill you, in which case they will disappear so it's not all that bad.

name: Imagination Screening
description: A picture is worth a thousand words. By projecting your thoughts or imagination onto a screen, people would better understand you.
summary: The ability to project your imagination onto a screen
strengths: No need to make powerpoint presentations anymore.
Quick way to communicate.
No grammar, semantic or orthograph needed.
weaknesses: You can't afford a lack of concentration and compromise yourself with a random thought.
Screen not included.

name: Dream Transmission
description: When you dream, you'll recieve future events that will happen way later. This will make you able to warn people of what is to come.
summary: The ability to receive future events (like 5000 years later future) through dreams
strengths: See what's in the future
Warn people
weaknesses: Not everyone will believe you
Hard to tell apart future info and just your dream

name: Neuron Activity Catalyst
description: This power speeds up the firing of neurons of anyone within a few yards, as well as their ability to handle the faster thought processes. The effects of the catalyst include increased efficiency of skill, such as a doctor suddenly becoming better at his job, or sudden epiphanies and memory recall as new synapses are formed. However, the power doesn't work on its user, and is involuntary, so Anyone that is nearby will gain the effects, regardless of alliance.
summary: The ability to boost the frequency and the efficiency of brain activity in the people around you.
strengths: Improve the skills and sensibilities of the people around you, for better results in battle or work
Help your friends work through their problems or remember important things... just by staying nearby
You'll always be an invaluable member of any team or group
weaknesses: The power itself isn't choosy - it'll work on both friend and foe alike with equal efficiency
You might feel left behind as all your friends/allies improve by leaps and bounds around you
The power doesn't really work on cyborgs or aliens or other more-or-less inhuman brain chemistries

name: Forgotten Luck
description: This is strange, but useful gift. Anyone with this ability can induce 12 hour long luck in themselves and others. Everything that happens to them will be good for them. But, at the end of the 12 hours, they will totally forget everything in the last 12 hours. So the end result will be them waking up(the memory loss will knock them out)in a strange place, and finding that their life is a lot better. For example, they could wake up in a library with a ton of money in their pockets.
summary: The ability to induce incredible luck and then forget it.
strengths: Inducing great luck in you and others.
It has cool name.
weaknesses: You forget everything after the hour of luck are over.

name: Episode Inducing
description: This power allows the user to cause the resurfacing of any condition that the subject has ever previously experienced. This resurfacing can range from hiccups to laughter to crying to coughing or sneezing (withouit even BEING sick) to burping to farting and the like, as long as the subject has experienced it before. The user can even cause certain illnesses to resurface (such as viruses/ailments--HIV, eczema, ringworms, herpes, etc-- and mental illness).
summary: The ability to reproduce any condition the user has ever previously experienced
strengths: Common experiences (consume them with uncontrollable laughter, itching, sneezing, coughing, etc. )
Condition can be revoked at will (and controlled in intensity)
If you don't know WHAT previous conditions a foe has, use the power; the most RECENT thing emerges
weaknesses: If you can't control intensity of the episode
If you can't stop the episode at will
If your foe has never been sick or cannot get sick

name: Myth Power: Oistros' Attraction
description: Oistros (Oestros, Oestrus, Estros, Estrus), in Greek myth, was the god of maddening excitement and rage, especially in matters of love. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive and communicate with attracted/attractive subjects. In addition, one can absorb sexual energy from one's surroundings, converting it into physical power; the longer it is held in, the stronger (and more maddening) it gets. One can even amplify others' sexual energy, by touch, sending them into a frenzy.
summary: The ability to channel Oistros' command over the essence of romantic frenzy or sexual rage
strengths: Psychically perceive and communicate with people who attract you, or are attracted to you
Absorb sexual energy and convert it into physical power (or, when developed, Berserker Rage)
Amplify subjects' sexual energy to a fever pitch, by touch, sending them into a frenzy
weaknesses: If sexual energy is held in too long before use, it may cause temporary symptoms of psychosis
MythPower: Aphrodisia, MythPower: Arrows of Eros and MythPower: Oath of Ouranos provide immunity
Empathic Backlash or similar emotion-resistant abilities (or not being sentient) provide immunity

name: Kinesis Bandit
description: An individual with this ability has no ability on their own. However if they are in the presence of someone with psychokinetic abilities, they can harness that energy and use that power if it is actively being used. For example being around a pyrokinetic lets you use pyrokinesis but only when the holder of the power uses it.
summary: The ability to mimic the psychic energies used by someone else.
strengths: Can potentially have any psychokinetic power
weaknesses: Can only copy one power at a time
Power must be active to tap into it

name: Myth Power: Mania's Madness
description: Mania and the Maniae (Maniai), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of madness and insanity. As such, channeling them allows one to think with a superhuman form of sanity that, in normal humans, would come across as insanity or dementia. In addition, one can psychically induce, amplify, reduce and negate mental instability by touch, as well as completely withstanding it. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those who are eccentric, demented, insane or mad at will.
summary: The ability to channel Mania and the Maniae's command over the essence of madness, insanity and mental instability
strengths: Gain a superhuman genius form of sanity that resembles insanity (immunity to mental penetration)
Induce, amplify, reduce and negate madness/dementia/insanity by a touch; withstand TRUE insanity
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those who are crazy/insane/mad
weaknesses: Cannot project 'Madness Bolts' (matter-distorting psychic energy) until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Lyssa's Lunacy, Berserker Rage, etc provide benefits to Pro #2
MythPower: Sophrosyne's Solace, etc provide immunity (NCN)

name: Three Laws Of Robotics Aura
description: In classic science fiction these laws applied to robots. Your power changes them and makes them apply to everyone around in a 500 foot radius. Affected beings can't injure you or through inaction allow a unaffected being to injure you. Any affected being must obey any command you give,except where it conflicts with the first law. Any affected being will protect its/his/her existence as long as the first two laws aren't in conflict with such protection.
summary: The ability to affect everyone in a 500 radius around with the three laws of robotics.
strengths: A mobile effect that turns anyone into your helpers or bodyguards.
Bank personal will just give you all the money you want.
A great power against a hero without the means to stop it affecting him.
weaknesses: Anti-telepathy,mind control immunity powers. Anything similar.
Anyone who has ranged attack of more than 500 feet.
Your former 'robots' will want revenge on you.

name: Forget Me
description: With this power you can make anybody forget who you are and that they had anything to do with you. This is useful if you get caught doing something you're not supposed to be doing (stealing, trespassing, cheating etc. ) Unfortunately you cannot make them forget only one thing about you when you use this power on a person they forget that they even knew you or met you and everything else about you.
summary: The ability to make people forget who you are
strengths: The pros are listed above
weaknesses: The cons are listed above

name: Headache
description: Cause mental pain with your mind to either severely hurt somebody or leave them unconscious. Or, just by merely touching the brow of a victim, you can leave them in a small coma. However, without control you can cause mental pain to people all around you.
summary: The ability to cause mental pain with or without touching a person, leaving them unconscious
strengths: Hurt your enemies easily
weaknesses: You must have control of the power

name: Myth Power: Hypnos' Lullaby
description: Hypnos (Hypnus) in Greek myth, was the god of sleep. As such, channeling him allows one to induce sleep (or insomnia) at will, as well as manipulating the length and depth of sleep (from a light catnap to a total coma); even putting machines to "sleep". In addition, one can compel the sleeping, causing them to sleepwalk to carry out commands. Furthermore, one maintains his awareness as he sleeps, and awakes fully rested from any amount of sleep he has; one can even go without sleep if desired.
summary: The ability to channel Hypnos' command over the essence of sleep
strengths: Induce, amplify, reduce, negate and withstand sleep at will; even put machines to "sleep"
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel the sleeping (and sleepwalkers)
Sleep is entirely voluntary, and totally recharges energy and restores your health
weaknesses: Cannot use this ability to manipulate dreams (NCN)
Cannot enter a sleepwalking trance with Precognitive Reflexes until the higher levels (NCN)
Sleeplessness, Dreamlessness, Perspicuity, etc provide immunity (NCN)

name: Swords Of De Aging
description: The swords cause what they touch to de-age by 1,000,000,000 seconds and are composed of light. They only cause things within a close proximity of what they touch to de-age. Ex: Your hand is touched and only it will de-age. The swords can be controlled mentally by the user and only five swords can be used created/controlled at a time.
summary: The ability to create and control swords that cause what they touch to become younger
strengths: Things younger than 1 billion seconds will find themselves turned into base atoms.
Help the elderly relive their teenage days.
weaknesses: Enemies immune to having their age supernaturally changed.
User is not immune to the effects of their swords.

name: Werewolf Control
description: With this power you have complete control of any person who is a werewolf, even if they're not in their werewolf form
summary: The ability to control werewolves
strengths: Werewolves are very strong
Werewolves usually travel in packs so you can have a lot of werewolves under your control
Goes well with werewolf tracker and wolves to werewolves
weaknesses: It only works on werewolves not regular wolves

name: Children Of The Spirit
description: You are a ghost basically, you can't die but you can reincarnate at will. When you reincarnate the next time you die you turn ghost again and remember everything from your past lives. When you curse a human, they can see you. You can turn human for 7 hours at a time and eat, sleep, etc. If you are killed while in human form you just turn back into a ghost. You can possess people and make them do whatever you want. You can teleport wherever you want to go and you can fly or float.
summary: The ability to be a ghost and turn into a human for 7hours at a time and curse 7 humans at a time
strengths: Phasing; Imperceptibility (except to those you curse)
Possess people to make them do whatever you want them to do (or curse them with bad luck)
You can choose to reincarnate as a human for seven hours at a time (Never die)
weaknesses: Can only become a human again for 7 hours at a time before you become a ghost again
Being a ghost can and will eventually get boring (MAYBE)
Only 7 people at a time can see you

name: Myth Power: Oath Of Ouranos
description: Ouranos (Uranos), in Greek myth, was the god of the sky's expanses and the dome of the sky (the atmosphere). As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive any location open to the sky (including weather and subjects' activity), at will. In addition, one can psychically manipulate clouds (lower them to generate fog, etc), at will. One can also psychically propel oneself in flight, at will. One can even psychically propel oneself into outer space, at will (and survive its conditions).
summary: The ability to channel Ouranos' command over the essence of the sky's expanses and the dome of the sky
strengths: Psychically perceive any location open to the sky (weather, subjects' activity, etc), at will
Psychically manipulate clouds (move them around, obscure the sun, generate fog, etc) at will
Fly, propel oneself into outer space and survive its conditions
weaknesses: Cannot psychically teleport foes to the sky or the atmosphere, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive life and events on alien planets/worlds, until developed (NCN)
No perception underground or in densely shrouded areas (NCN)

name: Pro And Con
description: When you mentally activate this power, you have a fifty per cent chance to permanently remove either the positive or negative aspects of a super power of your choosing.
summary: The ability to either remove all negative aspects of a power or all positive aspects by chance.
strengths: No more limitations on powers.
You may become exceptionally powerful, or foes exceptionally weak.
Can be used on other people.
weaknesses: Stuck with the outcome. (Powers may become liabilities or foes may lose weaknesses)
Power is unaffected by luck-altering powers.
No, you can't remove the cons from this power.

name: Myth Power: Asclepius' Effect
description: Asclepius (Asklepios), in Greek myth, was the god of medicine and doctors. As such, channeling him allows one to gain skill with every medical and therapeutic procedure, tool and piece of equipment in existence. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel doctors/physicians, other medical professionals, as well as subjects with healing, regenerative and restorative powers. One can even restore the dead to life, fully healed of injury, illness and ailment, by touch.
summary: The ability to channel Asclepius' command over the essence of medicine, doctors and healing
strengths: Gain skill in every field of medicine, surgery and therapy
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel medical professionals and healers
Restore the dead to life, fully healed of injury, illness and ailment (physical and mental)
weaknesses: Cannot enhance or disrupt/negate the healing process of self/others until developed (NCN)
Pro #3 can only restore the dead (has no effect on the living) until developed (NCN)
Medical/healing/restoration-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Insanitation
description: With this power, you will be able to control the amount of sanity a person has with a thought. It's only a temporary change but a useful one. Most insane people feel very little pain.
summary: The ability to temporarily drive anyone around you insane.
strengths: Cops will be temporarily unable to realize they were supposed to catch you.
An army of painless insane people is usually a good one.
By causing the insanity of a great political leader, they will be overthrown.
weaknesses: Insane people might still attack you.
Mental hold is broken while in extreme pain.
This is not mind control.

name: Summon Maids
description: A person with this power can summon maids. The maids are skilled at almost everything and are very good at cleaning. In addition they know martial arts. They also have emotions, so if you get one angry they will beat you up even if you were the one that summoned them. There are a possible of 300 different kinds of maids you can summon and you can also summon unlimited clones of one maid.
summary: The ability to summon maids
strengths: They are very skilled
They will clean things if you ask them nicely
They can also fight
weaknesses: They will only follow reasonable orders and will take offense at your remarks
They have emotions so you can make them angry/sad and they will attack you
Only 300 different maids with different names and you need to address them by name

name: Arbitrium Ab Canor
description: The latin meaning of Arbitrium Ab Canor translates into Controls with Song. You are blessed with not only the abitily to sing beautifuly but the ability to control people with your song, melody, voice, etc.
summary: The ability to manipulate people with songs.
strengths: Easily Lure people with your voice.
You don't need to sing what you want them to do, you can just hum and think what you want them to do
It can be at any voice level and the form of song doesn't matter.
weaknesses: Not exactly the greatest time and moment to use when you need to be quiet.
You can't control your soul mate.
You have to be careful of what your thinking when you're singing.

name: Zombie Superiority
description: A zombie with this power is of such a high level that other zombies automatically do what they're told by the zombie with this power. Due to the nature of this power, only a zombie can have this power. If two beings with this power try to give a command to the same being, the one who is more powerful gets their command followed first.
summary: The ability to give orders to zombies and have the orders followed
strengths: You get servants who will follow your every command.
Works for any type of zombie.
You're immune to the commands of someone else with this power, regardless of strength.
weaknesses: Zombies are generally mindless creatures.
Only really helps if the zombie with this power is intelligent.
You don't want to meet someone with this power who's more powerful.

name: Artkinesis
description: Say you want to fill an empty canvas with a beautiful sunset but you lack the talent and/or patience to do it. With artkinesis you don't even have to lift a brush. Just think of what you want to make on the canvas and it's there.
summary: The ability to create any artistic imagery with your mind
strengths: Literally putting your mind onto paper
Profting from your art
Freeing your creativity
weaknesses: May be seen as lazy in art community

name: Hallucinogen
description: Your blood becomes filled with a rare hallucinogen that causes such powerful hallucinations that they don't STAY hallucinations. As such, you're a very powerful reality warper, but that's not necessarily a good thing, as you don't really have control over what happens. Luckily, you aren't in much danger as long as you don't do anything that might cause a 'bad trip,' like watching gruesome movies.
summary: The ability to have hallucinations that become real
strengths: Can do almost anything, as long as you hallucinate it happening.
Remember, your subconscious (the origins of the hallucinations) is influenced by your conscious mind
Your mind will probably adjust to this new state, as it's filled with mind-altering substances
weaknesses: Two words: bad trip. A bad trip is where you start having hallucinations of horrific things.
You're going to go crazy. No doubt about it. Unless you have a will of iron and a powerful mind.
The hallucinations might not be helpful whatsoever, be uncontrollable, or permenantly alter you.

name: Reincarnation 2: Soulstone
description: When you acquire this power, you grow an organ in your chest which, when you place a copy of your consciousness inside, it turns into a gem-like substance. You can leave it in you or you can cough it up and place it somewhere safe. However, someone with a mental ability can target you from anywhere as long as they are in range of this gem. You can only have one of these organs at a time. If someone touches it, you can use a telepathic ability on them.
summary: The ability to survive as a gem-like object.
strengths: Survive in a gem-like object, able to absorb biomass to form a new body.
Holds a copy of all your powers -can use it restore lost powers.
Can use telepathic ability on those who touch it.
weaknesses: Can only have one at a time.
Takes a week to grow to be ready to hold your consciousness.
You can only revive if either your body or the gem survives.

name: Decision Induced Life
description: To use this power, you must declare "What if I chose to" followed by a decision you wanted to make in the past and the exact moment that decision would have come into your mind. You will then be sent back in your former self at that same moment without any memories of your "previous" life and the fact that you just used your power, free to continue your life. These memories will only come back if you succeed to live to the moment you used your power, you can then choose to revert what you did.
summary: The ability to live the life you would have lived if you made other choices in life
strengths: Change the things you regret in your life.
Try out slightly or completely different lifes.
Build your way to a more fulfilling life.
weaknesses: It's not guaranteed that you will fulfill the decisions you made.
Your decisions can have unforeseen consequences.
If you become unconscious or die, the changes you made will remain.

name: Myth Power: Nyx's Night Shift
description: Nyx, in Greek myth, was the primeval goddess of night; nightfall and the nighttime sky. As such, channeling her gifts one with Night Vision to see better at nighttime. In addition, one can perceive any location in the world where it is nighttime, and the activities of any creatures in said locations. Furthermore, one can travel to and from any location where it is daytime, at will. One can even withstand shadow/darkness-based attacks and psychically disrupt light-based attacks at will.
summary: The ability to channel Nyx's command over the essence of the dark of night and the nighttime sky
strengths: Gain Night Vision to see better at night
Psychically perceive any location where it is night (and creatures' activities in said locations)
Teleport self and others to any nighttime location; withstand dark powers, disrupt light powers
weaknesses: Only generate 'dark of night' or Time Travel to future/past nighttimes at the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive communicate with, and compel nocturnal creatures until developed (NCN)
Sun/moon/sky/celestial-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Behind Blue Eyes
description: People will trust that anything you say while using this power, is false. If you apply reverse psychology, you can get anything you want. Can be resisted and manipulated, especially by telepaths and people with a willpower ability.
summary: The ability to make any statement you make become false when the power is activated.
strengths: Fulfill or negate practically anything.
weaknesses: People will think you are always wrong.
If you use it without focussing on what you are saying it will get you the opposite of what you are
Can be manipulated and resisted

name: Time Recorder
description: While the power is active small rings that look like clock faces appear around objects and people that undoes any damage such as physical, mental, and spiritual. The change is not permanent however because as soon as the power is turned off the damage returns in full force. This power causes the user to become exhausted if used for too long.
summary: The ability to record damage so that it does not happen until a later date.
strengths: Fixes any damage done to objects.
Records damage so that a person will not even have death will affect them.
Lasts for as long as the user has endurance.
weaknesses: If power stops all damage returns instantly.
Cause user to become exhausted if used extensively
People would know if they would die when the power turns off.

name: Artistic Outlet
description: The ability to create art from your thoughts simply by touching a surface. With this power the art of your wildest imagination can be placed on any surface simply by touching it.
summary: The ability to create art from touching a surface
strengths: Make painting or drawing you can think of
weaknesses: Not useful in a fight unless your enemy is ADD

name: Friendly Memory Deletion
description: This power allows you to erase all of the positive memories someone has of another person. Good memories containing only the two of them are completely exorcized, while the person is deleted from any good memory that contains more people. The bad memories your victim has of this person are left completely intact.
summary: The ability to delete all the good memories someone associates with a specific person.
strengths: Alter someones perception of someone else.
Ruin someones reputation.
weaknesses: If you want to compleatly ruin someones reputation, you have to get to most of their supporters.
The person you erace dosen't change, and has a chance to get back in the victims good graces.

name: Myth Power: Tapestry Of Fate
description: The Moirae (Moirai, Moerae, Moires, Fates), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of destiny and fate. As such, channeling Clotho (Klotho- Spinner of the Thread), one can psychically perceive and time-travel to a subject's birth date, by touch, at will. Channeling Lachesis (Lakhesis- Dispenser of Lots), one can psychically perceive a subject's lifespan and events from their life so far. Channeling Atropos (Atropus- Cutter of the Thread), one can perceive subjects' deaths and cause of death, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Moirae (Fates) and their command over the forces of destiny, the essence of fate
strengths: Psychically perceive and time-travel back to a person's birth date, by touch, at will
Psychically perceive a subject's lifespan, lived life events, death and cause of death
Psychically perceive passage of time (Chronopathy); gain Time Defiance and Unpredictability
weaknesses: Cannot psychically bind foes in their metaphysical thread of fate, at will, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically summon divine shears, which cut/kill nearly anything, until developed (NCN)
Immortality, Time Defiance, probability/chance/luck based MythPowers, etc provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Iapetus' Impetus
description: Iapetus (Iapetos), in Greek myth, was the Titan god of wounding and mortality (the mortal lifespan). As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive the extent of a subject's mortality (how long a person has lived, has left to live, etc) at will. In addition, one can afflict wounds on any subject, as well as amplify wounds, make them better (heal them), prevent healing, etc, at will. One can even psychically render mortals immortal, and render non-deity immortals mortal, by touch.
summary: The ability to channel Iapetos' command over the essence of mortality, the mortal life span and wounding
strengths: Psychically perceive mortality (how long someone has lived/will live, vulnerability to harm, etc)
Afflict wounds, heal them, prevent them from healing, etc, at will
Render mortals immortal, render (non-deity) immortals mortal, etc, by touch
weaknesses: Pro #2 requires touch (Pro #3 requires touch, and only works one at a time) until developed (NCN)
Cannot gain Eternal Youth or rapidly regenerate one's own wounds, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Oath of Ouranos and MythPowers based on Iapetos' children provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Cydoimos' Confusion
description: Cydoimos (Cydoimus, Kydoimos, Ceidomos, Keidomos, Ceidomus), in Greek myth, was the god of uproar, confusion and misunderstanding (especially in combat). As such, channeling him allows one to psychically induce and negate confusion, by touch, as well as withstand it. In addition, one can psychically encode language into (and decode language from) gibberish, at will. One can even psychically generate illusions of battle or rioting, which cause foes to mistake their allies for foes, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Cydoimos' command over the essence of confusion and misunderstanding
strengths: Psychically induce and negate confusion, by touch; withstand confusion/disorientation effects
Psychically encode language into (or decode language from) gibberish, to communicate privately
Psychically generate illusions of battle/rioting; make foes mistake their allies for enemies
weaknesses: Part 1 of Pro #1 requires touch, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Eris' Enmity provides immunity (NCN)
Mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Demos' Demeanor
description: Demos (Demus), in Greek myth, was the god of the people and the population. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive the entire population of the land one currently occupies, as well as various facts about the population, at will. In addition, one can psychically comprehend and communicate in all languages of subjects in that land. One can even psychically teleport to anywhere with people at will, as well as gaining physical power proportional to the number of subjects present.
summary: The ability to channel Demos' command over the essence of people and the population
strengths: Psychically perceive the population (and population facts) of any land one currently occupies
Psychically comprehend and communicate in all languages of subjects in that land
Teleport self and others to anywhere with people; gain physical power in the presence of people
weaknesses: Cannot tap into the entire population of one's current land for power until developed (NCN)
Cannot shapeshift into any citizen of one's current land until developed (NCN)
Shapeshifting, Omnilingualism powers, etc, only apply to humanoids (NCN)

name: Emotional Wreck
description: If you are angry, things around you explode. If you are tired, others get tired. When you are depressed or sad, people become wrecks and cry or become suicidal. If you are lonely, people will try to comfort and be around you. It takes years to gain control over this ability. Your aura is visible during one of these episodes.
summary: The ability to make things happen depending on your mood
strengths: Are rarely lonely
People are afraid of angering you
weaknesses: Takes a long time to gain control
Is dangerous to people around you
Your emotions are always obvious, making it difficult to lie

name: Myth Power: Muses' Message1
description: The Muses (Mousai, Mousae, Musae), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of knowledge, sciences, the arts and inspiration. As such, channeling Calliope (Kalliope- Epic Poetry, Eloquence) allows one to psychically access knowledge of all epic works, at will. In addition, one can psychically travel into any epic story world, at will. One can also psychically summon objects and characters from epic story worlds, at will. One can even psychically perceive and communicate in nearly any language, at will
summary: The ability to channel the Muses' command over the essence of knowledge, inspiration and art
strengths: Psychically access knowledge of epic story works, at will
Psychically travel into (and summon objects/characters from) epic story worlds, at will
Psychically perceive and communicate in nearly any language
weaknesses: Cannot psychically disrupt creativity (or negate ideas), by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive subject's ideas until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Apollo's Gift may cause bossy attitude toward the user (NCN)

name: Mind Drain Grip
description: You have the power of neuralyzing your opponents by pressing one's fingers against their head to wipe the witnesses' memories of what they have seen and heard.
summary: The ability to erase a person's memory just by squeezing the top of their skull.
strengths: You can drain your opponent's memory and store it into yours.
weaknesses: Don't try to drain it too much cause your brain would grow to gigantic size.

name: Myth Power: Arrows Of Eros
description: Eros, in Greek myth, was the god of sexual attraction and sexual affection. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive lust, love and affection, as well as a subject's sexual preference, their sexual capacity and their destined soul mate at will. In addition, one can psychically induce attraction (toward oneself or others) at will, and withstand love-based effects. Furthermore, one can generate wings at will. One can even summon (and gain skill in using) a bow and arrow at will.
summary: The ability to channel Eros' command over the essence of sexuality and attraction
strengths: Psychically perceive lust/love/affection, subjects' sexual preference, sexual capacity and soul mate
Psychically induce sexual attraction (toward self or others) at will; withstand love-based effects
Generate wings at will to fly; summon (and gain skill with) a bow and arrow at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically imbue arrows with love-inducing powers, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot gain Superhuman Accuracy and Blindsight (Blind Sight or Blind Sense) until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Oath of Ouranos, Aphrodisia, Train of Erotes, etc provide immunity (NCN)

name: Pain Resurgence
description: Whenever you touch someone, all the injuries they once had reappear, all the diseases they once had relapse, and all their bad memories come back to their mind, even the long forgotten and repressed ones. This power is passive, so you need training and concentration if you want to turn it on and off at will. If the victim acquired an immunity against a disease, it doesn't matter. It just means they will heal faster from that disease after being infected again.
summary: The ability to bring back past injuries, diseases and bad memories.
strengths: Effectively hurt or even destroy anyone physically and mentally.
The more damage someone sustained in the past, the deadlier this power will be.
weaknesses: You can end up being contaminated if your victim once had a contagious disease.
Your family, friends and lover will avoid touching you if you don't learn to turn off your power.

name: Power Suggestion
description: This power lets you tell a person that they have a certain power and they will believe you and not question you. If they actually have the power then they will only use the powers you have suggested to them and forget or not notice the other powers they have. If they do not have the power you suggested then anything could happen based on what you suggested to them. Have to shock the person to get them out of the suggestion.
summary: The ability to suggest to people that they have a power, even if they do not have it.
strengths: Convince people that they only have the powers that you tell them.
They wont notice or use powers that you have not suggested to them.
Tell enemies they can fly when on a cliff.
weaknesses: Mental powers, people with strong wills, or if they have some shock they could get out of this power
Have to be able to explain the power to the person.
Powers that are always active, or passive powers will still be used, but unnoticed by person.

name: Demon Blade
description: You can summon a sword from the shadows that grants you a mystic power. The sword's form will express your dreams, the mystic power will match your personality and fighting style. The mystic power granted can be nearly anything: from flight to mind control passing by elemental manipulation. The sword can be summoned and sent back anytime, if separated you can call it back to your hand. The power given can be used even without the sword in hand but you must have summoned it once before.
summary: The ability to summon a sword with mystic powers
strengths: Have a sword anytime
Are granted a mystic power from the sword
Mystic powers can be used even without the sword in hand
weaknesses: Can't tell what the power will be untill you fully summon the sword
The mystic power can be nearly anything, even a power you have never even thought of

name: Power Protection Filter
description: With this power, you can tell your powers to allow an "attack" to work on you. For instance, you can tell a telepathy-blocking power to allow telepathic communication while still blocking mind control and mind reading.
summary: The ability to prevent your powers from "protecting" you from beneficial things.
strengths: Can now communicate telepathically even with Anti-Telepathy.
Allow a friend with Inverse Shapeshifting to alter your appearance even if you have Immutability.
Allow medication to work on you despite Chemical Invulnerability.
weaknesses: Cannot make a power protect you from something it normally cannot.
Must be consciously set to do so; a person cannot heal you unless you tell your powers to allow it.
This power cannot be affected by Con Negation and similar powers.

name: Esp Interference
description: With this power, one can interfere with extrasensory detection of events and objects. It has no effect on enhanced senses or information collected from another source (e. G. Via Telepathy or Technopathy). The effect is able to be applied to any object, event or concept.
summary: The ability to interfere with ESP.
strengths: Keep secrets and enjoy privacy.
Can be applied to almost anything.
Difficult to counteract.
weaknesses: There are ways of getting around this power, depending on what it is hiding.
This power provides no immunity to itself.
Does not protect against those physically viewing what is hidden.

name: Blank
description: This is a passive ability, it can't be turned off, which makes it kinda sad. As soon as you leave someone's presence they will forget you and every moment that they associate with you. So you can shoplift with no consequence, but you'll never have a meaningful relationship. You can still be caught on tape, but people will forget the tape after seeing it. A person with this ability will develop one of three personalities: really clingy, completely insane, or apathetic. Usually in that order.
summary: The ability to be completely forgotten by anyone
strengths: Shoplift with no consequence
Do whatever you want. Who Cares!
This is a dream power for a lonely personality
weaknesses: Never have a deep relationship
Always a stranger
Will likely develop a lot of mental disorders

name: Capgras Effect
description: This ability definitely has its uses. With it, you can naturally perceive when mimicry is taking place. Shapeshifters never escape your notice. Illusionists can be discovered. Twins are a cinch to tell apart. And replicates and clones are easily distinguished from the people that produced them. You can even detect voice impersonation, written forgeries and various other types of counterfeit.
summary: The ability to perceive twins, clones, replicates, copies, mimics, forgeries and counterfeits
strengths: Easily tell identical twins apart; easily pick out a foe from his replicates/clones
Sense when a person is in shapeshifted form (or otherwise mimics someone else)
Recognize forgeries and counterfeits at a glance
weaknesses: Mimicry is identified by the sense it is trying to deceive (must HEAR vocal mimicry to identify it)
Recognizing that a shapeshifter is transformed doesn't identify what his TRUE form is
Doesn't prevent you from being mimicked (just lets you know its happening)

name: Imprinting
description: Writer's cramp no more! An Imprinter can 'write' by waving their hand over a surface and applying minimal concentration. This can be cursive, print, any color or size. Sign 30 contracts at a time, make indelible graffitti, copy signatures or create sketches from memory.
summary: The ability to mentally write marks on surfaces
strengths: Can be cursive, print, any color/size
Requires minimal concentration
Graffitti that cannot be washed away
weaknesses: Must wave hand over surface
Not really useful outside of the office
Cannot 'unwrite' something without much greater effort

name: Mode Swap
description: A good example of this ability would be like if you have the ability to turn into a giant monster. Well you will be able to change it around. Instead of turning into the monster, you can project a monster or make it happen in someone else's mind, who knows? All abilities are different when you switch them.
summary: The ability to switch ability from physical to mental or the other way around.
strengths: If you have a lot of abilities, you'll be able to open a whole new world of abilities.
Gives you two ways to fight opponents.
weaknesses: You'll never know what will come out when you switch the nature of your abilites.

name: Myth Power: Nympholepsy
description: The Nymphae (Nymphai, Nymphs), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of nature's various landforms. As such, channeling them allows one to gain entrancing supernatural beauty. In addition, one can attune oneself to, and thus survive in, any environment, at will. One can even psychically empathize with nature; psychically perceive and communicate with plants and animals, psychically induce subtle influences in nature to give combat advantage, nature responding to one's emotions, and the like.
summary: The ability to channel the Nymphs and their command over the essence of natural landforms
strengths: Gain entrancing supernatural beauty (snapped into peak physical condition)
Psychically adapt to survive in any climate at will
Psychically empathize with nature for various defensive and offensive effects
weaknesses: Lifeline may become linked to natural land features like a tree (while the ability is active)
No Dryad Tree Form, Air/Wind Mimicry, or Water Mimicry until the higher levels(NCN)
Cannot use this ability to manipulate weather, or induce major weather/nature events (NCN)

name: Imagination Crusher
description: This ability lets you destroy anything that someone is imagining. Imagined creatures, objects, and imagined realities are instantly destroyed via touch and touching another person directly destroys their imagination.
summary: The ability to destroy a person's imagination
strengths: Destroys Reality Warpers except for those that can erase your existence
Destroys things that require visualization such as projections of a Green Lantern Ring
As Einstein said "Imagination is more important than knowledge"
weaknesses: Normal memorized actions are not negated
If the user is actually a figment of imagination this power will destroy them
Without gloves you can accidentally destroy people's imagination

name: Myth Power: Spondae Special
description: The Spondae (Spondai), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of treaties, contractual agreements and drinking wine to seal deals. As such, channeling them allows one to psychically summon and fill out a scroll-like contract (with feather quill pen and ink well for signing) at will; a contract may bind subjects to a promise (with deadly results for failure to comply), grant wishes, etc. In addition, one may summon a glass of wine to negate inhibitions. One may even gain skill in handling contracts.
summary: The ability to channel the Spondae and their command over the essence of treaties, contracts and treaty libations
strengths: Psychically summon a scroll/feather quill pen/ink well, and draw up contracts for wish granting, etc
Psychically summon a glass of inhibition-negating wine (making foes easier to trick and confuse)
Become a master at creating/exploiting loopholes; Tearing up contracts negates any deal
weaknesses: Summoned wine is only irresistible (and useful to heal self/others) at the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Horkos' Pledge, MythPower: Styx Bond, etc provide immunity (NCN)
Wine/festivity-based MythPowers provide immunity to (and power from) this ability (NCN)

name: Anthropomorphic Personifying
description: An anthropomorphic personifications is the physical, thinking, living form of a concept or idea. For example; the Grim Reaper for death. With this power you can personify any idea you like. The personification has full influence over the thing it's the personification of, and its personality is influenced by the way the idea is perceived by humanity. For example, the personification of Google would follow the company motto of "don't be evil" and the company would act on its wishes unconsciously.
summary: The ability to create anthropomorphic personifications of anything.
strengths: Turn something unthinking into a living being that can be influenced.
Personifications are as hard to destroy as the ideas or concepts they represent.
Personifications are intimatly connected to what they represent, and can share information with you.
weaknesses: The destruction of the personification will destroy what it represents as well.
The personification is not controled by you, and has its own feelings and opinions.

name: Hecation Ability
description: It's an anchient family which passes from uncle to nephew,they are characterized by going through several "jumps" in their lives which cause their abilities to intensify and diversify. They always start out with a starter ability, the three that are alive right now started with, clairvoyence, precognition and empathy.
