summary: The ability to have a genetic heratige that allows all abilities you possess to be magnified
strengths: They are very powerfull
They are unique
They are ususally taught by the uncle before them
weaknesses: They always feel they are different
There abilities can get out of control
They have a dislike of themselves

name: Myth Power: Demeter's Touch
description: Demeter, in Greek myth, was the goddess of food, agriculture and the Eleusinian Mysteries. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically access cooking skill. In addition, one can psychically perceive and teleport to any location with food, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically manipulate plants, at will. One can also psychically absorb sunlight and the earth's nutrients, to heal and gain physical power and sustenance, at will. One can even psychically perceive the Astral Realm, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Demeter's command over the essence of food, agriculture and the Eleusinian Mysteries
strengths: Psychically access cooking skill; perceive and teleport to any location with food, at will
Psychically manipulate plants; psychically perceive the Astral Realm, at will
Psychically absorb sunlight and earth's nutrients to heal, gain physical power/sustenance, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically absorb sunlight and earth's nutrients to grow in size, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically manipulate agricultural/economic/cooking/food-based powers, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically bond with users of MythPower: Persephone's Poise, until developed (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Smiting
description: Everyone knows that the Greek gods all had particular domains, but there was one thing they could ALL do: smite those who oppose them. If people thought they could surpass a god in something they presided over, they were turned into something, or driven mad, or their people were afflicted with plague, or died, or were struck by lightning, as Zeus was famous for. Channeling the divine wrath of the Olympians, you can do just the same, provided you don't disrespect the gods, yourself.
summary: The ability to channel the wrath of the ancient Greek gods
strengths: Inflict divine wrath upon foes for defying the Greek gods
Choose any method of smiting you like (and be immune to other gods' smiting)
Choose between a person, a group or an entire nation
weaknesses: Plague, famine, hunger, destruction, chaos, violence? That means a lot of clean-up
If you offend the gods in any way, you lose this power
If you offend the gods after you lose this power, YOU get smited

name: Myth Power: Iaso's Ideal
description: Iaso, in Greek myth, was the goddess of cures, remedies and modes of healing. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive and communicate with ill and injured subjects, at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive what treatment an ailing subject needs, as well as how to administer it, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically summon medicines and medical instruments, at will. One can even enhance medicines' curative effects (or weaponize medicines or instruments) at will.
summary: The ability to channel Iaso's command over the essence of recovery from illness and injury
strengths: Psychically perceive and communicate with ill and injured subjects, at will
Psychically perceive necessary treatments and how to perform them, at will
Psychically summon medicines and medical instruments, and enhance (or weaponize) them, at will
weaknesses: Cannot improve remedies' taste or smell (cod liver oil, etc) until developed (NCN)
Cannot summon medicines that provide or 'cure' superhuman powers until developed (NCN)
Medical/healing-based MythPowers provide immunity to part 3 of Pro #3 (NCN)

name: Mental Target
description: The possessor of this power designated a "target person" that from that moment onwards will become the target of all the mental powers within a certain area. If someone who has a mental power and the "target" too are located in this area, and the possessor of the mental power directs his/her power to someone or something, that power is automatically diverted to this "target person", both a positive and a negative power. The "target" stop being such only to the subject's liking.
summary: The ability to designate a person as target of every mental power within a certain area.
strengths: The subject can defend his/her friends and him/herself damaging his/her foes
The subject can also choose him/herself as target.
weaknesses: When activated, the power may have repercussions (a positive effect is diverted to a "target" foe)
The subject can also choose him/herself as target.

name: Anti Illusion
description: This power may seems useless but it can be used in many ways. If you need to remember something create an illusion of what you need to remember and have it follow you around. Bored? Make an entertaining illusion. You can act out your wildess dreams and no one would ever know. Your imagination is truly the limit with this ability.
summary: The ability to create illusions that only you can see
strengths: Never get bored or forget something ever again
You can act out your wildest dreams!
weaknesses: You might end up going crazy
Your the only one who can see your illusions

name: Improved Prestidigitation
description: Allows you to create simple magical effects that are not damaging, but impressive. Anything you can think of will happen... But it's limited to things that a magician could do through sleight of hand and misdirection... Except, you're actually doing it.
summary: The ability to generate simple tricks that boggle the mind and look totally awesome.
strengths: Do all those card tricks without resorting to sleight of hand.
Make spanish galeons out of pipe smoke.
Make your mother's meatloaf taste good.
weaknesses: Can't actually protect you...
Or harm anyone.

name: Mental Recreation
description: With this power one could make a person part of the mind that controls sight now hear and the part for movement now be speech and etc. so basically the user can completely destroy a persons brain and cripple them forever...but there is a way to reverse it by putting the parts back, but for this you need knowledge of where those parts a located. But if you where to "jumble" there brain very quickly, you would have a 1 in 65 chance of fixing it.
summary: The ability to simple recreate the minds functions
strengths: You can completly cripply the brain of your nemesis
weaknesses: You could  hurt allies and it would be hard to put things where thay belong.
If you take to long to put a part somewhere else it could react back on you and damage your mind.

name: Liliths Blessings
description: Liliths Blessings allows the beholder to cause pain to someone mentaly and physicaly as a disguise. They may also inflict illnesses on a person to fulfill selfish desires so they may attain what they want and they can also inflict death instantly on any living being with a significant cost as half of their life. Exaple: You have 30 years left to live and inflict death instantly, you now have 15 years left. You have a year? You now have 6 months. The power can be used multiple times.
summary: The ability to inflict pain, illness and even death.
strengths: Never losing a fight.
People fear you.
You can fufill your greed.
weaknesses: Your life can be drastically reduced.
You are targeted by some 'unknown force'.
You may hate yourself

name: Myth Power: Horae (Hours09)
description: These Horae (Horai, Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of the hours of the day. As such, channeling Acte (Acme- Dinner Hour), one can psychically perceive the passage of time, at will. In addition, one can withstand temporal effects. Furthermore, one can psychically regenerate, and gain physical power, when one eats. One can also psychically access an infinite extradimensional fridge/pantry, at will. One can even psychically become nearly any animal that can safely eat the foe, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Horae and their command over the essence of the hours of the day
strengths: Psychically perceive the passage of time, at will; withstand temporal effects
Psychically regenerate and gain physical power when one eats
Psychically access an infinite extradimensional food stash, turn into foe’s predator, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically receive taste-based insights, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically project one's mouth (eat, bite, breathe etc at a distance), until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically summon, communicate with and command foe's predators, until developed (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Hedone's Pleasure
description: Hedone, in Greek myth, was the goddess of pleasure, enjoyment and delight (of a sensual, sexual nature). As such, channeling her allows one to perceive what pleases others. In addition, one may psychically induce pleasant sensations by touch, word or thought, as well as heighten or diminish said sensations. One may even cast a convincing illusion, in which the subject feels as though they only experience that which sexually pleases them (regardless of what is actually happening around/to them).
summary: The ability to channel Hedone's command over the essence of sensual pleasure, enjoyment and delight
strengths: Perceive what pleases others (be the perfect people pleaser or heartbreaker)
Induce and alter pleasant sensations (even to the point of euphoric stupor, or addiction)
Cast a "Rose-Colored Glasses" illusion on foes; they only see what they want to see
weaknesses: Only telekinetically affect subjects with sexually-pleasing libido energy at the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot be used to induce love; only pleasure and sensual arousal (NCN)
MythPower: Arrows of Eros and MythPower: Psyche's Smile provide immunity (NCN)

name: Projective Prosopagnosia
description: Prosopagnosia is the condition in which someone is unable to cognitively recognize faces. With this ability, the facial recognition part of the brain can be switched off in someone else, so they can see your face or your friend's face and have no idea who it is they are looking at. They aren't blind or stupid, they just cannot recognize faces. However, similar to other prosopagnosics, they can recognize people from clothing or behaviours, such as a hat or a bounce in their step.
summary: The ability to cause others to have prosopagnosia.
strengths: You can make people not recognize you by your face
You can make people not recognize each other by their face
weaknesses: You need to consciously turn prosopagnosia on and off. It won't automatically happen
They can recognize you by something, such as an outfit you are known for wearing or your behaviour

name: Clone Control
description: Any clone you come upon you can control. You can control how old they appear, how they think, what they do, etc. You cannot however do things that change who they look like. Ex: no changing hair color, sex, face, height, etc.
summary: The ability to control the minds, bodies, and actions of clones
strengths: An enemy that uses an army of clones.
weaknesses: Not that many clones in the world.

name: Artifact: Diarium Ejus
description: Whenever you say "Adeat", it summons a book that can read someone's mind. The book automatically writes down anything they are saying and shows a picture that sums it all up.
summary: The ability to read people's minds using a book.
strengths: Seperating the book into smaller pieces that can read multiple people's minds.
weaknesses: Must know the person's name.
When you start reading, you become unaware of your surroundings.
All thoughts are deleted when you make the book go away.

name: Thought Piggy Back
description: This power can't be turned off. At first, you will have difficulty knowing which thoughts and memories are yours. You will have to guess by which stay when you leave that group. The more you concentrate this ability, the more you can widen the effect range. Others with mental-based powers may see this as a huge invasion of privacy (which it is).
summary: The ability to use the surrounding people's thoughts and memories as your own.
strengths: Fit into any group.
See any attack coming a mile away.
Know everyone better then they know themselves.
weaknesses: Nothing anyone ever tells you is news (by the time they say it, you already know ).
People may not want you to know their deep dark secrets or past.
Can't turn it off.

name: Dark Crosses Of Judgement
description: With this power you can create shadowlike crosses. You can create as many of them at a time as you want, but you are not immune to their effect. Whenever someone touches one of the crosses, they get hurt based upon the damage they have done to others mentally, spiritually, and physically. The crosses will ONLY disappear when touched by a living, sentient being. Using this power does NOT affect your karmic balance in any way.
summary: The ability to create shadowy crosses that hurt people based on karma
strengths: Crosses can only be gotten rid of by touching them.
The crosses also count in damage dealt by previous lives that haven't been affected by this power.
weaknesses: The crosses can affect you.
Someone who has never hurt others' lives. (like that'll happen)

name: Myth Power: Coeus' Cognition
description: Coeus (Koios, Polus, Polos), in Greek myth, was the Titan god of logic, intellect, inquiry and the North Pole (the northern axis of heaven). As such, channeling him allows one to gain Superhuman Intelligence; skill in research, argument/debate, analysis and deduction. In addition, one can psychically manipulate and absorb intelligence, by touch. Furthermore, one can even gain psychically perceive and communicate with other smart people. One can even gain numerous cold and magnetic benefits.
summary: The ability to channel Coeus' command over the essence of logic, intelligence, inquiry and the axis of heaven
strengths: Gain Superhuman Intelligence; Psychically manipulate and absorb intelligence, by touch
Psychically perceive, communicate with and (when developed) compel other smart/intelligent people
Psychically perceive magnetism; Sense 'True North' to act as a human compass; Withstand cold
weaknesses: Cannot psychically enforce questions (immobilize subjects or drive them mad), until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically manipulate magnetism/magnetic fields (enhanced in the cold) until developed (NCN)
Mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Power Counter
description: This power ensures that you cannot get possesed or used as an aquired ability/superpower by someone.  Your mind is also unaffected hypnosis, telepathy, or other mind affecting abilities and even filters out affecting magnetic, electric and electromagnetic waves.  The strength of your powers cannot be decreased by other abilities and if augumented, your powers remain under your control and won't go wild. You can still be affected by your own/allies' beneficial powers if you want to.
summary: The ability to not get possesed and receive other counters.
strengths: Works well with Power Safety and Hold.
Do not worry about your powers being weakened or dampened.
You can still be mentally/telepathically healed.
weaknesses: None.

name: Bleeding Hypnotic Effect
description: This superpower can let you control someone's mind to make them bleed to death within seconds. But first, you have to make sure the person is still, not walking, running, skipping, etc.
summary: The ability to make a person bleed to death
strengths: It doesn't take forever to do the power
You can control the power
It takes no body movements
weaknesses: The blood would be a complete mess
You might regret doing it
It will be pain-free for the person

name: Protected Sight
description: One with this ability possesses a psionic aura over his eyes that renders him invulnerable to physical harm as well as distortion in capacity or function. This means the user cannot be blinded, cannot have his eyes poked out, cannot feel pain (or sustain damage) from intense light, and is immune to light-based illusions (or mental illusions based on sight); if the user can naturally change his OWN sight (like if he has telescopic vision) this is not impaired
summary: The ability to resist optic distortion or harm
strengths: Eyes are immune to harm
Eyesight cannot be distorted
Win all staring contests (eyes don't tire easily if open too long)
weaknesses: If somebody can manipulate psionic energy, they can negate this ability
If power is negated, may also render the user blind (not used to outside irritants)
Othert types of illusion still work

name: Dream Vision!
description: Not to be confused with dreamscaping or manipulation; the user can witness their environment through the succession of vibrant colors and textures that one would indulge when asleep. Images become distinctively ghastly, taking on a somber state of being. Lights are either blurred or tinted, as to not blind the user; as well, the user can gain partial x-ray, microscopic, or any other sight they may acquire within a dream.
summary: The ability to view the world as though it were a dream!
strengths: User has the ability indefinitely.
There is no known weakness.
weaknesses: People discern dreams differently, and probably won't have the same effect.
Dreams are not always colorful, and can be any variation of the visible spectrum.

name: Ancestral Memory
description: You can recall anything that happened to your parents up until you were conceived, any thing that happened to your grandparents up until your parents were conceived, etc.
summary: The ability to remember things from your ancestors.
strengths: You can instantly know stuff that happened in the past.
You will be able to do geneology very easily.
weaknesses: Memory fades the farther back you go.
Some stuff you might not want to remember.

name: Reincarnesis
description: With this power you can connect to all your past lives and recall any important events or combinations to any event during those times. You can see all of your past selves as well as see anyone of the past selves of your family and friends. With this ability you can also revert back to your own childhood memories and see events unfolding as if you were there.
summary: The ability to recall or be all your previous selves.
strengths: You can learn all about why you were given your current life.
You can find out where all your fears originate from.
You will know what to do in this life to avoid repeating mistakes.
weaknesses: You will experience all of your deaths and see your own coming.
You cannot alter the events in any way only what you learn from them.
Knowing too much will give you migraines and paranoia.

name: X Men Summon V2
description: With this power you can summon any member of the X-Men. The X-Man doesn't have to be currently an active member of the team they don't even have to be living in the current comic book timeline. Also when you summon when of them they under your complete control. Unfortunately if you want to use the mind control function you can only summon one of them. If you summon two or more you lose control over them.
summary: The ability to summon any member of the X-Men
strengths: You can summon any member of the X-Men
You can control up to one of them
weaknesses: If you want to summon more than one you lose the mind control function

name: Instant Messaging
description: Send and receive texts and instant messages with your mind.
summary: The ability to send and receive texts and instant messages with your mind.
strengths: You'll never get in trouble for texting when you aren't supposed to (they won't know)
No need to try and push all those little buttons
No need to constantly check or charge up your phone
weaknesses: You can't instantly make calls. You still need a phone of some sort for that.

name: Myth Power: Aphrodisia
description: Aphrodite, in Greek myth, was the goddess of love, beauty, romance and sexual attraction. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically change one's appearance and voice, at will to match nearly ANYONE'S idea of beauty (including one's own). In addition, one can psychically induce sexual attraction or arousal in anyone of one's sexual preference, by touch, word or thought. One can even psychically perceive how to please any sexual partner they take, and charm nearly anyone, to get one's way.
summary: The ability to channel Aphrodite's command over the essence of love, beauty, romance and sexual attraction
strengths: Psychically change one's voice and appearance to match nearly anyone's idea of physical beauty
Psychically induce sexual attraction and/or sexual arousal by touch, word or thought
Psychically perceive how to please any sexual partner, or charm nearly any subject to get one's way
weaknesses: Cannot enhance or disrupt/negate/withstand love/romance/sex-based abilities until developed (NCN)
Cannot blow a kiss to psychically stun foes, and seduce them over a distance, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Oath of Ouranos, MythPower: Sophrosyne's Solace, etc provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Aether's Experience
description: Aether (Aither, Ether), in Greek myth, was the god of the bright, glowing upper air of heaven; divine essence, which the gods themselves were said to breathe (Ether or Quintessence, the pure essence of energy). As such, channeling him allows one to psychically generate and manipulate ether at will. In addition, one can psychically harness ether to enhance the physical stats of oneself and others with divine powers. One can even psychically perceive and communicate with MythPower users at will.
summary: The ability to channel Aether's command over the essence of the bright, glowing upper air of heaven
strengths: Generate and manipulate ether/quintessence/divine essence at will (may be used to harm or heal)
Harness either to enhance physical stats of self and others with divine abilities, etc
Gain power to fly, defy gravity, rapidly regenerate and psychically perceive MythPower users
weaknesses: Cannot turn into a form composed of ether (able to survive in space, etc) until developed (NCN)
Cannot impart ether (bestow others resistance to divine attacks) until developed  (NCN)
Cannot use ether/quintessence/divine essence to disrupt divine powers until developed (NCN)

name: The Ring
description: Alone, this power will cause an enemy mental harm by gesturing at them. The mental harm will make them feel like they have the worst hangover ever and 100 people are yelling at them simultaneously. If you also have The Crown, The Scepter, and The Mantle, then you can use this power's effect without gesturing just thinking about it.
summary: The ability to cause enemies mental harm by gesturing
strengths: Really cruel method of torture.
Like the rest of this series no need for any objects or artifacts to use this power.
weaknesses: Easy to get caught if you don't have The Crown and The Scepter.

name: Myth Power: Horae (Hours04)
description: These Horae (Horai, Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of the hours of the day. As such, channeling Gymnastica (Gymnastika, Gymnasia- Exercise Hour), one can psychically perceive the passage of time, at will. In addition, one can withstand temporal effects. Furthermore, one can psychically regenerate, and gain physical power, when one exercises. One can also psychically access peak condition. One can even psychically learn any physically possible feat, by observing it done once, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Horae and their command over the essence of the hours of the day
strengths: Psychically perceive the passage of time, at will; withstand temporal effects
Psychically regenerate and gain physical power when one works out, or practices athletics/sports
Psychically access peak physical condition; perform any physically possible feat, by observing once
weaknesses: Cannot psychically access Multi-Jump (Double Jump, Triple, etc), until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically access Body Supremacy and Precognitive Reflexes, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically summon projections of famous athletes, for psychic insight, until developed (NCN)

name: The World Within The Mind
description: There is a world within the mind of a host. The beings vary from living sentients to mindless monsters depending on the host. Much like the existence of the beings existing on the host, the powers of the host depend on the abilities of the beings. Unfortunately, just thinking of an all-powerful being doesn't make the host all-powerful. The beings are manifestations of the characteristics of the host.
summary: The ability to host an entire civilization within one's mind
strengths: It's the equivalent to being a God
You are the world in a sense
You are connected to the people of your mind
weaknesses: It's much like schizophrenia: Whose thoughts are whose?
When a being dies, the host can feel it; When the host dies, so does the civilization
Unfortunately, you have no powers if the people in your mind do not

name: Enhancement: Healing (M)
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. While attached, it changes the effect of the power to cause it to heal minds instead of the original effect. Can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to change the effect of a power to healing minds
strengths: Easy to do mass healings with Omni-Directional Blast.
Destructive powers can now have a second use.
A cure for insanity!!!
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
A fireball that heals might be a little odd.

name: Swords Of Aging
description: The swords cause whatever they touch to age 1,000,000,000 times faster than normal for one second. However, they only age whatever is in a close range to what they touch. Ex. If your hand is touched, only that will age rapidly. The user of this power can only have five swords out at a time. Aging the mind or brain however does not bestow increased intelligence by the way.
summary: The ability to create swords made of light that rapidly age whatever they touch
strengths: Age your enemies so that it's harder for them to move.
1,000,000,000 secs is approximately equal to 31 years, 8 months, 15 days 14 hours and 24 minutes.
Each cut makes it harder to dodge the next cut.
weaknesses: Those with powers that prevent aging can fully negate this power's effects on those they can affect.

name: Eye Projector
description: This power only works with absolute concentration. It can be used as an illusion to fool enemys and it helps when having flashbacks that are a little blurry. You have to let this power recharge itself for 5 minutes after use.
summary: The ability to project thougths through eyes like a movie
strengths: You can project maps and globes from your eyes
Using it as a decoy to trick enemys is a good strategy
Can be used like a flashlight
weaknesses: This power can cause short term memory loss
Using this power takes away your field of vision while in use
This power doesn't work in direct sunlight

name: Panontic Arch: Baroth
description: The Baroth dimension of false heroes. You gain two powers. First, the power to deceive anyone using empathy, mind reading, prediction, past detection, lie detection, body language reading or an alignment detection power on you. Second, you gain the power to not suffer any super powered consequences if you break an oath, promise, deal or pledge. Someone with a prediction power or body reading ability has to see you for you to give him a false impression.
summary: The ability to gain powers from the Baroth dimension.
strengths: Be evil as you want and be sensed as the nicest guy on the planet.
Be good as you want and fool a good-detecting super villain.
weaknesses: Your 'goodness' or 'evilness' in some situations will be difficult to explain.
You still suffer non-superpowered consequences by breaking a promise.

name: Oath Of Light
description: This power allows you to have a mind at peace with itself, without stress or worry. It also allows you to know subconsiously how to fix a bad, tense, or awkward situation. You can also bestow a mind at peace upon others. However, there is a price. You cannot kill a living creature, or act self-servingly in any way. This means that doing things like walking over grass very awkward, as you would not physically be able to step on a bug.
summary: The ability to have true happiness and bestow it upon others, at a price.
strengths: You will be truly happy.
People will automatically like you.
You will be safe from depression.
weaknesses: You cannot act even remotely self-servingly.
You cannot kill, so there are many jobs you will be unable to do.
You won't be much good in a fight, unless you have extremely strong willpower.

name: Empathetic Olfaction
description: Ever go into a room after a fight & you can sense strong emotions you can almost cut it with a knife. Well, you can't with this power, but you CAN smell it. Emotions take on an indescribable smell & they surround the person much like an aura. Different emotions emit different smells from pleasant like happy to foul odors like sad or angry. So strong you can almost taste it & if strong enough you could decipher & read a thought possibly.
summary: The ability to psychically smell a person's emotions & thoughts
strengths: Smell emotions & maybe be able to read some thoughts
weaknesses: Has to be a very strong emotion smell to read thoughts but may not always work
Psychopaths are hard to smell

name: Induce Apathy
description: Makes anyone in your sightlines (as in you can see them or could see them if you turned around) and range (defined here as the range at which you can make out their facial features) feel apathetic to everything. For example, you could murder someone in front of a loved one and they wouldn't care. In fact, you could murder anyone around you and they would not fight back.
summary: The ability to make those around you cease to care about anything.
strengths: Free to live your life as you like (criminally if you wish) unobstructed.
Avoid arguments and tricky social situations.
Undefeatable at any short-mid range form of combat.
weaknesses: Impossible to have face-to-face social contact with people.
Any instance of you having sex is debatably rape.
Any long range weapons such as Sniper Rifles are just as effective on you as normal people.

name: Myth Power: Horae (Growth3)
description: These Horae (Horai- Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of plant growth. As such, channeling Thallo (Buds, Shoots, Blooming) allows one to psychically perceive reduce plants to harmless green buds/shoots/blooms, at will. In addition, one can cause plants to produce weaponized buds/shoots/blooms (explosive, poison, acid etc) at will. Furthermore, one can grow buds/shoots/blooms from one's body, at will. One can even psychically loosen inhibitions, causing emotions to 'bloom', by touch.
summary: The ability to channel the Horae and their command over the essence of plant growth and production
strengths: Psychically reduce plants to harmless green buds/shoots/blooms, and at will
Psychically weaponize plants' buds/shoots/blooms, and produce buds from one's own body, at will
Psychically loosen inhibitions, causing emotions to heighten to 'full bloom', by touch
weaknesses: Cannot psychically communicate and eavesdrop through flower blooms, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically cause buds to bloom into magical flowers (lotus, moly, etc) until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Demeter's Touch and MythPower: Gaia's Gift provide immunity and negation (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Epimetheus' Idea
description: Epimetheus (Epimetheos), in Greek myth, was the Titan god of afterthought, or retrospect reflection. As such, channeling him allows one to reduce and distract meticulous thought and concentration in others (making subjects less capable of formulating a coherent plan, and more likely to make terrible decisions). In addition, one may perceive a subject's past regrets by touch, word or thought. One may even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those who are naturally flighty thinkers.
summary: The ability to channel Epimetheus' command over the essence of afterthought
strengths: Reduce and scatter otherwise meticulous thought (foes become unable to function effectively)
Psychically perceive a subject's past regrets by touch, word or thought
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel naturally flighty thinkers
weaknesses: People with mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory based MythPowers are immune to this ability
People with MythPower: Iapetos' Scorn are immune to this ability
At the lower levels, this ability may affect one's personality

name: Will Breaking: Deadlock
description: This ability may prove to be useful when you are up against extremely powerful opponents who seem to resist all types of manipulative abilities. By projecting your will directly on your target grants you of some sort of limited control on them. This limited control stems from your willpower that dwells inside your target's mind which now coexists with their freewill. In effect you can cancel out their actions by thinking of something opposite that action. Thus your opponent is rendered inactive.
summary: The ability to induce inaction resulting from the opposition of two uncompromising wills.
strengths: Can also target manipulated objects making it extremely useful against telekinetic targets.
Can be used on yourself to eliminate the effects of spirit, mental, physical, psychic manipulations.
Can be used around you to disrupt psychic and precognitive abilities.
weaknesses: Requires quick thinking and concentration.
You dont actually possess the control of your targets action; you only induce inaction.
No one completely wins in battles between two opposing free wills; it always ends with a draw.

name: Myth Power: Ioke's Onslaught
description: Ioke, in Greek myth, was the goddess of onslaught, when one side of battle is overwhelmed by another. As such, channeling her, one gains superhuman fighting and weapon prowess, and the ability to perceive a foe's moves in combat (or to predict the moves of ANYONE in radius with hostile intent). In addition, one can convert an enemy's allies into his own allies, who link minds with one for as long as the power lasts. Furthermore, one can replicate self and allies (natural or converted) at will.
summary: The ability to channel Ioke's command over the essence of onslaught, and overwhemling combat power
strengths: Gain superhuman fighting and weapon prowess (and gain a Combat Sense)
Convert an enemy's allies into one's own allies, who link minds to be perfectly in sync in combat
Replicate self and/or allies (natural or converted) at will
weaknesses: Number of replicates grows over time; only fuse self/replicates into a giant when developed (NCN)
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith and MythPower: Eris' Enmity provide immunity (NCN)
MythPower: Nike's Knowledge provides immunity (NCN)

name: Spychic
description: You have psychic abilities to move objects with your mind and read others minds. BUT only if you're spying on someone. The powers are strong but can only be activated if you're doing spywork for yourself or others.
summary: The ability to have psychic abilities as long as your spying
strengths: Be able to read minds
Be able to move objects with your mind
You could have a very fun and successful spy career!
weaknesses: This power only works if you're spying
If you don't want to be a spy, then you're out of luck

name: Myth Power: Furies' Fury
description: The Erinyes (Furies), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of divine punishment for crimes against the natural order. As such, channeling Tisiphone (Murder Retribution), one can psychically perceive and inflict curses on killers, at will. Channeling Megaera (Megaira, Megara- Grudge), one can psychically perceive and inflict curses on the jealous/envious and unfaithful, at will. Channeling Alecto (Alekto- Unceasing), one can psychically perceive and inflict curses on the wrongfully hateful, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Erinyes' command over the essence of divine punishment  and vengeance
strengths: Psychically perceive and inflict curses on murderers/killers, at will
Psychically perceive and inflict curses on the jealous, the envious and unfaithful lovers, at will
Perceive and inflict curses on the wrongfully hateful/wrathful/mean-spirited/spiteful, at will
weaknesses: Cannot summon a divine snake whip, or gain the power of winged flight, until developed (NCN)
Cannot attone criminals' crimes (so others forgive/forget them), until developed (NCN)
Law/order/justice-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Camera Mind
description: Having a camera mind would be great for all those moments when you wish you could have gotten a picture, such as a deer in the woods. To zoom, you have to get closer to whatever you're taking a picture of, and to get a sideways picture you'd have to tilt your head. Once you hit the capacity of 100 pictures, you have to transfer them to an actual camera (meaning no cell phone cameras) before they can go on the computer.
summary: The ability to take pictures with your mind
strengths: Can capture those perfect moments instantly
Doesn't matter if you forgot a camera
weaknesses: Can only store 100 pictures at a time
Need to transfer pictures to a camera and upload the pictures from there

name: Twilight Power: Anti Shield
description: This power works via physical contact with a target. With this ability the user can destroy or penetrate any Mental Shield, no matter the degree to which the shield holder has evolved it. The user can also break Physical shields after one thousand uses.
summary: The ability to penetrate or destroy shield abilities.
strengths: Shield Breaker
Works well with Tactile Thought Projection.
weaknesses: Physical shield breaking takes time.
Physical contact required.

name: Long Kiss Goodnight
description: With this power you can give any living thing the long kiss goodnight. Projected at the speed of thought, the long kiss goodnight has a range of about 8 kilometers and mentally locking target that cannot escape your deadly affections.
summary: The ability to use a blown kiss as a high caliber kinetic killshot
strengths: Direct pure linear kinetic force at the speed of thought
No misses. Victim is mentally tagged, kiss will go through anything to hit target
Headshots with the entering effect of a high caliber AP shell and the exit of a grenade
weaknesses: Must mentally tag a living being, then blow the kiss
Purely an offensive & no chance of shooting to wound, damage anything 3 meters behind target
No silencer. The effects are loud and reverberate. Just walk away no one will ever know.

name: Utopic Vision
description: Know who is stopping the creation of Utopia and who could aid it. Potentionary vision, (i.e. seeing what could be rather than what will be). See visions of acts that will lead to the birth of an idealistic world.
summary: The ability to know how to bring about Utopia
strengths: Create world peace
End all Suffering
weaknesses: May involve many crimes
Could harm your sanity

name: Gentrification
description: This quasi-magical ability temporarily transforms up to six people with little to no class (with respect to dress and behavior, not income) into well-mannered, refined, eloquent, and stylishly dressed individuals. It will not change their basic ethical makeup, i. E. A gentlemanly cad is still a cad, but it will make them classier. The duration of this transformation is roughly 24 hours divided by the number of people affected.
summary: The ability to temporarily transform people with little or no class into well-mannered and respectable persons.
strengths: Great for dressing up henchmen and hirelings to blend in to polite society.
Good for cleaning up rogues and thugs to avoid soiling one's gloves while at fisticuffs.
Good for polishing up wenches and doxies into semi-respectable ladies when tavern hopping.
weaknesses: Changes the appearance but not the substance of a person. Evil with nice manners is still evil.
All of the changes are temporary. The clothes and shoes change back when the effect ends.
This ability does not affect the person's health, but it may mask the symptoms. (Beware STDs! )

name: Sticky Fingers
description: Sticky Fingers allows anyone to get what they want, as long as it's on a physical plane, like money, jewelery, new videogames, even people. It can't get you things like respect, or something like that, more of the opposite for this one. The power automatically works by reading your mind and making whatever (physical) you want fly and stick to your hands. The problem is you steal things without purposely meaning to, and sleep stealing is an issue. So people will think you are a no good klepto.
summary: The ability to have what ever physical thing you want fly to your hands and stick to them.
strengths: You can always get what you want (as long as it's a physical thing)
It's automatic
weaknesses: People will accuse you of being a thief
It reads your subconcious(sleep stealing, getting things you want but don't want to get by stealing)

name: Myth Power: Said By Pseudologoi
description: The Pseudologoi (Pseudea), in Greek myth, were the gods and goddesses of falsehood, lying and deception. As such, channeling them allows one to tell lies so convincing that subjects automatically believe them, unless they see otherwise. In addition, one can psychically perceive lies. Furthermore, one may manipulate the brain of subjects with a touch, so that they are unable to tell lies at all, or able to ONLY tell lies. One may even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel liars.
summary: The ability to channel the Pseudologoi and their command over the essence of lying and deception
strengths: People automatically believe any lie you tell (unless they find out otherwise)
Psychically perceive lies; make foes incapable of lying, or able to ONLY tell lies, at will
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel people who are normally deceptive
weaknesses: People with MythPower: Aletheia's Absolute can perceive, withstand and disrupt this ability
At the lower levels, one may become a compulsive liar
At the lower levels, sensing lies may induce headaches or disorientation

name: Super Charge
description: With a mental "ON-OFF" switch, you can throw others' powers into hyper drive, causing them to lose all control and subconsciously destroy themselves with their own abilities. This lack of control grows more severe with a closer proximity to you.
summary: The ability to make other powers uncontrollable
strengths: Near-immunity to other powers
Targets would kill themselves, so you don't get your hands dirty
weaknesses: Targets would become time-bombs, potentially destroying everything around them
Inability to predict how this "super charge" will affect the target

name: Demonic Song
description: It's simple all you have to do is sing it effects all that can hear it so the louder the song is the more people you can control.
summary: The ability to control people who hear your song
strengths: Loud voice equals big army
it doesn't matter if you sing good or bad
karaoke is awesome
weaknesses: quiet voice equals ineffective
you could effect sombody you didn't want to effect
you may not like to sing

name: Drunk Control
description: With this power you can make any drunk person your mind slave. All you have to do is make contact with a drunk person and you will be able to take control of him until he becomes sober.
summary: The ability to control people when they are drunk
strengths: You can take over the minds of drunk people
weaknesses: If you never see a drunk person in your life this power is useless
You loose control once they become sober

name: Myth Power: Maidens' Maximum
description: The Hyperborean Maidens, in Greek myth, were the goddesses of archery. As such, channeling Opsis (Opis, Oupis, Upis- Aim), one can aim with superhuman accuracy, and can psychically disrupt aim, by touch. Channeling Loxo (Trajectory), one can psychically manipulate airborne objects' trajectory. Channeling Hekaerge (Hecaerge, Arge- Distancing), one can psychically perceive space (objects' presence, distance, speed, velocity, momentum, etc), and psychically disrupt others' spatial sense, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Hyperborean Maidens and their command over the essence of archery
strengths: Aim with Superhuman Accuracy, and psychically disrupt aim, by touch, at will
Psychically manipulate airborne objects' trajectory (Flight Manipulation) at will
Psychically perceive space, at will, and disrupt others' spatial sense, by touch, at will
weaknesses: Cannot summon indestructible bow and quiver of infinite arrows, until developed (NCN)
Cannot withstand the effects of the cold (Cold Immunity), until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Apollo's Gift and MythPower: Artemis' Gift provide immunity (NCN)

name: Primal Scream
description: Imagine the worst migraine you've ever had. Then multiply it by 70. A person with Primal Scream can induce this head-splitting pain in others with a raw, high-pitched cry. This is not particularily loud--100 decibels--but it causes mental anguish far greater than its volume. Experienced users can push the volume up to 150 decibels, which causes physical damage as well. However, it is totally fueled by emotion and drains its user of energy.
summary: The ability to produce a scream that attacks the minds of the listeners
strengths: 70 times worse than a migrane
Gets stronger the more you use it
Effective crowd control
weaknesses: Not particularily loud (100 dB)
Totally fueled by emotion
Drains user of energy

name: Power Ring Symbiosis
description: Power Ring Symbiosis turns you into a ring that retains all of your powers and force of will. The wielder must, and is compelled to give thier powers to the ring in order to use it. The wielder cannot, nor wants to remove the ring and can use all of the power within it at will. The wielder belives that they are in control, but in actuality, they are acting out your thoughts, desires and will. When the wielder dies, the ring comes off and retains the powers of itself and all previous wielders.
summary: The ability to permanently become an indestructable ring with all of your powers and force of will
strengths: Live through another and gain power each time a new host emerges.
Never truly die.
Gain the knowledge of each wielder.
weaknesses: You are a ring.
Nobody might put you on for quit a while.
Defenseless when not on a finger.

name: Rise Of The Legendary Pokemon
description: With this power you can turn into any of the legendary Pokemon even ones that have not be officially released or discovered. In Pokemon mode you retain your intelligence level, personality and ability to speak. You can stay in Pokemon form for as long as you want. Also if you turn into Manaphy, find a Ditto and give birth to a Phione it will be under your control.
summary: The ability to turn into any legendary pokemon
strengths: You have over 40 powerful forms
You retain your intelligence level, personality and ability to speak
If you give birth to a Phione by turning into Manaphy and breeding it will be under your control
weaknesses: You might be hunted by pokemon trainers
You might be hunted by pokemon collectors
The real legends might come after you

name: Streaker
description: Those with this power can cause people to streak, without anyone (except the user, people who can resist telepathy/mindcontrol/change to willpower) noticing anything wrong, with varying levels of control. Weak control can cause everyone around you to streak uncontrollably. Those with strong control can make only specific people streak, or make them only remove certain things, such as weapons, without them noticing. It is possible also to make people notice the streaker.
summary: The ability to cause people to streak.
strengths: Cause people to streak without anyone thinking its unnormal.
With strong control can make people not wear certain things, such as weapons.
Can streak yourself without worrying about breaking the law.
weaknesses: With weak control you might see people streak that you did not wish to see.
May take a lot of will power to keep people from noticing the streaking.
If you lose control and people notice the streaking you may get into trouble.

name: Death Memory Sight
description: By making physical contact with the corpse, he or she will be able to tap into the memories and thoughts of the deceased's life, but only while in contact with the corpse.
summary: The ability to see into the past of the dead
strengths: It will be easy was to find who murdered the deceased
An easy way to discover the secrets of the long dead
weaknesses: Morbid thoughts and seeing the death of the body
Can cause slight insanity if you accept the dead's memories and personality too well.

name: Myth Power: Methe's Mirth
description: Methe (Methyse, Methyne), in Greek myth, was the goddess of drunkenness. As such, channeling her allows one to withstand, as well as psychically manipulate drunkenness, at will. In addition, one can psychically elect to give in to the effects of drunkenness, at will, which improves both fighting and weapon skill. One can also psychically perceive subjects' drunken hallucinations, at will. One can even psychically realize said hallucinations, at will, so they affect foes as though they were real.
summary: The ability to channel Methe's command over the essence of drunken intoxication (drunkenness or inebriation)
strengths: Withstand, and psychically manipulate drunkenness, at will
Psychically elect to give in to effects of drunken, and it improves one's fighting and weapon skill
Psychically perceive and realize drunken hallucinations, so they can harm foes, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically summon a chalice of instantly-intoxicating wine to drink, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically cause foes to automatically share one's drunken state, until developed (NCN)
Wine/festivity-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Horae (Hours06)
description: These Horae (Horai, Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of the hours of the day. As such, channeling Mesembria (Noon Hour, Midday), one can psychically perceive the passage of time, at will. In addition, one can withstand temporal effects. Furthermore, one can psychically regenerate, and gain physical power, when noon hits. One can also psychically project one's vision to anywhere beneath the midday sun, at will. One can even psychically generate noonday heat/light, 12x stronger, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Horae and their command over the essence of the hours of the day
strengths: Psychically perceive the passage of time, at will; withstand temporal effects
Psychically regenerate and gain physical power when noon hits
Psychically project vision anywhere beneath midday sun, project noonday heat/light (x12), at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically access 'high noon' peak condition, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically teleport to any location where it is midday, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically time travel to past/future noon times, until developed (NCN)

name: Quartz Tag
description: This ability allows the user to tag an object or organism, through direct contact, with small quartz particles. The particles are psychically linked to the user and can be tracked anywhere in the world. If the quartz particles make it into the blood of a living organism they can override the effects of personal psychic canceling abilities.
summary: The ability to tag an object or organism with quartz particles that can be tracked psychically
strengths: Track any person or object
weaknesses: Requires skin contact

name: Dream Database
description: With this power whenever you touch a person you can be able to see every single dream they've had (while sleeping) throughout their entire life. Even dreams they themselves can't recall having.
summary: The ability to be able to page through all of a person's past dreams when you are in physical contact with them
strengths: You can see all of a person's dreams
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat
You might see something disturbing
Only works while touching the person

name: Primal Rage
description: Everyone has an animal in them. We just forget it. A person with Primal Rage subdues the conscious mind while simultaneously drawing our territorial animal out, causing the people around them to fight each other for space. Meaning? An instant fight to the death for 50 yards. This ability is totally voluntary and can be snapped off at any time. However, it makes your eyes glow red and targeting specific people is pretty difficult.
summary: The ability to induce uncontrollable rage in the people around you
strengths: Causes an instant fight to the death
Great distraction
Can be snapped on and off
weaknesses: Makes eyes glow red
Targeting people difficult
50-yard range

name: Spiritual Conjuration
description: When conjuring up dead spirits, you have to be near someone that is dead. When conjuring living spirits out of living people, you are in for a lifetime of servitude. The dead can turn on you, because their minds have been corrupted in the process of death.  Though it can be tiring, it's actually quite fun!
summary: The ability to conjure up spirits from the dead or the living
strengths: The living spirits completely obey you no matter what
weaknesses: The dead can sometimes turn on you
It is emotionally and mentally draining

name: Phys Men Pulse
description: "PhysMen" is a combination of the words 'physical' and 'mental', or 'mind' and 'body'. With this ability, you release a powerful two-part psychic pulse; the first part is released from the mind, and the second part is released from the body. The two combined can affect systems both mentally and physically; There is only one catch, when you use it both your mind and body will be weaken to the point that you would be tired if you were a regular person.
summary: The ability to combine your mind and body's power to discharge a psychic wave depending on one's mass.
strengths: Very powerful.
Affects mind and body.
Can elect to emit just "physical" or just "mental" or BOTH.
weaknesses: You will get tired and weak.
Your power will depend on your body mass.

name: The Evil Eye
description: The Evil Eye is the power to intimidate foes with a mean look. One with this power (usually) has a normal-looking face; however, it is in the user's power to give a glare that is so menacing that it psychically evokes the panic or fear response in the brains of foes, so that they cower at the sight of him.
summary: The ability to scare foes with a piercing stare
strengths: Scare foes (even to the point of wetting themselves or fainting)
Very inconspicuous (the eyes might glow, but that's the only sign the power is being used)
Not permanently-activated (not everybody is scared by looking the user in the eye)
weaknesses: Must make eye contact (or look at the foe at least); foes out of sight range are immune
People with the power fearlessness or aniothability are immune to this effect
Also called the "stink eye" which can get people to make fun of you.

name: Myth Power: Algos' Affliction
description: Algos (Algus) and the Algea, in Greek myth, were the gods of pain, suffering, sorrow and distress. As such, channeling Achos (Physical Pain), one can psychically induce and manipulate physical pain at will. Channeling Lupe (Mental Pain) one can psychically induce and manipulate mental pain at will. Channeling Ania (Distress, Trouble), one can psychically perceive factors that annoy, bother, trouble or distress the foe, and psychically manipulate probability to bring about said factors at will.
summary: The ability to channel Algos and the Algea's command over the essence of sadness, pain, misery, grief and suffering
strengths: Psychically induce and manipulate physical pain at will
Psychically induce and manipulate mental pain (sadness, worry, regret, trauma, etc) at will
Psychically perceive, and bring about factors which distress and trouble the foe at will
weaknesses: Cannot transfer pain or psychological trauma to/from self or others until developed (NCN)
Aniothability, Mental Immunity, etc provide immunity (NCN)
MythPower: Eris' Enmity and MythPower: Gaia's Gift provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Horae (Growth4)
description: These Horae (Horai- Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of plant growth. As such, channeling Carpo (Karpo, Damia- Ripening, Ripe Fruit) allows one to psychically summon ripe fruit, at will, as well as ripening unripened fruit, by touch. In addition, one can psychically perceive and teleport to any location with ripe fruit, at will. Furthermore, one can gain physical power by eating ripe fruit. One can even produce the aroma of ripe fruit, to attract and/or intoxicate subjects, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Horae and their command over the essence of plant growth and production
strengths: Psychically summon ripe fruit, and ripen unripe fruit, by touch, at will
Psychically perceive and teleport to anywhere with ripe fruit, at will
Gain physical power from eating ripe fruit; produce the aroma of ripe fruit to attract/intoxicate
weaknesses: Cannot turn into an immovable, indestructible divine fruit tree, at will, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically turn normal fruit into magical fruit (Golden Apples, etc) until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Demeter's Touch and MythPower: Gaia's Gift provide immunity and negation (NCN)

name: Unicity
description: This ability allows you to resist being added on to or increased. This means that you cannot be increased in size, possessed, mind controlled, forcibly psychically linked, given powers forcibly , or other things which add on to the body, mind, powers, or spirit of the person. It also prevents foreign agents from growing in or on you and can allow you to prevent any transformation that causes you to increase in some way whether physical or not. As a side affect you cannot get cancer.
summary: The ability to resist being added on to or increased.
strengths: Resist being given least wanted powers.
Cannot be possessed or mind controlled as it adds to the spirit or mind.
If you have powers to add on to yourself you are capable of doing so.
weaknesses: Does not protect against other types of damage.
Still affected by powers that reduce you.
Does not protect you from being totally destroyed.

name: Hypno Dance (Entrancing Dance)
description: Simply by dancing you can induce a trance in any person that is watching you. Clearly the person must be able to see, and must be looking at you when you begin your dance. Any interruptions before the full effect of your dance takes place will free the target unless he is foolish enough to stare at you again. That being said the skill makes excellent crowd control and through the use of video, like Youtube the possibilities are limitless. Once you stop dancing the effect fades in 20 minutes.
summary: The ability to dance in such a manner that any person watching is mesmerized.
strengths: You can compel men to do what you want.
Excellent crowd control
Get back at your ex
weaknesses: Only works for fthe opposite sex
Victims must be able to see
Physically taxing

name: Tunneling
description: Imagine a mole on steroids. On Java coffee. That is the effect that a Tunneler can achieve. By mentally displacing soil, they can burrow at speeds of up to 75 miles an hour and at depths of up to 2 miles below the surface. The user has a reduced need to breathe while under the surface and a heightened sense of touch (allowing them to "see" what is in their path). However, these bonuses only apply while Tunnelling.
summary: The ability to move quickly underground by displacing soil
strengths: Speeds of up to 75 mph
Depths of up to 2 miles
Reduced need to breathe + radar sense
weaknesses: Running into bedrock
Superhero name would suck
Enhancements only apply while tunnelling

name: Queen/King Of The Bees
description: With this power you are the king or queen of the bees meaning they do whatever you say; not to mention, you can see what they see, hear what they think, and understand bee dancing and buzzing
summary: The ability to have control of all types of bees
strengths: You can make the bees sting people  you don't like, and command them in other ways
You'll never get stung by bees again (and they'll defend you...even QUEEN bees obey you)
You get free honey (they let you reach into their hive without reacting)
weaknesses: Does not work on hornets, wasps or yellow jackets
Might make them like you too much (follow you everywhere, etc.)

name: Myth Power: Aletheia's Absolute
description: Aletheia (Alatheia, Alethea, Alathea, Alethea, Alethia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of truth, honesty and sincerity. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive lies, deception, dishonesty, untruth and insincerity at will. In addition, one can answer nearly any question they encounter with absolute truth. Furthermore, one can psychically force subjects to speak only truth, at will. One can even see through/negate illusions and shapeshifting, and restore lost memories, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Aletheia's command over the essence of truth, honesty and sincerity
strengths: Psychically perceive lies, deception (illusion, shapeshifting, etc), untruth and insincerity at will
Answer nearly any question with absolute truth; psychically force subjects to speak only truth
Psychically see past/prevent/negate illusion and shapeshifting and restore lost memories at will
weaknesses: Kinda turns you into a stickler for the truth
If you tell a lie while using this power, it short-circuits temporarily (honesty is the best policy)
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith and law/order/justice based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Mind Freak
description: Ever wondered how Criss Angel performs all his insane stunts? With this power, you can, too! This ability lets the user levitate, walk on water, make things disappear and reappear, and escape from impossible situations. You are still human, though, and can die.
summary: The ability to possess all the powers of master illusionist Criss Angel
strengths: Levitate, disappear, and other cool powers
Escape from practically anything
Be awesome in general
weaknesses: People will constantly be asking how you do it
You scare little kids

name: Mind Eraser
description: The power to erase stuff in your mind--intense traumas, irrational fears, etc.
summary: The ability to erase your own memories
strengths: Perfect for if you're watching a scary movie
Can erase your memories of clandestine activities
weaknesses: Cannot restore lost memories on your own

name: Myth Power: Soter/Soteria Says
description: Soter and Soteria, in Greek myth, were god and goddess counterparts (respectively) of safety, preservation and deliverance from harm. As such, males channel Soter; females channel Soteria. Doing so allows one to perceive impending danger for oneself and others. In addition, if one is in a dangerous situation, one may produce an aura about oneself and one's allies which prevents foes from thinking to do them harm. Similarly, dangers from inanimate objects are deflected off of this aura.
summary: The ability to channel Soter and Soteria's command over the essence of security, safety and deliverance from harm
strengths: Perceive impending danger
Produce an 'Aura of Safety' that keeps enemies from wanting to hurt you (and/or allies)
That same aura deflects harm from inanimate objects as well
weaknesses: The 'Aura of Safety' often doesn't draw people to come rescue you until the higher levels
Cannot stop or reverse time to prevent or undo harm until the higher levels
Cannot perceive the actual CAUSE of impending danger until the higher levels

name: Jli Summon V2
description: With this power you can summon any member of the Justice League International. The hero doesn't have to currently be an active member of the team, they don't even have to be living in the current comic book timeline. Also when you summon one of them they under your complete control. Unfortunately if you want to use the mind control function you can only summon one of them. If you summon two or more you lose control over them.
summary: The ability to summon any member of Justice League International
strengths: You can summon any member of the JLI
You can mind control up to one of them at a time
They don't have be an active or living member of the League
weaknesses: You can only use the mind control function if you summon only one hero

name: Empathy Switching
description: Like in The Crow or Powder, you will be able to touch someone & absorb their empathic memories like feelings of pain & tragedy & inject it into someone else. So you have a person that is in pain & dying, you take their empathy & go put it into the one who caused it. Or if someone has depressed feelings, you take a cheerful person's emotional thoughts & give it to the sad one. You do feel a little bit of the empathy you absorb & can only absorb one at a time.
summary: The ability to absorb a person's empathic memory & project it to another person
strengths: Trade emotions between people
weaknesses: You feel just some of the empathy you absorb but not as much as what you project
Can only take one empathy at a time

name: Stampede
description: You can summon any animal you want in great numbers. A worm hole opens up and releases the animals you are thinking of at the time. The worm hole opens behind you, giving you time to strike an epic pose. Also, a thought is subconsciously put in the animals' heads to run as fast as they can, avoiding you and aiming for your desired target. When they've done their job, they get taken back to their point of origin, not knowing it even happened.
summary: The ability to summon a group of any animal to trample your enemies
strengths: Can take out large groups of people
Makes for a good distraction
Useful for breaking out of cages, cells, and the like
weaknesses: The animal must exist somewere in the world at the moment (No dinosaurs)
Not usable in small rooms, for obvious reasons
Can only summon one kind of animal at a time

name: Myth Power: Pallas' Passion
description: Pallas, in Greek myth, was the Titan god of warcraft; planning and executing combat and military campaigns. As such, channeling him allows one to become a master strategist, by thinking of problems in terms of military conflict. In addition, one can psychically perceive the plans and schemes of others in proximity. Furthermore, one gains skill in every weapon and fighting style in his physical and mental capability. One can even augment or disrupt stats (strength, etc) and physical superpowers.
summary: The ability to channel Pallas command over the essence of warcraft and military campaigns
strengths: Become an expert strategist; psychically perceive plots/plans/schemes/strategies of those in radius
Gain skill in every weapon style and martial art (fighting style) in your physical/mental capacity
Augment/disrupt physical stats (strength, speed, reflexes, etc) and physical superpowers, by touch
weaknesses: Cannot augment/disrupt combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction based MythPowers until developed
People with mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory based MythPowers are immune to this ability
People with Unpredictability and MythPower: Ares' Wrath are immune to this ability (no Con Negation)

name: Dance!
description: With this power you can make anybody dance just by thinking of the person and saying "Dance! " after that the selected person will start dancing uncontrollably until you say "Stop! "
summary: The ability to make people dance uncontrollably
strengths: You can make anybody dance
You can cause your enemies to start dancing during a fight
You can make them stop by saying "Stop"
weaknesses: They can still attack you while dancing

name: Stupipathy.Telepathic Stupidity
description: It is the ability to make anyone stupid or defenseless through telepathic influence. Once used by a psychic con-man to make a lot of money and earn a living.
summary: The ability to make anyone stupid or defenseless through telepathic influence
strengths: More than normal convincing power to average intelligence people
Near mind control ability through repeated practice
Can be used to oneself as an effective disguise
weaknesses: Cannot be used in battle or life and death situations
Takes a lot of practice and creativity to be useful
Will not make you famous, only affects people at subliminal level

name: Expandable Mind
description: This power enables a person to extend their mind into the psychic realm that is the Astral Plane. This allows them to handle and store much more information than normal. It can be used in unison with other powers, like telepathy, to flash memorize vast amounts of data. Also it could allow a clairvoyant to use multiple view points with less disorientation by reducing the mental load on the brain. The downside to this is that your extended mind is open to attacks on the astral plane.
summary: The ability to expand one's mind into the astral plane.
strengths: Allows for increased intelligence, memory and mental agility.
Can be used to temporarily store information to complex to normally process.
Works well with other psychic powers.
weaknesses: Leaves one vulnerable to psychic attack on the astral plane.
Makes a very visible "Cloud" of psychic energy on the astral plane.

name: Myth Power: Phales' Philander
description: Phales, in Greek myth, was the god of the phallus (male sex organ), adultery, rape, pederasty and other male sexual indecency (like exposing genitalia). As such, channeling him allows one to assume the form of any male humanoid at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive and communicate with males of any species (and compel females) at will. One may even psychically absorb power (including sexual virility) from males by a touch; this same touch induces sexual pleasure in females.
summary: The ability to channel Phales' command over the essence of the phallus, adultery, rape and pederasty
strengths: Assume the form of anymale humanoid at will (regardless of one's true gender)
Psychically perceive and communicate with males (and compel females)
Touch males to absorb power (and enhance male attributes); touch females to induce sexual pleasure
weaknesses: Cannot assume the form of male animals (besides humanoids) until developed (NCN)
Cannot use phallus as divining rod (locating/navigation, detecting lies, etc) until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Bacchanalia and MythPower: Baubo's Burlesque provide immunity (NCN)

name: Selective Recall
description: A person with this power has the power to hide knowledge or memories from himself until a certain time period or until he says a certain code word. This power also allows someone to have more memory than an average person to cope with stored memories. When activated, this power has a sort of pseudoamnesia effect where the person has absolutely no idea what they are doing. However, they can still remember new bits of information while they are in the amnesiac state.
summary: The ability to have memories that are only available when the user decides to access it
strengths: You can hide the truth and lie without any repercussions
You make a great spy-I dont know anything and you would be half right
Forget painful memories unless you needed to recall it
weaknesses: Sudden rush of old information can shock you, you may have switched sides previously, etc.
This only affects your memory so you will still look the same
If the code word is lost or you are killed before the time to recall is possible

name: Myth Power: Thanatos' Threat
description: Thanatos (Thanatus), in Greek myth, was the god of peaceful, non-violent, painless death. As such, channeling him allows one to perceive painless death in one's range, at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel the undead (ghosts/spirits, zombies, etc) of those who died painlessly. Furthermore, by a paralyzing touch, one may induce simultaneous shutdown in all of a subject's organ systems. One can even withstand death/underworld/afterlife-based effects.
summary: The ability to channel Thanatos' command over the essence of peaceful, painless, non-violent death
strengths: Psychically perceive past, present and future non-violent death in one's range at will
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel undead who died non-violent deaths
Induce instantaneous (painless) death, by touch; withstand necromantic effects
weaknesses: Cannot generate wings to fly until the higher levels
Cannot summon an indestructible scythe (similar to Thanatos' Scythe) until the higher levels (NCN)
Death/underworld/afterlife-based MythPowers (and Immortality) provide immunity (NCN)

name: False Cognition
description: Also called Psychic Sleepwalking, Hypnagogic/Sleepwalker Automatism or (Psychic) Somnambulance, this ability allows you to undergo a hypnagogic trance, like a psychic autopilot command. This allows the conscious mind to rest, so your body can heal and recover, without having to stop for rest. In this trance, one can respond to one's environment as though still awake (though, whether the eyes are open or not depends on the user).
summary: The ability to act under a hypnagogic trance in which no true cognition takes place
strengths: Get sleep without having to stop (subconscious knows your needs/desires/routines and can direct you)
Immune to mental tampering in the trance state (no true cognition, just impulse and instinct)
If your eyes aren't open in the trance state, your power is often accompanied by a Spatial Sense
weaknesses: If subconscious desires are harmful and take you somewhere you didn't want or need to go
If your eyes aren't open in this state, and you have no Spatial Sense
No dreaming in this state (though this can also be good as it protects you from dream manipulation)

name: Myth Power: Ctesios' Title
description: Ctesios (Ctesius, Ktesios), in Greek myth, was the god of the house/home and property. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive and teleport to one's home at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive and communicate with members of one's household, as well as psychically compel visitors to one's home, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically fortify one's home as an invulnerable fortress, at will. One can even psychically summon and manipulate one's property, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Ctesios' command over the essence of the house, the home and property
strengths: Psychically perceive and teleport to one's home at will
Psychically perceive and communicate with household members, and compel visitors, at will
Psychically fortify one's home, at will; Psychically summon and manipulate one's property, at will
weaknesses: Cannot apply Pro #1 and Pro #3 to allies and foes, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically manipulate one's home (or bend reality within it) at will, until developed (NCN)
Home/family/domestic-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Arcana: 7 The Chariot
description: This power is difficult to control. It automatically attempts to destroy anything you view as an "obstacle". It'll smash walls, send people flying, and flatten cars. Anything that gets in your way is going to be at least damaged, if not destroyed outright. This power only works if you have a particular goal in mind, and something is getting in the way of it. Non-physical things that get in your way will make this power demolish things in the general area. The key to this power is control.
summary: The ability to passively telekinetically demolish any and all obstacles.
strengths: At times, you can be about as easy to stop as the Juggernaut.
You can go from point A to point B and heaven help what gets in your way.
Gains power with emotions.
weaknesses: Without control you'll LITERALLY leave a trail of destruction behind you.
A non-physical obstacle will make this power go berserk and destroy everything in the general area.

name: Myth Power: Themis' Decree
description: Themis, in Greek myth, was the Titan goddess of divine law and order; traditions of good conduct, and other divine decrees, as passed down by the gods. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive the laws, customs and traditions of any land at will; in addition, one can sense defiance of said law (true crimes and immoral acts). Furthermore, one can compel subjects to do anything in their physical/mental capacity, as long as it is legal. One can even receive and bestow divine oracular insight.
summary: The ability to channel Themis' command over the essence of divine law and order
strengths: Perceive the essence of law and order (laws/customs/traditions) and defiances of law
Psychically compel people to do anything in mental/physical capacity, as long as it isn't illegal
Receive (at will) and bestow (by touch, word or thought) divine oracular revelations
weaknesses: Cannot enhance or disrupt/negate law/order/justice based MythPowers until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot erase illegal/unlawful thoughts from others' minds by touch until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith provides immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Tychon's Hand
description: Tychon (Tykhon), in Greek myth, was the god of opportunity, chance and accident. As such, channeling him gifts one with the ability to perceive, manipulate and benefit from the same. This means one becomes a genius at calculating and understanding probability; one can tell when the "right time" is to make any move; one can tell when a decision is a good or bad idea; and if they allow their intuition to lead them, they will find fortune constantly.
summary: The ability to channel Tychon's power over the forces opportunity, chance and accident
strengths: Your feelings can lead you to the right decisions making you seem almost psychic
Become a genius at stochastic sabotage (tossing a rock out a window leads to your foe's murder)
Tell if an idea is a good one or not
weaknesses: Cannot apply powers from Pro #3 to oneself until the HIGHEST levels (no Con Negation)
People with probability/chance/luck based MythPowers and Unpredictability are immune to this ability
People with Luck Reversal can disrupt this ability, until it is developed

name: Myth Power: Panacea's Patience
description: Panacea (Panaceia, Panakea, Panakeia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of cures, remedies, antidotes and panaceas. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive how to mix cures, remedies, antidotes and antivenin at will (ingredients, where to find them and how to prepare them). Furthermore, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and share senses with the ill and injured. One can even psychically transfer healing abilities, by touch, to and from oneself and others, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Panacea's command over the essence of cures, remedies, antidotes and panaceas
strengths: Psychically access knowledge and skill in finding and preparing any cure/remedy/antidote/antivenin
Psychically perceive, communicate with and share senses with those in need of healing
Psychically transfer regeneration/healing abilities to/from oneself/others, by touch
weaknesses: Cannot cure harm (illness and injury) of  self at will (others by touch), until developed (NCN)
Cannot turn medicines to/from poisons and other dangerous substances, at will, until developed (NCN)
