Medical/healing/restorative MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Hesychia's Hush
description: Hesychia (Hesykhia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of quiet, rest and tranquility. As such, channeling her allows one to calm subjects with a touch, a word or a thought; this even works on Berserker Rage, and similar angered/frenzied mental states. In addition, with prolonged contact, one can even lull a subject into peaceful sleep. The user may even manipulate probability to prevent any events that disrupt the user (or subjects) from restful ease, quiet relaxation and peaceful harmony.
summary: The ability to channel Hesychia's command over the essence of quiet, rest, silence and stillness
strengths: Induce calm and tranquility in any subject (including oneself); quell Berserker Rage, and the like
If contact is prolonged, subjects can even be lulled into peaceful slumber
Manipulate probability to prevent disruption of peace, tranquility and rest
weaknesses: Cannot PREVENT Berserker Rage or other angry mental states until the higher levels (NCN)
Only psychically induce temporal/molecular stasis (stillness) in matter at the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Dike's Decision provides immunity (NCN)

name: Healer 5: Genetic Purification
description: With this power, you project a field with a diameter of 25 kilometers around yourself. When an unborn child is within this range, all genetic disorders or at least the negative aspects are removed. As a side effect, you establish genetic-based telepathic link with them you can use for things like communication, spirit transference/reincarnation (with powers) and sharing senses. This power can be switched off at will and the range of the ability increases at one meter each year.
summary: The ability to remove genetic disorders from unborn children and establish a link.
strengths: Range of 25 kilometers, increase by one meter each year of possession. Can be turned off at will.
Instant and permanent.
You gain a telepathic link which can be used by other powers for even more purposes.
weaknesses: You will need another power to cure genetic disorders in anyone else.
Limited range.
Unlike other healing powers, this cannot heal wounds or other ailments.

name: Witch Species: Fair Folk
description: The fair folk could do many things including teleportation, creating illusions, and thousands of other magical abilities. Originally called faeries these beings are some or the most powerful, albeit odd looking witch species around
summary: The ability to have all of the powers of the fair folk
strengths: You are probably the most powerful thing out there
You are the king (or queen) of practical jokes
You get to travel between this world and the true world of magic
weaknesses: Your, oh about anywhere from three inches to about 3 feet tall

name: Shadow Lugia
description: At will, you can become the 'Shadow' form of the Pokemon Lugia. You can communicate with telepathy and also control other's perceptions of reality, implant/erase thoughts, and also read and control minds, all exactly like Matt Parkman. You also have extremely powerful regenerative capabilities, and can heal others regardless of injury or ailment severity. You also have hydrokinesis like Percy Jackson from 'The Lightning Thief', and vector telekinesis like Sylar from 'Heroes'.
summary: The ability to transform at will into the 'shadow' form of Lugia with near-limitless power
strengths: This is a very versatile, and cool, power to have!
Both your hydrokinesis, and the Lugia's song, can heal and strengthen both yourself and others
Your greatest weapon is your mind and despite being a Shadow Lugia, you are not evil!!
weaknesses: Harnessing your powers will take time
Psychic static from your telepathy can give you headaches when learning to control the power

name: Enhancement: Unblockable
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the power ignore all barriers. This power can only be attached to powers that do no harm to the target. Ex: works on "Mind Reading" but not "Mind Control". This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced so long as the power does no harm to any being.
summary: The ability to make a non-damaging power unblockable
strengths: Harmless powers unblockable.
Scanning powers don't have to worry about walls or barriers that are in the way
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Only usable on harmless powers.
Con negation and similar powers have no effect. No altering in RPs or discussions to get rid of cons

name: Special Memory Manipulation
description: With this superpower, you can instantly erase any embarrassing situation from your memory. For example, suppose you made a fool of yourself at a party and your mates keep reminding you about it. Well, now you won't have any idea what they're talking about. Ah, blissful ignorance.
summary: The ability to forget any embarrassing situations you might have experienced.
strengths: Forget all embarrassing moments.
Remain blissfully ignorant of your embarrassing mistakes.
Feel better about yourself.
weaknesses: Once you erase a memory, you can't get it back.
You might not learn from your mistakes if you keep erasing them.
You might start to think you're perfect.

name: Mini Me
description: You can create a 2-inch chibi version of yourself that follows your orders but also has a slightly different personality than its creator. Ex. The Mini-Me could be more spunky, flirtatious, etc. The Mini-Me will be three heads tall, in other words its head is 1/3 of its total height and also looks cuter than its creator. You can communicate with the Mini-Me telepathically and also verbally. This power can only be gained by using Telepathy at the same time you use Astral Projection.
summary: The ability to create a 2-inch chibi version of oneself
strengths: Carry him/her around in your pocket as a companion.
Instant servant!
The Mini-Me likes anyone you like and hates anyone you hate.
weaknesses: Only one way to gain this power.
The Mini-Me's strength is in proportion to how small it is in comparison to its creator.
You will know when you gain this power because you will faint.

name: The  Less Power
description: You have the ability to less-in yourself in some way. Ex. Shadowless or ageless; also death, time, fear, sound, emotion, color, life, power, change or sin; any trait that make sense with a -less added to it. You can't choose boundless or limitless and be omni-powerful. You can only reduce yourself in one trait but can change it at will. Becoming mindless, lifeless or powerless for example would require secondary powers to restore yourself.
summary: The ability to reduce yourself in some way.
strengths: Become translucent and hard to see.
Live longer.
Protect yourself from shadow control powers.
weaknesses: Secondary powers are required to recover certain traits.

name: Myth Power: Nomos' Nomination
description: Nomos (Nomus), in Greek myth, was the god of rules, law, ordinances and statutes. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically inscribe rules on subjects; subjects will follow their inscribed rule without question, and act with hostility toward those who don't. In addition, one can psychically summon (and recall every word of) a book with every rule and/or law in existence, at will. Furthermore, one may point to a rule in the Rule Book, and perceive/teleport to any place said rule applies.
summary: The ability to channel Nomos' command over the essence of rules, law, ordinance and statutes
strengths: Psychically inscribe rules on subjects that serve as psychic compulsions
Psychically summon a Rule Book with every rule/law in existence; check for rule/law loopholes, etc.
Point to a rule in the Rule Book and teleport self/others to anywhere said rule applies
weaknesses: Rule-compulsions must not contradict one another, or both are negated (NCN)
Only inscribe subjects with one rule at a time until developed; no direct inscription of death (NCN)
Law/order/justice-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Epiphron's Appeal
description: Epiphron, in Greek myth, was the god of prudence, carefulness, shrewdness, thoughtfulness and caution. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive nearly any significant events in subjects' lives, so they can prepare for them. In addition, one's luck increases when one takes time to practice, prepare and plan ahead carefully. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive and communicate with careful, meticulous people at will. One may even psychically compel rash and reckless people.
summary: The ability to channel Epiphron's command over the essence of prudence, carefulness and caution
strengths: Psychically perceive especially significant events in the lives of others at will (by touch)
Gain better and better luck the longer one takes time to practice, prepare and plan ahead
Psychically perceive and communicate with cautious, prudent people; compel reckless people
weaknesses: Cannot perceive especially significant events in one's own life until the higher levels (NCN)
Probability/chance/luck based-MythPowers and Unpredictability provide immunity (NCN)
Mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Muses' Message4
description: The Muses (Mousai, Mousae, Musae), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of knowledge, sciences, the arts and inspiration. As such, channeling Euterpe (Lyric Poetry) allows one to psychically access knowledge of all lyrical works, at will. In addition, one can psychically generate and manipulate rhythm and tempo, by touch and/or proximity, at will. One can also psychically convert objects into other objects with rhyming names, at will. One can even psychically compel subjects, by rhyming, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Muses' command over the essence of knowledge, inspiration and art
strengths: Psychically access knowledge of lyrical works, at will
Psychically generate and manipulate rhythm/tempo, by touch or proximity, at will
Psychically convert objects into rhyming objects; compel subject, by rhyming, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically disrupt creativity (or negate ideas), by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive subject's ideas until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Apollo's Gift may cause bossy attitude toward the user (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Amechania's Aim
description: Amechania (Amekhania), in Greek myth, was the goddess of weakness, helplessness, defenselessness, incompetence and incapability. As such, channeling her allows one to turn a subject entirely intangible, inaudible, etc by touch; others can touch the subject if they desire, but if he tries to touch anything, he phases through it. In addition, one can psychically weaken subjects by touch; the longer the contact, the physically weaker they get. One can even withstand any of the foe's abilities.
summary: The ability to channel Amechania's command over the essence of helplessness, powerlessness and weakness
strengths: Turn foe helplessly intangible (can be touched, but can't touch anything) and inaudible (can't talk)
Physically weaken subjects by touch (the longer the contact, the weaker they get)
None of the foe's powers directly work on the user (even powers like Superstrength)
weaknesses: Can still be harmed indirectly by the foe; Pro #2's effects are only temporary (NCN)
Cannot transfer strength/stamina/durability from one subject to another until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Penia's Penalty and Ptocheia's Talent provide immunity (NCN)

name: Fourth Wall Creation
description: If you hate poor acting, then this is the power for you! With fourth wall creation, you can litterally turn the old theater device into a barrier between the set and the audience. All you have to do is make a stage, give everyone scripts, and create the wall. BOOM! Everyone with a part becomes their character: with all the personality, memories, and abilities that come with it. While there is no physical wall, the "fourth wall" appears as a real wall to the actors in their minds.
summary: The ability to create a fourth wall around any stage/set, trapping the actors in their parts.
strengths: You can make acting more realistic and make tons of cash.
If you want, make your own dream world by getting your friends to do a play you wrote.
You're imune to the the power, so you won't get sucked in.
weaknesses: Since the wall is not physical, the actors could fall off if they tried to walk through it.
No one will remember what happened behind the wall but you.
If you don't remember to turn the wall off, you'll have a bunch of crazy people.

name: Kinesis Ii: The Healer
description: Anyone, anything on the planet can be healed by you. All you need is to see them. Even if they are on TV, as long as you see them you could heal them in an instantaneous rush. You see them, you establish a empathetic link to them, feeling what they feel, you heal them in the blink of an eye.
summary: The ability to remotely heal any living creature
strengths: Heal people around the world from the comfort of your own home
You could walk through hospitals and heal everyone anonymously
You could heal yourself by looking at your own reflection
weaknesses: Finding something to reflect yourself for your own healings
Someone may find out you're healing folks and then the "savior" talk will begin
Seeing someone hurt and not healing them will cause you pain until you heal them

name: Psychopomp Interference
description: Everytime someone is about to die, a strange formless creature appears and waits for the right moment to extract the soul of the deceased. Their true intents are still uncertain, but some people believe they guide souls to the afterlife and others say it is Death itself. While they are usually imperceptible to living beings, this power allows you to see them and actually affect them. So, you can prevent them from taking a new soul by fighting them away, albeit temporarily.
summary: The ability to perceive and interfere with the work of soul carriers.
strengths: Prevent someone's death.
Get a chance to prevent your own death.
weaknesses: The dying person may continue to suffer horribly.
When the moment comes, you will realize you're about to die soon.

name: Lara Fabian'd
description: When you activate this power, out of nowhere the chorus of Lara Fabian's song "Je T'aime" will play at a very high volume and in a loop. You are of course immune to the potentially psychologically-damaging experience. If you want someone to keep hearing this song over and over, you need to follow that person while keeping this power activated. Even if they pluck their ears with their fingers, the song is loud enough to still be heard.
summary: The ability to psychologically torture people by loop-playing the chorus of Lara Fabian's "Je T'aime".
strengths: Drive people crazy by loop-playing the intense chorus of this arguably beautiful song.
You can safely listen to this song.
weaknesses: The chorus will only be clearly heard in your surrounding as the epicenter of the song is you.
People can still get away from you to avoid hearing it.
Lara Fabian's fans are immune to this power.
tags: was edited as it was too similar to another power

name: Power Apprentice
description: This ability allows create an apprentice out anyone with 10% of their powers or less. The reverse is true for finding a master. The master can control the apprentice and use their senses, while the apprentice can resurrect, has boosted powers and masters his powers more quickly. Both parties must agree to this and may break it off at any time (in the case of the apprentice, even while being controlled). Each party can telepathically communicate with the other.
summary: The ability to make an apprentice with anyone with 10% of your powers or less.
strengths: The master gains an assistant and spy.
The apprentice can master his/her powers more quickly, has them boosted and will resurrect.
Either party can communicate telepathically.
weaknesses: Only one master or apprentice per person (although your master may have a master and vice versa).
Powers such as Con Negation cannot be used on this.
The connection can be broken at will by either individual or by the master's death.

name: Myth Power: Oknos' Activity
description: Oknos (Ocnos, Ocnus), in Greek myth, was the god of hesitation, delay, procrastination, futile effort and (somewhat) sloth. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically impose mental hindrance, to make foes hesitant, lazy or indecisive, with eye contact. In addition, one can psychically amplify delay to its peak, to temporarily immobilize foes, by touch. One can even psychically remove mental delay, so speed, reflexes and cognition of self/others reach peak potential capacity, by touch.
summary: The ability to channel Oknos' command over the essence of hesitation, delay, procrastination and sloth
strengths: Psychically make foes lazy, hesitant and indecisive (including delayed power use), with eye contact
Psychically immobilize foes temporarily, by touch
Psychically amplify speed, reflexes and cognition to peak mental/physical capacity, by touch
weaknesses: Cannot psychically induce delay between cause and effect (Hysteresis) until developed (NCN)
Cannot delay subjects' sight (Optic Delay), reflexes, etc, until developed (NCN)
Mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Nevermore
description: You could possess the power to bestow bad luck among villains. By a combination of simple empathic gestures and mental concentration, you can create a raven (which is a sign of sorrow) that'll cause extreme misfortunes and eternal death to your foes from your own dark energy, can manipulate reality, and essentially can have any abilities needed to accomplish your goal of vengeance.
summary: The ability to cause worst things happen to evildoers.
strengths: It'll be fun to watch your enemies to suffer in agony or misery.
weaknesses: However, once those goals are met, you'll lose this powers and your existence in the real world.

name: Myth Power: Hearken To Hybris
description: Hybris (Hubris), in Greek myth, was the goddess of insolence, excessive pride, outrage, outrageous behavior and violence. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically impose admiration on neutrals in one's vicinity, so they think highly of the user. In addition, the angrier one gets, the easier objects become to break in his vicinity; one's insults inflict literal physical pain. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel the proud, the violent and the eccentric.
summary: The ability to channel Hybris' command over the essence of insolence, arrogance, outrage and violence
strengths: Psychically cause neutrals in radius to think highly of you; insults inflict literal physical pain
When angered, objects in one's vicinity become easier to break
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel pompous/conceited, eccentric and violent people
weaknesses: Cannot use injury to inflict injury, or reduce a subject in size until the higher levels (NCN)
Effect of insults depends on how much an insult hurts the subject (NCN)
MythPowers based on Nyx or her children provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Plane's Plight
description: Plane, in Greek myth, was the goddess of errors, flaws and mistakes. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive flaws in truth, logic, strategy, structure, etc. In addition, one can psychically reveal said flaws to others (reveal physical flaws by touch; reveal immaterial flaws by word/thought). When immaterial flaws are exposed, they can be exaggerated to deal MENTAL pain/injury/damage. When physical flaws are exposed, they can be exaggerated to deal PHYSICAL pain/injury/damage.
summary: The ability to channel Plane's command over the essence of error, wrongness and failure
strengths: Perceive errors of all kinds (structure, grammar, logic, strategy, procedure, etc) at will
Exaggerate physical errors/flaws (cracks, scrapes, scars, etc) to deal physical pain/injury/damage
Exaggerate immaterial errors/flaws (grammar, lies, logic, etc) to deal mental damage
weaknesses: Cannot induce erroneous choices or erroneous behavior/clumsiness until the higher levels (NCN)
Flaw Exaggeration must develop with time; NEVER exaggerate error/mistakes YOU cause (NCN)
People with MythPower: Momos' Mockery are immune to this ability (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Phoebe's Phenomenon
description: Phoebe (Phoibe), in Greek myth, was the Titan goddess of bright intellect and prophecy. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive the past, present and future. In addition, one can psychically manipulate subjects' extrasensory powers, by touch, at will. One can also psychically absorb ambient light to increase one's intelligence and extrasensory powers, at will. One can even psychically project the feeling of being blinded/burned by intense light into subjects' minds, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Phoebe's command over the essence of bright intellect and prophecy
strengths: Psychically perceive past/present/future; manipulate subjects' extrasensory power, by touch, at will
Psychically absorb light to temporarily increase one's intelligence and extrasensory powers, at will
Psychically project sensation of being blinded/burned by intense light into subjects' minds, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically project light to extend range for Part 2 of Pro #1, until developed (NCN)
Effects of Pro #2 and Part 2 of pro #1 only last while power is active (NCN)
MythPower: Leto's Grace, Apollo's Appeal and Artemis' Art provide immunity (NCN)

name: Hell Bent
description: Have you ever heard the term Hell Bent on something? Well this power can motivate people to do things in you want them to do, and when you do it they won't stop until they die or succeed. This is what it means by being Hell Bent.
summary: The ability to make people Hell Bent.
strengths: Make people do your will.
They won't stop ever.
weaknesses: They might die.

name: Myth Power: Hemera's Daybreak
description: Hemera, in Greek myth, was the primeval goddess of daytime; daybreak and the daytime sky. As such, channeling her gifts one with Ultraviolet Vision to see better at day. In addition, one can perceive any location in the world where it is daytime, and the activities of any creatures in said locations. Furthermore, one can travel to and from any location where it is daytime, at will. One can even withstand light-based attacks and psychically disrupt shadow/darkness-based attacks at will.
summary: The ability to channel Hemera's command over the essence of daylight and the daytime sky
strengths: Gain Ultraviolet Vision to see better during the day
Psychically perceive any location where it is day (and creatures' activities in said locations)
Teleport self and others to any daytime location; withstand light powers, disrupt dark powers
weaknesses: Only generate 'daylight' or Time Travel to future/past daytimes at the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with and compel diurnal creatures until developed (NCN)
Sun/moon/sky/celestial-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Mystis' Mission
description: Mystis, in Greek myth, was the goddess of initiates into mystery rites, like cults and secret societies. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically convert normal language into language only the user and chosen subjects can understand, at will. In addition, one can psychically establish a telepathic and/or empathic bond between the user and/or chosen subjects, at will. One can even psychically project a forcefield nearly impenetrable by anyone except the user and chosen subjects, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Mystis' command over the essence of members initiated into mysteries
strengths: Convert normal spoken/written language into a language only the user/chosen subjects can understand
Psychically establish a telepathic and/or empathic link between user/chosen subjects
Psychically project a force field, nearly impenetrable by anyone except user/chosen subjects
weaknesses: Pro #2 requires touch (and cannot develop into user-dominated hive-mind), until developed (NCN)
Cannot access arcane/occult knowledge to cast magic spells until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Bacchanalia and MythPower: Telete's Test provide immunity (NCN)

name: Sarcasm Detection
description: With this ability, the user can detect sarcasm, whether spoken, telepathic, written or otherwise. It manifests as knowledge, not a sense, when sarcasm is used.
summary: The ability to detect sarcasm in any form.
strengths: Detect sarcasm flawlessly.
Good for autistic people.
Very useful when on the internet.
weaknesses: If you are good at picking up on sarcasm, this is next to useless.
Nearly useless if you do not understand the means of communication.
Very limited number of possible uses.

name: Hereditary Memory
description: With this ability your children will know what you know. Your memories will be passed down to your children , the youngest knowing the most.
summary: The ability to pass your memories to your offspring.
strengths: This skill is hereditary.
Your children will be the smartest.
Save time on education.
weaknesses: Only effects males.
Share the same personality.
Sibling rivalry.

name: Myth Power: Power Of Perses
description: Perses, in Greek myth, was the god of savagery, pillaging, destruction and laying of waste. As such, channeling him allows one to exaggerate the weak points within a structure, to the point it will tear, break, crumble, collapse or otherwise come apart. In addition, the user becomes physically empowered by destruction NOT caused by him. The user can even psychically perceive, communicate with, share senses with and compel those who are naturally vicious, ferocious, fierce, savage or destructive.
summary: The ability to channel Perses' command over the forces of destruction, pillaging and savagery
strengths: Destroy inorganic matter with a touch, a word or a thought (causing it to come apart, or the like)
Gain physical power from destruction that is not cause by you
Psychically perceive, communicate with, share senses with and compel vicious/ferocious/savage people
weaknesses: Cannot disintegrate or vaporize matter with a touch until the HIGHEST levels (no Con Negation)
Cannot REVERSE or UNDO damage (Mending) until the higher levels
People with combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction based MythPowers are empowered by this ability

name: Hellish Banishment
description: A person with this power does not have the ability to send someone to hell but they have something very similar. Everyone likely has been to a place that was very hellish and would not ever want to go there again. Well now you can send them to that exact time/place courtesy of this power. If the place does not exist anymore or has changed instead their mind gets tricked into replaying that scene until the user decides not to. If people get used to the hell, they will be sent to the next hell.
summary: The ability to send someone's mind or body to his/her hell on earth
strengths: You can send someone's mind to relive his hell on earth
You can send a person to their least favorite place in the world
You can talk to the person while they are in their hell
weaknesses: If someone's life is already living hell then you can't send them anywhere
People can get used to hell over time, but then they will be sent to their next hellish place
If someone does not have the concept of hell

name: Myth Power: Elpis' Elevation
description: Elpis, in Greek myth, was the goddess of hope. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive subjects' hopes, wishes and dreams, their likelihood and how to achieve them, at will. In addition, one can gain physical power and sustenance in the presence of hopeful subjects. One can also psychically cast illusions of subjects' hopes, wishes and dreams, at will. One can even psychically induce a powerful physical and/or mental backlash in subjects hoping for one's misfortune, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Elpis' command over the essence of hope and expectation
strengths: Psychically perceive subjects' hopes/wishes/dreams (likelihood, how to achieve them, etc), at will
Gain physical power and sustenance in the presence of optimists, at will
Psychically cast illusions of hopes, backlash foes' negative hopes as physical/mental pain, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically backlash foes' negative hopes as matching misfortune, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with and compel optimists, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Pandora's Box provides power from this ability (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Lethe's Legacy
description: Lethe, in Greek myth, was the goddess of oblivion (forgetfulness and forgottenness) and Lethe, the Underworld River of Oblivion. As such, channeling her allows one to wipe memories with a touch, a word or a thought. In addition, one can withstand the same effects, unless one DESIRES to forget unwanted/unneeded experiences. Furthermore, one has access to an extradimensional Lethe Space; it contains the user's forgotten memories, as well as lost memories of his allies, and anyone else he touches.
summary: The ability to channel Lethe's command over the essence of forgetfulness, oblivion and the Underworld River Lethe
strengths: Psychically wipe memories with a touch, a word or a thought
Withstand mermory wiping and memory loss (natural or otherwise) unless one DESIRES to forget
Psychically access (and/or travel to) a Lethe Space, which contains lost/forgotten/wiped memories
weaknesses: Only banish foes to the Underworld River Lethe by touch/word/thought when developed (NCN)
Once banished to the River Lethe, foes' memories are completely forgotten (NCN)
Mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Graces' Grandeur
description: These Charites (Kharites, Graces), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of fame, fortune and glory. As such, channeling Eupheme (Praise), one gains physical power from every compliment or word of praise/encouragement that one receives. Channeling Eucleia (Eukleia- Good Repute), one can psychically spread (or wipe subjects' minds of) rumor/scandal about self/others at will. Channeling Euthenia (Wealth, Prosperity), one can psychically transform property into their proper monetary value with a touch.
summary: The ability to channel the Charites' command over the essence of glory and reputation
strengths: Become physically more powerful (stronger, etc) with every compliment (even if they only think it)
Psychically spread (or wipe subjects' memories of) embarrassing rumors and scandals at will
Psychically exchange property for its monetary value (ie touch a car, instantly get thousands back)
weaknesses: Cannot "trade reputations" with others by touch until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Pheme's Feat provides immunity to Pro #2 (NCN)
MythPower: Plutos' Bounty and MythPower: Tryphe's Trifle make Pro #3 useless (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Horae (Hours01)
description: These Horae (Horai, Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of the hours of the day. As such, channeling Auge (Daybreak), one can psychically perceive the passage of time, at will. In addition, one can withstand temporal effects. Furthermore, one can psychically regenerate, wake up feeling rejuvenated and gain physical power at daybreak. One can psychically generate light from the eyes to see in the dark, at will. One can psychically teleport through darkness, as an entity of light, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Horae and their command over the essence of the hours of the day
strengths: Psychically perceive the passage of time, at will; withstand temporal effects
Psychically regenerate, wake up refreshed and gain physical power at daybreak
Psychically generate light from eyes to see in the dark, teleport through shadows as entity of light
weaknesses: Cannot psychically induce wakefulness (allies) or drowsiness (foes), by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically teleport to any location where it is daybreak, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically time travel to past/future daybreaks, until developed (NCN)

name: Swan Song
description: In legends, a swan is thought to be mute for its entire life, except right when it is about to die, when it emits a lovely song called the Swan Song. One with this ability imitates this effect on a foe. The user closes the subject's mouth and programs vital organs with a psionic "kill-switch" function linked to the voice. So the next time the subject speaks, the vital organs automatically shut down at the same time, causing the subject to die a fairly quick, but painful, and irreversible, death.
summary: The ability to use a subject's voice as a kill-switch
strengths: Force a foe to be silent for the rest of his life, or DIE
Works on nearly any species (even non-divine immortals)
The effect can be undone at will
weaknesses: Can only be undone by the actual one who uses it, and cannot be undone if the subject dies
Does not affect undead, extradimensional entities or divinities
Mimesis (Mime Power) or natural muteness renders the ability moot

name: 32 Gb Memory
description: The user has a 32 GB memory chip in their head that can only be used to absorb knowledge that has to do with human history, scientific breakthroughs, government files, top secret government files, scientific files as well as military strategies. The user can't absorb knowledge that is deemed unnecessary to the survival of the human knowledge. The download is done with a special neural link headset that is linked to a computer, using the bluetooth or USB port.
summary: The ability to have a 32 GB memory storage in the user's brain.
strengths: A living repository of human knowledge
A source of wisdom and information for other people
weaknesses: Can't fight with this power
Ambiguous which cultural info is "necessary"

name: Myth Power: Eleos' Empathy
description: Eleos (Eleus), in Greek myth, was the goddess of mercy, pity, compassion, empathy, sympathy and forgiveness. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive others' emotions, or show others one's own emotions (as the case calls for it) in order to show, or be shown, pity, compassion or mercy. In addition, one may perceive those who are naturally unmerciful, and harm them by a touch. One can even shapeshift into a cute and cuddly form that subjects find so cute that it is impossible to do harm to.
summary: The ability to channel Eleos' command over the essence of mercy, pity and compassion
strengths: Perceive the emotions of others, and show others one's own emotions (to gain, or better show, mercy)
Perceive the merciless/insensitive/unforgiving and harm them by a touch
Shapeshift into a form (of one's choosing) so cute/cuddly, people will defend/refuse to harm it
weaknesses: Only perceive emotion to better show mercy; only project emotion to receive mercy (NCN)
Only heal subjects (or kill them painlessly as an act of mercy) by touch at the higher levels
MythPower: Anaideia's Anger provides immunity

name: Quintesson Summon
description: With this power you can summon any Quintesson and have them be under your complete control. You can summon Quintesson scientists to create things for you or Quintesson Executioners to kill people for you etc. When you're done with them you can send them back.
summary: The ability to summon any Quintesson
strengths: You can summon any Quintesson
They are under your complete control
weaknesses: They can be killed

name: Opposite Personality
description:
This ability you can change the personality of a person to be the exact and direct opposite.
E.g a shy and quiet person becomes talkative and loud.
However you can not change what they are feeling or emotion only their personality. You can't make an upset person happy.
summary: The ability to change the personality of a person to the exact opposite.
strengths: Give shy people a confidence boost.
Effect of ability can be reversed. (Just use it a second time. duh!)
weaknesses: Behavioural changes in opposing personality can cause person to take devasting actions.

name: Memory Limit
description: When this ability is activated, the person's memories of last week are wiped and the person is now only able to remember 3 new things at a time besides subconscious acts like breathing.   When the target wants to remember something new they will have to forget about the first thing they learned.   This power can be used on yourself and can be deactivated only by you.
summary: The ability to make a person only able to remember 3 things at a time
strengths: Your opponents will be severely limited in capacity
If you fill their head with irrelevant information you can mess with them
weaknesses: Trying to explain something to a person you accidentally used this on
Notebooks or writing in hand

name: Mental Photo Editing
description: With this power you can take a picture every time you blink and then edit the photo in your mind. You can end captions, change the colors of things, photoshop things into the image, add speech bubbles, crop it, erase the redeye etc. You can then transfer the image to any computer you want. You can turn this power on and off so you don't take a picture every time you blink.
summary: The ability to take and edit photos with your brain
strengths: You can take and edit photos with your brain
You can send the pictures to any computer in the world
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat
If you don't send the pictures to a computer eventually your brain will become cluttered

name: Myth Power: Train Of Erotes5
description: The Erotes, in Greek myth, were the gods of various aspects of love and relationships. As such, channeling Himeros (Himerus- Sexual Desire, Longing and Yearning), one can perceive and manipulate sexual desire (for reasons other than producing offspring) within others. In addition, one can direct the focus of a subject's sexual desire to anyone --or anyTHING-- one wants. One can even psychically compel (and do enhanced damage against) subjects when they naturally experience the sexual urge.
summary: The ability to channel the Erotes' command over the essence of love, sexuality and relationships
strengths: Psychically perceive and manipulate a subject's desire to pleasure themselves sexually
Psychically direct a subject's affections to anyone --or anything-- one desires
Psychically compel (and do enhanced damage against) subjects naturally experiencing a sexual urge
weaknesses: Cannot psychically gravitate or repulse attractive/attracted subjects until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Aphrodisia, MythPower: Arrows of Eros and MythPower: Oath of Ouranos provide immunity
Empathic Backlash or similar emotion-resistant abilities provide immunity

name: Myth Power: Apolausis' Applause
description: Apolausis, in Greek myth, was the goddess of pleasure, enjoyment and delight (in an entertainment/fun sense). As such, channeling her allows one to gain numerous entertainment skills. In addition, one can psychically entrance subjects, immobilizing them in awe of one's performances, at will. Furthermore,one can psychically induce pleasant, happy sensations, by touch. One can even psychically rewind time and memory, at will, by clapping, making subjects relive previous actions and experiences.
summary: The ability to channel Apolausis' command over the essence of enjoyment, pleasure and delight
strengths: Gain numerous entertainment skills (acrobatics, juggling, dancing, singing, stage magic, etc)
Psychically entrance subjects with one's performances; induce pleasant, happy sensations by touch
Induce a 'psychic encore' (reversal of time/memory) of a subject's experiences, by applauding them
weaknesses: Cannot cast an illusion of (or gain physical power from) cheering/applause until developed (NCN)
Cannot gain power from others' natural smiles, laughs and happiness until developed (NCN)
Humor/entertainment-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Pan's Prowess
description: Pan, in Greek myth, was the god of shepherds, flocks, pastures, wilderness, hunting and rustic music. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive, communicate with and compel plants and animals. In addition, one can gain a supernatural awareness of events in the immediate environment. Furthermore, one can produce the "Call of the Wild" by voice, or by the entrancing music of summoned panpipes. One's presence even evokes a fear in foes, similar to being lost in the woods.
summary: The ability to channel Pan's command over the essence of shepherds, flocks, wilderness, hunting and rustic music
strengths: Commune with nature psychically (awareness of weather conditions, one's immediate environment)
Communicate with and control animals (and unleash animal nature in people)
Your presence can invoke fear reminiscent of being lost in the woods (they become panicked/nervous)
weaknesses: Aniothability, Mental Immunity and the like provide immunity to Pro #2 and Pro #3
MythPower: Sophrosyne's Solace provide immunity to the direct effects of Pro #2
Plant/animal/nature-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Idiots To Geniuses
description: With this power you can turn anybody you want into a genius, but it works best if the person has a low IQ (diminished by mental retardation, old age, infancy, etc.) to start.
summary: The ability to turn stupid people into geniuses
strengths: Help friends out
Help out the "mentally challenged"
Help out the elderly and little kids
weaknesses: You can't use this power on yourself
Some say ignorance is bliss

name: Mosquitos
description: Fun fact: It would take about 1,000,000 mosquito bites to completely drain an average adult human of all of their blood. With this power you can summon up to 1,000,000 bloodthirsty mosquitoes that are under your complete control. You can use them to attack you enemies or just summon a couple to be a mild annoyance to your friends. The mosquitos will never bite you no matter what. If some of your mosquitos die they are replaced with new ones so that you can have up to 1,000,000 at all times.
summary: The ability to summon 1,000,000 mosquitos
strengths: You can summon up to 1,000,000 mosquitos
They are under your complete control
They will never bite you
weaknesses: Their buzzing can get annoting
They can't penetrate armor

name: Myth Power: Tryphe's Trifle
description: Tryphe, in Greek myth, was the goddess of luxury, extravagance, and lavish living. As such, channeling her allows one to receive services, products or deals offered by any upscale establishment (country club, luxury hotel, etc) for free. In addition, one can psychically manipulate (and receive insight from) designer items. Furthermore, one can turn luxury items into similarly shaped weapons, tools and armor. One can even psychically perceive, locate and manipulate precious metals and stones.
summary: The ability to channel Tryphe's command over the essence of luxury, extravagance and lavish lifestyle
strengths: Full free access to luxury/upscale places and services; turn luxury items into weapons/tools/armor
Psychically manipulate (levitate, move, etc) and receive psychic insight from luxury items
Psychically perceive and manipulate precious metals/stones
weaknesses: Only psychically perceive, communicate with and compel the rich/spoiled/greedy when developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically upgrade normal items into luxury items, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Money/economy/wealth-based MythPowers provide immunity/disruption/negation (NCN)

name: Nasa Warehouse
description: With this power you can summon anything that NASA has created, invented, or designed. You can control the size of the object that you summon so it does not have to be the same size as the one NASA made. You also gain knowledge of how the object was made and how to use it for as long as it is summoned. The knowledge is lost when the object is unsummoned. NASA does not lose the objects it makes when you summon, you summon a copy. You also have a mental catalog of everything you can summon.
summary: The ability to summon anything that NASA has created.
strengths: Summon anything NASA has created, invented, or designed.
Have knowledge of how the object is made, and how to use it.
Can control the size of the copy you are summoning as well.
weaknesses: NASA will not like you stealing their ideas.
If NASA goes out of business.
Can only use what NASA has made.

name: Monster Control
description: With this power you can control any monster as long as it exists
summary: The ability to control monsters
strengths: You might be able to have an army of monsters
Can control their behaviors, and they like you (act like pets or guardians around you)
They won't want to scare you
weaknesses: If you exist in a universe where no monsters exist, this power is useless
If you're a scaredy-cat, this power won't do you much good...

name: Myth Power: Pledge Peitharchia
description: Peitharchia, in Greek myth, was goddess of obedience to command, subservience and submission. As such, channeling her allows one to compel nearly any subject to do one's bidding. In addition, one can cause the requests and commands of others to effect a subject like psychic compulsions. Furthermore, the user is immune to compulsion of any kind, compulsions directed to do him harm are instantly negated, and the user may psychically perceive and communicate with those who are naturally obedient.
summary: The ability to channel Peitharchia's command over the essence of obedience, subservience and submission
strengths: Make foes subject to one's own will, and/or the will of others (and immune to compulsions of others)
Compulsions directed to do you harm automatically fail
Psychically perceive and communicate with those who are obedient by nature (servants, etc)
weaknesses: Abilities which bestow Compulsion Immunity
Cannot pass on the Compulsion Immunity until the higher levels
Cannot induce pain in disobedient people (who disobey orders OR compulsions) until the higher levels

name: Dive Compulsion
description: With this power you can let out a mental pulse that will compel anything in an area of water to dive to the bottom of it. How large the area is is left to the users discretion. Creatures will continue swimming toward the bottom regardless of temperature, pressure, or need for oxygen. Should the creature actually reach the bottom the compulsion is broken.
summary: The ability to compel any living thing in a body of water to swim toward the bottom
strengths: Keep living things off of the waters surface.
Send anything attacking you underwater.
weaknesses: Depending on how deep the water is, this will kill pretty much everything in the target area.

name: Mood Change
description: Change anyone's mood. For example, happy to sad.
summary: The ability to change someone's mood.
strengths: Love.
Sad to happy.
Angry to happy.
weaknesses: Not real love.
Mad to happy will slowly make them lose their sanity.
Moods will be off.

name: Aniothability
description: Aniothability is the superhuman inability to feel any negative emotion at all. This ability is not the same as having no emotion at all, and one with this ability is not overly chipper; they simply don't feel fear, nervousness, apprehension, doubt, anger, jealousy, embarrassment or the like. They cannot even have these feelings psychically imposed by means of emotion manipulation or the like. They can often still feel pain, however, of the physical sort (not betrayal or anger; like cuts, etc. )
summary: The ability to entirely resist all negative emotion
strengths: No irrational fear or worries
Calm minded at all times
Only experience positive emotions
weaknesses: May annoy people if you can't relate to their pain
May be unable to perceive physical pain which can be very disadvantageous
May make people dislike you if you're always saying "what is pain? What is sad? Sounds unpleasant"

name: Solace Mancy
description: You can see a subject's fading aura going through emotional crisis. Then you can help them out by instantly removing people's despair and misery, and giving your unconditional pure embrace or comforting touch.
summary: The ability to absorb sadness and imbue hope.
strengths: Totally free someone from depression and unwanted feelings.
Take away their pain and replace it with happiness
weaknesses: Feel one's sorrow and pain.
It won't work by force.

name: Myth Power: Harpocrates' Secret
description: Harpocrates (Harpokrates), in Greek myth, was the god of silence, secrets and secrecy. As such, channeling him allows one to perceive when people are hiding something, what it is, and (if it's a physical thing) WHERE it is. In addition, one's own mind is protected from the same intrusion; when subjects try to invade one's mind, all they hear is silence. Furthermore, one can psychically nullify ambient sound at will. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and command mute creatures.
summary: The ability to channel Harpocrates' command over the essence of silence and secrecy
strengths: Perceive secrets of any kind (treasure chest, kidnapped person, embarassing thought, etc)
Mind/aura can't be read; Nullify ambient sound (move silently; withstand/disrupt sonic attacks)
Psychically perceive, communicate with and command mute/non-speaking/non-vocal creatures
weaknesses: Cannot hide subjects' thoughts/emotions/memories/personality from them until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot SHARE one's Power Cloaking, Aura Cloaking or Mental Immunity until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Hesykhia's Hush provides immunity (NCN)

name: The Crown
description: With this power alone you can cause anyone to kneel down to you. When kneeling they are prevented from doing anything else. If you have the powers, 'The Throne' and 'The Scepter' as well then you can control their minds instead of just forcing them to kneel.
summary: The ability to cause anyone to kneel down in one's presence
strengths: You can control almost anyone if you have all three powers.
weaknesses: Forcing people to kneel isn't all that useful.

name: Orange Light
description: You can make a 20 meter thick orange field that, when entered, greatly slows human thought, weakens reflexes and allows one to escape foes.
summary: The ability to generate a thick orange field around you that greatly slows human thought.
strengths: Escape.
Stop plan making.
Covers large area.
weaknesses: Will affect every one in area.

name: Nova Tiger Staff
description: The nova tiger staff is a powerful bo staff that has tiger stripes on it with larger spearheads at both ends, and with it you can illuminate yourself with a yellow-orange force and strike your opponent, could posess some special mind powers, allowing you to conjure up illusions and make others believe that something is happening, and extensively transform it into trichucks.
summary: The ability to use it to strike enemies with a glowing essence.
strengths: Can use it to put a forcefield around yourself which causes projectiles to go through you.
Could use it to teleport back to you.
Can use it to gather up energy and shoot from the staff.
weaknesses: Using this staff requires a great deal of advanced preparation and it drains you.
If it is used too long, then you'll become feral and your human memories will be erased.

name: Myth Power: Graces' Graces
description: These Charites (Kharites, Graces), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of charm, elegance, grace and beauty. As such, channeling Aglaia (Adornment), one can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those wearing flashy or fancy clothes, jewelry or accessories. Channeling Thalia (Thaleia- Good Cheer), one can induce and amplify positive emotion by touch (and withstand negative emotion). Channeling Euphrosyne (Mirth), one can generate sparkles and illusions to entertain or mesmerize foes.
summary: The ability to channel the Charites' command over the essence of grace, elegance and charm
strengths: Psychically perceive, communicate with, share senses with and compel those with a flashy wardrobe
Induce/amplify good emotions by a touch; immune to bad emotions
Cast entertaining illusions; generate mesmerizing sparkles
weaknesses: Cannot gain Hypnotic Charm or Laughter Inducing (by touch) until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Said by Pseudologoi provide immunity to Part 1 of Pro #3 (NCN)
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith provides immunity (NCN)

name: Piece Of Eden: The Staff
description: The Staff has the ability to create powerful illusions. It can also be used as a weapon.
summary: The ability to use a staff that can create powerful illusions.
strengths: Has a blade at the bottom that can be used in a fight.
weaknesses: Can be destroyed and if it is, it causes a HUGE explosion.
Enemies can use it.

name: Moon Blade 7th: Lost Violet
description: The moon blade allows you to: 1) Show someone your emotions (can also be a multiple of your emotions, such as 2x the happiness you have). 2) Multiply their emotion (or reduce it). 3) Create additional emotions
summary: The ability to create a moon blade that manipulates emotions.
strengths: You can inflict extreme sadness or laziness on a person, which kills them almost instantly
Makes them unable to do anything.
weaknesses: Must touch the person with the blade.
Useless on anything without feelings (zombies are a good example)

name: Myth Power: Calocagathia's Call
description: Calocagathia (Kalokagathia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of nobility and goodness. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive and alter others' noble qualities (chivalry, charity, honor, loyalty, devotion to just causes, etc). In addition, one may withstand compulsions they see as morally wrong.  Furthermore, one may psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those of noble lineage (aristocrats, heirs/heiresses, etc). One may even become a literal knight in shining armor at will.
summary: The ability to channel Calocagathia's command over the essence of goodness, nobility, honor and prestige
strengths: Perceive and manipulate others' noble qualities at will; withstand immoral compulsions
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those descended from prestige (noble pedigree)
Turn into a literal knight in shining armor at will (indestructible armor/weapons, immortal horse)
weaknesses: Effects of Pro #1 and Pro #2 last only until power's use is up (NCN)
Mental Immunity/Perspicuity provide immunity to Pro #1 and Pro #2 (NCN)
Sin/injustice/corruption-based MythPowers and MythPower: Zeus' Zenith provide immunity (NCN)

name: Brick Creation
description: Like the little guys from Blockland, you can create colored bricks that are of the material of your imagination. Up to 128 thousand of these bricks can be created on one world.
summary: The ability to create blocks of any material with your mind.
strengths: Create any kind of material in the shape of a brick.
You can trap people in these bricks.
You can make a house at no cost.
weaknesses: Limited to 128 thousand on one world.
The whole block will be demolished from the hit of a hammer, as long as it's not a support block.
You can only create them from a limted distance.

name: Illusion Vision
description: You can see trough illusions! It's like the x-ray vision on illusions! Just don't use it during magic shows.
summary: The ability to see through illusions
strengths: If your enemy's power is to make illusions, they're screwed
You don't run into mirage water in the desert
Be a show off at the desert
weaknesses: Magic shows won't be fun if you use it
If you can make illusions and your enemy has this power, you're screwed
It's not fun to see through every illusion

name: Songspeak
description: One with this ability can communicate psychically with others through song. They need only sing or hum a note, and the musical sound conveys the message without need for lyrics (similarly, music from others conveys a message to the user). In addition, the user may use this ability to mimic (and resist) Hypnotic Song, Psychic Song, Dread Song, Siren Song, or the like, based on what is needed. Furthermore, the ability results in a beautiful, tireless singing voice.
summary: The ability to communicate psychically with others through song
strengths: Communicate in a way that's even more discreet than telepathy or empathy
Mimic (and resist) any song-based ability
Awesome singing voice
weaknesses: Doesn't allow you to otherwise manipulate sound
No sonic attacks unless they sound song-like (no just outright compulsions)
Deaf people

name: Concretakinesis
description: The power to mentally move concrete with your mind, allowing you to destroy concrete, use it as a shield, and make concrete mud slides.
summary: The ability to mentally move concrete with your mind.
strengths: Destroy concrete.
Make shields out of concrete.
Good protection.
weaknesses: Slower than most -kinesis.

name: Myth Power: Train Of Erotes7
description: The Erotes, in Greek myth, were the gods of various aspects of love and relationships. As such, channeling Pothos (Pothus- Passionate Longing, Desire and Yearning for the Unattainable), one can perceive the identity of a subject's dream lover, and summon a copy of that being to life. It can be altered completely to suit the user/subject's whims and falls instantly in love with the user/subject. One can even travel to and from a fictional universe where a fictional dream lover lives, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Erotes' command over the essence of love, sexuality and relationships
strengths: Psychically perceive the identity of a subject's dream lover
Psychically summon a copy of a subject's dream lover to life (create, edit and delete them) at will
Teleport self/others to and from a fictional universe where a dream lover lives, at will
weaknesses: Knowledge/Skills/Powers/Abilities bestowed on a dream lover must grow in power over time (NCN)
MythPower: Aphrodisia, MythPower: Arrows of Eros and MythPower: Oath of Ouranos provide immunity
Empathic Backlash or similar emotion-resistant abilities provide immunity

name: Author's Genius
description: This power grants the user a fully functioning yet inherently loyal mind inside your own. While it cannot use your superpowers directly, it will serve it's master in any way. It begins with the same level of intelligence, memory and creativity as its masters', but increase exponentially when a power the user added to the superpower list is acquired.
summary: The ability to have a secondary mind whose capabilities increase exponentially.
strengths: If you create a lot of popular powers, this mind will be extremely intelligent and creative.
Completely loyal and obedient; in spite of intelligence, it will do whatever you want it to.
Memory increases as well.
weaknesses: Cannot effect the outside world.
Cannot stop you if you fall under the influence of another.
Cannot use your powers, although it will be telepathically shielded if you are.

name: Extraterrestrial Psychic Link
description: When this power manifests, a psychic link between you and a random alien will be established. From then on, you will be able to exchange telepathically (thoughts), empathically (emotions), sensorily (senses) and mnemonically (memories) with that alien. Unless special conditions arise, you will never be able to change to another alien 'correspondent'. The reason why that specific alien was chosen is because he/she/it(?) has this power as well.
summary: The ability to psychically communicate with one specific alien in the whole universe.
strengths: You or the alien can turn this power off, but you won't change correspondent when you turn it on.
You can obtain valuable information about alien technology, culture and knowledge.
You will psychically understand each other and can become friends or more.
weaknesses: You most likely will never meet your new friend in person. And you cannot change your correspondent.
People can think you're crazy if you tell them you're in communication with an alien.
You may be psychically invaded by the alien, meaning it may take over your body.

name: Surface Compulsion
description: With this power you can let out a mental pulse that will compel anything in an area of water to rise to the surface of it. How large the area is is left to the users discretion. Creatures will remain at the surface of the water for as long as the user wills.
summary: The ability to compel any living creature in an area of water to rise to the surface.
strengths: Find people trying to hide underwater.
Scoop up sea life with a net when they surface.
Send anything attacking you underwater to the surface.
weaknesses: You'll probably end up killing deepwater life that can't hendel the change in pressure.
You have no control over them once they reach the surface, you can only tell them to come up.

name: Youtube Hypnosis
description: With this ability you can hypnotize or brainwash any one through youtube videos. It doesn't matter what the video itself is about as long as you have encoded your command, general idea or opinion etc. And whoever watches the video will be instantly hypnotized and/or brainwashed.
summary: The ability to hypnotise or brainwash people through youtube videos
strengths: Hypnotize millions of people to do or think what you want
Using this power on really popular videos insures you will get a wide affect
Can change or remove the command from videos
weaknesses: Can only use on 10 videos at a time
Videos can be deleted along with the command
Person has to watch the entire video for the power to work

name: Myth Power: Pheme's Feat
description: Pheme (Ossa), in Greek myth, was the goddess of rumor, gossip and fame. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive any rumors that are circulating, as well as the truth behind them. In addition, any gossip one speaks will be taken as truth, and those who hear it will feel compelled to spread it to others, before also forgetting who first told them. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel gossipmongers (those who love to hear and tell gossip).
summary: The ability to channel Pheme's command over the forces of rumor, gossip, fame and reputation
strengths: Perceive any circulating rumors, and the truth behind them
Spread (or stop) any rumor by a word, a touch or a thought
Perceive, communicate with and compel those who love to gossip
weaknesses: Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with and compel celebrities until the higher levels
Cannot psychically heighten or reduce popularity (one's own or others') until the higher levels
At the lower levels, powers may work at either too SMALL a range, or too WIDE a range

name: Dark Powers: Depression
description: You can summon the Depressions, small humanoid monsters that are able to slowly steal the energy of everyone around them and transfer it to you. They are very fast, but cannot walk like a normal person: they walk crouching, like monkeys. They are mindless but follow all your orders without question. Very useful as soldiers, since they are always many and they have claws that are more dangerous than any sword. This power turns you evil.
summary: The ability to summon humanoid creatures that absorb the energy of everyone around them and redirect it to you.
strengths: You have an army of loyal minions that follow all your orders.
The Depressions will slowly restore your energy, if there is at least one person nearby them.
weaknesses: The Depressions are ALWAYS absorbing the energy of people around them, so you might hurt your allies
Just like all abilities from the DarkPower kind, this power turns you evil and addicted to using it

name: Myth Power: Olympus Invocation
description: Mount Olympus, in Greek myth, was the abode of the Olympian Pantheon (the assembly of twelve of the most powerful and influential gods). As such, channeling it allows one to perceive whenever a meeting is being held (or going to be held) among the Olympian Council. In addition, one can psychically attune his consciousness to the meetings, and listen in on them, at will. Furthermore, one may psychically perceive and communicate with those with MythPowers based on the Twelve Olympians, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the splendor of Mount Olympus, the abode of the twelve Olympians
strengths: Perceive when a meeting of the Olympian Council will be held (or is being held)
Be an oracle, able to foretell disasters, heroic feats, daring adventures and the fate of the world
Recognize (and psychically communicate with) those who have MythPowers based on the Twelve Olympians
weaknesses: Doesn't make Olympian MythPower users automatically respect or like you
Cannot be used to travel TO the peak of Mount Olympus (NCN)
Cannot be used to perceive the thoughts of the ACTUAL Olympians (NCN)

name: Think Room Temperature
description: With this power you can make things that are either too hot or too cold, room temperature
summary: The ability to make things room temperature
strengths: Make weather nice and mild
Make enemies have to eat room-temperature food
People ever throw boiling water at you 'cause you can't sing? Now it's only lukewarm
weaknesses: Devastating Environmental Effects
KILL PEOPLE by making their body room temperature (about 70 degrees Fahrenheit)

name: Arcana: 9 The Hermit
description: This ability allows you to form imperceptible (Invisible, Intangible, etc) thought-forms from your own mental energies. These thought-forms have the exact same senses as you do and can float speedily through the air to wherever you send them. However, these thought-forms can only obey simple orders and will dissipate once they use up all of the energy you gave them. They are unable to physically affect anything around them and can only relay information to you by merging with your mind again.
summary: The ability to send out thought-forms to collect information.
strengths: Allows you to keep track of important people, items, or places.
Offers some of the benefits of astral projection without many of the risks.
With efficient use of energy, you can have a virtual army of invisible spys.
weaknesses: Thought-forms have no intelligence to speak of and blindly follow only simple orders.
They can be detected and destroyed by psychic means.
Unless they return to you, you gain no information.

name: Pull/Push
description: With this power you cause the commands for pull and push to be reversed in a person's mind. When they want to pull something they will push it and when they want to push something they will pull it. This can be useful if someone is trying to take something away from you you can cause them to actually push it towards you. Or if someone is trying to push something hazardous towards you can make them pull it towards them. It works on telekinesis and robots as well.
summary: The ability to make people pull things when they want to push them and vice versa
strengths: You can make people push things when they try to pull them and vice versa
You can really screw with someone when they try to open a door
weaknesses: Your enemy can figure out what you're trying to do and simply do the opposite action

name: Exploder
description: No one will ever want to hit you. You will explode with any concussive trauma & subsequently reintegrate anywhere you want within the blast zone. Ram into structures, vehicles, whatever. Here's a personal favorite: jump off a building and see what kind of crater you'll make.
summary: The ability to explode when you are hit
strengths: Hits, punches will cause a small reactive explosion roughly 5 times the force of the hit
Large hits, hit by moving vehicles or hit by the superstrong causes exponentially massive explosions
Explode and reintegrate wherever you want within the blast zone
weaknesses: No more pats on the back, high-fives or the like. Slicing and energy weapons pose a threat
Accidentally bumping into things, tripping and walking through crowds are precarious adventures
When you reintegrate you are buck-naked to the world & slightly disoriented
tags: blowing up like you thought i would

name: Myth Power: Laelaps' Pursuit
description: Laelaps (Lailaps), in Greek myth, was a magical dog who was fated always catch any pursued target, regardless of their speed. As such, channeling him allows one to move with speed that adapts to outdo any any subject that one pursues; likewise, one's reflexes, friction/wind resistance, etc adapt to handle changes in speed. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and command dogs at will. One can even turn into any breed of dog, or mimic the abilities of a dog at will.
summary: The ability to channel the superhuman chasing prowess of the mythical dog Laelaps
strengths: Adapt speed, reflexes and wind/friction resistance to catch any target
Psychically perceive, communicate with and command dogs
Turn into any breed of dog, or mimic the abilities of a dog at will
weaknesses: Every hear of the tale of Laelaps and the Teumessian Fox? Look it up.
Speed/athletics/competition-based MythPowers provide immunity
MythPower: Artemis' Gift and other animal-based MythPowers (may provide immunity and/or control)

name: Mind Blower
description: Tired of people not listening to you? Is your voice lost in the sea of opinions and ramblings of your friends and acquaintences? Do people not take you seriously? A Mind Blower has all of these issues handled with ease. Everything you say will be seen as deeply profound and insightful. You will capture the attention of anyone and everyone within earshot, and they will be eager to listen to you. Even casually saying "let's blow this popsicle stand" will arouse deep fascination and interest.
summary: The ability to cause others to think everything you say is profound
strengths: Never be ignored or seen as boring
Captivate audiences, friends, family
Gain respect and admiration
weaknesses: You cannot shut this power off. It's active at all times.
Goofing around will still be seen as profound

name: Music Of  Sound Soul
description: Play the concerto of your soul on an instrumental manifestation of your powers in order to purge yourself of all ailments and access the perfect form of your abilities while you play it. The instrument does not manifest itself in the physical realm but instead exists only in your mental realm.
summary: The ability to reset yourself to your perfect state.
strengths: Instantly rid yourself of injuries or mind control by resetting yourself.
You do not have to lug the instrument around since it exists inside of your mind.
The song coordinates muscle movements in a fight and ups your reaction time.
weaknesses: If a spirit enters your mind and hijacks the instrument it can take control of and alter your body.
If you play the wrong song or make to many mistakes it could damage your spirit permanently.
Playing the first few notes requires intense concentration and zero movement for a small time.

name: Enhancement: Sealing
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached it allows a power to seal things away based on what the power does originally. Ex. Telepathy seals minds, Aerokinesis seals away air, etc. This power can only be attached to one power at a time and can only seal the things away while attached to the power. If this power is stolen, it permanently enhances the power it is attached to and seals are still working.
summary: The ability to allow a power to seal things away by attaching this power to it
strengths: Seal your enemy's mind into the back of their mind.
Power seals based on original use.
Last sentence is the theft rule (for con 3).
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Power might be useless with sealing or more trouble.
Seals disappear when attached power changes unless this is stolen, then theft rule applies.

name: Steamroll Summoning
description: This power let's you summon working steamrollers that you can control with your mind.  You can summon up to 10 steamrollers.
summary: The ability to summon steamrollers
strengths: You can control them with your mind.
You can summon them such that they land on your opponents' heads.
Your steamrollers are roadworthy.
weaknesses: Not exactly useful for close combat situations.
The farthest distance you can summon them is 20m (can extend with training)
There top speed is 80KmH(Kilometers per Hour)

name: Myth Power: Eniautos' Annual
description: Eniautos (Eniautus, Eniatos, Eniatus), in Greek myth, was the god of the calendar year. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive the passage of time, at will. In addition, one can withstand temporal effects. Furthermore, one can psychically receive insight from a year in the past or the future. One can also psychically age and de-age matter by a year, by touch, at will. One can even psychically perceive and grant subjects' (physically possible) New Years' resolutions, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Eniautos' command over the essence of the calendar year
strengths: Psychically perceive the passage of time, at will; withstand temporal effects
Psychically receive insight from a year into past/future; psychically age/de-age matter by a year
Psychically perceive and grant subjects' New Years' resolutions, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically time travel to New Year or one year from power use, until developed (NCN)
Cannot gain physical power on New Year (time travel allowed) until developed (NCN)
Pro #3 only works on subjects' actual New Years' resolutions, and adheres to genie rules (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Theia's Light
description: Theia (or Thea) in Greek myth, was the Titan goddess of sight and heavenly light (the light of the clear, blue sky and the twinkle of precious metals and stones). As such, channeling her allows one to see in all visual aspects (telescopic, microscopic, periscopic, infrared, ultraviolet, 360-degrees, night vision, etc). In addition, when under the clear, blue sky, one can call down beams of searing light on foes. One can even psychically perceive, locate and manipulate precious metals and stones.
summary: The ability to channel Theia's command over the essence of sight and heavenly light
strengths: See/spy in all visual aspects (night vision, telescopic vision, microscopic vision, etc.)
Call down searing beams of light to harm foes when under the light of the clear blue sky
Psychically perceive and manipulate precious metals/stones; immune to MythPower: Hyperion's Watch
weaknesses: Cannot control others' vision (blinding, etc) until the higher levels (no Con Negation)
Cannot gain Laser Vision, Heat Vision, or Clairvoyance until the higher levels (no Con Negation)
People with sun/moon/sky/celestial based MythPowers are immune to this ability

name: Myth Power: Apate's Aptitude
description: Apate, in Greek myth, was the goddess of deception, fraud, deceit, manipulation and treachery. As such, channeling her allows one to gain skill in how to speak and act to manipulate and mislead others. In addition, one can cast illusions to deceive any of the senses at will; one can also totally withstand illusions and hallucinations. One can even psychically take subjects for allies and lovers, by touch, as long as they are the allies or loved ones of one's foes (reversing subjects' alliances).
summary: The ability to channel Apate's command over the essence of deception, fraud, manipulation, deceit and treachery
strengths: Gain superhuman skill in misleading and manipulating others
Cast illusions to deceive the senses (natural senses, ESP, etc); withstand illusion/hallucination
Befriend allies and charm lovers, by touch, as long as they are allies/lovers of one's foes
weaknesses: Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with and compel deceivers/frauds until developed (NCN)
Cannot gain the power of Crocodile Tears and (eventually) Mirage Inducing until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Aletheia's Absolute and MythPower: Eris' Enmity provide immunity (NCN)

name: Random Teleportation
description: Basically you use this on a teleportor and he'll go to a set of random coordinates within the range of his power when he teleports. This power starts by affecting a teleportor's first two teleports. With practice and mental focus you can make this ten teleports. If someone's teleportation power prevents teleporting into solid matter then this power can't make that happen.
summary: The ability to make teleportors teleport to random coordinates.
strengths: A teleportor that can teleport in solid matter will be afraid to teleport.
A good secondary power to Teleportation Manipulation.
weaknesses: Only affects the first ten teleports of the victim.
Affecting more than two teleports of a victim requires practice and effort.

name: Myth Power: Prophasis' Plea
description: Prophasis, in Greek myth, was the goddess of excuses, apology and pleading forgiveness. As such, channeling her allows one to make up nearly any excuse, and those who hear it will believe it. In addition, one can perceive the truth behind the excuses of others and make false excuses (which often pertain to personal misfortune) come true, until the subject apologizes. One with this ability may even withstand compulsions and probability/reality manipulation as long as one has a good excuse.
summary: The ability to channel Prophasis' command over the essence of excuse, apology and asking forgiveness
strengths: Make up any excuse, and subjects will believe it (unless they can see otherwise)
Perceive the truth behind the excuses of others (untrue excuses can be made true)
With a good excuse, withstand compulsions, magic and reality/probability/chance/luck manipulation
weaknesses: ESPECIALLY vulnerable to MythPower: Epimetheus' Idea
People with MythPower: Prometheus' Plan are immune to this ability
People with probability/chance/luck based MythPowers and Unpredictability are immune to this ability

name: Myth Power: Effect Of Eos
description: Eos, in Greek myth, was the goddess of the dawn. As such, channeling her allows one to rewind or fast-forward time to the dawn of any day (the current day or any other one desires). One can also psychically perceive and communicate with anyone who is awake at that time, as well as project his sight to anywhere the light of dawn touches. Furthermore, one is gifted with the ability to generate wings for flight, stand on clouds, withstand atmospheric conditions and generate/glide on wind at will.
summary: The ability to channel Eos' command over the essence of the dawn
strengths: Rewind or fast-forward time to the dawn of any day of one's choice
Project sight to anywhere dawn's light touches; perceive and communicate with anyone awake at dawn
Generate/manipulate/glide on winds, stand on clouds, winged flight
weaknesses: Cannot disrupt or repel effects of MythPower: Nyx's Night Shift until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Help from Helios and MythPower: Salute to Selene provide immunity (NCN)
MythPower: Hyperion's Watch and MythPower: Theia's Light provide immunity (NCN)

name: Vampirism: Empathic
