description: Also called Empathic Absorption or Emotion Absorption, this is the ability to absorb energy from emotions (which sometimes relieves people of their emotions), or to simply become stronger in the presence of intense emotion; sometimes, the user become stronger only in the presence of a certain emotion, such as love or doubt, or anger, or bravery, or the like (as such, this power is especially effective on empaths and others who give off powerful empathic emanations)
summary: The ability to gain sustenance and power from the emotions of others
strengths: Drain your foes' emotions, making your foe temporarily emotionally numb
Draining their emotions also builds your physical stats and your resistance to empathic powers
Foes with empathic (emotion-related) abilities have nearly no effect
weaknesses: Can still have emotions READ when this power is in use (though it also drains empathic perception)
Sometimes it requires and actual bite like a vampire
If you can't control it, friends and family won't want to be around you

name: Psionic Fruit Ripening
description: Ripen unripe fruits and vegetables to make them ripe, or take already ripe fruits and vegetables and ripen them until they ferment.
summary: The ability to ripen fruit and vegetables with your mind.
strengths: If the store only has green banannas, no worries.
If you want an orange off the tree, but it hasn't fully ripened, no worries.
If you want to ferment something, no worries.
weaknesses: Accidentally overripening fruit or vegetables.
If you hate fruits and vegetables, I guess it wouldn't do you much good.
Friends and family will always be wanting you to ripen things for them.

name: Good/Evil Seperation
description:
This ability causes other people to divide into two people that look exactly like them. However, one person has all the good traits, while the other person has all the evil and bad traits. It divides the good and evil qualities of that person.
On top of the separation. The good and evil traits are defined by the original (whole person's) moral perception of good and evil, what they think of being essentially the "worst" and "best" attributes of themselves.
summary: The ability to divide a person in two, separating their good and evil sides.
strengths: You create a purely good person.
weaknesses: You create a purely evil person.
The morality of good and evil is based on your subject's perception of morality, and not your own.

name: Hall Of Fear
description: The Hall of Fear is an illusion power. It forces the victim's mind into a dark hall illuminated by torches. There they are confronted by their worst fears. If they lose to them, they fall into insanity. If they beat their fears, you are forced into the Hall and have to face your fears.
summary: The ability to use the Hall of Fear.
strengths: Forces people to fight worst fears.
Drives people insane.
weaknesses: You might be driven to insanity.

name: Piece Of Eden: The Apple
description: The Apple can give you the ability to create illusions and control people's minds. As long as it is in your possession, you can use this power.
summary: The ability to use an apple that can control people and create illusions.
strengths: You can carry it in your pocket or bag and still use its power.
weaknesses: It must be in YOUR possession.
Enemies can use it if they take it from you.
Can be destroyed. And if it is, it will cause a HUGE explosion.

name: Hive Mind
description: Hive Mind is very easy to overlook, but do so at your peril. People in a Hive Mind share a mind--they are one mind with several bodies. Therefore, anything one person in a Hive Mind knows, the whole Hive Mind knows. It also knows where each of its members is. Finally, the Mind can flood all of itself into a single member, giving them telepathy and hypnosis.  This leaves the other members comatose. There is no individuality in a Hive Mind, and when one member dies, it almost kills the others.
summary: The ability to share a mind with several others
strengths: Can be as many as 20 people
Know what your Hivemates know
Can flood all of it into one member, giving them psychic powers
weaknesses: No individuality in a Hive Mind
When one dies, the others almost die too
"Flooding" leaves the others comatose

name: Flight Of The Lemmings
description: Ever heard the story of how a group of lemmings will run off a cliff to their deaths without hesiatation, while following the group? This is the same concept. If you force a member of a group does something, all of the others do it as well, even with inanimate objects. One enemy get's scared, all of them get scared. you pickpocket one person, you pickpocket them all. You always decide when the effect takes place.
summary: The ability to force a group of objects to copy the actions of one member of said group.
strengths: Seduce/mesmerise/enlist/control large groups of people at once.
You can decide if when the effect takes place
You are not affected by this power yourself.
weaknesses: Be careful of who's included in a group when you initiate a response for obvious reasons.

name: Empathic Linking
description: This power links two people together empathically, meaning they feel what the other is feeling in terms of emotions. You can choose to connect their lives as well; if one person is hurt or dies, the other one is hurt or dies as well.
summary: The ability to connect two persons together empathically
strengths: Make people understand each other by placing them in their shoes
You can tell is someone is lying
You can use it on anyone you like
weaknesses: You may not like what you find out.
Both targets could die

name: Gustance Deduction
description: A person with this power is able to figure out vast amounts of information by tasting something. They analyze the exact tastes of the components that went into the tasted object. This lets one figure out the composition of their food as well as give them the ability to simulate the flavor of any food in their mind by combining the tastes of said ingredients in their mind. However, there are cons - you have to have tasted something before in your life to determine what ingredient it is.
summary: The ability to determine details of something by taste
strengths: Figure out the composition of your food - what type of meat etc
Become a very good food critiquer
Become an excellent experimental chef
weaknesses: Figuring out there was poison in something
You might not want to taste everything
You need to have a reference to figure out the exact taste

name: Myth Power: Dysnomia's Deed
description: Dysnomia, in Greek myth, was the goddess of defiance, disobedience, insubordination and lawlessness. As such, channeling her allows one to withstand and negate any compulsion, short of command by an omnipotent being. One can share this immunity by a touch. Furthermore, one's touch can also make subjects lose all respect for law, invoking a havoc-wreaking frenzy until the power's use is spent. One can even psychically perceive and communicate with those who are naturally disobedient and defiant.
summary: The ability to channel Dysnomia's command over the essence of disobedience, insubordination and lawlessness
strengths: Immunity to ANY compulsion, short of direct omnipotent influence; Compulsion Immunity can be shared
One's touch can negate respect for the law/rules, so subjects go into a frenzy of anarchy
Psychically perceive, communicate with and share senses with the naturally disobedient and defiant
weaknesses: Cannot compel the naturally obedient, defiant, disobedient or insubordinant (no Con Negation)
People with law and order based MythPowers are immune to this ability (higher level can negate it)
People with MythPower: Eris' Enmity are immune to (and empowered by) this ability

name: Myth Power: Eirene's Elegance
description: Eirene (Irene), in Greek myth, was the goddess of peace. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically quell conflicts at will (by causing any two or more conflicting subjects to lose the ability to speak and/or forget what they were going to say/do). In addition, one can produce a molecular and temporal stasis around any weapon to prevent that weapon from going forth and doing subjects harm. One can even psychically calm any kind of rage and ease troubled minds by touch, word or thought.
summary: The ability to channel Eirene's command over the essence of peace and pacifism
strengths: Prevent and end arguments by erasing hostile memories, or rendering subjects mute
Induce a temporal AND molecular stasis around weapons (rendering them TOTALLY useless)
Calm any rage (even by rage/madness/frenzy-based MythPowers) and soothe troubled minds
weaknesses: Only perceive, communicate with and compel pacifists/peacemakers at the higher levels (NCN)
Only quell earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, stormy skies or violent seas at the higher levels (NCN)
Combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction-based MythPowers provide immunity until the higher levels

name: Myth Power: Harpax's Haul
description: Harpax, in Greek myth, was the god of taking. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically bypass the legal/social consequences of stealing. In addition, one can psychically access a pocket dimension as infinite storage for loot, at will. Furthermore, one can deal enhanced damage against foes they have stolen from. One can also deal enhanced damage against foes who have stolen from them. One can even psychically perceive and teleport to the site of any theft or robbery in progress, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Harpax's command over the essence of taking, theft and robbery
strengths: Psychically bypass legal/social consequences of stealing, access pocket dimension for infinite storage, at will
Deal enhanced damage against foes who have stolen from them, or who they have stolen from
Psychically perceive and teleport to the site of any theft/robbery in progress, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically steal knowledge, skills or (random) superpowers, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically steal injuries, beauty, breath or life-force, by touch, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Dos' Donation and law/order/justice-based MythPowers provide immunity

name: Enhancement: Damage Resistant
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached it makes anything that the enhanced power creates harder to damage. For physical items, the atoms become more tightly bonded together. For mental powers, it feels to enemies as though more willpower is holding the thoughts together. If this power is stolen, the enhanced power is permanently enhanced. This can only be attached to one power at a time.
summary: The ability to make a power's creations harder to damage
strengths: Your creations are harder to damage.
Works on mentally- and physically- based powers.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Doesn't work with shapeshifting powers.

name: Myth Power: Krios' Creed
description: Krios (Kreios, Crios, Creios, Crius, Creius), in Greek myth, was the Titan god of leadership, mastery, domestic animals and the constellations. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive, intimidate and compel subjects (as well as psychically perceive, communicate with and command animals) at will. In addition, one can totally withstand the compulsions of others. One can even assume the form of any domestic animal, as well as anyone who has one's same astrological sign, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Krios' command over the essence of leadership, mastery, domestic animals and constellations
strengths: Psychically perceive, intimidate and compel subjects; perceive, communicate with and command animals
Totally withstand the compulsions of others
Assume the form of any DOMESTIC animal, or anyone who share's one's astrological sign
weaknesses: Cannot turn others into domestic animals, by touch, until the higher levels (NCN)
Pro #3 only extends to zodiac/constellation characters at the higher levels (NCN)
Sun/moon/sky/celestial-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Sirius' Service
description: Sirius (Sirios, Seirios), in Greek myth, was the god of the Dog Star and the scorching heat of midsummer. As such, channeling him allows one to fly, as well as gain adaptation to survive in space. In addition, one can psychically generate an aura mimicking the effects of a summer day's intense heat, at will. Furthermore, one can transform oneself into any species of dog (or weredog), at will (others, by touch). One can even psychically perceive, communicate with, command and mimic dogs, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Sirius' command over the essence of the Dog Star and the scorching heat of midsummer
strengths: Gain flight; gain adaptation to survive in space (physical change voluntary)
Psychically generate an aura mimicking the intense heat of a summer day
Psychically perceive, communicate with, command and mimic dogs; turn self/others into dogs/weredogs
weaknesses: Pro #3 used, when used on others, always requires touch (NCN)
Cannot astral-project a dog-spirit at will, until developed (NCN)
Cannot use star-based and dog-based parts of the power at the same time, until developed (NCN)

name: Master Of The Monkeys
description: When desired you are able to telepathically summon your personal army of 10000 monkeys to defeat your opponent.
summary: The ability to summon an army of monkeys at will.
strengths: You defeat people with your monkey army
You are able to call more monkeys to assist you from nearby zoos and jungles
Monkeys can help you with daily life e. G. Shopping, saving places/seats etc
weaknesses: The mokeys are evil and may turn against you.
You are resposible for keeping these monkeys alive and sheltered, which will be hard.
You have to clear up the monkey doo doo.

name: Musical Marionette
description: This ability involves a form of mass hypnosis, however it is still restricted by space and does not last very long. Essentially it creates a short, mini-musical around the wielder, forcing any within range to follow along with their whims in a jolly song and dance routine.
summary: The ability to spontaneously burst into song and dance, and everybody in a ten-meter radius joins in
strengths: Creates a great distraction
Humiliates enemies caught within range
Lifts moods
weaknesses: Not everyone can sing or dance
Can ruin a good night's sleep
Laryngitis

name: Severe Boomerangs
description: A person creates them from power of their mind. They appear in the person's hand, the person throws them at the target (or targets) causing the target or targets to have a headache, feel largely exhausted, and see 6 of the same person, or persons, with the whole dizzy feeling.
summary: The ability to project severe boomerangs
strengths: No need for guns when you have this deadly arsenal
Make Fools of Terrorists, Drug Lords, Dictators, and other deplorable Miscreants
Anything but ordinary boomerangs
weaknesses: People might get carried away using out of spite

name: Goldworks: Anansi's Spider
description: An ancient African story is one of Anansi the Spider. Anansi asked the spirits to give him the power of storytelling. The spirits agreed to give the spider the power if he captured three trouble-makers: the Python, the Leopard, and the Hornet. After doing this, he was granted the power of storytelling, through the power of illusion. Anansi focused this gift into a small golden spider statue. The wielder of this gains the power of illusion, and the ability to walk on vertical surfaces.
summary: The ability to wield the Spider of Anansi
strengths: Casting illusions and wallcrawling
You can also cause the spider to vanish, while still using it's powers
The spider's powers protect it, so it cannot be destroyed
weaknesses: The spider can be stolen and used by others.
Illusions are still just illusions

name: Myth Power: Styx Bond
description: Styx, in Greek myth, was the goddess of hatred, and Styx the Underworld River of Hate, by which the gods swore. As such, channeling her allows one to induce hatred at will. In addition, one is empowered by others' naturally occurring hate. Furthermore, one can subconsciously bend chance to his will, to fulfill any promise one makes, no matter what (in physical and mental capacity). And if others fail promises to the user, they instantly die (or are snatched up by the Furies into the underworld).
summary: The ability to channel Styx's command over the essence of hatred and the oath-binding Underworld River Styx
strengths: Induce, amplify, reduce, redirect, gain physical power from and negate hatred at will
Subconsicously manipulate chance to fulfill any promise in capacity (make it anywhere on time, etc)
If people go back on their word, they die, or get hoisted off to the Underworld (you choose)
weaknesses: Sometimes you can't choose to excuse broken promises
Can't apply Pro #2 to loved ones and allies until the higher levels (Con #1 becomes a real problem)
People with MythPowers based on Styx or Styx's Children (Cratos, Bia, Nike, Zelos) are immune

name: Myth Power: Hygeia's Hand
description: Hygeia (Hygea), in Greek myth, was the goddess of good health and hygiene. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive, repel and kill bacteria, viruses and other pathogens, at will. In addition, one can psychically produce a forcefield, which repels any projectile or attack with pathogens on it, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically induce a severe germophobia (fear of germs) in subjects, by touch, at will. One can even totally withstand pathogen-based illness and poisoning.
summary: The ability to channel Hygeia's command over the essence of good health and hygiene
strengths: Psychically perceive, repel and kill bacteria, viruses and other pathogens, at will
Psychically produce an anti-pathogen forcefield (keeps out nearly any physical attack) at will
Psychically turn foes into extreme germophobe; immunity to sickness, disease and poisoning
weaknesses: Sanitized and non-physical (energy-based, psychic) attacks can bypass anti-pathogen forcefield (NCN)
Cannot gain Immune Immortality (soul 'infects' ally, sneezed out as new body) until developed (NCN)
Medical/healing/restorative MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Nemesis Indignation
description: Nemesis, in Greek myth, was the goddess of divine indignation and retribution (hatred of, and punishment for, injustice). As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive subjects' overall moral alignment (and past actions reflecting those morals), by touch or thought. In addition, one can psychically perceive the foe's most recent evil act, and inflict misfortune according to the act's severity, by touch. One can even psychically summon an indestructible, prehensile bullwhip at will.
summary: The ability to channel Nemesis' command over the essence of divine indignation and retribution
strengths: Psychically perceive subjects' overall moral alignment (and past actions reflecting those morals)
Psychically perceive foe's most recent evil act, and inflict misfortune/harm based on act's severity
Psychically summon an indestructible, prehensile (grabbing) bullwhip at will
weaknesses: Only show foes their past evil actions, by touch/eye contact, to drive them mad when developed (NCN)
Presence does not intimidate evil foes, do not gain power against evil foes until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Nyx's Night-Shift, Zeus' Zenith and honestly-good moral alignment provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Phonos' Focus
description: Phonos (Phonus) and the Phonoi, in Greek myth, were the gods of murder, killing and slaughter. As such, channeling them allows one to generate a murderous impulse within others' minds, or quell this urge, by touch, word or thought. In addition, one gains a masterful knowledge of the arts of murder and assassination. One can even psychically perceive whenever a person is murdered in their radius, and who the murderer is (this radius is increased if one's loved ones are somehow involved).
summary: The ability to channel Phonos and the Phonoi's command over the essence of murder and the murder impulse
strengths: Fill subjects with the impulse to kill (and decide who the impulse is directed toward)
Quell the murder impulse within anyone (whether or not their impulse was caused by you)
Perceive any murder in radius (and see through the eyes of killers or their victims)
weaknesses: Cannot psychically summon common killing tools/weapons/implements until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Asclepius' Effect provides immunity allows one to disrupt this ability (NCN)
MythPower: Ker's Curse and MythPower: Thanatos' Threat provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Oizys' Omen
description: Oizys, in Greek myth, was the goddess of misery, suffering, sadness and woe. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive, induce, amplify, reduce, negate and withstand feelings of sadness and suffering at will. In addition, one may gain physical power in the presence of 'natural' sadness, misery and suffering. Furthermore, one may withstand and negate happiness or sadness based abilities. One may even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those currently feeling sad or miserable.
summary: The ability to channel Oizys' command over the essence of misery, sadness and woe
strengths: Induce, amplify, reduce, negate and withstand sadness at will; empowered by others' true sadness
Withstand and negate happiness or sadness based abilities
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those currently experiencing feelings of sadness
weaknesses: Cannot transfer one's own sadness onto others until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot choose to take on others' suffering or sadness until the higher levels (NCN)
Aniothability and sadness/grief/misery-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Myiagros' Meaning
description: Myiagros (Myiagrus, Myagros, Myagrus, Myiagron, Myodes, Myiodes, Achor, Achoros, Achorus, Akhoros) in Greek myth, was the god of flies and mice. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive, communicate with and command flies and mice at will. In addition, one can psychically mimic the features and abilities of a fly or mouse at will. Furthermore, one can project the illusory buzzing of flies or squeaking of mice into foes' minds, or ones' own mind (ie block telepathy), at will.
summary: The ability to channel Myiagros' command over the essence of flies and mice
strengths: Perceive, communicate with, command and mimic powers of flies and mice
Psychically project the buzzing of flies, squeaking of mice into foes minds (scare, distract, etc)
Psychically produce the buzzing of flies, squeaking of mice in one's own mind (block telepathy, etc)
weaknesses: Cannot astral-project a swarm of spirit-flies at will, until developed (NCN)
Cannot turn into a swarm of flies at will (others, by touch), until developed (NCN)
Cannot gain Fly-Swarm Immortality (spirit-flies released to form new body) until developed (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Muses' Mastery
description: The Titan Muses (Mousai/Mousae/Musae Titanides), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of various aspects of music. As such, channeling Melete (Practice), one can psychically perceive physical and mental flaws and errors, at will. Channeling Aiode (Aeode- Song), one can psychically access Perfect Pitch, and generate musical notes to manipulate matter, at will. Channeling Mneme (Memory), one can psychically record and replay any audio, as well as recalling lyrics to any song they hear, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Titan Muses and their command over various aspects of music
strengths: Psychically perceive physical and mental (ie logical and strategic) flaws and errors, at will
Psychically access Perfect Pitch, generate music notes to manipulate matter (ie F for Fire), at will
Psychically recall/remember any song lyrics one hears, record/play any audio one hears, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically practice (no physical strain, gain skills faster), until develop (NCN)
Cannot psychically teleport to any location where music is playing, until developed (NCN)
Sonic/music/song-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Twilight Power:Tactile Telepathy
description: Can see all the thoughts someone has ever had upon physical contact with them. The longer the contact, the more the user is able to see others' thoughts, and memories.
summary: The ability to read ALL thoughts.
strengths: Read every thought someones ever had.
weaknesses: Requires physical contact.
You may need bodyguards.

name: Myth Power: Muses' Missive
description: The Apollonid Muses (Mousai/Mousae/Musae Apollonides, Delphic Muses, Mousai/Mousae/Musae Delphikoi), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of musical notes. As such, channeling Nete (Low Notes), one can psychically perceive, generate and manipulate low frequencies, at will. Channeling Mese (Middle Notes), one can psychically perceive, generate and manipulate medium frequencies, at will. Channeling Hypate (High Notes), one can psychically perceive, generate and manipulate high frequencies, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Apollonid Muses' command over essence of musical notes
strengths: Psychically perceive, generate and manipulate sounds of your chosen frequency
Any sound-based powers you have are changed to the frequency you're currently attuned to
Users of MythPower: Apollo's Gift tend to act favorably toward you
weaknesses: Cannot gain Sonic Immunity and Protected Hearing until developed (NCN)
Sonokinesis, Sonic Absorption, Inaudibility, Protected Hearing, deafness, etc provide immunity (NCN)
Sonic/music/song-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Snap You're A Pokemon
description: With this power you can turn people into any Pokemon of your choice by just thinking of them as the desired Pokemon and you can turn them back by thinking of them as a person again
summary: The ability to turn people into Pokemon
strengths: You can turn people into Pokemon
weaknesses: You do not have control over them

name: Vanishing Blood
description: With this power the user can selected specific amounts of its blood and cause it to vanish out of existence with any other objects the blood is touching. This power is activated mentally by the user and only selected quantities of blood will vanish so that the users whole does not vanish. A speck of blood on a person could vanish to leave a hole the size of the blood drop.
summary: The ability to cause your blood to make objects vanish.
strengths: Use your blood to remove obstacles.
Vanish anything that causes you to bleed.
Can create a supply of your blood to use as a weapon.
weaknesses: Blood loss.
Have to be bleeding or have a supply of your blood.
If you are caused to lose control your whole body could vanish.

name: Myth Power: Graces' Greetings
description: These Charites (Kharites, Graces), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of lounging and social interaction. As such, channeling Philophrosyne (Welcome, Friendliness), one can generate a forcefield only loved ones/allies can enter. Channeling Antheia (Anthea, Anthia- Floral Arrangement), one can induce plant growth and speak to flowers. Channeling Pasithea (Rest, Hallucination, Prophetic Dreams), one can induce sleep and cast pleasant illusions, as well as withstand illusion and sleep/dream effects.
summary: The ability to channel the Charites' command over the essence of lounging and social interaction
strengths: Generate a forcefield impenetrable by anyone but loved ones/allies (not even Barrier Defiance)
Grow and communicate with plants/flowers; when developed, compel plants via verbal Agrokinesis
Induce sleep and cast pleasant illusions; withstand illusion and sleep/dream manipulation
weaknesses: Only generate a whole DIMENSION impenetrable by anyone but loved ones/allies at higher levels (NCN)
Only withstand impact/environmental factors/bodily needs when tired at the higher levels (NCN)
Only withstand need for natural sleep (and gain/bestow prophetic dreams) at the higher levels (NCN)

name: Lord Of The Flies
description: This power allows the user to summon and control swarms of flies. The user can use these flies to spread plagues,whether they be normal diseases (such as typhoid, onchocerciasis, and leprosy) or negative emotions(plagues of fear, hatred, and paranoia).
summary: The ability to produce and controll swarms of flies.
strengths: Induce diseases and paranoia.
Create a cloud of buzzing flies to blind opponants.
weaknesses: The flies can be killed.
You are not immune to the effects of diseas, or the ensueing witch-hunt.

name: Genre Savvy
description: A person with this power knows every single plot twist in the book and will not fall for them. For example, they immediately know when someone is under mind control and can see through disguises immediately. In addition they can exploit any trope that they find to great success. For example, if they save someone that person will eventually help him/her later etc. For more examples on how to use this power go to tvtropes.com
summary: The ability to be incredibly genre savvy
strengths: Don't fall for stupid plot twists
Come up with ideas that work due to the use of tropes
Don't have to obey the rules of plot
weaknesses: Not everyone listens to you

name: Induce Tickling
description: Using your mind, you can excite your enemy's nerves to such an extent that they fall onto the ground in helpless laughter for as long as you concentrate on them. This power only works on one person at a time and will abruptly halt when it is used on another.
summary: The ability to disable your enemy from within
strengths: Humiliate your attacker
Good at birthday parties
Makes you the center of attention
weaknesses: Makes you far more sensitive to the same trick
Opponents will be more inclined to retaliate
Requires intense concentration

name: Lord Of Tunes
description: Broken your iPod, mp3 player, radio or computer? Well, now all you need is your mind to play tunes. This power lets the user play music in their head and broadcast it to make it sound like a radio.
summary: The ability to broadcast music
strengths: No need for eletricity.
Can take the place of sterios at the party
Completely controlable
weaknesses: Might bother other people.

name: Myth Power: Ponos' Punishment
description: Ponos (or Ponus), in Greek myth, was the god of back-breaking hard labor, and exhausting toil. As such, channeling him allows one to produce an aura at will, which has two effects. Primarily, it gifts the user with infinite stamina, by supernaturally "shedding" exhaustion; in addition, when in proximity of foes, the aura transfers the user's exhaustion on to any subjects present with hostile intent toward him. One can also psychically perceive, communicate with and compel naturally hard workers.
summary: The ability to channel Ponos' command over the essence of painful toil and back-breaking hard labor
strengths: Infinite stamina at will (immunity to fatigue and exhaustion; run at top speed as long as you want)
Gain all the health benefits of strenuous exercise and hard labor, while foes take the fatigue
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel naturally hard workers (and workaholics)
weaknesses: Non-hard-workers may also be compelled, but ONLY to do hard labor in physical capacity (NCN)
People with Superhuman Durability, Superhuman Stamina, Invulnerability or the like are immune
People with MythPower: Eris' Enmity are immune to this ability

name: Personality Absorber
description: Whenever someone's soul or astral body gets too close to you, you can completely absorb that person's consciousness into yours, leaving their original body as an empty shell. From now on, that person will manifest themself as one of your alternate personalities, keeping their thoughts, behaviour, memory, personality and superpower if they had one. The powers you acquired this way can only only be activated when their owner's personality emerges, therefore making your personality dormant
summary: The ability to absorb a person's psyche and manifest them as an alternate personality.
strengths: You can absorb superpowers!
Ghosts of deceased people can live again through you.
You can trap astral bodies.
weaknesses: You will develop a dissociative identity disorder.
You only have access to an absorbed power when the owner's personality takes control of your body.
People with Astral Projection could leave your body if they manage to take control of it.

name: Myth Power: Prometheus' Plan
description: Prometheus (Prometheos), in Greek myth, was the Titan god of forethought, or planning ahead. As such, channeling him allows one to induce and amplify meticulous thought and consideration in others (making subjects consider so deeply what could go wrong with their ideas that they cannot function). In addition, one may psychically perceive a subject's future plans by touch, word or thought. One may even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those who are naturally meticulous thinkers.
summary: The ability to channel Prometheus' command over the essence of forethought
strengths: Induce and amplify extremely meticulous thought (foes become unable to function effectively)
Psychically perceive a subject's plans for the future by touch, word or thought
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel naturally meticulous thinkers
weaknesses: People with mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory based MythPowers are immune to this ability
People with MythPower: Iapetos' Scorn are immune to this ability
At the lower levels, this ability may affect one's personality

name: Myth Power: Coalemos' Code
description: Coalemos (Coalemus, Koalemos), in Greek myth, was the god of stupidity, ignorance and foolishness. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive subjects' intelligence (IQ) at will. In addition, one can psychically reduce subjects' intelligence (IQ), by touch. Furthermore, new knowledge erased from subjects' minds may be psychically absorbed and kept for oneself, while the rest is psychically discarded. One can withstand intelligence-reducing effects, which may be shared, by touch.
summary: The ability to channel Coalemos' command over the essence of ignorance, stupidity and foolishness
strengths: Psychically perceive subjects' IQs, at will; psychically reduce their IQs, by touch
New knowledge erased from subjects' minds may be absorbed and kept for oneself, at will
Withstand intelligence-reducing effects, which may be shared, by touch
weaknesses: Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with and compel stupid people until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically shift physics to adhere to 'Stupid Logic' until developed (NCN)
Mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Echo Echo
description: Echo (Ekho), in Greek myth, was the goddess of echoes. As such, channeling her allows one to perfectly mimic any sound at will, after hearing it once. In addition, with a touch, a word or a thought, one may afflict subjects with echolalia, in which they can neither speak BEFORE anybody else has spoken, nor be silent AFTER anybody else has spoken. Furthermore, when one speaks questions into echoing areas, the echoes will utter answers to those questions, rather than simply repeating the user.
summary: The ability to channel Echo's command over the essence of echoes
strengths: Perfect Sound/Vocal Mimicry (even numerous sounds at once); gain superhuman ventriloquism powers
Afflict subjects with echolalia (forced to repeat what others say; PERFECT for blackmail, etc)
When speaking questions into areas that echo, the echoes will utter answers to those questions
weaknesses: Pro #1 only applies to vocal powers (Sonic Scream, Psychic Persuasion, etc) at the higher levels
Cannot cause thoughts to loudly echo in subjects' minds (Psychic Echo) until the higher levels (NCN)
Mimesis and sound/noise/silence-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Televangelism
description: Simply point to person and say, "The Lord wants you to give me money! " They will then give you all that they have, and go get more if you want them to.
summary: The ability to get money from people by saying "The Lord wants you to give me money! "
strengths: You have an unlimited supply of money as long as there are Christians around.
It's not CrackTart.
weaknesses: Not much use in combat.
Well, it's not CrackTart...

name: Cat's Eyes
description: You can tap into the network of feline minds and see what they see. Can also see things that cats have seen by looking at the particular cat in the eye.
summary: The ability to see through the eyes of a cat, any cat.
strengths: Can solve crimes by looking in the eyes of feline "witnesses".
Can observe other people/events without being physically there.
weaknesses: Can only see things within the cat's vision range.
Empathic feedback: if the cat you're looking through gets hurt, you get hurt too.

name: Myth Power: Arete's Excellence
description: Arete, in Greek myth, was the goddess of excellence, virtue, honor, valor (bravery and courage) and prestige. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive subjects' morals, as well as the extent of their valor, at will. In addition, one can gain physical power from feeling fear, worry and doubt. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel experts; those considered the best at what they do (fighters, singers, scientists, artists, politicians, athletes, etc).
summary: The ability to channel Arete's command over the essence of virtue, excellence and valor
strengths: Psychically perceive subjects' morals, and the extent of their valor (bravery/courage)
Gain physical power when one feels fear, worry or doubt (natural or projected)
Perceive, communicate with and compel those who are talented/experts/role models in their field
weaknesses: Pro #2 does not completely PREVENT the feeling of fear/dread/doubt until developed (NCN)
Pro #2 only uses one's own fear; No enhanced damage against dishonorable foes until developed (NCN)
Cannot gain enhancement of one's natural skills until developed (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Comos' Charisma
description: Comos (Comus, Komos), in Greek myth, was the god of revelry, celebration, merrymaking and festivity. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive the dates/customs of any holiday/special event, at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive communicate with and compel anyone born on the day of power use, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically induce an overwhelming urge to party, by touch. One can even psychically summon gifts, and weaponized party decorations, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Comos' command over the essence of revelry, merrymaking and festivity
strengths: Psychically perceive the dates/customs of any holiday/special event (even birthdays, etc) at will
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel anyone born on day of power use
Psychically induce overwhelming urge to party; summon random gifts and weaponized party favors
weaknesses: Cannot withstand fatigue and negative drinking/drug effects (shared by touch), until developed (NCN)
Cannot teleport/time travel to parties (and gain physical power at parties) until developed (NCN)
Cannot banish party crashers to the Underworld until developed (NCN)

name: Synesthesia
description: Synesthesia is a great gift. It allows the user to perceive sound as color. This lets them easily discern musical key, or see differing pitches as color, or even different timbres as different colors. This ability can prove a bit vexing if the user is asked to identify a red object while listening to a blue pitch, or if a sound is so loud it makes them go blind.
summary: The ability to have mildly crosswired senses
strengths: Easily identify key
Adds an extra dimension to perception of music
Really fun to have
weaknesses: Being blinded by sound
Considered a bit strange
Arguing with other synesthetes over perceived colors

name: Arcana: 10 The Wheel Of Change
description: A person with this power is the bane of reliability. This power creates a aura around a person that cause everything to flux and change. Superpowers may become stronger or weaker, or change function entirely. People may become happy, sad, excited, scared, all emotions and thoughts in flux. Probability is warped as the unlikely becomes likely and vice versa. The only one immune it the person with this power themselves. This power is difficult to shut off- if it can be at all.
summary: The ability to cause things and people around you to be in constant flux.
strengths: Send your enemies into chaos.
Win money in Vegas.
weaknesses: Power also affects allies.
May empower enemies
Totally random

name: Myth Power: Oxylus' Option
description: Oxylus (Oxylos), in Greek myth, was the god of mountain forests. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically generate and manipulate plants indigenous to mountains at will. In addition, one may cast the illusion of being high on a mountain top at will. Furthermore, one gains adaptation to survive on any mountain (enhanced toughness, cold immunity, adapted respiration, etc), which may be shared by touch. One can even teleport (self or others) to or from any mountain in the Cosmos at will.
summary: The ability to channel Oxylus' command over the essence of mountain forests
strengths: Generate and manipulate mountain plants and trees at will; cast illusions of being on a mountaintop
Teleport to/survive on mountains (enhanced toughness and respiration, cold/wind immunity, etc)
Share Montane Adaptation (adaptation to survive mountain conditions) by a touch
weaknesses: Cannot turn subjects into trees indigenous to mountains with a touch until the higher levels (NCN)
People with agrokinetic MythPowers are immune to being turned into mountain trees
People with MythPower: Honor of the Ourea can resist being teleported to a mountain

name: Myth Power: Penia's Penalty
description: Penia, in Greek myth, was the goddess of poverty, penury and neediness. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive how much money anybody has on them at any given time, at will. In addition, one can compel subjects to give away all of their money and valuable possessions to any person or organization that one desires. One can even compel foes to destroy their valuable items at will. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive, communicate with, and compel the poor and the homeless at will.
summary: The ability to channel Penia's command over the essence of poverty, penury and the poor
strengths: Perceive how much money subjects have; perceive, communicate with and compel the poor/homeless
Compel subjects to give away their valuables at will (to you, friends, charity or the like)
Compel subjects to destroy their valuables at will
weaknesses: If people ever learn about your power, they'll likely expect you to help end poverty
People with MythPower: Plutos' Bounty are immune to this ability
People with MythPowers based on Penia's sisters are immune to this ability (and vice versa)

name: Old One Power: Nyarlathotep
description: Messenger of the Outer Gods, Nyarlathotep. While Nyarlathotep incarnates in various avatars known as "masks" to do the bidding of the other Outer Gods, you are limited to one body, but do gain his many forms. Many are useful for combat, but the more powerful your new shape, the more uncontrollable the destruction. You also gain his mastery of telepathic communication, though no mind-reading, and a genius mind geared towards long-reaching and complicated plans of manipulation.
summary: The ability to channel the power of the Outer God Nyarlathotep
strengths: Telepathy, limited shapeshifting (limited to 999 forms), and the brain power to use it.
Nyarlathotep also has plans and pawns EVERYWHERE, who will act favorably towards you.
If manipulation doesn't work, the shapeshifting can blast someone's sanity, and packs a punch.
weaknesses: Your descent into sadism and hatred is inevitable. There is no arguing or avoiding it.
On the best of days, Nyarlathotep considers you a valuable pawn. On the worst, an obstruction.
Unless they directly oppose you, other Old One Powers users can command you.

name: Coupon Authenticity
description: The ability to make other people believe that your expired or fake coupons are real and be able to use them to acquire things. Extremely unrealistic coupons may get noticed unless you attempt to persuade that they are real. People with psychic powers may be immune to this power. After you use the coupon, it might be hard to explain how you got whatever you used the coupon for.
summary: The ability to make expired or fake coupons real and useable.
strengths: Really good deals.
Trick people into giving you their stuff.
Those "free kiss" coupons.
weaknesses: If it's extremely unrealistic, it might get noticed.
Psychics are immune to this trick.
Explaining how you got so much stuff.

name: The Trollforce Master
description: This force can be used in two major ways. The first is for actual trolling. Besides being granted major manipulation and computer skills, the trollforce can be used to read minds and control computers. But it can also be used to create 'epic' real life 'trolls'. Though its preferred form is in standard psychic (particularly telepathic) powers and trickster magic. The catch is that it must be recharged through actual trolling if you use it for non-trolling.
summary: The ability to control the force behind trolling and Schadenfreude
strengths: Become a legend wherever you go, for bringing devestation through manipulation
Have the powers of Professor X and Mr. Mxyzptlk, particularly if you're just wreaking havoc
Manipulative and computer skills for free! The manipulation/computer powers are recharged easily
weaknesses: While the lighter effects may only require browsing the internet and enjoying the works of others,
The really dramatic stuff requires you to pull very epic (and hurtful) trolls
People will hate (and possibly even fear) you if you can't hide the way you charge your powers

name: Myth Power: Ecomene's Example
description: Ecomene (Oikoumene, Oecomene, Oecoumene, Ecoumene), in Greek myth, was the goddess of the inhabited world. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive anywhere on the planet inhabited by sentient subjects. In addition, one can psychically teleport anywhere on the planet inhabited by sentient subjects. One can even psychically tap into the collective unconscious (mental reserve of knowledge, thoughts, emotions, dreams, memories and raw psychic power) of the inhabited world at will.
summary: The ability to channel Ecomene's command over the essence of the inhabited world
strengths: Psychically perceive anywhere on the planet inhabited by sentient beings
Psychically teleport self/others anywhere on the planet inhabited by sentient beings
Psychically tap into the collective unconscious (psychic reservoir) of the inhabited world at will
weaknesses: Places for Pro #1 and Pro #2 require at least one sentient being at the target destination (NCN)
Pro #3 only allows enhancement of any psychic abilities one ALREADY possesses until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Demos' Demeanor, etc provides immunity (NCN)

name: Summon Kruai
description: Kruai are 6 and a half feet tall. They look like scaly monkeys. Kruai can shape their hatred of non-kystians into solid melee weapons of emotional energy. Impenetrable forcefield, anti-telepathy and psionic armor will block the attack. Someone who can absorb emotions will temporarily disrupt this power. The weapon will otherwise ignore armor and normal forcefields cutting through any solid foe. Kruai can lift 10 tons and run 40 mph. Kruai are summoned with regular weapons.
summary: The ability to summon a hate-based weaponsmaster Kystian.
strengths: The melee weapons can be anything. Whip, katana, pole arm,etc.
Kruai can use two weapons at the same time.
Kruai are summoned with weapons to deal with foes immune to its special ability.
weaknesses: Emotion-based powers can manipulate the weapons

name: Liquoromancy
description: This way of the seeing the future was first thought of by someone only known as WHD. This is how the power works. The number of shots you pour determines how many questions you can get a yes or no answer to and how many days you can see in the future. You have to down all the shots in rapid succession or you get no questions answered. Cheap or bad liquor reduces the chances to get a correct answer. Good moonshine or a aged liquor will give best chances to get a correct answer.
summary: The ability to see the know the future by pouring shots.
strengths: One question and one day into the future for each shot of liquor.
If you can't get drunk.
You can get your hands on some good moonshine or aged liquor.
weaknesses: You can't/won't drink liquor.
You're underaged.

name: Myth Power: Ate's Attitude
description: Ate, in Greek myth, was the goddess of evil, mischief, ruin and delusion (infatuation, blind folly, naivete, rash choices, etc). As such, channeling her allows one to psychically induce false comfort, by touch. In addition, one can psychically act as a subject's conscience, by touch, word or thought; subjects will follow any naive or unwise suggestion one gives. One can even psychically take on one other deceptive ability (Shapeshifting, Illusion Casting, etc) to cause mischief with, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Ate's command over the essence of evil, mischief, ruin and delusion
strengths: Induce false comfort by touch (subjects will trust you)
Act as a subject's conscience by touch, word or thought; they will take any detrimental suggestions
Take on one other mischievous, deceptive ability (Vocal Mimicry, Ventriloquism, Invisibility, etc)
weaknesses: Pro #3 only allows use of one extra deceptive/mischievous power at a time until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Eris' Enmity and MythPower: Thrasos' Thrill provide immunity (NCN)
Law/order/justice-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Meiboia's Measure
description: Meiboia, in Greek myth, was the goddess of bees. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive, communicate with and command bees at will. In addition, one can psychically mimic the features and abilities of a bee at will. Furthermore, one can generate sonic force, or hypnotic influence, from one's wings, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically convert liquids into edible honey, by touch. One can even psychically convert neutrals into a user-dominated hive mind, by touch, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Meiboia's command over the essence of bees
strengths: Perceive, communicate with, command and mimic powers of bees
Generate sonic or hypnotic effects from one's wings, convert liquids into honey (by touch), at will
Psychically assimilate neutrals into a user-dominated hive-mind, by touch, at will
weaknesses: Cannot astral-project a hive of spirit-bees at will, until developed (NCN)
Cannot turn into a swarm of bees at will (or generate beeswax from hands) until developed (NCN)
Cannot gain Bee-Swarm Immortality (spirit-bees released to form new body) until developed (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Train Of Erotes6
description: The Erotes, in Greek myth, were the gods of various aspects of love and relationships. As such, channeling Hymenaios (Hymenaeus, Hymen- Marriage, the Wedding Ceremony and the Wedding Song), one can sense if a subject is destined to be married, to whom, and many other facts about people's marriages. In addition, one can psionically produce a wedding song that affects subjects based on their marital (marriage) status. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive and communicate with married people.
summary: The ability to channel the Erotes' command over the essence of love, sexuality and relationships
strengths: Psychically perceive if a subject will ever get married, as well as to whom and other marriage info
Psionic Marriage Song (UNMARRIED: strengthen allies, weaken foes; MARRIED: damage foes, heal allies)
Psychically perceive, communicate with and (when developed) compel married subjects
weaknesses: Cannot form a positive psychic link with one's married spouse until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Aphrodisia, MythPower: Arrows of Eros and MythPower: Oath of Ouranos provide immunity
Empathic Backlash or similar emotion-resistant abilities provide immunity

name: Myth Power: Penthus' Penance
description: Penthus (Penthos), in Greek myth, was the god of grief (grieving), mourning, and lamentation (crying). As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive and remind subjects of past traumas, sorrows and regrets, at will. In addition, one can psychically suppress traumas, sorrows, grief and regrets of self and others at will. Furthermore, one can psychically induce uncontrollable crying, at will. One can even psychically teleport to the site of any intense psychological trauma, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Penthus' command over the essence of depression, grief, mourning and lamentation
strengths: Psychically perceive and remind subjects of past traumas/sorrows/regrets of others at will
Psychically uncontrollable crying by a touch, a word or a thought
Psychically teleport to the site of any intense trauma, at will
weaknesses: Cannot perceive, communicate with and compel unhappy/depressed/crying people until developed (NCN)
Pro #3 works best when combined with the perception-based part of Pro #1
Aniothability or sadness/grief/misery-based abilities provide immunity (NCN)

name: Angelic Hierarchy: Angels
description: The Angel, also recognized as the Malakhim, is the most common celestial being in the Angelic Hierarchy. The Angels are the ones most concerned with the affairs of living things. Within the category of angels, they have many functions as there are many different types. The Angels are mainly sent as messengers to mankind. Angels have been perceived as humans with a pair of white feathered wings.
summary: The ability to become the lowest ranking angel in the Angelic Hierarchy.
strengths: Utilize pure light as offense and defense.
Take off to the skies at magnificent speeds.
weaknesses: Limited amount of abilities.
Lowest order of angels in the hierarchy.

name: Consumptive Psychometry
description: Anything that you eat, you will know the past events that have occurred to it (prior to it being eaten). When developed, you can learn something's past by just licking or biting it.
summary: The ability to know the past events that have occured to something by eating it
strengths: Forensics will be a lot easier, but it is definitely disgusting to eat a corpse.
Find out how hot dogs are REALLY made
Find out the Colonel's secret recipe and have the KFC food chain at your mercy
weaknesses: Sharp, pointy, foods will still hurt.
Eating a hamburger will give you knowledge of the lives of a cow and wheat from their perspective.

name: End Dream
description: Has this ever happened to you? You're having a terrible nightmare, and you want to wake up, but it's just not happening? Well with this power you can instantly end any nightmare. You can also end dreams.
summary: The ability to stop any nightmare
strengths: Can end any nightmare (immunity to dream manipulation)
Can end any dream (wake up on time for work and the like; also works on daydreams)
If your power develops, can also end others' dreams
weaknesses: Sometime your power develops so you can only end OTHER people's dreams
Not quite the same as Lucid Dreaming (can't change dreams other than ENDING them)

name: Myth Power: Angelia's Angle
description: Angelia, in Greek myth, was the goddess of news, tidings, messages, declarations and announcements. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive whenever good or bad news arises (for oneself or those to whom one is connected; loved ones, enemies, etc). In addition, one may psychically communicate with others, over long distances, as though the sender and intended recipient were right next to one another; one can also withstand Telepathy. One may even sprout wings and fly at will.
summary: The ability to channel Angelia's command over the essence of news, messages, announcements and declarations
strengths: Psychically perceive whenever news arises pertaining to self, loved ones, allies and foes
Psychically communicate with intended subjects, as though in person (Telepresence), at will
Withstand Telepathy; sprout wings and fly at will
weaknesses: Bad news (duh); cannot keep psychically prevent subjects from relaying news until developed (NCN)
Wings do not gain Superhuman Strength until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Hermes' Hustle provides immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Eupraxia's Practice
description: Eupraxia, in Greek myth, was the goddess of success, especially that which results from good deeds. As such, channeling her allows one to gain increased fortune by doing good deeds (regardless of one's morals or one's attitude while doing the good deed). In addition, one can do enhanced damage to any foe who has done fewer good deeds than they have in the last 24 hours. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and gain good fortune in the presence of those who wish for his success.
summary: The ability to channel Eupraxia's command over the essence of good deeds and success
strengths: Gain increased fortune (luck) by doing good deeds
Enhance damage done to foes by doing more good deeds than they do in a 24-hr period
Psychically perceive, communicate with and gain good luck around subjects who wish for your success
weaknesses: Cannot psychically perceive or communicate with the successful until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive how to bring about (or prevent) success until the higher levels (NCN)
Law/order/justice-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Ghost Of Bats
description: Everyone has potential psionic abilities. The Ghost of Bats can sink their teeth into any sentient being and drain psionic power. If a person already displays their power, telepathy, telekinesis, pyrokinesis etc. You rob them of their power. Stolen abilities last longer but potential psionic energy taste better.
summary: The ability to be a psionic vampire
strengths: Potentially gain a host of psionic, psychic abilities
Stealth; exist between the astral & physical plane, intangibility & phasing may be possible
Every psychic meal taste different & gives you an addictive rush so you never get bored
weaknesses: Unhinging your jaw and sinking your enlarged canines into people's skulls leaves brain dead victims
You will never eat normal food again; you only eat potential or existing mental power
In a few hours stolen mental abilities begins to fade & you begin to hunger for more graymatter

name: Myth Power: Metis' Method
description: Metis, in Greek myth, was the Titan goddess of wisdom, wise counsel and prudence. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically access superhuman wisdom, at will, as well as withstand effects which reduce one's wise judgment. In addition, one can psychically perceive and communicate with those one considers wise (or their spirit, if they've died), at will. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive the future. One can even psychically compel subjects to do anything considered wise, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Metis' command over the essence of wisdom and wise counsel (good advice)
strengths: Psychically access superhuman wisdom, at will; withstand effects that can reduce one's wise judgment
Psychically perceive and communicate with anyone one considers wise (if dead, contact their spirit)
Psychically perceive the future; psyhically compel subjects to do wise things, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically summon a psionic manifestation of one's conscience, until developed (NCN)
Mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith provides immunity (NCN)

name: Text Messaging Telepathy
description: With this ability you can communicate with other minds just like any other telepath. However, your telepathy has a slight hitch. All the messages that you produce and receive will be expressed in TXT language, the shorthand "language" that texters use to communicate quickly.
summary: The ability to communicate in TXT telepathically
strengths: Most of the same capabilities of normal Telepathy
You can do it anytime you want.
You can also do it while you are asleep (called Dream Text Telepathy).
weaknesses: It may give you headaches to have to to deal with all that TXT all the time.
No visual illusions may be produced, except to physically depict spellings of text messages

name: Myth Power: Ktisis' Ticket
description: Ktisis (Ctisis), in Greek myth, was the goddess of conquest, acquisition, possession and foundation of establishments. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive when any building was built or established, by touch. In addition, one can psychically 'claim' objects, by touch; one can telekinetically manipulate claimed objects, and psychically track them at will. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and channel knowledge, skills and powers of conquerors at will.
summary: The ability to channel Ktisis' command over the essence of conquest, acquisition, possession, foundation
strengths: Psychically perceive a building's founding date, by touch
Psychically 'claim' objects by touch; track and telekinetically manipulate claimed objects
Psychically perceive, communicate with and channel knowledge/skills/powers of conquerors
weaknesses: Cannot use Pro #1 to Time Travel to a building's founding date until the higher levels (NCN)
Larger objects are more difficult (and take longer) to 'claim' until developed (NCN)
Pro #2 does not apply to mental/physically 'claim' living subjects until developed (NCN)

name: Feng Shui Yo Yo
description: Most often referred to simply as 'killer yo-yo' it may looked harmless at first, but it can be tricky & lethal, you can use whatever trick is possible with the yo-yo such as the throw sleep, loop grab, whip off-string, freehand slam and zero-g swing. You can also transfom it into a variety of psychic weapons like a circular psychic buzzsaw comes out of it, a meteor hammer, or a morning star (mace). The yo-yo also flashes while it is being used.
summary: The ability to use it to cause the spool to strike your foes with it.
strengths: With the yo-yo, you can could excite the pain receptors in your foes.
The yo-yo could cause your victim to become stunned, or even killed.
weaknesses: None.

name: Guilty As Charged
description: The power to mentally create emotional distress (like guilt, depression and fear) in others.  Using this power too much can cause you to become overwhelmed with emotion.
summary: The ability to create emotional distress
strengths: Distracts enemies
Weakness to enemies
weaknesses: Too much can overwhelm your emotional feelings

name: Twilight Power: Mental Shield
description: This shield blocks powers having to do with the mind, Telepathy, Mind Control, etc.  The user can also expand the shield, starts at twenty yards, expands twenty yards per 200 uses. When the user expands the shield they gain a secondary shield around them personally. This power is useless against physical attacks.
summary: The ability to shield your mind.
strengths: Anti Mental Powers.
Shielding Allies.
Evolves to become stronger.
weaknesses: Physical Attacks.
People can leave the shield.
Slow ability evolution.

name: Barnacle
description: With this ability you can create agressively spreading mutant barnacle-like creatures that quicky cover surrounding areas and people, trapping them. Also allows for the creation of single special barnacles that when attached to a target's head gives you control of them much like a puppeteer has control of a puppet. The target will move with little grace or control, like a zombie. This mind control is limited and only works on a few people at a time.
summary: The ability to create and spread mutant barnacles onto anything and anyone
strengths: Trap your enemies
Control a few people at a time
weaknesses: Barnacles(although mutated) die quickly out of water

name: To Fyuron To Biographicon
description: When you say "Adeat", a bookmark and a collection of books that have biographies of anybody you've ever met appear. When you place the bookmark inside a book and slide it out, you can become a clone of the person the book belongs too. You can also completely become a person (thoughts, emotions, memories, personality, etc. ) for a full 10 minutes.
summary: The ability to summon a collection of books that can be used to copy anybody you've met.
strengths: Can copy the person's powers when you transform into them.
weaknesses: You can only be a person who's stronger than you for a few minutes.
If you ever completely become a person, you can never become them again.

name: Myth Power: Amphilogia's Ambush
description: Amphilogia (Amphillogia) and the Amphilogiae (Amphilogiai, Amphillogiae, Amphillogiai), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of dispute, debate controversy and other unclear words. As such, channeling them allows one to gain skill in using clever double-speak to outwit subjects. In addition, any statement one disagrees with may be converted into a psionic blast that may be turned back on whoever said it. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel naturally argumentative people.
summary: The ability to channel Amphilogia and the Amphilogiae's command over the essence of dispute and disagreement
strengths: Gain skill in using clever double-speak to confuse and outwit subjects, and win arguments
Any subject one disagrees with may be turned into a psionic blast to harm the subject who spoke it
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel naturally controversial and argumentative people
weaknesses: Cannot make a subject forget their point in an argument, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot use Pro #2 to harm anyone other than the controversial speaker, until developed (NCN)
Mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Transformers: Shockwave
description: With this power you are able to contemplate every situation and scenario logically, when making decisions you are not affected by emotions or personal bias but only by what makes the most logical sense. An unfortunate side effect of this power is that if you use it too much you start to actually lose your emotions.
summary: The ability to think through every situation logically
strengths: You are able to think through every situation logically
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat
You may start to lose your emotions

name: Miracle: Duplication Of Loaves
description: With this power you can't really duplicate loaves but you can encourage people to share more often so it looks like everyone has more. Against someone who feeds on negative emotions exposure to this ability hurts--akin to healing zombies.
summary: The ability to induce people to share more often
strengths: Help a Scrooge donate
"Sharing is Caring"
Hurts people who rely on negative emotions to win
weaknesses: No offensive capability (except hurting those who require negative emotions)

name: Myth Power: Poros' Provision
description: Poros, in Greek myth, was the god of expediency, the tactics taken to provide for self and loved ones. As such, channeling him allows one to perceive the needs and desires of one's loved ones (family and friends). In addition, one can psychically perceive the steps to take which will allow one to most efficiently achieve the means to provide what one's loved ones want. This includes the most efficient way to commit crimes without leaving evidence or getting caught.
summary: The ability to channel Poros command over the essence of expediency, contrivance and provision
strengths: Perceive the wants and desires of loved ones
Perceive the most efficient way to go about obtaining the desires of self, loved ones and allies
If one wants something only possible by crime, perceive how to efficiently get away with it
weaknesses: Planning efficiency grows with practice; no widescale planning until higher levels (no Con Negation)
People with MythPower: Penia's Penalty are immune to this ability
People with justice/law/morals-based MythPowers can still sense your crimes

name: Myth Power: Rhea's Nurture
description: Rhea, in Greek myth, was the Titan goddess of flow, fertility and generation. As such, channeling her allows one to induce and manipulate fertility in soil, plants, animals and people (to make a sterile man virile, make a barren woman fertile, fertilize soil, etc). In addition, one can perceive his generations (if he will have children; their genetic traits, thoughts, emotions, etc). One can even manipulate flow (that of blood, water, mother's milk, energy, etc; at the higher levels, even time).
summary: The ability to channel Rhea's command over the essence of flow, fertility and generation (reproduction)
strengths: Induce, amplify, reduce, and negate fertility at will; immune to Olympian MythPowers
Perceive one's past/future generations (location, genetic traits, thoughts, emotions, etc)
Manipulate flow of wind, water, milk, blood, energy, etc; at higher level, even time; gain Longevity
weaknesses: Cannot share Longevity, or gain/bestow Immortality until the highest levels (no Con Negation)
Also perceive barrenness/infertility/sterility, future/past adoptions, abortions and miscarriages
People with MythPower: Kronos' Craft are immune to this ability (and it doesn't allow time travel)

name: Living Laundromat
description: With this ability, you can clean clothes with your mind. You never have to go to the laundromat ever again. You can even clean the clothes you are wearing.
summary: The ability to clean clothes with your mind.
strengths: Clean clothes with your mind.
Save money.
Never go to the laundromat again.
weaknesses: You still have to fold the clothes.
You still have to organize your closet.
You still have to do other things.

name: Secret Keeper
description: If you have this power, you will never be forced to reveal any secret you know, unless the person you are telling already knows. Right before you attempt to reveal the secret, you will forget completely about it. When you are no longer in the situation where you would reveal the secret, the memory of the secret comes back to you. This power works automatically for any secret you know.
summary: The ability to always keep secrets by forgetting them before you can reveal the secret.
strengths: Never accidentally reveal secrets again.
Not even torture can make you reveal the secret.
Would become a great government intel keeper.
weaknesses: Works without your control.
If you are tortured, you cannot give up the information.
May forget things temporarily that you want to remember

name: Petulance
description: Everyone has pet peeves. So if you use this power on someone, every little thing will annoy & piss them off to the breaking point of extreme irritation, aggravation & frustration. Causing them to flip out. They'll either go berserk on something or someone or just become hysterically crazy.
summary: The ability to induce extreme annoyance & frustration into someone
strengths: Induce P.O.ness x1000 in someone
Cause them to become a crazed berserking animal once they reach a breaking point
weaknesses: Don't want to be around once they go all psycho hopped up on PCP

name: Myth Power: Eunomia's Notice
description: Eunomia, in Greek myth, was the goddess of lawful conduct and following rules. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive the law of whatever land they currently reside in (as well as bring said laws to others' minds at will). In addition, one can compel subjects to do nearly anything, so long as it is legal, as well as withstanding and negating illegal compulsions. One can even mark a foe as a target, by touch; if he breaks any laws, all neutrals in vicinity will turn on/attack him.
summary: The ability to channel Eunomia's command over the essence over good order and lawful behavior
strengths: Perceive the law of the land; remind others of them at will
Induce law-abiding compulsions (and negate law-breaking ones)
Mark a foe (by touch); if he breaks a law, or a moral convention, neutrals will turn against him
weaknesses: Only teleport self/others to lands with laws closely fitting one's morals at the higher levels (NCN)
Maybe feel bad about MAKING others do the right thing; Immoral compulsions fail automatically
Sin/injustice/corruption-based MythPowers and MythPower: Zeus' Zenith provide immunity (NCN)

name: Noel Organon
description: With this power you can extend and control harp strings from your fingers. The strings are near invisible to the human eye. The strings can slice through most objects easily. The user can make the strings vibrate when they are attached to something to create music. The music has the effect of causing paralysis in whoever feels the vibrations. The user can decide who gets paralyzed. Those affected are also paralyzed in the mind and will have a harder time thinking. Many strings can be made.
summary: The ability to create harp strings from your fingers.
strengths: Harp strings can slice through most objects.
Music causes paralysis in selected targets.
Can have as many strings as you are able to control.
weaknesses: Very difficult to control the strings precisely.
Sound powers could negate or reverse the music.
Those with enhanced sight could advoid the strings.

name: Proximity High
description: Just by being within a certain distance, people around you will become high. The drawback is you suffer by being in a constant high. Drugs work oppositely for you, they make you sober.
summary: The ability to make people go into an altered state of mind while in proximity
strengths: Makes people around you high
Can be used to disorientate
weaknesses: Costly if you want to be normal
People will be high around you
Hallucinations

name: Make 'em  Sing And Dance
description: This power,also called The Glee Effect,mentally compels any foe or foes as soon as they can see you to dance and sing instead of walking and talking. If their not moving they will dance in one spot. Foes can defend themselves from your attacks but they must use dance moves to do so. Foes can attack you but will always dance when they do. This power stops working when you are no longer visible to any foes. Mute foes will still dance. Foes unable to walk will still sing.
summary: The ability to make a foe or foes sing and dance instead of talking and walking.
strengths: This is a kind of wild card power-it could be very useful against certain foes.
weaknesses: Any one who can resist mind control.
Any blind foe.
This is a kind of wild card power-it could utterly useless against the wrong foes.

name: Myth Power: Telesidromos' Tool
description: Telesidromos (Telesidromus), in Greek myth, was the god of horses' safety (especially during the Olympian games and other races). As such, channeling him allows one to absorb psychic energy from bravery, courage, determination, hope and similar positive emotion to form into a pseudo-sentient horse construct. In addition, the construct is immune to fear, as is the rider, when mounted. One can even ride the construct through space-time to/through a place designated one's "happy place", at will.
summary: The ability to channel Telesidromos' command over the essence of horses' safety
strengths: Form psychic energy from bravery/courage/determination/hope (of self/others) into a horse construct
Horse construct is immune to fear and fear effects, as is the rider (when mounted)
Ride horse construct to/through one's ideal happy place (via Teleportation, Time Travel, etc)
weaknesses: Horse construct cannot be reserved for self/allies (or multiplied) until the higher levels (NCN)
Only turn foe into horse under the user's hope-fueled control, by touch, at the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Poseidon's Prestige, MythPower: Artemis' Gift, etc provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Bacchanalia
description: Dionysus (Dionysos, Bacchus, Bakkhos), in Greek myth, was the god of wine, drunkenness and festivity. As such, channeling him allows one to induce drunkenness (including euphoric drunken ecstasy, or the Bacchanalia, an uncontrollable drunken rage), as well as amplify, negate and withstand the same at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel wild partiers and the drunken. One can even psychically manipulate grapes, grape vines and other grape products, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Dionysus' command over the essence of wine, drunkenness, revelry and debauchery
strengths: Psychically induce, amplify, reduce, negate and withstand inebriation (drunken intoxication)
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel wild partiers and the inebriated/intoxicated
Psychically generate and manipulate grapes, grape vines and other grape products at will
weaknesses: Cannot harness the Bacchanalia for oneself until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Lyssa's Lunacy, Berserker Rage, etc provide benefits to Pro #2
MythPower: Sophrosyne's Solace, etc provide immunity (NCN)

name: Gremlin Summon
description: With this power you can summon an infinite number of gremlins from their home dimension and make them do whatever you want. When you're done using them you can just send them back to their dimension.
summary: The ability to summon an army of Gremlins
strengths: You can summon an infinite amount of gremlins
When you're done with them you can just send them back to their dimension
They are under your complete control
weaknesses: They can be killed

name: .50 Caliber Tail
description: You have a mechanical scorpion-like tail, from which you can shoot bullets. You can control your tail simply with your mind. There's also a mechanical eye on the tail, which gives you very good aiming skills.
summary: The ability to have a scorpion tail from which you can shoot bullets.
strengths: You can always protect yourself.
weaknesses: Difficult to sit down.

name: Radio & T.V. Signal Control
description: With this ability you're like a human satellite, walking on the Earth instead of orbiting. You can control radio and television signals using your mind, controlling all radio and T.V. stations. On the radio, people will hear your thoughts and on T.V. they will watch your thoughts. Through enough understanding and experience of your power, you will soon have control over communication devices (e.g. the internet and phones).
summary: The ability to have control over radio and television signals.
strengths: Control what is broadcast on television and radio.
Are able to alter, erase, create, and control all signals via satellite.
Enough practice with this power, can learn to control communication devices.
weaknesses: Don't want to be controlling radio signals and 'think' something embarrassing.
Don't want to imagine an image while controlling television signals.

name: Myth Power: Philote's Affection
description: Philote (Philotes), in Greek myth, was the goddess of friendship, affection and sex (especially in an insidious, dangerous or deceptive sense). As such, channeling her allows one to befriend any neutral, by touch, word or thought. In addition, those one befriends will defend him as best they can, and are fiercely loyal. Furthermore, one may psychically perceive, communicate with, share senses with and summon friends (true and befriended) at will. This also applies to anyone one sleeps with.
