summary: The ability to channel Philote's command over the essence of friendship, affection and sex
strengths: Befriend any neutral (non-friend, non-enemy) by touch, word or thought, at will
Psychically perceive, communicate with, share senses with and summon friends at will
Power also applies to any past lovers (anybody one has dated, married, slept with/had sex with, etc)
weaknesses: Only psychically perceive/manipulate others' friendships/relationships at the higher levels (NCN)
Love/romance/sex-based MythPowers (or being the user's enemy) provide immunity (NCN)
MythPower: Nyx's Night Shift provides immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Neikos' Nerve
description: Neikos (Neicos, Neicus) and the Neikea, in Greek myth, were the gods of quarreling, disagreement and feuding. As such, channeling them allows one to perceive and induce argument within any two or more subjects at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive what to say in order to prevent or stop any argument. One can even psychically cause nearly any subject to disagree with anything that one says, and feel compelled to feel or do the opposite (within physical and/or mental capability).
summary: The ability to channel Neikos and the Neikea's command over the essence of arguments, disagreement and feuds
strengths: Induce arguments (and perceive them, even sometimes before they occur)
Know how to prevent, stop or win any argument (even if you're wrong)
Cause people to disagree with you so strongly, they feel compelled to do or feel the opposite
weaknesses: Combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction-based MythPowers provide benefits to this ability (NCN)
Mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)
MythPower: Harmonia's Heart provides immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Opora's Opulence
description: Opora, in Greek myth, was the goddess of the time of the year when fruit are at their peak ripeness, and ready to be harvested. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically take subjects' abilities from their bodies, encasing them into a fruit-shaped construct to 'ripen'. In addition, one can psychically summon ripe fruit, as well as teleport to ripe-fruit-bearing locations at will. Furthermore, one can even psychically perceive time, counting down to nearly any event one desires, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Opora's command over the essence of the time for harvesting ripe fruit
strengths: Psychically take subjects' abilities, encasing them in a psionic fruit construct to 'ripen'
Psychically summon ripe fruit and teleport self/others to any location with ripe fruit at will
Psychically perceive time counting down to nearly any event (Countdown Chronopathy)
weaknesses: Pro #1 does not work on ordinary skills, until developed (NCN)
Pro #1 does not work on souls, unless combined with MythPower: Psyche's Smile (NCN)
Cannot time travel to fruit-harvest locations in the past or future, until developed (NCN)

name: Smell Animation
description: This power allows you to make anything you smell appear instantly. If you smell gasoline, you will have an infinite supply of gas for free! If you smell pie, you'll be able to hit your enemies with pie (same goes for bullets). The smell you smell will automatically be in your memory and you'll be able to summon it on command.
summary: The ability to make anything you smell appear.
strengths: Get infinite gas
Get infinite pie
weaknesses: Don't smell poop, for god's sake!

name: Kiss Of Death
description: This ability is perhaps a power that can make even the wimpiest, scrawny weakling superhuman a powerful femme fatale (or the male equivalent); by kissing your opponent, you channel death-force energy through yourself into the foe, killing them; even blowing a kiss in their direction can kill foes (if they don't move or otherwise try to blow the kiss); sometimes, this ability is accompanied by seductive powers like Hypnotic Beauty, so others won't try to avoid the kiss
summary: The ability to induce death by a kiss
strengths: If you have Hypnotic Charm or Hypnotic Beauty along with this power, no one will mind kissing you
If people don't know about your ability, then they won't try to avoid your kisses.
Get back at your ex
weaknesses: If you have poor control over the power, kissing loved ones can kill them
If your power is too strong, it can also work by people kissing you
You can't undo the killing if you feel remorse

name: Myth Power: Androctasia Attacks
description: Androctasia (Androktasia) and the Androctasiae (Androctasiai, Androktasiai), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of manslaughter; slaughter in battle. As such, channeling them allows one to psychically perceive when fights of any kind are about to break out, and if any fatalities are involved. In addition, one can psychically summon and communicate with spirits of those who died in battle. One can even psychically channel the knowledge, skills and abilities of relatives who died in battle.
summary: The ability to channel Androctasia and the Androctasiae's command over the essence of manslaughter in battle
strengths: Psychically perceive impending fights, as well as number and identity of fatalities
Psychically summon the ghosts/spirits of fallen warriors
Psychically channel knowledge/memories/skills/abilities from spirits of relatives who died in combat
weaknesses: Can only perceive past/present/future fatalities that result from a FIGHT(NCN)
Cannot COMPEL summoned spirits (best not to summon Attila the Hun or Genghis Kahn)
Only gain knowledge/memories/skills/abilities from spirits of people from one's bloodline (NCN)

name: 5 Faces Of Darkness
description: With this power you can turn into a Quintesson Judge or Alpha Quintesson. As a Quintesson Judge you have five different personalities and you have above average intelligence and are good at making plans. You also can control any Sharkticons or Allicons if you come across them. As Alpha Quintesson you also have five distinct personalities and are smart with the added addition of being able to create new planets however you can't control drones.
summary: The ability to turn into a Quintesson
strengths: You can turn into a Quintesson Judge or Alpha Quintesson
You will have above average intelligence no matter which form you're in (aside from maybe your norm)
You can create planets (but not people) or control Sharkticons and Allicons (but not summon them)
weaknesses: You might start arguing with yourself

name: Zombie Heroes V2
description: With this power you can summon zombie versions of any superhero that are under your complete control. You can summon as many zombies as you want and you can unsummon it whenever you want.
summary: The ability to summon zombie versions of superheroes that are under your complete control
strengths: You can summon as many zombie heroes as you want that are under your complete control
weaknesses: They might accidentally harm innocent people

name: Myth Power: Narcissus' Curse
description: Narcissus, in Greek myth, was a mortal youth so vain that the goddess Nemesis cursed him to fall in love with his reflection in a pond. As such, channeling this ability, one can inflict similar vanity on foes, consuming them with the thought of themselves. If they get their hands on a mirror, you'll not soon be able to relieve them of it. This even overrules their desire to eat, to drink, to sleep, until they waste away to nothing and die of either starvation, dehydration, or your merciful hand.
summary: The ability to inflict the vanity of Narcissus on foes
strengths: Make foes consumed in the thought of their own looks (even if they aren't good looking)
They refuse to eat, drink, sleep or fight unless they have a mirror or reflective surface with them
They eventually die or something like that.
weaknesses: If they manage somehow to fight and maintain a rapport with a mirror
If the curse is broken (by some act of divinity)
They can get so bothersome ("Who's a beautiful person? You are! Oh, yes you are! ")

name: Myth Power: Horme's Handiwork
description: Horme (Hormes), in Greek myth, was the goddess of energetic activity, hard work, eagerness and impulse. As such, channeling her allows one to have infinite stamina (may be shared by touch); one is immune to unnatural sleep and the like, but not from natural sleep, if one desires. In addition, one can gain physical power from the excitement and intense emotions of others. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with, and compel naturally eager, impulsive, spontaneous and excitable people.
summary: The ability to channel Horme's command over the essence of energetic activity, hard work, eagerness and impulse
strengths: Infinite stamina at will (can be shared); immunity to unnatural sleep, but not normal sleep
Feed off of eagerness/excitement/intense emotion and impulsiveness to get physically more powerful
Psychically perceive, communicate with, share senses with and compel impulsive and eager people
weaknesses: Cannot amplify emotions until the higher levels; NEVER gain power from amplified emotion (NCN)
Combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)
Aergia's Allegiance provide immunity (NCN)

name: Anime Liveactonizator
description: With this ability, you can watch any Japanese animated movie, as it were shot with live actors/actresses and in real scenes. Only works on Japanese animes.
summary: The ability to watch an anime as it was a live-action movie.
strengths: It feels so REAL, man.
You can watch the epic sequences live-action, which makes them not just epic, but EPIC.
Don't have to watch crappy Hollywood remakes.
weaknesses: Only works on Japanese animated movies.
If you use your ability too much, you can have an eye- or headache.
You may temporarily lose the natural ability too see animes as they really were made.

name: Teen Titans Summon V2
description: With this power you can summon any Teen Titan. The Titans doesn't have to currently be an active member of the team, they don't even have to be living in the current comic book timeline. Also when you summon one of them they are under your complete control. Unfortunately if you want to use the mind control function you can only summon one of them. If you summon two or more you lose control over all of them.
summary: The ability to summon and of the Teen Titans and be able to control the mind of one of them
strengths: You can summon and Teen Titan
You can mind control up to one of them at a time
They don't have be an active or living member of the team
weaknesses: You can only mind control one of them at a time

name: Myth Power: Euboleus' Boast
description: Euboleus (Euboleos, Eubolus, Eubolos), in Greek myth, was the god of plowing, the sowing (planting) of grain seeds and the sacrificial swine in Eleusinian mystery rites. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically disturb the soil of the ground at will, causing it to toss and turn unstably. In addition, one can psychically revert plants back into harmless seeds (allowing only the user to psychically manipulate said plants). Furthermore, one is granted a wish for every pig they sacrifice.
summary: The ability to channel Euboleus' command over the essence of plowing, the sowing of grain and the sacrificial swine
strengths: Psychically disturb the ground's soil (prevent stable footing; uproot trees and structures) at will
Revert plants to seeds (and render all seeds immune to manipulation by anyone except the user)
A wish granted for every pig one kills; psychically perceive, communicate with and command pigs
weaknesses: Cannot gain nutrition by absorbing nutrients from the soil until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot psychically turn subjects into pigs by a touch until the higher levels (NCN)
Plant/animal/nature-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Ben E. Jezrit
description: You basically have everything you desire from the training arsenal of the Bene Gesserit order, in Frank Herbert's Dune series. This includes mastery of the Voice (audial compulsion), the Weirding Way (ultimate amalgam of martial arts), jaw-dropping youth/vigor, nigh-superhuman intelligence, Other Memory (genetic memory of same sex ancestors), Prana-Bindu (perfect total body control), internal biochemical control, sexual imprinting, Truthsaying (lie detection), and Simulflow (mental multitasking
summary: The ability to acquire/use any abilities of the Bene Gesserits at the proficiency level of a full Reverend Mother
strengths: Toughest fighter around. Peak human and then some
Using the Voice means never having to say "I’m Sorry"
If you’re a male, you might turn out to be the Kwisatz Haderach
weaknesses: You will know every time friends or family are lying
Will experience strong urges to control the bloodlines of friends and family
You have a fear of putting your hand into small boxes

name: Tele Optic Chromamorphism
description: This is an extension of the power Optic Chromamorphism. Psychically, someone with this power can change the eye color of someone else.
summary: The ability to change other people's eye color
strengths: Meh.
weaknesses: Not very useful.
May not have good range/control.

name: Untimely Explosive Sound
description: You're going to hate this power. Whenever you need to concentrate, e.g. because you're doing something dangerous or that requires a lot of precision, a big explosion sound occurs. It will be heard by anyone in a large vicinity. It also happens when you need to be quiet. It can also extend to someone else's concentration or silence if you empathize with them.
summary: The ability to have a loud explosive sound detonate whenever you need to concentrate or be quiet.
strengths: Because it's so loud, noone will know it's your fault.
It can be triggered by other people if you're in empathy with them.
You'll never become deaf because of this power, neither will the other people.
weaknesses: You're never going to finish that castle of cards.
You will deconcentrate anyone you empathize with, like your friends.
It's the worst power if you're a deminer.
tags: was edited as it was not really a superpower

name: Siren's Song (Siren Song)
description: One with this ability has the superhuman ability to produce a subliminally seductive song. It will work as long as the subject is within earshot, and surpasses any mental barriers that otherwise would pose a problem for the user. However, one caveat prevents this from being as effective as a typical hypnotic song (or even MythPower: Siren's Song); it only works on males. Males of any species, regardless of language, but only males. Females often will not even hear it, let alone respond to it.
summary: The ability to produce a male-oriented song of sexuality and psychic domination
strengths: Produce a beautiful hypnotic song (perfect for seduction, or to convey a psychic compulsion)
Bypasses nearly any barrier, including language, age (if you desire) and species
Any man will be putty in your hands (regardless of sexual orientation)
weaknesses: It's the original siren's song (only works on males)
Females will not be affected AT ALL (if particularly girly, they can hear it and it annoys them)
Great singing voice, but anytime you sing, it'll be hypnotic in capacity (until REALLY developed)

name: Myth Power: Poena's Payback
description: Poena (Poene, Poine) and the Poenae (Poinai), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of revenge, vengeance, retaliation and punishment/penalty for wrongs.  As such, channeling them allows one to psychically perceive subjects who have wronged him (and what they did). In addition, with a touch, one can afflict subjects with misfortune until they ask for and receive forgiveness. Furthermore, any injury foes directly inflict will be automatically inflicted back on them (when developed, damage increases).
summary: The ability to channel Poena and the Poenae's command over the essence of revenge, retaliation and punishment
strengths: Perceive those who have offended you (and how they offended you)
Afflict foes with misfortune by touch, until they ask for (and receive) forgiveness
If the foe attempts to directly inflict harm on one, the injury will show up on the foe instead
weaknesses: May become consumed with anger and vengeful thoughts
Only psychically perceive, communicate with and compel grudge-holders at the higher levels (NCN)
Law/order/justice-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Sea Monster Control
description: With this power you can have complete control over any sea monster as long as you've seen it or a picture or depiction of it. The mind control only activates when you are within one hundred miles of the monster. When you are within range you will instantly know that there is a sea monster within range and you can take control of it.
summary: The ability to control any sea monster
strengths: You can take control of any sea monster
weaknesses: You have to be within one hundred miles of it
You have to have seen it or a picture or depiction of it before
If there are no sea monsters in your universe or on your planet this power is useless

name: Myth Power: Dial Diallage
description: Diallage, in Greek myth, was the goddess of reconciliation; making up and making amends after a conflict. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive when subjects are in conflict, and why. In addition, one may mix or swap two or more conflicting subjects' personalities, by touch. Furthermore, one may erase subjects' negative memories/feelings about each other, by touch. One may even reveal subjects' POSITIVE memories/feelings about each other, by touch, so they can resolve their differences.
summary: The ability to channel Diallage's command over the essence of reconciliation and conflict resolution
strengths: Psychically perceive when subjects are angry with one another (and why)
Psychically switch subjects' personalities, by touch, so they can walk a mile in each others' shoes
Psychically erase subjects' negative memories/feelings; reveal subjects' positive memories/feelings
weaknesses: Cannot travel in time to prevent/resolve conflicts until developed (NCN)
Pro #2 is temporary (ending after all conflicting parties resolve their differences) until developed
Combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Sword Of Ultimate Pain!
description: With this ability, you can summon the sword of pain. The sword of pain extremely sharp sword that inflicts lasting physical pain as well as temporary emotional pain. The wounds might heal, but the physical pain lasts for a year. During that time, your foes will develop tolerance to that pain. After a year, they will be so sensitive to physical pain that a gentle breeze will feel like pain to them. They will be teased at by a troll only they could see and continually be more emotionally sensitive
summary: The ability to summon the sword of pain that inflicts lasting pain and leaves foes extremely sensitive to pain.
strengths: Make your enemies feel the worst pain possible.
When they get wounded, they will also feel emotional pain.
After one year, they will know what true pain is (not just physical)
weaknesses: Emotional pain only last for a few minutes at the beginning, and forever at the end.
Have to wait one year for them to feel the ultimate emotional pain.
Do NOT get cut with your own sword!

name: Myth Power: Chrysothemis' Care
description: Chrysothemis (Khrysothemis, Acacallis, Akakallis), in Greek myth, was the goddess of the "golden custom"; the harvest festival. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically wipe subjects' minds of current knowledge, by touch, causing them to think like farmers of old. In addition, one can psychically teleport to any farm, at will, as well as gaining physical power when on a farm. One can even psychically summon Golden Tamarisk pastries, at will, to heal allies who eat them, and poison foes.
summary: The ability to channel Chrysothemis' command over the essence of the harvest festival
strengths: Psychically wipe subjects' minds of present day knowledge, so they assume ancient farming roles
Psychically teleport self and others to any farm; gain physical power on a farm, or in a crop field
Summon irresistibly delicious Golden Tamarisk pastries to heal self/allies and poison foes
weaknesses: Cannot psychically perceive/manipulate crop plants (grain, wheat, etc) until developed (NCN)
Cannot act as a living scarecrow (psychically repel any flying object/subject) until developed (NCN)
Agricultural/economic/cooking/food-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Jodo Shinshu: Middle Path
description: Going to either side of the extremes is not always a good thing and balance is generally best. Someone with this power has realized that and will be able to make others be more balanced in what they do/are. This works for all qualities, not just mental ones. Physical and spiritual ones can be changed too. Only one quality can be changed at a time and there is a recharge time of one hour between each use.
summary: The ability to get qualities of a person to go down the middle path instead of towards extremes
strengths: You can make troublemakers more mature.
Someone with this power will most likely get rid of fully evil beings.
If you have this power you will definitely be neutral in as many things as possible (may be con).
weaknesses: Using this on a pacifist will make them more violent.
It's always a 50-50 blend of the two qualities altered.
Someone with this power will most likely get rid of fully good beings.

name: Myth Power: Ananke's Answer
description: Ananke (Anance), in Greek myth, was the goddess of compulsion, necessity and inevitability. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically compel subjects, or bestow others' voices with compulsive power, at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive the future, which may be shared, by touch. Furthermore, one can withstand compulsions and probability manipulation, and evade Precognition. One can even psychically negate compulsions, probability manipulation and Precognition, by touch.
summary: The ability to channel Ananke's command over the essence of compulsion, necessity and inevitability
strengths: Psychically compel subjects, or bestow others' voices with compulsive power at will
Psychically perceive the future (Precognition), which may be shared, by touch
Withstand and psychically negate compulsions, probability manipulation and Precognition
weaknesses: Cannot seal a foreseen event as unavoidable (destined to happen) until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Kronos' Craft allows one to withstand and negate this ability (NCN)
Probability/chance/luck based MythPowers and Unpredictability provide immunity (NCN)

name: No Pain Receptors
description: You feel no physical pain. At all. This is because your pain receptors don't exist, driving your pain threshold off the charts. This power doesn't apply to emotional pain.
summary: The ability to have no pain receptors
strengths: No more pain, which can be a very annoying distraction.
Show off to people randomly.
weaknesses: No pain, no gain.
Pain is a warning system, so you don't discover injuries until the tunnel vision kicks in.

name: Instantly Zombies Once Dead
description: With this power you can put a curse on a living person which makes them become zombies that are under your control as soon as they die. You can put this curse on up to ten people after that you lose this power. If the person you curse is immortal it has no effect on them unless you can find a way to negate their immortality. Once they are zombies they act as normal zombies (they have a desire for brains, their limbs can come off easily, they can't be killed etc. )
summary: The ability to cause people to become zombies that are under your control as soon as they die
strengths: You can put a curse on people which causes them to become zombies that are under your control
weaknesses: You can only curse at most ten people
The zombies might eat innocent people's brains

name: Myth Power: Cacia's Corruption
description: Cacia (Kakia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of sin, vice, immorality, weak morals and corruption. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive sinful thoughts and acts (including what sin affects a subject most) at will. In addition, one can psychically cast illusions pertaining to which of the Seven Deadly Sins affects a subject most. One can even psychically replicate oneself six times, at will, for a total of seven bodies (each representing one of the Seven Deadly Sins).
summary: The ability to channel Cacia's command over the essence of vice, sinfulness and corruption
strengths: Psychically perceive sin (in thoughts and actions) at will
Psychically cast illusions, which target subjects based on the Deadly Sin that affects them most
Psychically replicate six times (seven total bodies; one for each Deadly Sin)
weaknesses: Replicates don't gain powers based on their sin (compulsion, etc) until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Nyx's Night Shift and MythPower: Eris' Enmity provide immunity (NCN)
Law/order/justice-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Dinosaur Virus
description: With this power you can scratch or bite a animal and, over the course of several hours, that creature will transform into a dinosaur. From then on any animal that the new dinosaur bites or scratches will also become a dinosaur, so long as it doesn't die. They become dinosaurs completely, with nothing remaining of their pre-dinosaur mind. Creatures will only become dinosaurs that are within their size range. Small animals will become smaller dinosaurs, big animals will become bigger dinosaurs.
summary: The ability to unleash a virus that turns modern animals into dinosaurs.
strengths: It's like a zombie plague, but with dinosaurs.
Bring back dinosaurs to the modern era.
Like with any virus a vaccine is posible.
weaknesses: You do not control the dinosaurs.
You are not immune to the dinosaur virus. If you are bitten you'll become a dinosaur.
Like with any virus a vaccine is posible.

name: Song Of The Past
description: This power allows the user to, when listening to a piece of music, travel back in time to any moment where they had heard that music previously. The time travel is only mental, and your present mind will replace that of your past self at the moment you listened to the music.
summary: The ability to travel back to any moment where you heard a song.
strengths: Travel back to whatever moment you heard a song.
weaknesses: You must be listening to a piece of music to use this power.
You must remember a previous instance of listening to this music to travel back to it.

name: Godot Curse
description: Whenever the accursed waits for something to happen, it will be put on hold. The only way for it to resume is to pay no attention to it at all and to let it happen-well, that is if it is supposed to happen. As such, it becomes tricky to overcome once they know about it, because they really have to take their mind off of it. They can't just do something else while waiting for the first thing to happen. They have to completely forget about it.
summary: The ability to pause events the accursed is waiting to happen.
strengths: This is a big social hindrance. Can't wait for the bus, the end of the day, a date, food, etc.
You can strategically curse yourself to buy some time and lift the curse when you're done.
An opponent can't wait for an attack to charge up, nor buy some time so an ally can sneak up on you.
weaknesses: If they are waiting for you to do something, you can't do anything until they are distracted.
Be careful if you decide to curse yourself, as it could backfire.

name: Psycho Kinesis
description: Using Psycho-kinesis, you can control the minds or bodies of mental patients. You can make them go under your command, and you can directly control their bodies by making them float around or indirectly by controlling their mind and making them move.
summary: The ability to control mental patients.
strengths: A nice way to escape from a mental hospital.
Fling multiple patients at your foes.
weaknesses: Only legally registered mental patients can be controlled.
They have complete control of themselves after you release your control.

name: Enhancement: Explosion Creating
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it allows a power to cause explosions upon impact with something else. Ex. Telepathy-another mind, physically-affecting power-something physical. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced. This power can only be attached to one power at a time.
summary: The ability to have a power create an explosion on 'impact' by attaching this power to it
strengths: Explosion causing powers!
Mental and physical explosions can both be caused.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Might not want a power to cause explosions. Ex. Hostage situation if good guy.
Explosion happens upon impact.

name: Sedation And Murder
description: With this ability, you can seduce victims into a sleepy state and then have the choice to murder them by removing all brain functions. The ability also has control over limited emotions, such as love, hate, or a neutral friendship.
summary: The ability to seduce victims to be  safe around you and then shut off their brain functions, therefore killing the
strengths: force a person you have a crush on to love you
kill any enemy, no matter how much stronger
fix a screwed up relationship
weaknesses: the ability could backfire and kill you
you could unconciously kill a loved one

name: Phone Head
description: Those who own this power can call people's phones by 1.) thinking of their number and 2.) talking to them with their thoughts. The user of this power needs good thought control, or they might say what they didn't mean to or call the wrong number.
summary: The ability to call people in your head
strengths: Have a conversation in your head with people (now that sounds funny)!
You don't look like you're just talking to yourself all the time.
Call people in the middle of that boring math class!
weaknesses: Still need phone numbers and can't text people.
You could end up with that song "867-5309" by Tommy Tutone stuck in your head.
Wandering thoughts. If you're a guy, you should probably call hot girls on a regular phone.

name: Myth Power: Dike's Decision
description: Dike (Dice, Dikaiosyne, Dikaeosyne, Dicaeosyne), in Greek myth, was the goddess of justice, fairness and rights established by law. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically subjects' guilt/innocence in criminal situations, based on the law, at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive a subject's chance of being a repeat-offender, by touch; if over fifty percent, the subject can be banished to an extradimensional prison. One can even summon an indestructible weapon at will.
summary: The ability to channel Dike's command over the essence of justice, fair judgment and rights established by law
strengths: Psychically perceive subjects' guilt or innocence of crimes, at will
Psychically perceive criminals' chances of repeat-offense; banish high-risk criminals
Psychically summon a powerful, indestructible sword and/or club (can only harm criminals) at will
weaknesses: Cannot perceive past/future crimes (just ones in progress) until developed (NCN)
The definition of a crime shifts according to jurisdiction of one's location (NCN)
Law/order/justice-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Harmonia's Heart
description: Harmonia (Homonoia, Hermione), in Greek myth, was the goddess of harmony, agreement and unanimity. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically induce harmony between any two or more subjects (quelling arguments, getting subjects to work together, etc), at will. In addition, one can psychically compel neutral subjects to agree with nearly anything one says, at will. One can even psychically attune oneself to the auras of others, to mimic their voices, appearances and skills, etc, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Harmonia's command over the essence of harmony, agreement and unanimity (oneness of mind)
strengths: Psychically induce agreement, harmony and cooperation/teamwork, at will
Psychically compel neutrals to agree with nearly anything one says, at will
Psychically attune oneself to the auras of others to mimic their traits, at will
weaknesses: Cannot use harmonic resonance to break matter apart, by touch or proximity, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Aphrodisia and MythPower: Ares' Wrath allow one to withstand (and disrupt) this ability
MythPower: Eris' Enmity and MythPower: Nerve of the Neikea provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Zelos' Rivalry
description: Zelos, in Greek myth, was the god of zeal, emulation, rivalry and envy, especially in matters of competition. As such, channeling him allows one to perceive the location, thoughts and emotions of anyone he is jealous/envious of, as well as anyone who is jealous/envious of him (like rivals). In addition, one can perceive a foe's strategic weakness in competition. Furthermore, the more dedicated one is to a cause, the easier it is to catch on to skills pertaining to that cause (sports, etc).
summary: The ability to channel Zelos' command over the essence of rivalry, emulation, jealousy and zealotry
strengths: Psychically perceive location/thoughts/emotions of rivals/enemies/admirers/haters
Psychically perceive a foe's strategic weakness (adapt your style to outdo them)
The more dedicated you are to a cause, the easier it is to catch onto skills related to that cause
weaknesses: Success Auto-Training only works with PRACTICE (and does not apply to superpowers; no Con Negation)
People with MythPower: Philote's Affection are immune to this ability
People with MythPowers based on Styx or Styx's Children (Cratos, Bia, Nike, Zelos) are immune

name: Myth Power: Momos' Mockery
description: Momos (Momus), in Greek myth, was the god of mockery, blame, ridicule, scorn, complaint and harsh criticism. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive flaws, weaknesses and shortcomings of any kind. In addition, one gains a superhuman ranting ability in which one reveals the foes' deepest, innermost thoughts, feelings and secrets aloud, without even knowing it. One can even psychically cause matter to take damage, by mocking flaws in its physical or chemical structure, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Momos' command over the essence of criticism, blame and mockery
strengths: Psychically perceive flaws, weaknesses and shortcomings of any kind
Superhuman ranting ability that subconsciously reveals foe's innermost secrets
Psychically cause matter to literally break down by mocking it physical and structure
weaknesses: Cannot do physical/mental pain or damage to living things with insults until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Aphrodisia provides immunity
Mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory-based MythPowers provide immunity

name: Myth Power: Call To Convalesce
description: Aceso (Akeso) and Telesphoros (Telesphorus, Acesis, Akesis), in Greek myth, were goddess and god counterparts (respectively) of the start and completion of convalescence (natural recovery). As such, channeling them allows one to psychically perceive and communicate with ill/injured subjects at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive and manipulate the speed of the healing process at will. One can even psychically transfer illness and injury to/from oneself and other subjects, by touch.
summary: The ability to channel Telesphoros ad Aceso's command over the essence of convalescence (the recuperation process)
strengths: Psychically perceive and communicate with ill/injured subjects at will
Psychically manipulate the speed of the healing process at will
Psychically transfer illnesses and injuries to/from self and others, by touch, at will
weaknesses: Pro #2 requires touch until developed (NCN)
Cannot manipulate recovery of stamina, by touch, at will, until developed (NCN)
Medical/healing/restoration-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Facial Hair Control
description: With this power you can control any human that has som sort of beard or mustache unless they are a superhuman. You can control up to eleven people at a time and those people are under your complete control.
summary: The ability to control any human with facial hair
strengths: You can control anybody who has a beard or mustache
weaknesses: You can't control them if they have superpowers

name: Superpower List Eraser
description: You can erase other people's powers off the superpower list, so you can put yours into existance under your name. I thought that was explanatory in the overview. You can also use any language you want in your power description and it can be longer than 500 characters.
summary: The ability to delete other people's powers so you can make your own and get them accepted
strengths: You can make all the powers that come to mind
You are basically an admin
Saves a lot of time and frustration
weaknesses: Cannot erase other profiles and comments
Might get banned from the site
You are kind of a prick

name: Snap Judgement
description: This power will make a foe go with the first choice for any decisions they make. They won't analyze, consider or think about any other choices they could make. They'll take the first possibility and go with it. They won't use any powers that let them compare all possibilities of a situation, even if these powers only take an instant to use. Their mind will be made up. Choice A only. Forget choices B to ZZZ.
summary: The ability to make an opponent go with the first choice they have.
strengths: Choice A could be great for you.
weaknesses: Choice A could be terrible for you.

name: Myth Power: Adikia's Advantage
description: Adikia (Adicia) in Greek myth, was the goddess of injustice, unfairness (unfair judgment) and corruption. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically suppress morality by touch, making subjects more likely to give in to corrupt urges. In addition, one can lie, cheat, steal, etc (nearly any crime, short of physical abuse, rape or murder) and, even if caught, one will not be punished. One can even psychically inflict harm/misfortune on lawful citizens, and bestow healing/fortune on crooks.
summary: The ability to channel Adikia's command over the essence of injustice, wrong-doing, cheating and corruption
strengths: Suppress morality with a touch, so subjects are more prone to sneaky wrongdoings
No penalty if one lies/cheats/steals; immune to direct effects of law/order/justice based MythPowers
Bestow good luck and healing on crooks; inflict bad luck and harm/pain on lawful citizens (by touch)
weaknesses: Can still face punishment for physical abuse, rape and murder until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with and compel true crooks until developed (NCN)
Law/order/justice-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Summoning: Animus
description: Animus is a demon of knowledge, reading books and scrolls and collecting any knowledge he can. While he is an incredibly powerful demon, he never fights. He has an incredible memory, and never forgets anything. Summoning him gives you access to his knowledge.
summary: The ability to summon Animus.
strengths: Immense knowledge.
weaknesses: Not a fighter.
Hard to summon.

name: Myth Power: Aristaeus' Arrival
description: Aristaeus (Aristaios), in Greek myth, was the god of various rustic pursuits; tending flocks as a shepherd, cheese-making, bee-keeping, growing olives and medicinal herbs, and hunting. As such, channeling him allows one to gain skill in said pursuits. In addition, one can psychically perceive and manipulate various medicinal herbs, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and command bees and sheep. One can even psychically generate soothing breezes, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Aristaeus' command over the essence of rustic pursuits
strengths: Gain skill in shepherding, cheese-making, bee-keeping, growing olives/herbs and hunting/trapping
Psychically perceive and manipulate herbs (Agrokinesis); generate soothing breezes (Aerokinesis)
Psychically perceive, communicate with and command sheep and bees, at will
weaknesses: Cannot turn into a bee, a swarm of bees or a sheep at will (others by touch) until developed (NCN)
Cannot summon powerful winds/rain, or withstand/suppress/suppress heat/fire until developed (NCN)
Plant/animal/nature-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Facelight
description: Seeing in the dark is hard. We know this. We live with it every night. With this power, your face shines brightly when you want it to, casting light over anything you are turned towards. You are also not blinded by your own light. However, in really dangerous or scary situations, your mind instinctively turns it on as a knee-jerk reaction.
summary: The ability to emit light from your face.
strengths: Finally quit carrying that flashlight in your car.
Impress your friends.
Search for stuff under your bed.
weaknesses: Pranks played on you will probably involve lampshades.
Your face lights up when you watch scary movies or at haunted houses.
Shining faces aren't very stealthy or good for hide-and-seek.

name: Zodiac: Lunar: Snake
description: You draw upon the power of the Snake. You can transform into a snake, talk with snakes, and slip out of the grasp of any enemy. This includes mental as well as physical grasps.
summary: The ability to use the powers of the lunar calender's Snake
strengths: Full moon gives full power.
No one can contain your mind or body.
weaknesses: New moon gives no power.
Can only use if born in a year of the Snake. 1917, 1929, 1941, 1953, 1965, 1977, 1989, 2001, etc.

name: Myth Power: Goof Of Gelos
description: Gelos (Gelus), in Greek myth, was the god of laughter. As such, channeling him allows to psychically perceive how to make nearly any subject laugh with humor, jokes and comedy routines. In addition, one can recall any existing comedic material at will. Furthermore, one can induce uncontrollable laughter by touch, word or thought. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with, share senses with and compel comedians (those who are humorous/comedic/funny or who like to joke and play pranks).
summary: The ability to channel Gelos' command over the essence of laughter
strengths: Perceive how to make nearly anybody laugh; perceive and recall existing jokes and comedic routines
Induce uncontrollable laughter by a touch, a word or a thought
Psychically perceive, communicate with, share senses with and compel comedians/jokers and pranksters
weaknesses: Cannot exhibit Cartoon Physics or gain power from natural laughter until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot cast a "Constant Laughter Illusion" or produce a Sonic Laugh until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Sophrosyne's Solace and humor/entertainment-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Shared Energy Pool
description: Chi, mana, psychic energy, etc. Any energy that someone in the group is able to use is put into the collective pool of energy. Any person in the group can utilize the energies that their own powers allow them to use. People can only be added to or subtracted from the group by someone with a copy of this power. A being can only be added to the group if they want to be added.
summary: The ability to have a pool of energy that is shared between a group of beings
strengths: Allies can now use powers longer than they originally could.
Allies who can drain power from enemies.
The power levels of the shared pool is everyone's power levels added together.
weaknesses: You'll run out of power faster than before if you had the highest levels of power originally.
If one person in the group runs out of power, everyone runs out of power.

name: Myth Power: Train Of Erotes2
description: The Erotes, in Greek myth, were the gods of various aspects of love and relationships. As such, channeling the Elder Eros (Procreation) allows one to manipulate sexual arousal and induce an overwhelming urge to have sex (for the sake of bearing offspring) in any animal species by touch, word or thought. In addition, one can perceive and manipulate reproductive sexual capacity (in oneself and others) at will. Furthermore, one can enhance or reduce sexual attributes (in self and others) at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Erotes' command over the essence of love, sexuality and relationships
strengths: Psychically manipulate sexual arousal and induce an overwhelming urge to reproduce
Psychically perceive and manipulate sexual capacity (the ability to reproduce) of self/others
Enhance or reduce sexual attributes (breasts, etc) in self/others
weaknesses: Cannot psychically perceive or communicate with well-endowed subjects until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Aphrodisia, MythPower: Arrows of Eros and MythPower: Oath of Ouranos provide immunity
Empathic Backlash or similar emotion-resistant abilities provide immunity

name: Remote Explosive Max Pulse
description: The ability to explode biological/non-biological lifeforms/objects from a small or great distance, but still within the user reach, approximately 100 metres. May be very dangerous if not uncontrollable, since this ability is greatly affected by emotions. For example, if someone is having a breakdown or having a crush on someone, he or she may activate this ability when their heart rate is at it's maximum. Must be focused if want to explode desired objects.
summary: The ability to explode things from a distance when heart rate reaches it's maximum.
strengths: Can explode landmines for safety purposes.
Can make explosion without being detected or harmed.
Can get revenge on your enemies.
weaknesses: Can kill someone instantly.
Can set houses on fire or destroy them.
Gets tired after using for numerous time.

name: Myth Power: Sophrosyne's Solace
description: Sophrosyne, in Greek myth, was the goddess of self-control (self-discipline), temperance (restraint), discretion and sobriety. As such, channeling her allows one to resist any domination of one's body, mind or spirit. In addition, one gains superhuman patience, willpower and resilience (to resist any temptation or attempt at seduction, and come back from psychological trauma), is rendered immune to ALL compulsions, and cannot be intoxicated by drugs or alcoholic beverages.
summary: The ability to channel Sophrosyne's command over the essence of self-control, restraint, discretion and sobriety
strengths: Cannot be dominated by any force other than TRUE Omnipotence (which is HIGHLY unlikely)
Superhuman Patience, Willpower and Resilience; Immunity to ALL compulsions and intoxication
Discipline the body to do acrobatic feats, go longer without food/water/sleep, and assist metabolism
weaknesses: Often cannot share Compulsion/Domination Immunity, by touch until the higher levels
MythPower: Aphrodisia, MythPower: Arrows of Eros and MythPower: Train of Erotes (rivals)
MythPower: Bacchanalia (rivals)

name: Myth Power: Enyo's Laugh
description: Enyo, in Greek myth, was the goddess of violence and bloodshed. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive violence and bloodshed in one's proximity at will. In addition, one gains physical power from inflicting pain and injury on others; the more blood drawn, or pain inflicted, the better. One can also transfer wounds from one's own body to others' bodies, by touch, word or thought. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel particularly violent people.
summary: The ability to channel Enyo's command over the essence of violence and bloodshed
strengths: Psychically perceive violence and bloodshed at will (when developed, extends into past and future)
Gain physical power from inflicting harm; transfer one's wounds onto others by touch word or thought
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel particularly violent people
weaknesses: Cannot induce violent behavior in neutrals by touch until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Eirene's Elegance provides immunity (NCN)
Combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction-based MythPowers provide power from this ability (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Anaideia's Anger
description: Anaideia (Anaidea, Anaidia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of disrespect, mercilessness, shamelessness and unforgiveness. As such, channeling her allows one to speak and act nearly however one likes; people will not retaliate, no matter how rude, hurtful, vulgar, profane, obscene or disrespectful. In addition, one when holding a grudge, going against a foe one does not respect or when one's foe is down (pleading for mercy). One can even psychically compel subjects by talking to them rudely.
summary: The ability to channel Anaideia's command over the essence of disrespect, ruthlessness and unforgiveness
strengths: Do nearly whatever you like (even if it breaks the law), and nobody will retaliate
Gain physical power when holding a grudge, fighting a foe one doesn't respect, or when he is down
Psychically compel subjects by talking to them rudely (yelling, insults, cursing, etc)
weaknesses: Cannot get away with physical abuse, rape or murder until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Eleos' Empathy allows one to withstand and negate this ability (NCN)
Law/order/justice based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Geras' Guard
description: Geras, in Greek myth, was the god of old age, its associated conditions and the elderly (old). As such, channeling him to allows one to age, and yet never suffer or die from old age or geriatric conditions. In addition, one can psychically age subjects (physically and/or mentally), at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive and communicate with anyone older than middle age (senior citizens, etc), at will.  One can even psychically generate a forcefield that works on the elderly (old).
summary: The ability to channel Geras' command over the essence of old age, the old and geriatric conditions
strengths: Gain Graceful Aging (never die of old age or associated geriatric conditions)
Psychically age subjects (mentally and/or physically), at will
Psychically perceive, communicate with and generate a forcefield against the old, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically trade bodies/minds with the old, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically convert one's old age into physical power, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Hebe's Hedge and other time/age-based powers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Clairgustance
description: Just by concentrating a moment, you can taste the rainbow or anything else to which you set your mind. This power draws the essence of the substance out of the spiritual or ethereal realms straight to your taste buds!
summary: The ability to psychically taste anything.
strengths: Find that the world is delicious.
Make dieting far easier.
Science
weaknesses: Bad tastes

name: Song Stealer
description: This power allows you to remove any musical piece in existence from reality past and present. For example, if you removed Beethoven's 3rd Symphony, it would be as if he had never composed the song. The entire song, both in performed and written form, would then be transferred into your memory in its entirety. A byproduct of this superpower is that you will be able to play or sing stolen songs perfectly. However, you would play or sing any other songs only as you normally would.
summary: The ability to remove any musical piece from history and transfer it into your memory
strengths: Become known as a master musician (if you're not worried about stealing others' music)
Get rid of the songs you hate
A vicious counter to any musically-based superpower
weaknesses: You can't directly return any stolen songs to history (you can still play/reveal the melodies)
The songs you hate that you get rid of will be stuck in your mind forever
You might accidentally change a major part of history by removing important songs

name: Pain?
description: With this power you have the ability to know if the person you're talking to is in emotional or physical pain and you also know exactly how to help them. You also know what to do to worsen their pain if you decide to be a jerk.
summary: The ability to know if someone is in pain
strengths: You know if someone is in pain
You know how to help them
You know what to do to make their pain worse
weaknesses: You have to be talking to the person to know if they're in pain or not

name: Arcana 12: The Hanged Man
description: You may use this power to gain knowledge. You simply need to state a question and your power will supply you with the information required. Information gained by this power is always true, thorough and useful. However, using this power permanently removes one or more of your memories. The more obscure or valuable the information, the more precious or large the memory taken will be. If you regain the lost memory, you lose the knowledge gained, even if the information was stored or written down.
summary: The ability to sacrifice memories for knowledge.
strengths: You can gain knowledge of almost anything.
This power is nigh-impossible to trick or block.
weaknesses: The harder the knowledge would have been to obtain, the greater the memory loss.
You may forget why you sought to obtain the information.

name: Arcana 15: The Devil
description: With this power, you can cut down to the deepest part of a persons personality and cause them to indulge in whatever their most basic desire is. They will attempt to do whatever that is as much as possible until this power runs its course. Of course, their deepest desire may not be negative. A charitable person may end up giving away everything they own, but the urge is always complete and overwhelming. This power can spread from person to person whenever someone affected speaks to anyone.
summary: The ability to cause people to act on their innermost urges.
strengths: Reduce small towns to utter chaos as people abandon their responsibilities.
Easily access forbidden areas.
Discover people's innermost secrets and desires.
weaknesses: You may end up unleashing to much chaos.
Some desires may end up negatively impacting you, such as somone who deeply desires violence.
Emotional manipulation powers can cancel or redirect this effect.

name: Diary Of A Madman
description: You have a never-ending book that contains the entries of any people you choose. This book can be used to know what others are thinking, but it comes with a serious price (dramatic pause) YOUR SANITY! (Dun, Dun, Dum! ) If you have too many people in the book, their thoughts start to haunt your mind and you lose track of who you are, thus driving you to insanity.
summary: The ability to have a person's diary/journal entries appear in this book of yours
strengths: Track what certain people are doing.
You can give the book to someone you know would abuse this (MuaHaHa! )
If it fills up, the book automatically makes 10-20 more pages
weaknesses: Lose you sanity, and sense of self

name: Lyricopath
description: You can memorize the entire lyrics of a song after hearing it only once. After you've memorized a lyrics you never forget it. However, this does not make you sing better or more in tune. You just know all the words to every song you've ever heard. Unfortunately you can't forget songs.
summary: The ability to memorize the lyrics of any song you hear
strengths: Know the words to all your favorite songs
Impress people with your ability to memorize lyrics
Sing along to any song
weaknesses: You could hear a stupid song and you have to remember it forever
Some songs are annoying
You can't delete song lyrics from your head

name: Myth Power: Pistis' Promise
description: Pistis, in Greek myth, was the goddess of faith, trust and belief. As such, channeling her allows one to say nearly anything to nearly anyone and be believed; even when subjects know (or discover) one is lying, one will never lose the trust of those subjects. In addition, belief in oneself and one's allies will allow oneself and one's allies to work at peak physical and mental capacity. One can even psychically deal pain and/or injury, by touch, to those who lose (or do not have) one's trust.
summary: The ability to channel Pistis' command over the essence of faith, trust and belief
strengths: Say nearly anything to nearly anyone, and be believed; never lose others' trust when caught lying
Believing in self/others allows self/others to work at peak physical/mental capacity
Psychically deal pain and/or injury, by touch, to those who lose (or do not have) one's trust
weaknesses: Some people are not trusting; others are not trustworthy
Cannot harm subjects, by touch, who verbalize beliefs different from one's own until developed (NCN)
Cannot use one's faith for reality/probability-defying stunts until the higher levels (NCN)

name: Always Thinking V2
description: With this power, whenever you are given a question or problem you will constantly be working on it in your mind until you come to a solution or are given a new question.
summary: The ability to constantly think about a problem until you discover the solution
strengths: You will constantly be thinking about a problem until you reach an answer
You cannot get distracted
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat
You are not able to think about anything else until you come to a solution

name: Myth Power: Matton's Menu
description: Matton (Daites, Daiton, Daton), in Greek myth, was the god of kneading bread, baking and eating. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive and summon breads at will, as well as gaining skill in baking. In addition, one can superheat matter by touch; this same touch can also turn matter into bread; combined, the effects turn matter into baked bread. Furthermore, one can gain physical power from eating food (healthy is better). One can even knead matter like bread dough, by touch.
summary: The ability to channel Matton's command over the essence of kneading bread, baking and eating
strengths: Psychically perceive and summon bread at will; gain skill in baking (bread, pastries, etc)
Superheat matter (or turn it to bread) by touch; combined, turn matter into baked bread
Gain physical power from eating; knead matter like bread dough in one's hands, by touch
weaknesses: Cannot eat infinitely until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with and compel the hungry until the higher levels (NCN)
Agricultural/economic/cooking/food-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Fertility Force2
description: The phallic companions of Priapus, in Greek myth, were the gods of fertility. As such, channeling Conisalus (Conisalos, Konisalos, Gigon- sexual vigor; perspiration during intercourse), one can psychically increase one's own stamina, as long as one's mind is concentrated on sexual thoughts. In addition, one can psychically convert foes' exerted effort into sexual pleasure, to distract them from functioning, by touch. One can even psychically absorb superhuman powers through intercourse, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Priapus' companions' command over the essence of fertility
strengths: Psychically increase one's stamina by concentrating on sexual thoughts
Psychically convert foes' exerted effort into sexual pleasure (distract them), by touch
Psychically absorb superhuman abilities though sexual intercourse, at will
weaknesses: Pro #1 does not also increase strength and durability, until developed (NCN)
Pro #2 requires touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot just MIMIC powers via sexual intercourse (Pro #3 leaves lover helpless) until developed (NCN)

name: Folie A Deux
description: This power doesn't protect you from mind readers, but they sure would take a huge risk violating your mind, especially if you have a severe mental illness. Every time someone pokes into your brain for too long, this power kicks in and uses the opening they made into your psyche to alter theirs, reproducing every mental disorder you have. It works even better if they struggle to make sense of your mind. This power won't work if your mental illness is healed or negated by another power.
summary: The ability to share your mental disorders with anyone who probes your mind.
strengths: You can make mind readers crazy, stressed, depressed, delusional, paranoid, etc.
The longer they take to read your mind, the more likely this power will suceed.
weaknesses: You need to suffer from a mental illness yourself.
You can't affect someone who sporadically reads your mind.
Only mental disorders recognized by the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders (DSM).

name: Zeakinesis
description: One with this ability has full control over gains, such as, cereal, caryopsis, grasses. One with this ability only, but does not have full, Plant Manipulation; being that one only controls a certain type(s). One would have a huge advantage in areas such as wheat fields, but other than that, one has little use of this power.
summary: The ability to mentally manipulate grains
strengths: Control a whole field, which can be miles.
Grains are abundant
weaknesses: Being in an area not having grains.
Not Plant Manipulation.

name: Bugger Armada
description: SPOILERS for anyone who has not read the book: With this power you can summon the Buggers from Ender's Game. You can summon as many as you want, but you have to summon a Hive Queen first, as the Buggers operate on a hive mind and are controlled by the Hive Queen (which is under your control). You can summon and unsummon them as you please.
summary: The ability to summon the Buggers from the Ender's Game series
strengths: You can summon the Buggers
They are under your control
weaknesses: They can be killed
They're apparently pretty scary

name: The Last Laugh
description: You can use it by releasing a light-greenish puffball projectile at your opponent's mouth and they'll start to laugh endlessly. The effect of it is when they laugh hard they'll expand like a huge balloon before exploding into pieces. The second effect is your opponent will soon go totally irreversibly mad. You also say this quote after finishing your enemy "He/She who laughs last, laughs dead".
summary: The ability to unleash a lethal mind altering laughing gas that causes the opponent to explode like a balloon.
strengths: Can put your serious opponent into an severe laugher.
weaknesses: None.

name: Summon Agony One
description: Agony Ones look like bipedal hyenas. While in Kyst Agony Ones record every second of agony of a fallen foe of Kyst. Agony Ones can play back this recorded agony onto other beings. Agony Ones have finite memory of recorded agony so at some point you will have to unsummon it so it can record new material. Agony Ones can lift 5 tons and run 45 mph, they have a IQ of 200.
summary: The ability to summon a pain inducing kystian.
strengths: Your foes won't go to Kyst, let an Agony One do the next best thing.
Agony Ones can run down the fastest normal human.
Agony Ones can lift trucks and throw trucks.
weaknesses: Anyone immune to the effects of pain
Finite pain inducing ability; have to return to Kyst to recharge

name: Mr. Bubbles
description: With this ability, you can create large, opaque thought bubbles over people's heads, just like you see in the comics. Everyone can see the bubbles, except the person whose head they are over. You can only create one bubble at a time, but they can say anything you want. All you have to do is think about what you want the bubble to say. No one else will know who is doing it or suspect that it's you.
summary: The ability to create thought bubbles over people's heads.
strengths: Entertainment factor.
Instant pick-me-up if you're having a bad day.
Blackmail.
weaknesses: You could be caught if you concentrate too hard.
Thought bubbles may accidentally state your OWN thoughts.
Lack of sleep from doing this all the time.

name: Crocodile Tears
description: One with this ability is a very dangerous person indeed. By activating this ability, they will begin to cry (or otherwise display distress, depending on which their mind determines will be more believable). When others come up to the user, feeling sorry for him, his power builds up within. And if the subject gets within radius, the user's power is capped off and sends him into a berserker rage to attack that person.
summary: The ability to feign sadness or distress and gain power from the sympathy felt toward you
strengths: Your tears or other show of distress is convincing
Your power builds up the more people feel sympathy for you
This power is released in the form of a powerful berserker rage that pwns enemies
weaknesses: If nobody cares about your troubles
If the power isn't accompanied by the berserker rage part
Fool me once, shame on you, fool me twice, shame on me.

name: Baby Talk
description: Also called Baby Communication, Infantile Communication, Baby Omnilingualism, Infantile Omnilingualism or Babyspeak, this is the psychic ability to communicate with and understand babies, and for them to understand YOU. One with this ability can easily translate all the hiccups, burbles, gurgles, coos, whines, cries and giggles of a baby (regardless of species), and can also speak this language (or speak their normal voice, and empathically translate it into signals the baby can understand)
summary: The ability to psychically communicate with babies
strengths: Understand babies
They understand you
If power develops, you can exert mental control to COMMAND babies
weaknesses: Sometimes only extends to babies of YOUR race
Sometimes takes a while to learn baby language of another species
Baby minds are less developed so it may harm them if your influence over them is TOO strong

name: Myth Power: Fertility Force1
description: The phallic companions of Priapus, in Greek myth, were the gods of fertility. As such, channeling Tychon (Tykhon- sexual fortune; fertility, virility, sexual endowment), one gains favor with the plant and animal kingdoms; they will not attack/harm the user (even by compulsion), in exchange for enhancing their fertility. In addition, one can psychically perceive the right thing to say, to charm neutrals into doing one's bidding, at will. One can even psychically weaponize phallic items, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Priapus' companions' command over the essence of fertility
strengths: Favor with plant/animal kingdoms; they will assist/protect/fight for, and refuse to harm, the user
Psychically perceive the right thing to say to charm neutrals into doing one's bidding (Lucky Charm)
Psychically weaponize phallic items (ie enlarge and empower a baseball bat) at will
weaknesses: Cannot enhance one's own virility/fertility or sexual attributes, until developed (NCN)
Cannot summon, communicate with or share senses with plants/animals (NCN)
Plant/animal/nature-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Electryone's Alarm
description: Electryone (Electryona, Elektryone, Electryo, Elektryo, Alectrona, Alektrona), in Greek myth, was the goddess of the waking sense, that stirs men from sleep. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive the passage of time, at will. In addition, one can psychically negate altered mental states (unconsciousness etc), by touch, or proximity (psychically generating sunlight), at will. Furthermore, one can withstand them. One can even psychically project a sonic rooster crow, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Electryone's command over the essence of the waking sense
strengths: Psychically perceive the passage of time, at will; withstand altered mind states (intoxication, etc)
Psychically negate altered mental states, by touch, or proximity (generating sunlight), at will
Psychically project a sonic rooster crow, at will
weaknesses: Cannot fly, propel oneself into outer space and survive its conditions, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically time-travel to one's past/future wakings, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Helios' Help provides negation (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Horkos' Pledge
description: Horkos (Horcos, Horcus), in Greek myth, was the god of oaths, promises, pledges and punishment for perjury. As such, channeling him allows one to perceive, by touch or thought, any promise that a subject has made or received, and whether that promise was kept (including one's own promises). In addition, one can perceive lies. One can even afflict liars and oath-breakers with misfortunes associated with the promise they broke, or the lie they told, until the offense is either avenged or forgiven.
summary: The ability to channel Horkos' command over the essence of oaths, promises, pledges and the punishment of perjury
strengths: Perceive when promises have been made (and what the promise entails)
Perceive when lies have been told or deception is afoot
Afflict liars/oath-breakers with crime-based punishment (a liar begins vomiting uncontrollably, etc)
weaknesses: Cannot perceive promises (and lies) before OR after one's own lifetime until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Styx Bond provides immunity (NCN)
MythPower: Eris' Enmity and Duplicity provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Ceraon's Cup
description: Ceraon (Keraon), in Greek myth, was the god of mixing wine and drinking. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive and summon drinks at will, as well as gaining skill in mixing drinks. In addition, one can turn harmful liquids (acids, poisons, etc) into harmless drinks, or turn drinks into harmful liquids, medical remedies, etc, by touch. Furthermore, one can gain physical power from drinking beverages (healthy is better). One can even psychically manipulate beverages, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Ceraon's command over the essence of mixing wine and drinking
strengths: Psychically perceive and summon drinks at will; gain skill in mixing drinks
Turn harmful liquids into harmless drinks (or turn drinks into harmful liquids or medicines) at will
Gain physical power from drinking beverages; psychically manipulate beverages (like hydrokinesis)
weaknesses: Cannot drink infinitely until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with and compel drinkers until developed (NCN)
Agricultural/economic/cooking/food-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Dioskouroi Deluxe
description: The Dioskouroi (Dioscouroi, Dioskoroi, Dioscoroi), in Greek myth, were gods of athletics, travel, sailing and guests. As such, channeling them allows one to psychically access peak physical condition, as well as sports, horsemanship and sailing skill. In addition, one can psychically perceive directions to any location, at will. One can also psychically teleport to previously visited locations, at will. One can even psychically perceive and communicate the language of nearby subjects, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Dioskouroi and their command over the essence of athletics, travel and guests
strengths: Psychically access peak physical condition, as well as sports, horseback riding and sailing skill
Psychically perceive directions to any location, teleport to previously-visited locations, at will
Psychically perceive and communicate in the language of subjects in proximity (Xenoglossy), at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically summon divine immortal horses (up to two), until developed
Cannot psychically generate a divine 'twin' of plasma (or summon a true twin) until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically access Gemini Immortality (twin duplicates for a new body), until developed (NCN)

name: Uncanny Valley
description: When a person the user knew dies, they are given the opportunity to create a puppet version of them that will be true to them in some ways, but eerily different in others, usually varying in either appearance, personality, or powers. They can only create a certain amount of puppets at a time, and these puppets act with some degree of free will. This person has access to the puppets minds and powers at any time.
summary: The ability to create mock versions of the deceased.
strengths: Revive a fallen comrade (or enemy) who had a useful power to use that power again
Potentially switch the sides of the deceased villain by making a puppet whose personality differs.
Have agents the world over, and know what is going on in their minds.
weaknesses: Hatred due to potentially disrespecting the dead
Loss of ones own mind by sharing their mind with so many others.
Only allowed to have a set number of puppets, who cannot be killed on command.

name: Myth Power: Aporia's Appraisal
description: Aporia, in Greek myth, was the goddess of perplexity, difficulty, complication, inefficiency and ineffectiveness. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive a subject's skills, at will. In addition, one can psychically wipe a subject's memory of any and all skills, by touch. Furthermore, by touch, word or thought, one can psychically lock the subject's mind, so that they cannot pick up on NEW skills, and cannot relearn any lost or negated skills, until the power's use is over.
summary: The ability to channel Aporia's command over the essence of inefficiency, ineffectiveness and difficulty
strengths: Psychically erceive a subject's skills at will
Psychically reduce or erase a subject's skills, by touch
Lock subject's mind, so he can't pick up on new skills, or relearn lost skills until power use ends
weaknesses: Cannot reduce or negate more than a few skills at a time; no Power Negation until developed (NCN)
Cannot reduce or negate vital functions (breathing, heartbeat, etc), by touch, until developed (NCN)
Work/effort/force/strength-based MythPowers allows one to withstand and negate this ability (NCN)

name: Author's Rule
description: Also called Author Power or Author's Might, one with this ability can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel anyone who possesses a power one created on the Superpower List website. In addition, one can psychically increase, reduce or negate any powers they have, made by oneself (temporarily or permanently). Furthermore, even if they should ever get out of from under one's control, for any reason, one will never be affected by any power they possess that was made by oneself.
summary: The ability to take control over anyone possessing a power you have created
strengths: Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel possessors of powers made by you
Psychically manipulate the strength of powers made by you
Totally withstand any powers made by you
weaknesses: Above pros only work on powers made by oneself (NCN)
Con #1 can only be negated by the power Birhright Thief (NCN)
Cannot separate powers from their owners as pseudo-sentient energy beings until developed (NCN)

name: Thirteen Treasures: Halter
description: One of the thirteen treasures of Britain, guarded by Merlin the demon-wizard. When tied to the end of one's bed, any horse appearing in one's dream will appear tied to the halter.
summary: The ability to use the halter of Clydno Eiddyn
strengths: Summon shadow horses, cyborg horses, giant horses, kelpies, carnivorous dino-horses, and many more!
weaknesses: The halter could be stolen while you slept, rendering your equine dreams useless.

name: Ugly Vanity
description: By touch, you can create an illusionary cloud around a person that makes them appear really ugly or very beautiful to other people. This power wears off though in a day.
summary: The ability to create the illusion that someone appears really ugly or really beautiful
strengths: The power to make people appear ugly or beautiful
weaknesses: Have to make contact with the person
Spell wears off in a day

name: Jodo Shinshu: 3 Poisons
description: The three Buddist mental poisons are greed, ignorance, and wrath. This power makes you a master of the Jodo Shinshu (Buddhism sect) and thus, of the poisons. Their symbols are chicken for ignorance, pig for greed, and snake for wrath. This power allows full and total control of the poisons, but only one at a time. A user of this power can get rid of these poisons from a person or corrupt them with the poisons.
summary: The ability to control 3 Buddhist mental poisons and their symbols
strengths: Can make a person completely kind and gentle to all those they meet.
You also have three species of animals you can control.
Certain healing/mental/will powers can counteract this power.
weaknesses: Can make a person completely evil and uncaring towards other humans.
Can only control one poison & animal species at a time.
Con Negation and other alteration powers do not affect this power.

name: Spl User Detection
description: With this ability, you can sense whether anyone you perceive is on the superpower list or not and if so, their username, acquired powers and created powers.
summary: The ability to detect members of the superpower list.
strengths: Meet fellow members of the superpower list.
When combined with other powers, you may be able to sense users over greater distances.
Be prepared for fights.
weaknesses: Targets may hide themselves with superpowers.
May end up in a fight with them.
Highly restricted uses.

name: Myth Power: Train Of Erotes4
description: The Erotes, in Greek myth, were the gods of various aspects of love and relationships. As such, channeling Hermaphroditos (Hermaphroditus- Hermaphrodites, Effeminates, Transsexuals, and Gender Confusion), one can psychically cause subjects to act the opposite of the norm expected for their gender. In addition, one can alter the gender of self and others at will. One may even merge with a member of the opposite sex, to disguise one's appearance, gain power and share thoughts and skills/abilities.
summary: The ability to channel the Erotes' command over the essence of love, sexuality and relationships
strengths: Psychically cause subjects to act the opposite of the norms expected of their gender
Psychically alter one's own gender (and the gender of other animals/organisms)
Merge with a member of the opposite sex (disguise appearance, gain power, share thoughts/abilities)
weaknesses: This topic tends to make people uncomfortable...
MythPower: Hermes' Hustle provides immunity
MythPower: Aphrodisia, MythPower: Arrows of Eros and MythPower: Oath of Ouranos provide immunity

name: Awesome Mustach
description: You can change the style, length, color, and texture of the mustach at will, and control it's actions telepathically. The mustach has enough power to lift three metric tons, but if you don't want to be crushed use part of the mustach to transfer the added force to the ground. In addition, you gain the power of ultimate respect. The weak willed shall obey the power of the MUSTACH! In addition, your natural charm increases and you gain the powers of subduction and hypnosis through the mustach!
summary: The ability to grow the greatest mustach in existence not held by the omnipotent.
strengths: You get to beat the #@%(* out of people with your indestructable facial hair.
All shall bow down to the great Mustach.
Look cool.
weaknesses: Human females do not get seduction, hypnosis, or natural charm when they have this power.
You may devolope facial dander.
Cannot use this power to grow a beard.

name: Myth Power: Aergia's Allegiance
description: Aergia, in Greek myth, was the goddess of sloth, laziness, sluggishness, lethargy, inactivity and apathy. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically induce feelings of tiredness, lethargy, sluggishness and apathy (even affects machines, androids/cyborgs, etc) by touch. In addition, one's mere presence causes superhuman abilities to become lazier, which worsens the closer one gets to a subject.
