One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel the naturally lazy and apathetic.
summary: The ability to channel Aergia's command over the essence of idleness, laziness, inactivity, sloth and lethargy
strengths: Make subjects lazy/sluggish/slothful/idle by touch (too lazy even to attack, defend or flee)
The closer one gets to the foe, the weaker, lazier and more lax foes' powers become
Psychically perceive, communicate with, share senses with and compel lazy people
weaknesses: Cannot make autonomic functions lazy with a touch until developed (NCN)
Lazy/sluggish/slothful/idle/lethargic people take more concentration to compel until developed (NCN)
Work/effort/force/strength-based MythPowers provide immunity

name: Symbol: The Dreamer
description: You were born with the gift of the Dreamer. You are creative and someone who has brilliant ideas, but you are usually too weak to act on these ideas. The Dreamers are gifted with an active mind, and cursed with a weak body.
summary: The ability to use the Dreamer
strengths: Brilliant idealist.
Someone very creative.
weaknesses: Bad at sports and athletics.
Your body is naturally weak.

name: Think Vampiric Sheep
description: With this power you can turn any object into a vampiric sheep. These vampiric sheep are under your complete control and you can even turn them back into the object they originally were when you're done with them.
summary: The ability to turn any object into a vampiric sheep
strengths: You can turn any object into a vampire sheep
They are under your complete control
weaknesses: They crave human flesh and blood

name: Territorial Omnistupidity
description: This ability targets logical thoughts, knowledge, sensory perception (normal or extra), and precognition of other people 300 miles around you by becoming absolutely stupid like a drooling monkey yourself. This ability is the exact opposite of Omniscience.
summary: The ability to make others stupid around you by becoming stupid yourself
strengths: Doesn't need strategy
Absolutely swift. They won't know what hit them
Very useful against people who "know it all"
weaknesses: You become stupid yourself
God knows what will happen to all of you

name: Myth Power: Shades Of Graiae
description: The Graiae (Graeae, Graiai), named Enyo, Deino (Dino) and Pemphredo (Pephredo, Persis) in Greek myth, were the goddesses of the gray of the sea (gray clouds, gray mist, gray sea foam) and the gray of old age. As such, channeling them allows one to psychically generate and manipulate gray clouds at will. In addition, one can psychically summon blinding gray mists at will. Furthermore, one can psychically generate and manipulate gray sea foam at will. One can even turn self/others old at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Graiae and their command over the essence of the gray of the sea
strengths: Psychically generate and manipulate (stand/ride on, etc) gray clouds, summon blinding gray mists
Psychically generate and manipulate gray sea foam at will; psychically turn self/others old at will
Choose one eye with which to receive psychic visions, one tooth with which to detect lies, at will
weaknesses: Cannot turn self into a swan at will (others by touch), until developed (NCN)
Cannot turn self into sea foam/mist at will (others by touch), until developed (NCN)
Cannot show OTHERS the past/present/future by Foamy-Water Scrying until developed (NCN)

name: Happy Life
description: The ability to be happy all the time
summary: The ability to be happy all the time
strengths: Fun person to be around
Optimistic and enthusiastic
Difficult moments in life won't affect you (mother dies)
weaknesses: Can't feel the other emotions such as sadness
Being too happy will make you look crazy

name: Fashion Sense
description: While the name may come across as humorous, it is no joke. It allows one to perceive information about clothes for various purposes. For example, you could get an intuitive sense of what you should wear that day, as a form of psychic weather forecasting. You could also attune yourself to a type of clothing to track anyone wearing that type of clothes. In addition, you can perceive flaws in clothes (untied shoe laces, etc.) and use them to your advantage in fights.
summary: The ability to perceive information about clothing, fashion and style
strengths: Discern what you should wear that day as a way to predict the weather and other future events
Attune yourself to an article clothing, and track anyone wearing it (blue skirt, boots, etc. )
Sense clothing flaws, use them to your advantage in fights
weaknesses: Often comes off as being a "girl" power
If you go by a superhero name, it's gonna suck
Armor is hard to read as far as flaws go (requires more concentration)

name: Celtic Invocation: Accasbel
description: By invoking the power of Accasbel, the invoker can do many things involving alcohol and its effects. They can turn the ingredients needed to make a type of alcohol into the drink, for example, hops and barely for beer, or grapes to wine. They can also invoke a sense of delusion and drunkenness in a target, and cure people of it too. Expert users can even add special 'ingredients' into the alcohol, such as emotions or memories, or make a drink everlasting, such as a bottomless bottle of vodka.
summary: The ability to channel the power of Accasbel, the Irish god of alcohol and taverns.
strengths: Alcohol and its effects are under your domain.
You never have to bother buying it yourself- you're your own still.
You'll be very popular at parties.
weaknesses: The invoker is not immune to the effects of alcohol or other users of this ability.
Only the most masterful users can create everlasting alcohol or add emotions to the alcohol.
Those with abilities that make them immune to alcohol or mental manipulation.

name: Backwards V2
description: With this power you can make people do everything backwards. They'll talk backwards, walk backwards, wear their clothes backwards, point their weapons backwards etc. You can use this on as many people as you want and reverse the effects when you're done.
summary: The ability to make people do everything backwards
strengths: Make people do things backwards
weaknesses: If the person normally did everything backwards they'll do everything the right way

name: Myth Power: Eumolpus' Melody
description: Eumolpus (Eumolpos), in Greek myth, was the god of the songs sung in the Eleusinian mystery rites. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically produce an entrancing mystical song, by voice or instrument, at will; few subjects (including those the user touches) will be able to resist mindlessly joining in on the song. In addition, one can solidify music notes into vectors of solid force to attack or defend. One can even withstand sonic/music/song-based attacks, and negate them by touch.
summary: The ability to channel Eumolpus' command over the essence of the songs of the Eleusinian mysteries
strengths: Produce an entrancing mystical song (in an unknown language) that others can't resist joining in on
Psychically solidify music notes into vectors of force at will (Musical Bolts or Forcefields)
Withstand sonic/music/song-based attacks (and negate them by touch); share that immunity by touch
weaknesses: Cannot entirely negate sonic/music/song-based attacks until the higher levels (NCN)
Pro #2 only works with musical notes (not normal, non-musical sounds)
Sonic/music/song-based MythPowers provide resistance when developed (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Silenos' Style
description: Silenos (Seilenos, Silenus), in Greek myth, was the god of wine-making, the dance of the wine-press and (somewhat) drunkenness. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically fill any bucket/basin/tub with grapes at will; when the grapes are tread upon, the juice produced may serve many different purposes. In addition, if one drinks enough wine to get drunk, that drunken mental state grants psychic knowledge of past, present and future. Furthermore, one can never suffer alcohol's ill effects.
summary: The ability to channel Silenos' command over the essence of winemaking, the dance of the wine press and drunkenness
strengths: Fill any bin/bucket/tub/basin with grapes at will; never go hungry or thirsty again
Tread grapes in bin/bucket/tub/basin for juice, medicine, acids, drugs and other chemical weapons
Get drunk and access knowledge of past/present/future; never get a hangover, or alcohol poisoning
weaknesses: Only turn ground beneath a subject into a quicksand-like pit of grapes at the higher levels (NCN)
This ability does not prevent drunkenness, and only allows psychic benefit from being drunk on WINE
People with MythPower: Bacchanalia can negate Pro #2 and 3

name: Myth Power: Aroura's Array
description: Aroura, in Greek myth, was the goddess of the fields, and arable land; land suited for growing farm crops. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically generate life-force to fertilize soil (thus accelerating plant growth) at will. In addition, one can psychically cause soil to absorb life-force from anyone who touches it (except self/allies), at will. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive and manipulate fertile soil, at will. One can even psychically assume a form of soil, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Aroura's command over the essence of the fields, and arable land
strengths: Psychically fertilize soil (accelerating plant growth in that soil), at will
Psychically turn soil into an absorbant life-force trap (only the user/allies may withstand it)
Psychically perceive, manipulate and mimic soil, at will
weaknesses: Cannot absorb life-force (heal self, gain physical power) in soil form, until developed (NCN)
Cannot teleport self/others to an infinite extradimensional cornfield until developed (NCN)
Agricultural/economic/cooking/food-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Order Pathy
description: This power allows the user to place orders for food and drink at any venue that sells it, using only the mind. This would allow for greatly lessened waiting times and more accurate orders.
summary: The ability to order food through the power of thought.
strengths: Order quickly.
Place an order even when the venue is busy.
weaknesses: In the wrong hands, it could cause cases, such as "I did not order this!"
Practically useless in a battle situation.

name: Enhancement: Purifying (M)
description: This power is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it mentally purifies what the power affects, thus making the affected good guys. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to mentally purify what a power affects
strengths: The evil can be redeemed.
"I can see the light"!
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
If you're evil.

name: Omninescience
description: In effect, the user's mind, upon activating this ability, becomes a black hole, a void through which no intelligence may escape and no knowledge, memory, reflex, instinct or response may escape. This means that aside from mental invulnerability, the user's mind fortifies the body allowing it to also "be ignorant" of the effects of harm, disease or age. Sadly, this comes at the cost that the user is rendered an unintelligent dunce until his subliminal mind senses that the danger has passed.
summary: The ability to ignore everything and ultimately know nothing
strengths: Psychics try to read the user's mind with this power in effect, they go into the vegetable state too
The user is rendered invulnerable to harm
The user's mind goes back to normal after danger passes
weaknesses: The user becomes a mindless, thoughtless, drooling duncebag until danger passes
May "sense danger" during a test (FAIL)
Can't pass effect to others

name: Myth Power: Ptocheia's Talent
description: Ptocheia (Ptokheia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of begging, beggary and beggars. As such, channeling her allows one to compel subjects to do one's bidding; however, it only works if the user begs them to do it. In addition, if subjects ask the user for anything, the user can make them forget what they asked for with a touch, a word or a thought. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive, communicate with, share the senses of and compel beggars/bums/hobos/transients/vagrants/homeless people.
summary: The ability to channel Ptocheia's command over the essence of begging, beggars, and want of resource
strengths: Compel subjects to do whatever you want by begging
Make beggars forget what they were begging for (no more bothersome hobos/bums asking for change)
Psychically perceive, communicate with, share senses with and compel beggars/bums/hobos
weaknesses: Nobody likes a beggar; beggars can't be choosy, etc.
MythPower: Sophrosyne's Solace provides immunity (NCN)
MythPowers based on Ptocheia's sisters provide immunity (and vice versa)

name: Think Sunburn
description: With this people you can give people sunburns just by thinking of that person with a sunburn
summary: The ability to give people sunburns
strengths: You can make people in extreme pain by giving them sunburns all over their body
If an enemy is aiming a weapon at you you can give their hand a sunburn so that they drop the weapon
weaknesses: A sunburn isn't that painful

name: Mood Ring V2
description: If you're sad, your fingernails turn blue. If you're happy, they'll turn orange-pink. If you're angry, they'll turn red. If you are envious, they'll turn green. If you're agitated (as in, in pain), they'll turn purple. If you're in love, they'll turn completely pink.
summary: The ability to have your fingernails change colors depending on your mood
strengths: Possible to gain a new power whenever your nails change color
If you're uncertain if you're in love or not, look at your hands
weaknesses: Obvious when you're using it

name: Myth Power: Baubo's Burlesque
description: Baubo, in Greek myth, was the goddess of the vulva (female sex organ), as well as promiscuity and female sexual indecency (like exposing genitalia). As such, channeling her allows one to assume the form of any female humanoid at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive and communicate with females of any species (and compel males) at will. One may even psychically absorb power from females (including sexual fertility) by a touch; this same touch induces sexual pleasure in males.
summary: The ability to channel Baubo's command over the essence of the vulva, promiscuity and female indecency
strengths: Assume the form of any female humanoid at will (regardless of one's true gender)
Psychically perceive and communicate with females (and compel males)
Touch females to absorb power (and enhance female attributes); touch males to induce sexual pleasure
weaknesses: Cannot assume the form of female animals (besides humanoids) until developed (NCN)
Cannot develop a psychic link with subjects by sleeping with them until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Demeter's Touch and MythPower: Phales' Philander provide immunity (NCN)

name: Microsoft Manager
description: Cannot control any other computer operating systems.
summary: The ability to control anyone on microsoft at the time
strengths: Lots of people use microsoft
weaknesses: If the system goes down, so do you

name: Calli, The Trusted House
description: This power can be manifested in various ways. You can create a sealed house made of adobe bricks all around the targeted people. If they are in a house, you can reinforce the walls and fill any opening with adobe clay. These are spiritual manifestation of your will, so it's impervious to supernatural ways of violation, like teleportation. You can also create a "house" around people's mind and heart, reinforcing their trust in people they really know, while magnifying their distrust in others.
summary: The ability to close off people from outside and foreign influence.
strengths: Protect yourself or others with supernatural adobe houses.
Your houses are immune to supernatural ways of violation.
Your houses are unmovable too.
weaknesses: Not even you can violate the houses you created, except maybe by removing them.
If you create a house around you to protect yourself, you won't be able to move very far.
It's very dark in your houses since there are no windows either.

name: Myth Power: Thrasos' Thrill
description: Thrasos (Thrasus), in Greek myth, was the god of rush, carelessness, recklessness and rashness. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically disrupt perception of probability, luck, fate, chance, the past or the future by touch. In addition, one's luck increases when one acts erratically, recklessly and without careful forethought. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive and communicate with rash and reckless people at will. One may even psychically compel careful, meticulous people.
summary: The ability to channel Thrasos' command over the essence of carelessness, recklessness and rash action
strengths: Prevent psychic perception of luck/fortune/chance/probability/fate/destiny, the past or the future
Gain better and better luck the more rash, erratic, reckless and spontaneous one acts
Psychically perceive and communicate with reckless people; compel cautious, prudent people
weaknesses: You are encouraged to rash, spontaneous action (the make of this power is a prude)
Probability/chance/luck based-MythPowers and Unpredictability provide immunity (NCN)
Mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Malinalli, The Disease Carrier
description: This power has two phases. They alternate each time you activate it and last for 13 days before you can turn them off. During the first one, your hair will become withered grass and you will contaminate everyone near you with a contageous disease which exacerbates the worst aspects of one's emotions, personality, physical condition,... During the other, your hair will become green grass and everyone who has been contaminated will become completely healthy and receive a huge boost of vitality.
summary: The ability to alternatively cause periods of devastating epidemic and periods of rejuvenation.
strengths: Depending on the point of view, your power can be seen as a purge of the weak elements.
You can heal any disease, that is if the person can survive the first phase of your power.
Give a huge power boost to your allies during the 2nd phase, but they need to survive the 1st one.
weaknesses: You need to wait for thirteen days before you can turn each phase off.
If you made enemies during the 1st phase, they could get the means to kill you during the 2nd one.
The disease of the 1st phase doesn't kill directly, but it easily triggers wars and conflicts.

name: Hobokinesis
description: You can control hobos with your mind. Example of uses: slavery, armies, or just for entertainment.
summary: The ability to control hobos with one's mind.
strengths: Controlling hobos.
Formation of possible armies; slavery uses; entertainment purposes.
weaknesses: Uncleanliness
Hobos frequently self-defecate.

name: Call Of Cthulhu
description: With this power, all you need do is pick up a phone and say "Call Cthulhu" into the receiver. Within seconds, the Great Old One will pick up the phone, and you can talk to him. He will respond to you and act as if you might have been an old friend of his from school.
summary: The ability to call Cthulhu from any phone
strengths: You get to talk to Cthulhu
I'm sure Cthulhu knows a lot more than you do, and he might share that knowledge if you're nice
If you're really nice, and Cthulhu is in a good mood, he might just unleash his hell on your enemies
weaknesses: Cthulhu might be busy, and he probably doesn't like being interrupted
You may go insane from the knowledge he bestows upon you
You probably shouldn't make jokes at his expense

name: Myth Power: Eusebia's Sapience
description: Eusebia (Eusebeia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of piety, duty and filial respect. As such, channeling her allows one to strengthen one's connection to deities of one's same moral alignment for as long as the power is in use. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those who honestly believe in, love and respect divinity (regardless of mental defenses). One can even psychically inflict harm on those who honestly hate, deny or mock/disrespect divinity, by touch.
summary: The ability to channel Eusebia's command over the essence of piety, duty and filial respect
strengths: Psychically strengthen connection to deities of similar moral alignment, regardless of pantheon
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel pious people/people of faith
Psychically inflict pain/injury on atheists, agnostics, and the irreligious at will
weaknesses: When active, cannot use MythPower: Dyssebia's Defiance or other anti-divine abilities (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with and heal loved ones until the higher levels (NCN)
Law/order/justice-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Enhancement: Radioactive
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the power act like it is radioactive. E. G. Physical-based powers give off radiation that only you are immune to, and mental powers feel like they are giving off radioactive 'particles'. Potency is set at beta radiation. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced. This can only be attached to one power at a time.
summary: The ability to make a power act radioactive by attaching this power to it
strengths: Makes mind-based powers act like they are radioactive.
You are immune to the 'radiation' this power gives off.
Potency is at a good level.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Can still be damaged by other radiation.
Might not want a power to be radioactive.

name: Myth Power: Telete's Test
description: Telete, in Greek myth, was the goddess of initiation into mystery rites, such as cults and secret societies. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive the locations of meeting places for cults and secret societies. In addition, one may psychically perceive, communicate and compel members of secret societies and cults. Furthermore, one may inscribe arcane symbols on matter by touch; only the user, and subjects chosen by him, may interact with inscribed objects or subjects.
summary: The ability to channel Telete's command over the essence of mystic initiation
strengths: Psychically perceive the locatons of meeting places for cults and secret societies
Psychically perceive, communicate with, share senses with and compel secret society/cult members
Inscribe matter with cryptic symbols; only the user and chosen subjects can sense/interact with them
weaknesses: Only encode speech/writing into a special language for user and chosen subjects at the higher levels
Cannot decipher arcane/occult language to cast arcane/occult spells until the higher levels (NCN)
People with MythPower: Bacchanalia are immune to this ability

name: Imaginary Friendship
description: This power binds you to someone (You can't choose who) and allows you to see anything they imagine and make it real. However, the subject's mind has a noticeable affect on yours. If they're childish or immature, so are you, etc. Only the subject can see you, unless they want someone else to see you as well. The power runs out when the subject dies (and then you die) or decides to let you go (in which case you are free, and retain the power, only not bound to a single individual)
summary: The ability to turn someone else's imagination into reality.
strengths: A close friendship with whoever you're bound to.
Because of the effect on your mentality, anything they imagine is fun for you to create
If you're manipulative enough, you could get the subject to imagine whatever you want
weaknesses: Potential death
Having to be bound to one person, unable to interact with anyone else, unless the person wills it
You're basically a slave

name: Summon Haterage
description: Haterages look like sharks remolded into a elf-shape. Haterages can project a field that makes anyone affected go mindless and utterly hate and want to kill non-kystians (you're safe as is anyone with a kystian power). The field has a spherical radius of a 1000 feet. The effect last for 20 minutes. Anti-telepathy or like powers gives immunity to this power. Haterages can lift 15 tons,run 50 mph and actually swim as fast as a real shark.
summary: The ability to summon a hate-field projecting kystian.
strengths: Turning heroes against each other
If you're really evil then this power is perfect for you
weaknesses: Anti-telepathy or anything that works in a similar way

name: Myth Power: Agnoia's Annoyance
description: Agnoia, in Greek myth, was the goddess of ignorance, misunderstanding, misinformation, gullibility, naivete and mistaken identity. As such, channeling her allows one to make foes gullible and naive to information they see and hear, by touch. In addition, when one mentally/vocally expresses confusion or misunderstanding of a topic, one can psychically deal damage to the source of said confusion. One can even psychically distort words (spoken, heard, written, typed, etc) to misinform foes at will.
summary: The ability to channel Agnoia's command over the essence of ignorance, misunderstanding and mistaken identity
strengths: Psychically make foes gullible and naive, by touch
Psychically/psionically deal damage to anything that confuses you
Psychically distort words to misinform foes who hear or see/read them
weaknesses: Cannot cause subjects to mistake or forget identities (of self/others) until developed (NCN)
Effects of Pro #1 only last until power use is up, until developed (NCN)
Pro #3 does not work long-distance (or on thoughts) until developed (NCN)

name: Creepy Complexion
description: With this ability, you can creep a certain person out by making them get surrounded by your face in a creepy way -- or another way when you have more control. Though these faces can cause insanity to the victim of your ability, you can even make each face speak different things when you have learned to control it better. And, even if your victim is immune to mind abilities, they can still freak out because of your original "Creepy Complexion" face if you make them look directly into your eyes.
summary: The ability to change your face to look creepy to one person and duplicate it multiple times.
strengths: Can make people go insane
You can make it happen to anyone, unless they are immune to all abilities
People fear the mask you wear
weaknesses: You have to wear a mask, and cover your eyes most of the time.
Have to wear mask for protection of others who look upon your face.
Can make people go insane

name: Myth Power: Iynx's Jinx
description: Iynx (Jynx, Jinx), in Greek myth, was the goddess of the love charm. As such, channeling her allows one to gain skill in making and using love charms. In addition, one can psychically perceive the location of anybody with whom one is infatuated or enamored (as well as if they return one's affections), at will. Furthermore, against foes (and crushes who refuse one's affections), love charms may also/instead be used to induce misfortune. One can even withstand love charms and love-based abilities.
summary: The ability to channel Iynx's command over the essence of the love charm
strengths: Gain skill in making/using love charms; spells/potions/talismans, etc; immune to love effects
Psychically perceive location of those who attract you, or are attracted to you
Against foes (and refusers of one's affections) love potions may induce attraction OR misfortune
weaknesses: Cannot summon ready-made love charms or shapeshift into a magic wryneck bird until developed (NCN)
Magic Immunity, Magic Negation, etc provide immunity (NCN)
MythPower: Pan's Prowess, MythPower: Echo Echo provide immunity (NCN)

name: Four Eyes: Terror
description: This power is gained by not using the Four Eyes power at all and not opening the two other eyes. The Four Eyes power will slowly turn into this power. Whenever anyone stares into all four of your eyes simultaneously, they become scared and die. This happens because they see the demonic form that you can transform into at will. It is very powerful and different for everyone. But to transform, you have to be clear of all emotions when transforming.
summary: The ability to make anyone who looks into one's eyes scared and they die because they see one's demon form
strengths: You can transform and kill enemies quickly. Who's going to trace scaring to death?
You can still use the other Four Eyes powers.
This is an evolved form of Four Eyes.
weaknesses: Must have Four Eyes power and not use it (have the two oddball eyes closed).
The person must stare into all four eyes at the SAME time and this power can ONLY kill.
You cannot get the other Four Eyes evolutions anymore.

name: Myth Power: Koros' Cruelty
description: Koros (Corus), in Greek myth, was the god of greed, excess, disgust and disdain. As such, channeling him allows one to summon money, of any currency at will. In addition, one may use a safe, a wallet or one's pockets as infinite-storage hammerspace. Furthermore, one can psychically repel, or pass intangibly through anything that one considers shameful, undesirable or disgusting. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel greedy people, snobs and people with similar dislikes.
summary: The ability to channel Koros' command over the essence of greed, excess, disgust and disdain
strengths: Psychically summon money of any currency at will; use a safe, wallet or one's pockets as hammerspace
Psychically repel or pass intangibly through (via Phasing) anything one finds shameful/disgusting
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel people who are greedy/snobby/have similar dislikes
weaknesses: Amount of money that can be summoned must develop over time (NCN)
Only obliterate inanimate matter you dislike, by touch, when developed (NEVER living things) (NCN)
MythPower: Hearken to Hybris and Peace/harmony/friendship-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Zzz Powers
description: With this power you can put a curse on any power on this site, so that whenever somebody gets it, they fall asleep for one hundred years. During the hundred years of sleep the person cannot age and cannot be hurt or killed. He/she can however be moved to a different location. After one hundred years of sleep the person wakes up and can now use the power he had acquired. You can curse a 100 powers at a time and if you change your mind you can uncurse the powers.
summary: The ability to curse any power on the list so that when somebody gets it they fall asleep for 100 years
strengths: You can put a curse on powers that causes people to fall into a deep sleep for 100 years
The person cannot be hurt or killed and does not age
After the 100 year period the person wakes up and can use the powers
weaknesses: You cannot kill or hurt the person while they sleep
Limited to a 100 power at a time - choose wisely
Can't choose the daypower

name: Teenager's Invulnerability
description: During adolescence, the frontal lobe is under development and as a result, judgement of the consequences of one's actions is often poor. This power compensates by providing immunity while in this dangerous state. It will not work if you are of sound mind during this phase, but may activate if the same mentality arises at another time.
summary: The ability to be invulnerable to physical harm in adolescence.
strengths: Rode a bike down a hill, lost control and slammed into a concrete wall? No problem (for you).
The judgement of risk/reward is now truly an afterthought.
Even protects against things outside your control, effectively insuring you reach adulthood.
weaknesses: Cons cannot be removed by another power.
Only works while in this judgement-deprived state.
Does not protect you against diseases and still leaves you fertile.

name: Myth Power: Course Of Chronoi 2
description: The Chronoi (Khronoi, Times), in Greek myth, were the gods of past, present and future. As such, channeling Enestos (Enestus- Present), one can psychically perceive the passage of time, at will. In addition, one can withstand temporal effects. Furthermore, one can psychically receive insights from the present, at will. One can also psychically pause subjects' perception of the present, by touch, word or thought. One can also psychically summon past and/or future targets to the present, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Chronoi and their command over the essence of past, present and future
strengths: Psychically perceive the passage of time, at will; withstand temporal effects
Psychically preceive updates about the present, freeze subjects' senses in the present moment
Psychically summon past/future targets to the present, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically remove memories/negate visions of the past, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically bestow visions of the present, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically remove ability to plan for/negate visions of the future, until developed (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Britomartis' Best
description: Britomartis (Dictynna, Diktynna, Dicte, Dikte), in Greek myth, was the goddess of nets, for hunting, fishing and fowling. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive, communicate with and share senses with animals that are hunted in one's vicinity (for food, sport, etc). In addition, one can psychically summon nets, of various sizes and types (razor, electrified, butterfly, fish etc) at will. One can even psychically store any subject one captures in a net, in a pocket dimension.
summary: The ability to channel Britomartis' command over the essence of nets used for hunting, fishing and fowling
strengths: Psychically perceive, communicate with and share senses with game animals
Psychically summon nets of various sizes, types and utilities (electrified, razor, etc) at will
Psychically store any net-captured subjects in a pocket dimension, at will
weaknesses: Cannot compel hunters or command game animals until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically replicate net-captured subjects, and compel the replicates, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith, Hand of the Harvest and Artemis' Art provides immunity (NCN)

name: Itch Inducing
description: If induced by a touch, it is called a Pruritic Touch; if induced by a thought it is just called Itch Inducing. Either way, the user of this ability can cause an itching sensation in nearby living beings. This itching can be varied in intensity at will as well, rangning from maybe a mosquito bite to a continuous, maddening itch that isn't easily relieved. This ability may also include the capability to SUPPRESS itching sensations as well (called Itch Negation).
summary: The ability to induce itching of varying intensity
strengths: Distract foes with annoying itch
Easily control the intensity of the induced itch
Negate itches at will (even itches not caused by you)
weaknesses: If you cause itching randomly (no control over the power)
If you can't stop the itching
If you can only INCREASE itching sensation (not start it or stop it)

name: First Person Power
description: For example, if someone tries to say "See that guy over there? He's stupid," he'd end up saying "See me over here? I'm stupid. " He wouldn't notice it.
summary: The ability to have other people talk about you in the first person
strengths: Kinda hilarious
weaknesses: Not very useful
Can't turn it off.

name: Half Troll
description: Someone with this power has a higher resistance to physical and magical attacks, but is more susceptible to psychic/mental attacks. Also, they have a high regenerative factor that allows them to recover from most injuries within an hour, as well as higher physical strength.
summary: The ability to be half-human, half-troll
strengths: Most magical and physical attacks you can shrug off with ease making you a great tank.
weaknesses: Mental attacks will be your greatest weakness.

name: Myth Power: Polis Policy
description: Poleios (Poleius) and Polis, in Greek myth, were god and goddess counterparts (respectively) of the city. As such, channeling them allows one to psychically perceive the name, location and various other facts about any city in the Cosmos at will. In addition, one may psychically teleport to any city at will, as well as gaining physical power when in a city. One may even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel anyone who is native to (ie, was born in) the city that one travels to.
summary: The ability to channel Poleios and Polis' command over the essence of the city
strengths: Psychically perceive the name, location, etc of any city in the Cosmos
Teleport self and others to any city; gain physical power when in a city
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel natives of one's current city at will
weaknesses: Cannot teleport self and others to a skyscraper's top/height at will until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot teleport self and others to any FICTIONAL city until the higher levels (NCN)
Pro #3 does not apply to subjects who have lived in that city more than a year until developed (NCN)

name: Kyst: Emergency Power #1
description: This power lets Kyst use all your senses, know what you know and what emotions you are feeling. If Kyst feels a situation is going badly for you, it will call for kystians or more kystians to aid you. It will summon forty kystians. You will have no say over what kind of kystians are summoned nor any control over them. Kyst will determine what kind are needed and how they act. These kystians will disappear as soon as the situation is over. You are allowed three bad situations a day.
summary: The ability to have Kyst call for backup if you need more kystians.
strengths: Forty or forty more kystians to help in a fight.
weaknesses: Only 3 times a day.

name: Myth Power: Chresis' Course
description: Chresis (Khresis), in Greek myth, was the goddess of acquired wealth and property (inheritance, etc) and the proper use of acquired wealth and property. As such, channeling her allows one to psionically loot wallets, safes, and the like, of their contents, by touch. In addition, by touch, one can psychically perceive an object's proper function and operation, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically erase foes' memories of how to use or operate certain objects, by touch, word or thought.
summary: The ability to channel Chresis' command over the essence of acquired wealth, and its proper use
strengths: Psionically loot wallets, safes, etc of money (diverting loot into a personal hammerspace) by touch
Psychically perceive an object's proper function and operation, by touch, at will
Psychically erase foes' memories of how to use or operate certain objects, by touch, word or thought
weaknesses: MythPower: Ktisis' Ticket and MythPower: Ctesios' Title provide immunity to Pro #1 (NCN)
Cannot 'amplify' an object's use and make it operate on its own (ie Animation) until developed (NCN)
Cannot cause foe to suffer pain/injury for improper use of objects until developed (NCN)

name: Spawn: Roman Restaurant
description: You are able to spawn a roman restaurant.  You are served food by wind spirits.  This wind spirits are telepathic, so they will read your mind and will know what you want to eat.  The food is very good and up to 600 guests can be served at a time.
summary: The ability to spawn a roman restaurant.
strengths: Spawn an awesome mess hall
Food is great
Served quickly (wind spirits make food fast and serve fast)
weaknesses: People might think its a real restaurant and walk in.
Since they are fast, make one wrong movement and you can have your lunch on your face...

name: Zodiac: Capricorn
description: You know that old stereotype of goats eating anything even metal cans or plastics? By drawing the sign of Capricorn the Goat up to 2 metres in front of your target, you can make them want to eat anything around them, regardless of nutritional value, for 10 seconds.
summary: The ability to make an enemy think that it is a good idea to eat anything nearby
strengths: Long enough to run away.
weaknesses: Being the nearest thing to your target.
Anti-telepathy.

name: Myth Power: Graces' Gratuity
description: These Charites (Kharites, Graces), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of fame and honor. As such, channeling Cleta (Kleta- Sounds of Fame), one can psychically generate a forcefield of semi-solid music, applause and cheering, to contain subjects, at will. Channeling Phaenna (Brilliance, Brightness of Fame), one can psychically generate a forcefield of spotlights and camera flashes, to contain subjects, at will. One can even psychically convert light into blasts of sound, and vice versa, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Charites' command over the essence of fame and honor
strengths: Psychically generate a forcefield of music, applause and cheering to contain subjects, at will
Psychically generate a forcefield of spotlights and camera flashes to contain subjects, at will
Psychically convert light into blasts of sound, and sound into blasts of light, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically bend light to cast glamor of celebrities' appearances, until developed (NCN)
Cannot receive psychic insight in various celebrities' voices, until developed (NCN)
Light Immunity, Light Absorption, Sonic Immunity, Sonic Absorption, etc provide immunity (NCN)

name: Cheerleading
description: With the clap of your hands, you can make any specific individual feel good. If a little girl was crying, you could applaud her and erase the sadness from her mind. Cheering is another method of doing this. This power will only work if the specific individual hears the applause or cheer.
summary: The ability to make someone happy just by applauding or cheering.
strengths: You can spread happiness.
Erase sadness, grief, pain, etc.
weaknesses: Only works if the individual HEARS the applause or cheer.
Sometimes sadness can be a good thing.

name: Fluffy Bunny
description: You just scream "Super fluffy bunny power! " and whap! You're the hot pink bunny of your dreams. Of course, you're still the same size of a regular bunny, but you can shoot hot pink lasers out of your eyes.
summary: The ability to change into a fluffy, hot pink bunny whenever you want.
strengths: You can run really fast as a bunny
You can spy on people
weaknesses: If you accidentally scream "Super hot pink bunny power! " during school.

name: Myth Power: Dyssebia's Defiance
description: Dyssebia (Dyssebeia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of impiety, disrespect for deities/divinities and atheism. As such, channeling her allows one to prevent deities from contacting oneself for as long as the power is in use. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those who honestly hate, deny or mock/disrespect divinity (regardless of mental defenses). One can even psychically inflict harm on those who honestly believe in, love and respect divinity, by touch.
summary: The ability to channel Dyssebia's command over the essence of irreligious impiety and godlessness
strengths: Psychically prevent contact with any deities, regardless of moral alignment or pantheon
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel atheists, agnostics, and the irreligious
Psychically inflict pain/injury on pious people/people of faith
weaknesses: When active, cannot use MythPower: Eusebia's Sapience or other divine abilities (NCN)
Cannot disrupt others' connection to the divine by touch until the higher levels (NCN)
Sin/injustice/corruption-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Evil Mind
description: This power is only for villains. Whenever a person tries to manipulate your knowledge, emotion or willpower (this includes telepathy and empathy), they are then forced to look at your mind which will send them continuous terrible nightmares. You will gain amazing evil thoughts all of the time and be immune to fear inducers. Sometimes will project into a death stare and/or an uneasy aura if it's powerful enough.
summary: The ability to have an evil mind that is to horrible to manipulate.
strengths: Perspicuity with a terrifying twist.
You could be an extremely good evil mastermind.
People will feel uneasy around you.
weaknesses: You can't completely project the fear like a Psychic Intimidator or Fear Inducer.
This power is only for a villain.
Fear Immunity, Emotionlessness, etc.

name: Lampokinesis
description: Whenever you find that the suspension of disbelief is just about broken, you can use this power to bring the absurdity of something like, gee I don't know, superpowers, into perspective.  In order to have this power, you must exist in the real world, since having it in super hero land can sometimes come off as needlessly skeptical and stops the story altogether.   Examples include the one time I thought it was pretty weird that I said this won't work in real life. That seems out of place.
summary: The ability to lamp shade plot elements with your mind.
strengths: Reassure everyone that real life is boring.
Bring the audience back into the story.
Point out that superpowers aren't supposed to be real.
weaknesses: A major buzz-kill.
Makes world-building and creativity futile.
It doesn't stop the lamp shaded thing from existing.

name: Freak Out
description:
This ability is an instant cast ability that frees the user from their own boundaries allowing them to release their emotions upon their target with ease and control. 

Freak Out causes an instant explosion of emotion that confuses the target and usually causes them to run away and wonder what exactly they did or said to trigger such a sharp reaction.
summary: The ability to freak out on someone
strengths: Gets you out of just about any situation
Freak Out is instant cast, so it doesn't take any prep time
Doesn't require any thinking
weaknesses: You don't really know what the target's reaction to your freak out will be
People might think differently about you after you use Freak Out
Innocent bystanders might be affected by your Freak Out

name: Myth Power: Polemos' Pull
description: Polemos (Polemus), in Greek myth, was the god of civil war and civil battle (war and battle between two parts of the same nation). As such, channeling him allows one to perceive past, present and future civil war at will. In addition, one can psychically summon objects, items and weapons from past, present and future civil wars at will. Furthermore, one can time travel to any civil war in history. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel civil war veterans and experts.
summary: The ability to channel Polemos' command over the essence of civil war and civil battle
strengths: Psychically perceive past/present/future civil war (even alternate dimensions, when developed)
Psychically summon objects/items/weapons from past/present/future civil wars at will
Time Travel to any civil war; perceive, communicate with and compel civil war vets and experts
weaknesses: Civil wars on distant planets/in distant galazies are much harder to perceive (NCN)
Cannot psychically channel the spirits of dead civil war vets until the higher levels (NCN)
Combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction-based MythPowers provide power from this ability (NCN)

name: Monstrorient
description: The victim of this power will seek out ways to change into a monster. A mindless zombie will be a acceptable transformation. The transformed victim will try to avoid anyone or anything that would reverse the transformation. The range of this power is 500 feet.
summary: The ability to make a normal human want to become a monster.
strengths: The perfect power for a contagious monster.
weaknesses: The range is only 500 feet.

name: Antibacteriakinesis
description:
Users of antibacteriakinesis never worry about washing their hands, as they have the ability to generate an endless amount of antibacterial soap through sheer force of will! 

Advanced users develop the ability to psychokinetically manipulate said substance. Which might have some use I guess.
summary: The ability to create and manipulate antibacterial soap with your mind.
strengths: Neverending supply of antibacterial soap!
You can be the most cleanest!
Did I mention how germ-free you'll be!
weaknesses: There aren't any. Free soap.

name: Zombie Mind Conversion
description: One with this ability does not turn people into zombies, but instead causes them to act like zombies; use it on self and friends to give zombies the impression of being one of them; inflict it permanently on foes, so you have a right to kill them (cause, well, they'll act like a zombie); at the higher levels, use it on zombies to make them act civilized
summary: The ability to zombify a subject's thought pattern
strengths: Make zombies think you're one of them to avoid attack (at higher levels make zombies act civilized)
Make foes permanently act zombie-like (no risk of conversion)
Great with necromantic and other death related powers
weaknesses: At the lower levels, the effect may be temporary
At the lower levels, the effect may be permanent
Cannot CONTROL zombies or zombified minds with this power

name: Myth Power: Homage To Homados
description: Homados (Homadus), in Greek myth, was the god of battle-noise, uproar and the din of conflict (clanging weapons, etc). As such, channeling him allows one to cast an illusion of that same war noise, which drowns out conversation and sonic abilities (Sonic Scream, Psychic Persuasion, etc). It may also be used to enrage subjects in radius, making them hostile and violent until they can no longer hear it. One can even produce a cloud of (non-illusory) battle-noise at will, to fight foes.
summary: The ability to channel Homados' command over the essence of uproar and battle noise
strengths: Battle noise drowns out conversation (and sound-based effects) and distracts concentration
Battle noise may be used to enrage all neutrals in radius (until they can no longer hear it)
Produce a rushing, thrashing, whirling Battle-Noise Sound Cloud to literally fight foes
weaknesses: Cannot use Battle-Noise Sound Cloud to stand or ride/fly on until the higher levels (NCN)
Sonic Immunity, Sonic Absorption and/or Protected Hearing provide immunity (NCN)
Combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction-based MythPowers provide power with this ability (NCN)

name: Zombie Ninja Summon
description: With this power you can summon zombies with all of the skills and abilities of your average stereotypical ninja. Enhanced senses and agility, a black belt in several forms of karate, being able to wield swords, nun-chucks and ninja stars with ease and being able to move without making any noise. They're also undead so they have a craving for brains, smell horrible and can't be killed. The three ninja zombies are under your complete control and you can unsummon them whenever you want.
summary: The ability to summon three zombie ninjas
strengths: You can summon three zombie ninjas
They have all of the attributes of a zombie and a ninja
They are under your complete control
weaknesses: They smell bad
Sometimes they fall apart

name: Skeptic Vibe
description: You give off a vibe that makes the supernatural (psychics, ghosts, cryptids, aliens, witches, faith healers) extremely uncomfortable, to the point where anything supernatural avoids you and the area you're in.
summary: The ability to give off a vibe that makes the supernatural avoid you.
strengths: Never have to worry about supernatural threats.
Drive off the supernatural with your mere presence.
weaknesses: You will never encounter anything supernatural.

name: Obsessive Compulsive
description: If you are attacked by an enemy, this ability is a great defense. Instead of hurting this person their attack bonuses back on them making them obsessed over a thing or action, even a personal trait long enough for you get away or capture them, example making a person count every breath they take and trying repeat the same number every minute or something.
summary: The ability to make someone obsess over something or some act for a length of time.
strengths: Great defence mechanism. Distraction helps you gets past enemy and capture suspects.
Make people look like fools in battle. Free House cleaning. Perfect cooking everytime.
weaknesses: You could find yourself spending too time tormenting people.
You could get a victims killed if battling in large numbers.
You could make someone become obsessed for the rest of their life.

name: Cop Detector
description: With this power you can detect if there is a police officer near you or somebody near you is an undercover cop. The person will automatically have yellowish glow in your eyes and you a faint beeping will go off in your head if there is a cop near you that you can't see.
summary: The ability to know if somebody is a cop
strengths: You will know if there is a police officer near you
weaknesses: The beeping might get annoying
You can't turn this power off
Only works for police officers not any law enforcement officer (FBI, CIA etc. )

name: Myth Power: Hand Of The Harvest
description: Carmanor (Karmanor) and his granddaughter Carme (Karme), in Greek myth, were god and goddess counterparts (respectively) of the field's summer harvest. As such, channeling them allows one to psychically cut through plant matter at will. In addition, one may psychically disrupt plant-based abilities, by touch. Furthermore, one can withstand (and gain physical power in) hot/summer-like conditions. One may even summon indestructible farming implements (pitchfork, scythe, sickle, hoe, etc) at will.
summary: The ability to channel Carmanor and Carme's command over the essence of harvesting
strengths: Psychically cut through plant matter (fruits/vegetables, wood, cardboard, paper, etc) at will
Psychically disrupt plant-based abilities by touch; withstand (and gain power from) hot conditions
Summon indestructible harvest tools (scythe, sickle, hoe, pitchfork etc) for weapons at will
weaknesses: Cannot channel heat through harvest tools (summoned or not) until the higher levels (NCN)
Only psychically perceive and manipulate crop plants (grain, wheat, etc) at the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Gaia's Gift and MythPower: Demeter's Touch provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Carpos' Caper
description: Carpos (Carpus, Karpos) and the Carpoi (Karpoi), in Greek myth, were the gods of fruits of the earth, including the fruits of the fields (grain and the like). As such, channeling them allows one to psychically perceive, communicate with and manipulate fruit, grain and fruit- and grain-bearing plants, at will. In addition, one can gain physical power from eating fruits and farm-grown crops. One can even psychically compel subjects to gorge out on fruit and grain by touch, word or thought.
summary: The ability to channel Carpos and the Carpoi, and their command over the essence of the fruits of the earth
strengths: Psychically perceive, communicate with and manipulate fruits/grain and fruit/grain plants
Enhanced stats from eating fruits and wheat/grains; developed, psychically mimic fruit/grain at will
Compel subjects to gorge out on fruit/vegetables/grain (abandoning all else)
weaknesses: Cannot root subjects to the ground, sprouting various fruits/grain, by touch until developed (NCN)
Cannot generate supernatural fruit (even from body of self/others), until developed (NCN)
Plant/animal/nature-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Eileithyia's Labor
description: Eileithyia (Eilethyia, Eilethyia, Ilithyia, Eleutho) and the Eileithyiae (Eileithyiai, Eilethyiae, Eilethyiai), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of pregnancy, labor and childbirth. As such, channeling them allows one to perceive when a female subject is pregnant and many other facts about women's pregnancies. In addition, one may induce or delay birth labor at will. One may even induce or amplify labor pains on any female; males may be afflicted with the proportionate version of the same pain.
summary: The ability to channel Eileithyia and the Eileithyiae's command over the essence of pregnancy, labor and childbirth
strengths: Perceive information about any female's pregancy, labor and childbirth (including self, if female)
Induce or stall birth labor for as long as one desires
Induce, intensify or quell birth pangs in any female, pregnant or not (males feel similar pain)
weaknesses: Cannot induce/prevent a baby's conception or development genetics until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot alter unborn babies' genetics until the higher levels; NEVER induce pregnancy in males (NCN)
Cannot transfer one's soul into the body of an unborn baby (if killed) until the higher levels (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Demokratia's Demand
description: Demokratia (Democratia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of democracy. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive subjects' moral alignments as psionic 'votes'. If the evil 'votes' outnumber the good, then foes suffer bad luck; if the good 'votes' outnumber the evil, then self and allies gain good luck. In addition, psychic compulsion and reversal of moral alignment is automatically negated in one's presence. One can even psychically teleport to anywhere democracy is being exercised, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Demokratia's command over the essence of democracy
strengths: Psychically perceive subjects' moral alignments as 'votes'; use 'votes' to bestow good/bad luck
Psychic compulsion and reversal of moral alignment automatically fails in one's presence
Psychically perceive and teleport to anywhere democracy is being exercised, at will
weaknesses: Cannot use good votes to bestow HEALING, or bad votes to inflict PAIN/INJURY, until developed (NCN)
Cannot enhance the force behind subjects' voices until developed (NCN)
Law/order/justice-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Pompe's Procession
description: Pompe, in Greek myth, was the goddess of religious procession and ceremony. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically access the customs and traditions of every religion, religious sect and cult in existence. In addition, one may perceive the religious beliefs of others at will. Furthermore, one may psychically perceive, communicate with and share senses with those who share one's religious/spiritual views. One may even do physical and mental harm, by a touch, to those who do not.
summary: The ability to channel Pompe's command over the essence of religious procession
strengths: Psychically access all knowledge of existing religions, religious sects and cults
Psychically perceive others' religious views at will; harm those with differing religious views
Psychically perceive, communicate with and share senses with those with similar religious views
weaknesses: Cannot compel subjects with similar religious views until the higher levels
The closer a foe's religious views are to the user's, the less harm can be done by touch (NCN)
People with law/order/justice based MythPowers are immune to this ability

name: Needy Zombie
description: They won't eat your brains, but they won't leave you alone. Summon zombies who really need a friend then have them swarm your enemy.
summary: The ability to summon emotionally insecure zombies
strengths: Typical Zombie powers
weaknesses: If you don't leave the area, they may want to be your friend

name: Myth Power: Phthonos' Theory
description: Phthonos (Phthonus), in Greek myth, was the god of jealousy, envy and resentment, especially in matters of love. As such, channeling him allows one to perceive the thoughts, emotions, actions and locations of enemies and loved ones (relatives/friend/allies) at will. In addition, one can perceive, communicate with, share senses with and compel those who are naturally envious, jealous and possessive. One may even mimic the superhuman abilities/skills/capabilities of rivals when in radius of them.
summary: The ability to channel Phthonos' command over the essence of jealousy, envy and resentment
strengths: Perceive the thoughts, emotions, actions and locations of loved ones and enemies at will
Perceive, communicate with, share senses with and compel the envious, jealous and possessive
Mimic the powers and skills of rivals at will
weaknesses: Mimicry of powers/abilities/skills/talents lasts only an hour after leaving rival's presence (NCN)
People with MythPower: Nike's Knowledge and MythPower: Zeus' Zenith are immune to this ability
People with MythPower: Nemesis Indignation and MythPower: Aphrodisia are immune to this ability

name: Telephone Telepathy
description: People hear you all the time where ever you are in a kind of telepathic transmission. Even people on the other side of the world can hear you.
summary: The ability to be heard all of the time by everyone
strengths: Your Girlfriend won't need to be jealous
People will know you are alive
Everybody can be your alibi if you would be accused for a crime
weaknesses: No personal integrity
The world will hear you when you're sick
Sometimes it can be embarrasing

name: Myth Power: Chloris' Claim
description: Chloris (Khloris), in Greek myth, was the goddess of flowers. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically manipulate flowers and flowering plants, at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel subjects wearing flowers or flower patterns, at will. One can also mimic the powers of flowering plants (photosynthesis, producing roots, thorns, leaves, flower-based pheromones and toxins, etc) at will. One even gains favor with (thus, total immunity to) the winds.
summary: The ability to channel Chloris' command over the essence of flowers
strengths: Psychically manipulate flowers/flower plants; perceive, communicate with and compel flower-wearers
Psychically mimic the abilities of flowers (roses, belladonna, wolfsbane, nightshade, etc), at will
Gain favor with (immunity to the negative effects of) the winds
weaknesses: Cannot use flower-blooms as two-way communications systems or viewing portals, until developed (NCN)
Until developed, may cause one's breath to produce fragrant flower petals
MythPower: Demeter's Touch, Persephone's Poise and Gaia's Gift provide immunity (NCN)

name: Fwoosh
description: Have you ever been doing something and you just thought, 'How much funner would this be if I could make a Fwoosh sound while I did it? ' Well, with this power, you can make a Fwoosh sound whenever you do anything, without faking it. You can Fwoosh when you do paperwork, when you eat, even when you slap someone.
summary: The ability to make the ultimate Fwoosh sound effect.
strengths: Make a Fwoosh sound effect at will.
weaknesses: None.

name: Bigfoot Control
description: With this power you have complete control of the elusive cryptid, Bigfoot
summary: The ability to control Bigfoot
strengths: You can make him fight for you
You can bring him in for show and tell
You can use him to reach things for you that are in high places
weaknesses: He might not be near you when using this power so it will take awhile for him to get to you

name: Myth Power: Muses' Message5
description: The Muses (Mousai, Mousae, Musae), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of knowledge, sciences, the arts and inspiration. As such, channeling Melpomene (Tragedy) allows one to psychically access knowledge of all tragic works, at will. In addition, one can psychically travel into any tragic story world, at will. One can also psychically summon objects and characters from tragic story worlds, at will. One can even psychically drain happiness, by touch, and psychically compel 'sad' subjects, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Muses' command over the essence of knowledge, inspiration and art
strengths: Psychically access knowledge of tragic works, at will
Psychically travel into (and summon objects/characters from) tragic story worlds, at will
Psychically drain happiness, by touch, and compel 'sad' subjects, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically disrupt creativity (or negate ideas), by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive subject's ideas until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Apollo's Gift may cause bossy attitude toward the user (NCN)

name: Snap You're A Salt Pillar
description: With this power you can turn people into pillars of salt just by snapping, saying the persons name and the word salt. Keep in mind that you cannot turn people back into people once they become salt and the salt is edible.
summary: The ability to turn people into pillars of salt by snapping
strengths: You can turn your enemies into salt
It's edible salt
weaknesses: You can't turn them back into people
Too much salt is not good for you

name: The Superpower List Mind
description: This ability is really just limited Psychic Internet Access. You can do everything on the List you could with a computer but in your head! Read and compare superpowers! Add them faster than ever before! Also, you'll be able to sense when a new power is posted and what powers are up for grabs!
summary: The ability to have a mental link with the superpowerlist.com.
strengths: Knowing when a new power is posted.
Know which powers have the Get This Power button.
You'll never need a computer for this website again.
weaknesses: Nothing. It's the Superpower List!

name: Nap Kinesis
description: You have the ability to fold napkins using your mind alone! This works on both paper and cloth napkins.
summary: The ability to fold napkins with your mind!
strengths: You are free from folding napkins with your hands forever!
You can remotely fold napkins for others!
You can overcome unpleasant dining incidents with your mind alone!
weaknesses: Your napkin-folding muscles may become weak.
While you're busy folding napkins with your mind, you may neglect saving the Earth, etc.
You still spill soup.

description: With this people you can make people think they are living in the 1700s. This also makes them act, talk and dress as if they were living in the 1700s so they won't be able to use technology and will probably think you're some sort of witch if you use it. You can make as many people as you want think they're in the 1700s and you can reverse it too.
summary: The ability to make people think that they are living in the 1700s
strengths: You can make people think they're living in the 1700s so they can't use any modern technology
You can reverse the effects of this power
weaknesses: They could still kill you with swords and stuff

name: Condition Change: Sleep
description: By touching another superpowered being you make one of their powers work only when they are sleeping. It does not matter whether the being is friend or foe, this power works automatically.
summary: The ability to make a power work only when the user is asleep
strengths: The other being cannot use their power consciously anymore! Muhahahaha!!!
This power works automatically. May be pro or con.
weaknesses: Lucid dreamers...
Have to touch them and it affects friends as well as foes.

name: Campbell's Blessing
description: With a single thought you can shoot soup from your wrists. Much like Spiderman's web shooting powers, only much less useful. Then again, if you're hungry all you have to do is grab a bowl and you're set.
summary: The ability to shoot soup from your wrists
strengths: Burn enemies with steaming hot soup
You'll never be hungry again
You could solve world hunger... I guess
weaknesses: It might be too hot
Some people just don't like soup
Enemies probably won't die from over exposure to soup

name: Crossdresser
description: If a man with this ability puts on women's clothing he can transform partially to look like a woman, also he will be able to make men do almost anything he wants them to do. If as women puts on man's clothing she can change herself as well and control any woman with varying degrees.
summary: The ability to gain powers of persuation and transforming (limited) by crossdressing.
strengths: Useful for disguise and getting information. You can go places who wouldnt be allowed in.
You can control people and make them do nearly anything you want them to do.
You'll be able to understand the opposite sex.
weaknesses: Str8 Men who over use this power will physically change sex but their mind will remain male, forever
Only men will want you once you've over used this power. Women will no longer want you ever
If you've been changed into a woman, your male strengths will be lost. You'll be a normal woman.

name: Puddingkinesis
description: It's pretty simple. You can control pudding with your mind. However, if there are bananas in the banana pudding, you can not control the bananas.
summary: The ability to control pudding with your mind.
strengths: Control pudding.
weaknesses: Control pudding.

name: Myth Power: Dysaules' Design
description: Dysaules (Rharus, Rharos, Rarus, Raros), in Greek myth, was the god of plowing, and the sacred field of the Eleusinian Mysteries. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically trace trenches in the ground, impassible by anyone except the user and chosen subjects. In addition, one can attune to trenches dug by this ability, at will, and travel along them with superhuman power. One can even 'bless' the ground, at will, which keeps it from being manipulated by anyone except self and allies.
summary: The ability to channel Dysaules' command over the essence of plowing and the Eleusinian Mysteries' sacred field
strengths: Psychically trace ("plow") trenches in the ground, at will; trenches are impassible by foes
Travel along trenches dug by this ability, with superhuman strength/power and speed
'Bless' ground, which protects it from manipulation by anyone other than self/allies
weaknesses: Cannot psychically teleport from one 'blessed' patch of ground to another, until developed (NCN)
'Blessed' ground does accelerate plant growth, or enhance divine powers, until developed (NCN)
Agricultural/economic/cooking/food-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Misery Loves Company :(
description: Anyone within a 5 foot radius of you will turn that upside down frown back to a frown. You release an empathic psychic aura of pain & suffering to all & even those annoying perky happy all the time zen people. They become mopey & down as all of their fears, sadness & emo pain is amplified & flooding. Meanwhile you draw & absorb their positive optimistic happy energy. You're an emotional craving vampire leech.
summary: The ability to make everyone around you depressed & sad
strengths: Make everyone feel crappy while you feel upbeat :D
Especially making those way to perky happy contempt people feel like gutter trash
weaknesses: Only can affect people in your 5 ft radius
Everyone around you is sad & gloomy

name: Bettering Michael Bay Films
description: Have you ever thought "man transformers bombed! " Well now you have the ability to make that or any michael bay movie so good, it would be as if he never even came near the set of a movie.
summary: The ability to make any michael bay film you watch really good.
strengths: You wont regret watching his movies anymore
weaknesses: Nothing bad to that really.

name: Emotional Response Detection
